[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse|child|parent|sibling|grandchild|domestic_partner|trust|estate|charity|employer|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Model Regulation; AML/BSA FinCEN; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or triggering life event that prompted the beneficiary designation change. Used for actuarial experience studies, compliance monitoring, and customer lifecycle analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_policy|marriage|divorce|death_of_beneficiary|birth_of_child|court_order|owner_request|policy_assignment|adoption|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: contingent_condition
attributes.description: Free-text description of any special conditions or contingencies attached to this beneficiary designation (e.g., 'if beneficiary survives insured by 30 days', 'subject to divorce decree dated MM/DD/YYYY'). Supports complex designation structures and court-ordered conditions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Probate Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this beneficiary designation record was first created in the data platform. Represents the audit record creation time in the silver layer, distinct from the business effective date and the received date. Required for SOX audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: designation_method
attributes.description: The channel or legal instrument through which the beneficiary designation was submitted. 'paper_form' is a wet-ink signed ACORD or proprietary form; 'e_signature' is a digitally signed electronic form; 'court_order' is a legally mandated designation (e.g., divorce decree, QDRO); 'will_reference' designates the estate; 'online_portal' is a self-service digital submission; 'phone_request' is a voice-recorded request. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: paper_form|e_signature|court_order|will_reference|online_portal|phone_request — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; ESIGN Act; UETA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: designation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned by the Policy Administration System (e.g., Sapiens LifePro, FAST) to uniquely reference this designation transaction. Used in correspondence, audit trails, and claims adjudication workflows.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: designation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this designation transaction. 'pending' indicates the form has been received but not yet processed; 'active' indicates the designation is in force; 'superseded' indicates a newer designation has replaced this one; 'revoked' indicates the owner formally withdrew the designation; 'rejected' indicates the form was rejected (e.g., NIGO); 'cancelled' indicates administrative cancellation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: designation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the beneficiary's priority tier and revocability. 'primary' beneficiaries receive proceeds first; 'contingent' receive proceeds if all primary beneficiaries predecease the insured; 'tertiary' is a third-tier designation; 'irrevocable' designations cannot be changed without the beneficiary's written consent; 'revocable' designations may be changed by the owner at any time.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this beneficiary designation becomes legally binding and in force on the policy. Typically the date the completed, good-order form is received and accepted by the insurer. Critical for claims adjudication to determine which designation was active at the time of the insured event.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: guardian_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the court-appointed or designated guardian or custodian for a minor beneficiary. Required when minor_beneficiary_flag is True to ensure proceeds can be legally disbursed. Populated only for minor beneficiaries.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; UTMA/UGMA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: is_irrevocable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this beneficiary designation is irrevocable, meaning the policy owner cannot change or remove the beneficiary without the beneficiary's written consent. Irrevocable designations are common in divorce settlements, ILIT structures, and collateral assignments. Drives policy servicing workflow restrictions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Insurance Law; ILIT (Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust) Standards

attributes.name: is_nigo
attributes.description: Flags whether the beneficiary designation form was received in a Not In Good Order (NIGO) condition — i.e., missing required information, unsigned, or otherwise deficient. NIGO forms require follow-up with the policy owner before the designation can be processed and made effective.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro; FAST)

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction governing this beneficiary designation, typically the state where the policy was issued or the insured resides. Determines applicable state insurance law requirements for designation validity, notarization, and beneficiary rights.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation; ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: minor_beneficiary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designated beneficiary is a minor (under age 18 or applicable state age of majority). Minor beneficiaries require a guardian or custodian to receive proceeds, triggering special claims payment workflows and UTMA/UGMA account considerations.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; UTMA/UGMA; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: nigo_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the specific deficiency that caused the designation form to be flagged as NIGO. Examples include missing beneficiary SSN/TIN, missing owner signature, illegible form, or missing notarization. Populated only when is_nigo is True.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: nigo_resolved_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Not In Good Order (NIGO) Resolved Date
attributes.description: The date on which all NIGO deficiencies were remediated and the designation form was accepted as complete and in good order. Null if the form has not yet been resolved or was not NIGO. Used to measure NIGO resolution cycle time for operational reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: notarization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the beneficiary designation form was notarized, if notarization was required. Null if notarization was not required or has not yet been completed. Used to validate the legal completeness of the designation.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: notarization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the designation form required notarization under applicable state law, policy contract terms, or court order. Notarization is commonly required for irrevocable designations and court-ordered changes.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: prior_beneficiary_snapshot
attributes.description: A serialized summary of the beneficiary designation(s) that were in force immediately before this designation change was processed. Stored as a structured text snapshot (e.g., JSON-encoded summary) to support audit trail requirements and claims adjudication without requiring a full historical join. Captures prior beneficiary name, type, allocation percentage, and effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; SOX Section 404; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: processed_date
attributes.description: The date the designation change was fully processed and recorded in the Policy Administration System. Represents the completion of the administrative workflow, distinct from the received date and the effective date.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the beneficiary designation form or request was physically or electronically received by the insurer or its TPA. May differ from effective_date if the form required NIGO remediation or administrative processing time.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or administrative comments entered by the processing representative regarding this beneficiary designation event. Examples include notes on court order interpretation, special payment instructions, or follow-up actions required.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Policy Administration System (Sapiens LifePro; FAST)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this designation record originated. attributes.name: stoli_review_flag

STOLI arrangements involve designating a stranger or investor as beneficiary to circumvent insurable interest requirements. Flagged designations require compliance review and may result in policy rescission.

attributes.name: superseded_date

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: witness_required

products.name: party
products.description: Supertype master record representing any individual or legal entity that participates in the policyholder domain in any role (insured, owner, annuitant, beneficiary, guardian, attorney-in-fact, trustee, group sponsor). Stores core identity attributes shared across all roles: legal name, DOB (individuals), gender, SSN/TIN/EIN, citizenship, residency status, party type (individual, trust, corporation, association), and party status (active, deceased, incapacitated, sanctioned). For trust/legal entity parties: trust type (ILIT, revocable living trust, CRT, corporate entity), trustee names, grantor information, establishment date, state of formation, and termination provisions. Maintains identity credentials (SSN, TIN, EIN, passport, drivers license, state ID, ITIN, foreign tax IDs) with issuing authority, issue/expiry dates, document type, and masked/tokenized values for PII compliance. Tracks full party status history as embedded audit trail: prior status, new status, effective date, reason code, source system, and triggering analyst/process — covering transitions through active, deceased, incapacitated, legally incompetent, minor, expatriate, sanctioned/OFAC, and fraud-flagged states. All role-specific records (insured, contract_owner, annuitant, beneficiary) reference this party record via FK. SSOT for the unique person/entity identity — enabling de-duplication across roles where the same individual serves as both insured and owner. Supports IRS TIN matching, FATCA/CRS foreign account reporting, OFAC screening, HIPAA-compliant identity management, and ACORD Party model alignment.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the party record. Primary key. Serves as the single source of truth for any individual or legal entity participating in the policyholder domain across all roles (insured, owner, annuitant, beneficiary, trustee, etc.).

attributes.name: guardian_party_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on party (guardian_party_id)

attributes.name: aml_risk_rating
attributes.description: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) risk classification for the party based on customer due diligence (CDD) assessment. Low indicates standard risk. Medium indicates elevated risk requiring enhanced monitoring. High indicates significant risk requiring enhanced due diligence (EDD). Prohibited indicates party cannot be onboarded due to AML concerns.
attributes.references: FinCEN CDD Rule, Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: citizenship_country
attributes.description: Country of citizenship for the party. Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). For individuals with dual citizenship, primary citizenship for tax and regulatory purposes. Used for FATCA/CRS reporting, OFAC screening, and foreign national underwriting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Birth date of the individual party. Null for non-individual party types. Critical for age-based underwriting, mortality calculations, annuity payout schedules, Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) calculations, and identity verification. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B (RMD), NAIC Model Regulation, ACORD Party Model

attributes.name: deceased_date
attributes.description: Date of death for the party. Populated when party_status transitions to deceased. Triggers death benefit processing, annuity death benefit calculations, and beneficiary claim adjudication. Null for living parties. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, Death Benefit Processing Standards

attributes.name: deceased_verified_date
attributes.description: Date the party death was officially verified through death certificate, Social Security Death Master File (DMF), or other authoritative source. Used for death benefit claim processing and audit trail. Null for living parties. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: Social Security Death Master File (DMF), NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: entity_formation_date
attributes.description: Date the legal entity (corporation, partnership, association) was formed or registered with the state. Null for individual and trust party types. Used for entity age verification and legal entity validation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: entity_state_of_formation
attributes.description: U.S. state or jurisdiction where the legal entity (trust, corporation, partnership) was formed or registered. Two-letter state code. Null for individual party types. Determines governing law, regulatory jurisdiction, and legal entity validation.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the individual party. Null for non-individual party types (trust, corporation, etc.). Used for personalized communications and identity verification.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the individual party. Null for non-individual party types. Used for mortality table selection, underwriting risk classification, and actuarial valuation. Non_binary and unknown options support inclusive data capture and regulatory compliance in jurisdictions requiring gender diversity recognition.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, SOA Mortality Tables

attributes.name: grantor_name
attributes.description: Name of the grantor (settlor) who established the trust. Populated only when party_type is trust. Used for grantor trust tax rules, insurable interest verification, and estate planning documentation.

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current status of Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification for the party. Verified indicates successful identity verification. Pending indicates verification in progress. Failed indicates verification failure requiring manual review. Expired indicates verification has lapsed and requires renewal. Exempt indicates party is exempt from KYC (e.g., institutional entities).
attributes.references: USA PATRIOT Act Section 326, FinCEN CDD Rule, NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date the party successfully completed KYC identity verification. Used for KYC expiration tracking and periodic re-verification scheduling per AML program requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: USA PATRIOT Act Section 326, FinCEN CDD Rule

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Surname or family name of the individual party. Null for non-individual party types. Primary sorting and indexing field for individual parties.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the party as it appears on government-issued identification or legal formation documents. For individuals: full name including middle name/initial. For entities: registered legal name as filed with state or jurisdiction of formation. Used for policy issuance, tax reporting (1099, 1042-S), and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1179, NAIC Model Regulation, ACORD Party Model

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or middle initial of the individual party. Null for non-individual party types. Supports full name matching for identity verification and MIB (Medical Information Bureau) checks.
attributes.references: ACORD Party Model, MIB Group Standards

attributes.name: ofac_last_screened_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Last Screened Date
attributes.description: Date the party was last screened against OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list and other sanctions lists. Used for periodic re-screening scheduling per AML program requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: ofac_screening_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Screening Status
attributes.description: Status of Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctions screening for the party. Clear indicates no match to OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list. Match indicates potential match requiring investigation. Pending_review indicates match under investigation. Blocked indicates confirmed OFAC match prohibiting business relationship.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Programs, USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: party_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the party. Human-readable reference number used in correspondence, customer service, and external communications.

attributes.name: party_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the party. Active indicates normal operational state. Deceased triggers death benefit processing. Incapacitated may require guardian or power of attorney. Sanctioned indicates OFAC or regulatory restriction. Fraud_flagged indicates suspected fraudulent activity requiring investigation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, OFAC Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the party entity. Distinguishes between natural persons (individual) and legal entities (trust, corporation, partnership, association, estate). Drives downstream processing rules for identity verification, tax reporting, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: pep_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party is a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) - an individual who holds or has held a prominent public position (government official, senior executive of state-owned enterprise, etc.). True indicates PEP status requiring enhanced due diligence (EDD). False indicates non-PEP status.

attributes.name: residency_country
attributes.description: Country of tax residency for the party. Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Determines tax reporting obligations, withholding requirements, and regulatory jurisdiction. May differ from citizenship_country for expatriates and foreign residents.

attributes.name: residency_state
attributes.description: U.S. state or territory of primary residence for the party. Two-letter state code (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Determines state insurance department jurisdiction, premium tax situs, and state-specific regulatory requirements. Null for non-U.S. residents.

attributes.name: sar_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) has been filed for this party with FinCEN. True indicates SAR filing history requiring ongoing monitoring. False indicates no SAR filing history. SAR details are maintained in separate secure system per regulatory confidentiality requirements.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), FinCEN SAR Filing Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: source_system_party_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the party in the source operational system. Used for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracking, and bidirectional synchronization between lakehouse and operational systems.

attributes.name: ssn
attributes.description: Social Security Number for U.S. individual parties. Masked or tokenized in storage per PII compliance requirements. Used for tax reporting (1099-R, 1042-S), IRS TIN matching, and identity verification. Null for non-U.S. parties or entities using EIN/TIN.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1179, IRC Section 6109, HIPAA Privacy Rule

attributes.name: stoli_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has been flagged for potential Stranger-Originated Life Insurance (STOLI) or investor-owned life insurance activity. True indicates STOLI concern requiring enhanced underwriting review and insurable interest verification. False indicates no STOLI concern.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act on STOLI, State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: Generational or professional suffix appended to the individual party name (e.g., Jr., Sr., II, III, MD, Esq.). Null for non-individual party types. attributes.name: tin

attributes.name: tin_certification_status

domains.name: policy
domains.description: Core life insurance and annuity policy administration governing the full lifecycle from NB issuance through endorsements, riders (ADB, AWL, CAR, LTC), policy servicing, reinstatements, surrenders, and lapses. Owns policy status, face amount, death benefit (DB), policy values (CSV, AV), MEC/GPT/IRC 7702 compliance flags, and all policy-level master data. SSOT for all in-force contract records.

products.name: in_force_policy
products.description: Core master record and SSOT for every life insurance and annuity contract administered in the Policy Administration System. Stores policy number (unique business key), product type (WL, UL, IUL, VUL, YRT, FIA, SPIA, MYGA, DIA), issue date, effective date, policy status (active, lapsed, surrendered, matured, death claim, free-look, grace period, pending, rescinded, converted), face amount, death benefit (DB) type (Option A/B/C) and amount, issue age, risk class (preferred plus, preferred, standard, substandard with table rating), underwriting class, modal premium, policy currency, jurisdiction state, IRC 7702 compliance flag, MEC status flag, GPT/CVAT election, tax qualification status (qualified, non-qualified), policy form number, ACORD product code, reinsurance cession flag, and system-of-record identifiers. Links to policyholder domain for insured/owner/annuitant party references. All other policy domain entities reference this master record.

attributes.name: account_value
attributes.description: The current accumulated value in the policy account, representing premiums paid plus interest credited minus cost of insurance and expense charges. Applicable to universal life and annuity products.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this policy record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: csv_amount
attributes.description: The amount the policy owner would receive if the policy were surrendered today, net of surrender charges and policy loans. This is the guaranteed minimum non-forfeiture value.

attributes.name: death_benefit_amount
attributes.description: The current total death benefit payable upon death of the insured, including face amount plus any accumulated account value, riders, and adjustments. This is the actual amount payable to beneficiaries.

attributes.name: death_benefit_option
attributes.description: The death benefit structure elected by the policy owner. OPTION_A=level death benefit equal to face amount, OPTION_B=face amount plus account value, OPTION_C=increasing death benefit corridor, ROP=return of premium.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date coverage begins under the policy contract. May differ from issue date due to backdating or delayed effective date elections.

attributes.name: face_amount
attributes.description: The base death benefit amount stated on the policy face page, before any adjustments for riders, policy loans, or accumulated value. Also known as sum insured or coverage amount.

attributes.name: gpt_cvat_election
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guideline Premium Test (GPT) or Cash Value Accumulation Test (CVAT) Election
attributes.description: The IRC Section 7702 test elected at policy issue to determine life insurance qualification. GPT=Guideline Premium Test with guideline single and level premium limits, CVAT=Cash Value Accumulation Test with cash value corridor requirements.

attributes.name: insured_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party whose life is insured under this policy contract. Links to the policyholder domain party master.

attributes.name: irc_7702_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 7702 Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy meets IRC Section 7702 definition of life insurance for federal tax purposes. True=compliant and death benefit is tax-free, False=non-compliant and may lose tax advantages.

attributes.name: issue_age
attributes.description: The age of the insured at the time the policy was issued, calculated using the insurance age method (age nearest birthday or age last birthday per company practice). Used for premium rating and underwriting class assignment.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Illustrations Model Regulation

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date the policy was officially issued and became a binding contract. This is the principal business event timestamp for the policy lifecycle.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code where the policy was issued and is subject to regulatory oversight. Determines applicable insurance laws and regulations.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this policy record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking and incremental processing.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The date the policy contract reaches maturity and the death benefit becomes payable as an endowment. Nullable for term policies and annuities without fixed maturity.

attributes.name: mec_status_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy has been classified as a Modified Endowment Contract under IRC Section 7702A due to premium payments exceeding the 7-pay test. True=MEC status, distributions subject to LIFO tax treatment and 10% penalty.

attributes.name: modal_premium
attributes.description: The scheduled premium amount due per billing mode (monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual). Does not include additional premium payments or adjustments.

attributes.name: paid_to_date
attributes.description: The date through which premiums have been paid and coverage is guaranteed. Used to determine grace period expiration and lapse date.

attributes.name: policy_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all policy values, premiums, and benefits are denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: policy_loan_balance
attributes.description: The current outstanding principal balance of all policy loans taken against the cash value. Reduces the death benefit and cash surrender value. Null or zero if no loans outstanding.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier assigned to the policy contract at issuance. This is the externally-known policy number used across all customer communications, billing statements, and claims processing.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy contract. ACTIVE=in-force and premium-paying, LAPSED=terminated due to non-payment, SURRENDERED=voluntarily terminated by owner, MATURED=reached maturity date, DEATH_CLAIM=claim filed on insured death, FREE_LOOK=within free-look cancellation period, GRACE_PERIOD=premium overdue but within grace period. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ACTIVE|LAPSED|SURRENDERED|MATURED|DEATH_CLAIM|FREE_LOOK|GRACE_PERIOD — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: premium_mode
attributes.description: The frequency at which premiums are scheduled to be paid. SINGLE indicates a single premium paid at issue with no recurring payments.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance product. WL=Whole Life, UL=Universal Life, IUL=Indexed Universal Life, VUL=Variable Universal Life, YRT=Yearly Renewable Term, TERM=Term Life, FIA=Fixed Indexed Annuity, SPIA=Single Premium Immediate Annuity, MYGA=Multi-Year Guaranteed Annuity, DIA=Deferred Income Annuity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|YRT|TERM|FIA|SPIA|MYGA|DIA|VARIABLE_ANNUITY — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any portion of the policy risk has been ceded to a reinsurer under a reinsurance treaty. True=reinsurance in place, False=100% retained risk.

attributes.name: table_rating
attributes.description: Additional mortality rating applied to substandard risks, expressed as a letter (A-P) or numeric percentage (e.g., 150 for 150% of standard mortality). Null for standard and preferred risks.

attributes.name: tax_qualification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy is held within a tax-qualified retirement plan. QUALIFIED=held in employer-sponsored or individual retirement account, NON_QUALIFIED=personal after-tax policy. Specific plan types include IRA, Roth IRA, 401(k), 403(b), 457, TSP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: QUALIFIED|NON_QUALIFIED|IRA|ROTH_IRA|401K|403B|457|TSP — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date the policy contract was terminated, lapsed, surrendered, or otherwise ceased to be in force. Null for active policies.

Updated on each premium posting, withdrawal, loan, or monthly deduction cycle. Critical for ALM, actuarial reserving, and policyholder self-service.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy value record. Primary key for the policy value snapshot.

Daily policy valuation, statutory reserve cal

attributes.name: unit_value_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.unit_value. Business justification: Variable policy account value (av_amount), interest_credited_amount, and index_credit_amount are computed directly from unit values. Daily policy valuation processing, policyholder statements, and FIN

attributes.name: valuation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.valuation. Business justification: Variable product policy values are calculated by applying investment valuations (unit values) from separate accounts. Links policy accounting to investment accounting for daily unit value application,

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the actuarial valuation run that produced these policy values. Links to the actuarial valuation system for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: accumulated_premium_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative sum of all premiums paid into the policy from inception through the valuation date. Used for MEC testing and tax compliance.

attributes.name: admin_fee_amount
attributes.description: The administrative or policy fee deducted from the account value during the most recent billing cycle prior to the valuation date.
attributes.references: Universal Life Policy Provisions, NAIC Model Regulation 830

attributes.name: av_amount
attributes.description: The gross account value of the policy before any surrender charges or loan deductions. Represents accumulated premiums plus interest credits less cost of insurance and fees.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: coi_charge_amount
attributes.description: The cost of insurance charge deducted from the account value during the most recent billing cycle prior to the valuation date.
attributes.references: Universal Life Policy Provisions, NAIC Model Regulation 830

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this policy value record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: csv_amount
attributes.description: The cash surrender value available to the policyholder if the policy is surrendered on the valuation date. Represents account value less surrender charges and outstanding loans.

attributes.name: cvat_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cash Value Accumulation Test (CVAT) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy is in compliance with the Cash Value Accumulation Test under IRC Section 7702. True if compliant, False if failed. Alternative to GPT for tax qualification.

attributes.name: dac_balance_amount
attributes.description: The unamortized deferred acquisition cost balance allocated to this policy as of the valuation date. Represents capitalized sales and underwriting expenses under GAAP.

attributes.name: death_benefit_amount
attributes.description: The total death benefit payable to beneficiaries if the insured dies on the valuation date. Includes base face amount plus any riders and accumulated values per policy design.

attributes.name: dividend_accumulation_balance
attributes.description: The balance of policyholder dividends left on deposit with the insurer, earning interest. Available for withdrawal or to pay premiums.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, Participating Policy Provisions

attributes.name: fund_allocation_total
attributes.description: The total value of all sub-account or fund allocations for variable or indexed products. Should reconcile to account value for variable universal life (VUL) policies.
attributes.references: Variable Life Policy Provisions, SEC Form N-4/N-6

attributes.name: gpt_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy is in compliance with the Guideline Premium Test under IRC Section 7702. True if compliant, False if failed. Critical for tax-qualified life insurance status.

attributes.name: guaranteed_minimum_value
attributes.description: The guaranteed minimum cash value or account value as of the valuation date, per policy guarantees. Cannot fall below this floor regardless of performance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830, Policy Contract Guarantees

attributes.name: index_credit_amount
attributes.description: The index-linked interest credit applied to indexed universal life (IUL) or fixed indexed annuity (FIA) accounts during the most recent crediting cycle.
attributes.references: IUL/FIA Policy Provisions, NAIC Indexed Product Guidance

attributes.name: interest_credited_amount
attributes.description: The interest credited to the account value during the most recent crediting cycle prior to the valuation date. May include guaranteed and excess interest.
attributes.references: Universal Life Policy Provisions, NAIC Model Regulation 830

attributes.name: last_premium_payment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent premium payment received prior to or on the valuation date. Used for lapse monitoring and grace period calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Policy Provisions, State Insurance Codes

attributes.name: loan_balance_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding principal balance of all policy loans as of the valuation date. Reduces cash surrender value and may affect death benefit.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702, NAIC Model Policy Loan Regulation

attributes.name: loan_interest_accrued_amount
attributes.description: The accrued but unpaid interest on outstanding policy loans as of the valuation date. Typically capitalized into loan balance if unpaid.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Policy Loan Regulation, State Insurance Codes

attributes.name: mec_status_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy has been classified as a Modified Endowment Contract under IRC Section 7702A. True if MEC, False if not. Affects tax treatment of withdrawals.

attributes.name: nar_amount
attributes.description: The net amount at risk to the insurer, calculated as death benefit minus account value. Critical for risk-based capital calculations and reinsurance cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Instructions, Valuation Manual VM-20

attributes.name: next_billing_date
attributes.description: The next scheduled date on which premium is due or policy charges will be deducted. Critical for billing system integration and lapse prevention.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System Business Rules, NAIC Model Provisions

attributes.name: paid_up_additions_value
attributes.description: The accumulated value of paid-up additional insurance purchased with dividends or excess premiums. Increases both cash value and death benefit.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, Whole Life Policy Provisions

attributes.name: policy_anniversary_date
attributes.description: The annual anniversary date of the policy, used for age changes, rate adjustments, and anniversary-based policy actions.
attributes.references: Policy Contract Terms, NAIC Model Policy Provisions

attributes.name: premium_load_amount
attributes.description: The sales load or premium charge deducted from premiums received during the most recent billing cycle. Represents acquisition cost recovery.
attributes.references: Universal Life Policy Provisions, FASB ASC 944 (DAC)

attributes.name: premium_ytd_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of premiums received during the current calendar year through the valuation date. Used for MEC testing and premium tracking.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702A, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: The actuarial reserve held by the insurer for this policy as of the valuation date. Calculated per statutory or GAAP requirements depending on valuation basis.
attributes.references: NAIC Valuation Manual VM-20, FASB ASC 944, IFRS 17

attributes.name: rider_charge_amount
attributes.description: The total charges for all active policy riders (ADB, AWL, LTC, etc.) deducted during the most recent billing cycle prior to the valuation date.
attributes.references: Policy Rider Provisions, NAIC Model Regulation 830

attributes.name: surrender_charge_amount
attributes.description: The surrender charge that would be assessed if the policy is surrendered on the valuation date. Typically declines over time per the policy schedule.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830, State Insurance Codes

attributes.name: surrender_charge_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the surrender charge period expires and no further surrender charges will be assessed. Null if surrender charges have already expired.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830, Policy Contract Terms

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this policy value record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: valuation_basis_code
attributes.description: The accounting or regulatory basis under which these policy values were calculated. STAT=Statutory (SAP), GAAP=US GAAP, IFRS=IFRS 17, TAX=Tax basis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, IFRS 17, NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for which all policy values in this record are calculated. Critical for point-in-time financial reporting and actuarial analysis.

attributes.name: withdrawal_ytd_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of partial withdrawals taken from the policy during the current calendar year through the valuation date. Used for tax reporting and withdrawal limit tracking.

products.name: rider
products.description: Master record for every rider attached to a base policy. Covers all rider types: ADB (Accidental Death Benefit), AWL (Automatic Waiver of Premium), CAR (Company Action Rider), LTC (Long-Term Care), GMDB, GMIB, GMWB, GMAB, DI (Disability Income), child term, spouse term, and return-of-premium riders. Stores rider code, rider description, rider face amount, rider premium, rider effective date, rider expiry date, rider status, benefit trigger conditions, elimination period, benefit period, and ACORD rider form number. One policy may have multiple riders.

attributes.name: rider_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the rider record. Primary key.

attributes.name: mortality_table_id

attributes.name: policy_form_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy_form_approval. Business justification: Riders must be issued on DOI-approved forms, just like base policies. Market conduct exams review whether riders were issued on approved forms in each jurisdiction. acord_form_number on policy_rider i

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Variable riders (GMDB, GMWB, GMIB) reference separate account portfolios for benefit base calculations, guaranteed benefit valuations, hedge effectiveness testing, and actuarial reserve calculations.

attributes.name: pricing_basis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.pricing_basis. Business justification: Riders (LTC, ADB, waiver of premium, term) have distinct pricing bases with separate COI rates, benefit pricing, and expense loadings. Actuarial pricing and rider reserve calculations require the ride

attributes.name: primary_policy_in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the base policy contract to which this rider is attached. A policy may have multiple riders.

attributes.name: rider_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.rider_definition. Business justification: Riders on in-force policies must reference their product definition (rider_definition) for benefit structure, premium rates, underwriting class rules, form numbers, and compliance parameters. Essentia

attributes.name: risk_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.risk_class. Business justification: Riders (waiver of premium, LTC, disability income) carry their own underwriting risk classification separate from the base policy. The policy_rider has a denormalized `underwriting_class` text column.

attributes.name: separate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.separate_account. Business justification: Variable riders (GMDB, GMWB, GMIB) calculate charges and guarantee bases against the separate account's NAV. Rider reserve calculations, hedge effectiveness testing, and NAIC AG43/VM-21 reserve report

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.service_request. Business justification: Rider additions, modifications, and terminations are post-issue servicing transactions processed through service requests (request_type='RIDER_ADD', 'RIDER_TERMINATE', 'RIDER_MODIFY'). The service_req

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which this rider is ceded. Null if rider is not reinsured.

attributes.name: underwriting_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.underwriting_class. Business justification: Riders (DI, LTC) carry independent underwriting classes separate from the base policy. Linking policy_rider to underwriting_class enables rider-specific experience studies, independent reinsurance ces

attributes.name: attained_age
attributes.description: The current age of the insured. Used for age-based premium adjustments and benefit calculations. Expressed in years.

attributes.name: benefit_period_months
attributes.description: The maximum duration (in months) for which benefits will be paid once triggered. Common for disability income and long-term care riders. Null if benefit is a lump sum or lifetime benefit.

attributes.name: benefit_trigger_condition
attributes.description: The specific condition or event that must occur for the rider benefit to be payable. Examples: accidental death, disability, critical illness diagnosis, inability to perform ADLs (Activities of Daily Living), account value depletion, etc.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, ACORD Life and Annuity Framework

attributes.name: cash_value
attributes.description: The accumulated cash value or account value associated with this rider, if applicable. Some riders (e.g., paid-up additions riders) accumulate cash value. Null for term riders or pure protection riders. Expressed in policy currency.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, ACORD Life and Annuity Framework

attributes.name: cost_of_insurance_rate
attributes.description: The per-unit cost of insurance rate applied to the rider face amount to calculate the rider charge. Common for universal life and variable universal life riders. Expressed as a rate per thousand of coverage.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, ACORD Life and Annuity Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rider record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this specific rider coverage became effective on the policy. May differ from policy issue date if rider was added post-issue.

attributes.name: elimination_period_days
attributes.description: The waiting period (in days) from the date of a qualifying event until benefits begin to be paid. Common for disability income and long-term care riders. Zero or null if no elimination period applies.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rider coverage ends or matures. Nullable for riders with lifetime coverage or those tied to base policy duration.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, ACORD Life and Annuity Framework

attributes.name: face_amount
attributes.description: The benefit amount for this specific rider attachment. For ADB riders, this is the accidental death benefit amount. For term riders, this is the additional death benefit. Amount is specific to this policy-rider combination.

attributes.name: guaranteed_insurability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rider includes a guaranteed insurability option, allowing the policyholder to increase coverage at specified intervals without additional underwriting. True if option is included, False otherwise.

attributes.name: issue_age
attributes.description: The age of the insured at the time the rider was issued. Used for premium calculation and benefit determination. Expressed in years.

attributes.name: loan_outstanding_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding loan amount taken against this riders cash value, if loans are permitted. Expressed in policy currency. Null or zero if no loan exists.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: The premium charged for this specific rider on this policy, calculated based on rider premium_basis, insured age, risk class, and face amount. This is the actual premium for this policy-rider instance.

attributes.name: premium_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the rider premium is charged. Annual: once per year. Semi-annual: twice per year. Quarterly: four times per year. Monthly: twelve times per year. Single: one-time premium payment.

attributes.name: premium_mode
attributes.description: Pattern of premium payments over the rider term. Level: constant premium. Increasing: premium increases over time. Decreasing: premium decreases over time. Flexible: premium varies based on policyholder elections or account performance.

attributes.name: rating_percentage
attributes.description: Additional premium percentage applied for substandard underwriting risk. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 25.00 means 25% additional premium). Null or zero for standard and preferred classes.

attributes.name: reinsurance_ceded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the risk for this rider has been ceded to a reinsurer. True if reinsured, False if retained. Used for risk management and financial reporting.

attributes.name: rider_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rider. Active: rider is in force and providing coverage. Suspended: temporarily not in force. Terminated: rider has been cancelled. Lapsed: rider has lapsed due to non-payment. Pending: rider application is under review. Matured: rider has reached its maturity date.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the operational system from which this rider record originated (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle Insurance Policy Administration). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code where the rider was issued. Determines applicable state insurance regulations and tax treatment.

attributes.name: surrender_charge
attributes.description: The penalty or charge applied if the rider is surrendered or terminated early. Common for riders with cash value or guaranteed benefits. Expressed in policy currency. Null if no surrender charge applies.

attributes.name: tax_qualified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rider is part of a tax-qualified plan (e.g., 401k, IRA, 403b). True if tax-qualified, False otherwise. Affects tax treatment of premiums and benefits.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this rider coverage was terminated, either due to rider expiry age, policy termination, or voluntary removal by policy owner.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rider record was last modified in the data platform. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version or edition of the rider form. Used to track changes in rider terms, benefits, or pricing over time. Important for compliance and benefit administration.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, ACORD Life and Annuity Framework

attributes.name: waiver_of_premium_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rider includes a waiver of premium benefit, meaning rider premiums are waived if the insured becomes disabled or meets other qualifying conditions. True if waiver applies, False otherwise.

attributes.name: withdrawal_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum annual withdrawal percentage allowed under a GMWB (Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit) rider without penalty. Expressed as a percentage of the benefit base (e.g., 5.00 means 5% per year).

products.name: status_history
products.description: Immutable audit log of every policy status transition throughout the full policy lifecycle. SSOT for grace period tracking, free-look period management, and all status-driven compliance events. Records prior status, new status, transition reason code (lapse for non-payment, reinstatement, surrender, death claim, maturity, conversion, rescission, free-look cancellation, grace period expiry), effective date, processed timestamp, grace period start date, grace period end date, grace period length in days, overdue premium amount, grace period notice sent date, grace period status (active, expired, cured), lapse effective date (if grace expired without payment), free-look period start date, free-look period end date, free-look cancellation request date, free-look refund amount, free-look refund method, free-look refund disbursement date, reinstatement eligibility expiry date, and the system or user that triggered the transition. Supports regulatory reporting, lapse studies, state DOI grace period compliance (30-61 day minimums), free-look cancellation processing (10-30 day state DOI requirements), and actuarial experience analysis.

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each policy status transition record. Primary key for the policy status history audit log.

attributes.name: grace_period_id

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the policy contract that experienced this status transition. Links to the policy master record.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. attributes.name: status_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Policy status changes (lapse, termination) trigger reserve release journal entries. Finance teams reconcile reserve releases to specific lapse events for statutory reserve adequacy reporting and LDTI

attributes.name: status_notice_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Policy status changes (lapse, grace period, reinstatement eligibility) trigger mandatory regulatory notices (grace period notices, lapse notices) required by state insurance codes. Direct FK links the

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers to document special circumstances, regulatory considerations, or audit notes related to this status transition.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business-effective date when the new status became active. This is the date used for policy valuation, billing, and regulatory reporting. May differ from processed timestamp.

attributes.name: free_look_cancellation_request_date
attributes.description: Date when the policyholder requested cancellation during the free-look period. Null if no free-look cancellation occurred.

attributes.name: free_look_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the free-look period expires. Typically 10-30 days after start date per state DOI requirements. Policyholder may cancel without penalty before this date.

attributes.name: free_look_period_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the free-look period began. Typically starts on policy delivery or issue date. Null if not applicable to this transition.

attributes.name: free_look_refund_amount
attributes.description: Total amount refunded to the policyholder upon free-look cancellation. Typically includes all premiums paid minus any policy charges per state regulations.

attributes.name: free_look_refund_disbursement_date
attributes.description: Date when the free-look refund was actually disbursed to the policyholder. Null if no refund occurred.

attributes.name: free_look_refund_method
attributes.description: Method used to refund the premium during free-look cancellation. Null if no refund occurred.

attributes.name: lapse_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the policy officially lapsed due to non-payment after grace period expiry. Null if policy did not lapse.

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The policy status after this transition. Captures the to-state in the status lifecycle. attributes.name: overdue_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium amount that is overdue and triggered the grace period or lapse. Null if transition is not payment-related.

attributes.name: policy_number

attributes.name: processed_timestamp

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag

attributes.name: reinstatement_eligibility_expiry_date

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition was later reversed or corrected. True if reversed, False otherwise. Used for audit trail integrity.

attributes.name: reversal_reason

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp

attributes.name: source_transaction_code

attributes.name: source_transaction_type

attributes.name: transition_reason_code
