attributes.name: transition_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the reason for the status transition. Provides business context beyond the reason code.

attributes.name: transition_triggered_by_system
attributes.description: Name of the system that triggered the status transition. Examples: Policy Administration System, Billing System, Claims System, Underwriting Workbench, Manual Entry.

attributes.name: transition_triggered_by_user_name
attributes.description: Full name of the user who initiated the status transition. Denormalized for audit trail completeness. Null if transition was system-automated.

products.name: policy_beneficiary
products.description: Master record for all primary and contingent beneficiaries designated on a life insurance policy or annuity contract. Stores beneficiary name, relationship to insured, beneficiary type (primary, contingent, tertiary, irrevocable), designation percentage, TIN/SSN (masked), date of birth, address, effective date of designation, revocable flag, trust name (for ILIT designations), minor guardian details, and beneficiary change history reference. Owned by the policy domain as a direct contractual attribute of the policy.

attributes.name: policy_beneficiary_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy beneficiary record. Primary key for the policy beneficiary entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: designation_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Beneficiary designation changes require executed designation forms as legal documents governing death benefit distribution. Direct FK links the beneficiary record to its governing designation document

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy or annuity contract to which this beneficiary designation applies.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy servicing change request that created or modified this beneficiary designation. Links to the policy change history for audit trail purposes. Null for original designations at policy issue.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the beneficiary. Used for mailing death benefit checks, tax forms (1099-R), and beneficiary correspondence.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, or unit number. Optional field for additional address details.

attributes.name: beneficiary_type
attributes.description: Classification of the beneficiary designation indicating the order of precedence and revocability. Primary beneficiaries receive proceeds first; contingent beneficiaries receive proceeds if primary beneficiaries predecease the insured; tertiary beneficiaries are third in line; irrevocable beneficiaries cannot be changed without their consent; final beneficiaries receive any remaining proceeds.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 787 - Life Insurance Illustrations

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the beneficiary address.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the beneficiary address (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Used for international beneficiary management and tax treaty compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1, IRS Publication 515 (Withholding of Tax on Nonresident Aliens)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this beneficiary record was first created in the policy administration system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the individual beneficiary. Used for age verification, minor beneficiary identification, and Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) calculations for inherited annuities. Null for trust or entity beneficiaries.

attributes.name: designation_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount designated to this beneficiary, used when the beneficiary receives a specific amount rather than a percentage. Null if percentage-based designation is used.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: designation_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this beneficiary designation became effective. Corresponds to the policy issue date for original designations or the change request approval date for subsequent changes.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model, NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: designation_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this beneficiary designation was terminated or superseded by a new designation. Null for currently active beneficiary designations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: designation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the death benefit (DB) or annuity proceeds allocated to this beneficiary. Must sum to 100.00 within each beneficiary type class for a given policy. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 50.00 for 50%).

attributes.name: designation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the beneficiary designation. Active designations are in force; superseded designations have been replaced by newer designations; deceased indicates the beneficiary predeceased the insured; removed indicates the beneficiary was explicitly removed; pending indicates a change request is in process.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address for electronic communication with the beneficiary. Used for beneficiary notifications, digital document delivery, and claims correspondence.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the beneficiary as an individual person, trust, estate, charitable organization, or business entity. Determines tax treatment and distribution rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|trust|estate|charity|corporation|partnership|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: First or given name of the individual beneficiary. Null for trust or entity beneficiaries.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The complete legal name of the beneficiary as it should appear on death benefit or annuity payout documentation. For trust beneficiaries, this is the full legal name of the trust.

attributes.name: guardian_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal guardian or custodian designated to manage death benefit proceeds on behalf of a minor beneficiary until the minor reaches the age of majority. Required when is_minor is True.
attributes.references: Uniform Transfers to Minors Act (UTMA), State Insurance Codes

attributes.name: guardian_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the guardian or custodian to the minor beneficiary. Used for legal verification and compliance with state minor beneficiary laws.

attributes.name: is_minor
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the beneficiary is a minor (under age 18 or state-specific age of majority). True if minor, False if adult. Determines whether guardian or custodian designation is required.
attributes.references: State Insurance Codes, Uniform Transfers to Minors Act (UTMA)

attributes.name: is_revocable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the beneficiary designation can be changed by the policy owner without the beneficiary consent. True if revocable (can be changed), False if irrevocable (requires beneficiary consent to change).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation, State Insurance Codes

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Last name or surname of the individual beneficiary. Null for trust or entity beneficiaries.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the individual beneficiary. Null for trust or entity beneficiaries.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: per_stirpes_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the beneficiary share should be distributed per stirpes (by branch) if the beneficiary predeceases the insured. True means the beneficiary share passes to their descendants; False means the share is redistributed among surviving beneficiaries of the same class.
attributes.references: State Insurance Codes, Estate Planning Standards

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the beneficiary. Used for beneficiary outreach during claims processing and death benefit distribution.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the beneficiary address. Used for mailing and geographic analysis.

attributes.name: relationship_to_insured
attributes.description: The familial, legal, or business relationship between the beneficiary and the insured or annuitant. Used for underwriting, tax reporting, and regulatory compliance purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spouse|child|parent|sibling|grandchild|other_relative|trust|estate|charity|business_entity|other — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sequence
attributes.description: Ordering number within the beneficiary type class to establish precedence when multiple beneficiaries of the same type exist.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: settlement_option
attributes.description: The method by which the death benefit or annuity proceeds will be paid to the beneficiary. Lump sum is a single payment; installment is periodic payments over time; life income provides payments for the beneficiary lifetime; interest only holds proceeds and pays interest.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the policy administration system or source application from which this beneficiary record originated (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle Insurance Policy Administration). Used for data lineage and integration tracking.

attributes.name: ssn
attributes.description: Social Security Number of the individual beneficiary. Stored in masked or encrypted format. Required for tax reporting (Form 1099-R) upon distribution of death benefits or annuity proceeds. Null for non-US beneficiaries.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the beneficiary address. Two-letter state code for US addresses (e.g., CA, NY, TX).

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: Generational or professional suffix appended to the beneficiary name (e.g., Jr., Sr., II, III).

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Taxpayer Identification Number for trust, estate, or entity beneficiaries. Used for IRS tax reporting when the beneficiary is not an individual. Stored in masked or encrypted format.

attributes.name: trust_date_established
attributes.description: Date the trust was legally established. Used for trust qualification verification and estate planning documentation. Null for non-trust beneficiaries.

attributes.name: trust_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the trust when the beneficiary is an Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust (ILIT) or other trust entity. Null for individual beneficiaries.

attributes.name: trustee_name
attributes.description: Name of the trustee responsible for administering the trust and receiving death benefit proceeds on behalf of trust beneficiaries. Null for non-trust beneficiaries.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this beneficiary record was last modified in the policy administration system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: owner
products.description: Association entity linking a policy to its legal owner(s), capturing ownership type (individual, trust, corporation, ILIT, employer), ownership percentage for co-ownership scenarios, ownership effective date, ownership termination date, ownership transfer reason, power-of-attorney flag, and collateral assignment flag. Distinct from the insured (policyholder domain) and from the beneficiary. Supports ownership change transactions, collateral assignment tracking, and 1035 exchange origination.

attributes.name: owner_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy ownership record. Primary key for the policy owner association entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance or annuity policy contract that is owned. Links to the policy master record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: owner_collateral_assignee_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (typically a lender or financial institution) who holds the collateral assignment interest in the policy. Null if collateral_assignment_flag is False.

attributes.name: owner_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal owner party (individual, trust, corporation, or other entity) who holds ownership rights to the policy. Links to the party master record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: owner_poa_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party who holds power of attorney authority to act on behalf of the owner. Null if power_of_attorney_flag is False.

attributes.name: ownership_transfer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy servicing transaction that created or modified this ownership record. Links to the transaction audit trail for ownership changes.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: party_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary mailing address for the policy owner. Used for correspondence, premium notices, and regulatory communications. Links to the address master record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Model

attributes.name: absolute_assignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy has been absolutely assigned (full transfer of all ownership rights) versus collateral assignment (partial rights for security). True = absolute assignment; False = not absolutely assigned. Absolute assignment typically results in ownership transfer.

attributes.name: collateral_assignment_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount of the loan or obligation secured by the collateral assignment. Used to determine assignee priority claim on death benefit and CSV. Null if collateral_assignment_flag is False.

attributes.name: collateral_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when the collateral assignment became effective. Null if collateral_assignment_flag is False.

attributes.name: collateral_assignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy has been assigned as collateral for a loan or other financial obligation. True = policy is assigned as collateral; False = no collateral assignment. Affects death benefit and CSV distribution rights.

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date when the owner provided written consent to the ownership arrangement. Required for certain ownership structures (e.g., employer-owned life insurance requires employee consent per IRC Section 101(j)).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this policy ownership record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, NAIC Record Retention Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this ownership relationship became legally effective. For original policy issuance, this is the policy issue date. For ownership transfers, this is the transfer effective date.

attributes.name: insurable_interest_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether insurable interest between the owner and insured was verified at policy issuance or ownership transfer. True = insurable interest documented and verified; False = not verified. Required for STOLI prevention and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act on Stranger-Originated Life Insurance (STOLI)

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when KYC and AML verification was completed for the policy owner. Null if kyc_verification_status is pending or not_required.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: kyc_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of KYC and AML verification for the policy owner. Verified = identity and AML checks passed; Pending = verification in progress; Failed = verification failed; Not Required = KYC not required for this owner type. Required for AML compliance and FinCEN reporting.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), FinCEN AML Requirements, USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: notice_preference
attributes.description: Preferred method for delivering policy notices, statements, and communications to the owner. Mail = postal mail; Email = electronic delivery; Portal = online customer portal; Agent = through agent/producer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Electronic Delivery

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of ownership interest held by this owner in the policy. For sole ownership = 100.00; for co-ownership scenarios, sum of all owner percentages must equal 100.00. Used for CSV and AV distribution calculations.

attributes.name: ownership_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source policy administration system or platform that originated this ownership record (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle Insurance). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: ownership_source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this ownership record in the source policy administration system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and bidirectional synchronization.

attributes.name: ownership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ownership relationship. Active = ownership is in force; Terminated = ownership has ended; Suspended = ownership temporarily inactive; Pending = ownership change awaiting approval.

attributes.name: ownership_transfer_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for ownership change or termination. Sale = ownership sold to another party; Gift = ownership gifted; Divorce = ownership transferred due to divorce settlement; Death = ownership transferred due to owner death; Trust Transfer = ownership moved to/from trust; 1035 Exchange = tax-free policy exchange per IRC Section 1035.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035, NAIC Policy Administration Guidelines

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal ownership structure. Individual = single person owner; Joint = multiple co-owners; Trust = trust entity; Corporation = corporate owner; Partnership = partnership entity; ILIT = Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust.

attributes.name: pep_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policy owner is identified as a Politically Exposed Person per AML regulations. True = owner is PEP; False = not PEP. PEP status requires enhanced due diligence and monitoring.

attributes.name: power_of_attorney_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a power of attorney arrangement is in place allowing another party to act on behalf of the owner for policy servicing transactions. True = POA is active; False = no POA.

attributes.name: relationship_to_insured
attributes.description: Relationship of the policy owner to the insured life. Self = owner is the insured; Spouse = owner is spouse of insured; Employer = employer-owned life insurance; Trust = trust owns policy on insured; Other = other relationship. Used for underwriting, compliance, and STOLI detection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|spouse|parent|child|sibling|employer|trust|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act on Stranger-Originated Life Insurance (STOLI)

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent sanctions screening was performed for the policy owner. Null if sanctions_screening_status is not_screened.

attributes.name: sanctions_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of screening the policy owner against OFAC and other sanctions lists. Clear = no match found; Match = potential match requires review; Pending = screening in progress; Not Screened = screening not yet performed.
attributes.references: OFAC Sanctions Programs, FinCEN AML Requirements

attributes.name: tax_reporting_owner_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this owner is the designated party for IRS tax reporting purposes (1099-R, 1099-INT). True = this owner receives tax forms; False = not the tax reporting owner. Critical for IRC Section 7702 and 72 compliance.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702, IRC Section 72, IRS Publication 525

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this ownership relationship ended. Null for active ownership. Populated upon ownership transfer, policy surrender, or policy maturity.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Tax identification number (SSN or EIN) of the policy owner for IRS reporting. Required for tax reporting and 1099 issuance. May be SSN for individual owners or EIN for entity owners.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this policy ownership record was last modified in the data platform. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, NAIC Record Retention Guidelines

products.name: policy_reinstatement
products.description: Tracks all policy reinstatement applications and decisions for lapsed policies. Captures reinstatement application date, lapse date, reinstatement effective date, reinstatement status (pending, approved, declined, withdrawn), evidence of insurability requirement flag, APS required flag, back-premium amount due, reinstatement premium collected, interest on back-premiums, health statement attestation date, underwriting decision reference, and reinstatement denial reason code. Sourced from the Policy Administration System reinstatement module.

attributes.name: policy_reinstatement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the policy reinstatement record. Primary key for the policy reinstatement entity.

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: Reinstatement requiring evidence of insurability generates a new underwriting application. The reinstatement record must reference this application to track the underwriting submission, decision, and

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.assumption_set. Business justification: Reinstatement underwriting uses actuarial assumption sets to determine evidence of insurability thresholds, back-premium interest rates, and contestability period restart rules. Actuarial and complian

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.reinsurance_cession. Business justification: Policy reinstatement requires reinstating the associated reinsurance cession, which may have lapsed or been terminated. Reinsurance operations must coordinate cession reinstatement with the reinsurer.

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Reinstatement applications require health statements, evidence of insurability forms, and back-premium receipts as regulatory documents. Insurers must retain these for contestability period compliance

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy being reinstated. Links to the master policy record in the policy administration system.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Reinstatements collect back premiums and fees, generating journal entries for premium income and fee revenue recognition. Finance reconciliation of reinstatement collections to GL postings is required

attributes.name: lapse_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.lapse_event. Business justification: Reinstatement applications must reference the specific lapse event to verify lapse reason, duration, outstanding amounts, and reinstatement eligibility window. Critical for underwriting decision workf

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent who assisted with or submitted the reinstatement application. Supports commission tracking and agent performance metrics.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.underwriting_risk_assessment. Business justification: Reinstatement underwriting produces a formal risk assessment. The reinstatement record carries denormalized `underwriting_decision` and `underwriting_decision_date` fields that belong on the risk asse

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.service_request. Business justification: A policy reinstatement application is initiated through a service request (request_type='REINSTATEMENT'). Linking policy_reinstatement to the originating service_request provides full traceability fro

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Reinstatement eligibility windows, evidence of insurability requirements, and back-premium interest rules are state-regulated. Compliance reporting on reinstatement practices during market conduct exa

attributes.name: adverse_action_notice_sent_date
attributes.description: Date the adverse action notice was sent to the applicant following a denial or rated decision. Required for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: amount_collected
attributes.description: Total amount collected from the policyholder toward reinstatement. Tracks partial payments and full settlement.

attributes.name: application_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the reinstatement application was submitted. Supports channel performance analysis and customer experience tracking.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date the policyholder submitted the reinstatement application. Key date for calculating time-sensitive requirements and deadlines.

attributes.name: aps_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Attending Physician Statement is required as part of the reinstatement underwriting. Typically required for longer lapse periods or health-related concerns.

attributes.name: back_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of unpaid premiums owed from the lapse date to reinstatement date. Must be paid for reinstatement approval.

attributes.name: back_premium_interest_amount
attributes.description: Interest charged on unpaid back premiums calculated per state regulation and company policy. Added to total reinstatement cost.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments from underwriters, processors, or customer service regarding the reinstatement case. Supports case management and audit trail.

attributes.name: contestable_period_restart_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the two-year contestable period restarts from the reinstatement effective date. Impacts claims adjudication and fraud investigation rights.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reinstatement record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: csv_at_lapse_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cash Surrender Value (CSV) at Lapse Amount
attributes.description: Cash surrender value of the policy at the time of lapse. May be applied toward back premiums or returned to policyholder based on policy provisions.

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the primary reason for denial of the reinstatement application. Required for regulatory reporting and adverse action notices.

attributes.name: denial_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the reinstatement application was denied. Supports adverse action letter generation and appeals process.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date the policy coverage is restored if reinstatement is approved. May be retroactive to lapse date or prospective based on company policy and state regulation.

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant must provide evidence of continued insurability for reinstatement. Typically required if lapse exceeded a threshold period.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Administrative fee charged for processing the reinstatement application. May vary by policy type and jurisdiction.

attributes.name: health_statement_attestation_date
attributes.description: Date the applicant signed and attested to the accuracy of the health statement. Legal date for representation and warranty purposes.

attributes.name: health_statement_received_date
attributes.description: Date the completed health statement was received from the applicant. Tracks compliance with evidence of insurability requirements.

attributes.name: health_statement_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant must complete a health statement questionnaire. Standard requirement for reinstatements beyond the grace period.

attributes.name: lapse_date
attributes.description: Date the policy originally lapsed due to non-payment of premium or other reason. Determines reinstatement eligibility window and requirements.

attributes.name: lapse_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason the policy lapsed. Influences reinstatement requirements and underwriting criteria.

attributes.name: loan_balance_at_lapse_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Policy Loan Balance at Lapse Amount
attributes.description: Outstanding policy loan balance at the time of lapse. Must be repaid or reinstated along with the policy.

attributes.name: nigo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the application was initially submitted incomplete or with errors requiring rework. Tracks application quality and processing efficiency.

attributes.name: nigo_reason_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Not In Good Order (NIGO) Reason Code
attributes.description: Code indicating the specific deficiency that caused the application to be marked as not in good order. Supports root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used by the policyholder to pay reinstatement amounts. Influences processing time and reconciliation procedures.

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date the reinstatement payment was received by the company. Key date for determining when reinstatement can be processed.

attributes.name: processing_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from application receipt to final decision. Key performance indicator for operational efficiency and customer experience.

attributes.name: reinstatement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the reinstatement application in the workflow. Tracks progression from initial application through final decision.

attributes.name: reinstatement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reinstatement based on requirements and conditions. Automatic requires only payment; conditional requires underwriting; unconditional is within grace period.

attributes.name: suicide_exclusion_restart_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suicide exclusion period restarts from the reinstatement effective date. Impacts death benefit eligibility for suicide claims.

attributes.name: total_amount_due
attributes.description: Total amount required for reinstatement including back premiums, interest, and fees. Must be collected before policy is reinstated.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reinstatement record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking for compliance and operational monitoring.

attributes.name: window_expiry_date
attributes.description: Last date the policy is eligible for reinstatement per policy terms and state regulation. Typically 3-5 years from lapse date.

products.name: surrender

SSOT for nonforfeiture option elections and outcomes. Stores transaction type (full surrender, partial surrender, systematic withdrawal, extended term insurance election, reduced paid-up insurance election, automatic premium loan election, cash surrender value nonforfeiture), request date, effective date, gross amount, surrender charge applied, market value adjustment (MVA) applied, net proceeds, tax withholding amount, 1099-R indicator, free withdrawal amount utilized, reason code (financial hardship, 1035 exchange, annuitization, death, lapse nonforfeiture), nonforfeiture option type elected or defaulted, nonforfeiture election date, extended term insurance expiry date, reduced paid-up face amount, reduced paid-up policy status, CSV amount used to fund the nonforfeiture benefit, disbursement method, and compliance with NAIC Standard Nonforfeiture Law. Sourced from the Policy Administration System surrender, lapse administration, and nonforfeiture processing modules.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the surrender request was approved by underwriting, policy services, or automated workflow. Marks transition from pending to approved status.

attributes.name: charge_amount
attributes.description: Surrender charge assessed against the gross amount per the policy or contract schedule. Recovers deferred acquisition costs (DAC) and early termination expenses.

attributes.name: cost_basis_amount
attributes.description: Policyholder's cost basis in the contract at the time of surrender, representing total premiums paid less any prior non-taxable distributions. Used to calculate taxable gain per IRC Section 72.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this surrender transaction record was first created in the policy administration system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: csv_amount_used

attributes.references: NAIC Standard Nonforfeiture Law for Life Insurance

attributes.name: disbursement_date
attributes.description: Date the net surrender proceeds were disbursed to the policyholder, beneficiary, or receiving financial institution.

attributes.name: disbursement_method
attributes.description: Method by which net surrender proceeds were disbursed to the policyholder or receiving institution: check (mailed check), EFT (electronic funds transfer), wire transfer (same-day wire), 1035 direct transfer (trustee-to-trustee transfer for tax-free exchange), ACH (automated clearing house transfer).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the surrender transaction became effective for policy value calculations, coverage termination, and accounting purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Standard Nonforfeiture Law for Life Insurance

attributes.name: extended_term_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the extended term insurance coverage when the extended term nonforfeiture option is elected. Coverage terminates on this date unless the policy is reinstated.
attributes.references: NAIC Standard Nonforfeiture Law for Life Insurance

attributes.name: form_1099r_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this surrender transaction requires IRS Form 1099-R reporting for taxable distributions from life insurance, annuities, pensions, or retirement plans. True if 1099-R reporting is required; false otherwise.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72 and IRS Form 1099-R Instructions

attributes.name: free_withdrawal_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the withdrawal that falls within the contract's free withdrawal corridor (typically 10% of account value annually) and is not subject to surrender charges.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross value available for surrender before application of surrender charges, market value adjustments, or tax withholding. Represents the Cash Surrender Value (CSV) or Account Value (AV) at the time of surrender.

attributes.name: mva_amount
attributes.description: Market Value Adjustment applied to fixed indexed annuities (FIA) or fixed annuities with MVA riders. Positive value indicates upward adjustment; negative value indicates downward adjustment based on interest rate movements since contract issue.

attributes.name: naic_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this surrender transaction complies with NAIC Standard Nonforfeiture Law requirements for minimum cash values, nonforfeiture options, and grace period provisions. True if compliant; false if exception or waiver applies.
attributes.references: NAIC Standard Nonforfeiture Law for Life Insurance

attributes.name: net_proceeds
attributes.description: Net amount payable to the policyholder or contract owner after deducting surrender charges, market value adjustments, outstanding policy loans, and tax withholding from the gross amount.

attributes.name: nonforfeiture_election_date
attributes.description: Date the policyholder elected or the insurer applied the default nonforfeiture option. Applicable when policy lapses without premium payment and nonforfeiture provisions are triggered.
attributes.references: NAIC Standard Nonforfeiture Law for Life Insurance

attributes.name: nonforfeiture_option_type
attributes.description: Nonforfeiture benefit option elected or defaulted upon policy lapse or surrender: cash surrender (CSV payout), extended term insurance (CSV purchases term coverage for original face amount), reduced paid-up insurance (CSV purchases reduced permanent coverage), automatic premium loan (CSV funds overdue premiums), or none (no nonforfeiture benefit applicable).
attributes.references: NAIC Standard Nonforfeiture Law for Life Insurance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments captured by policy service representatives or underwriters regarding special circumstances, exceptions, or processing details for this surrender transaction.

attributes.name: outstanding_loan_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding policy loan principal and accrued interest deducted from the gross surrender value at the time of surrender. Applies to life insurance policies with loan provisions.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Policy Loan Interest Rate Regulation

attributes.name: processing_date
attributes.description: Date the surrender transaction was processed and posted to the policy administration system, updating policy status, values, and accounting ledgers.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason for the surrender or withdrawal: financial hardship (policyholder financial need), 1035 exchange (tax-free transfer to another policy per IRC Section 1035), annuitization (conversion to income stream), death (beneficiary surrender post-claim), lapse nonforfeiture (automatic nonforfeiture election upon lapse), policy maturity (endowment maturity payout).
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035 and NAIC Model Regulation Service

attributes.name: receiving_carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the receiving insurance carrier or financial institution for 1035 exchange transactions. Populated when the surrender is part of a tax-free policy exchange.

attributes.name: receiving_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy or contract number at the receiving carrier for 1035 exchange transactions. Links the surrendered policy to the replacement contract.

attributes.name: reduced_paid_up_face_amount
attributes.description: Face amount (death benefit) of the reduced paid-up insurance coverage when the reduced paid-up nonforfeiture option is elected. Calculated based on the CSV and attained age of the insured.
attributes.references: NAIC Standard Nonforfeiture Law for Life Insurance

attributes.name: reduced_paid_up_status
attributes.description: Current status of the reduced paid-up policy resulting from the nonforfeiture election: active (coverage in force), lapsed (coverage terminated), matured (endowment matured), surrendered (subsequently surrendered for remaining CSV).

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date the policyholder or contract owner submitted the surrender or withdrawal request to the insurer.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the policy administration system or platform that originated this surrender transaction record (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle Insurance Policy Administration).

attributes.name: source_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the source policy administration system. Enables traceability and reconciliation between lakehouse and operational systems.

attributes.name: tax_withholding_amount
attributes.description: Federal and state income tax withholding amount deducted from the surrender proceeds per IRS regulations and policyholder election. Applies to taxable gain portion of the distribution.

attributes.name: taxable_gain_amount
attributes.description: Taxable gain portion of the surrender distribution calculated as the excess of the amount received over the cost basis (premiums paid less prior distributions). Reported on IRS Form 1099-R.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number assigned to this surrender event for customer and agent reference.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the surrender transaction: pending (request received, under review), approved (authorized for processing), processed (transaction completed in policy admin system), disbursed (funds paid out), rejected (request denied), reversed (transaction voided or corrected).

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of surrender or nonforfeiture transaction: full surrender (complete termination with CSV payout), partial surrender (partial withdrawal retaining policy), systematic withdrawal (scheduled recurring withdrawals), extended term insurance election (nonforfeiture option converting CSV to term coverage), reduced paid-up insurance election (nonforfeiture option converting CSV to reduced permanent coverage), or automatic premium loan election (nonforfeiture option using CSV to pay overdue premiums).
attributes.references: NAIC Standard Nonforfeiture Law for Life Insurance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this surrender transaction record was last modified in the policy administration system. Tracks data currency and change history.

attributes.description: Total interest accrued on the loan that has not been paid or capitalized into principal.

attributes.name: apl_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loan was automatically triggered due to insufficient funds to pay a premium. True if the loan was initiated by the APL provision; False if borrower-initiated.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date the loan was fully closed (either through full repayment, offset at death, offset at surrender, or foreclosure). Null if loan is still active.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason the loan was closed. Full_repayment indicates borrower paid off loan; offset_death_claim indicates loan was deducted from death benefit; offset_surrender indicates loan was deducted from surrender proceeds; policy_lapse indicates policy lapsed due to loan exceeding CSV; loan_forgiveness indicates loan was forgiven (rare, typically taxable event).

attributes.name: collateral_csv_amount
attributes.description: Cash Surrender Value (CSV) of the policy at the time of loan origination, representing the maximum collateral available to secure the loan.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this policy loan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disbursement_date
attributes.description: Date on which loan proceeds were disbursed to the policyholder or applied to premium/loan interest.

attributes.name: disbursement_method
attributes.description: Method by which loan proceeds were disbursed. Check indicates mailed check; EFT indicates electronic funds transfer to bank account; wire indicates wire transfer; applied_to_premium indicates loan was used to pay premium (APL); applied_to_loan indicates loan was used to pay interest on existing loan.

attributes.name: interest_capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date on which accrued interest was capitalized (added to principal balance), typically occurring annually on the policy anniversary if interest remains unpaid.

attributes.name: interest_crediting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which interest is calculated and added to the accrued interest balance.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to the policy loan, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5%). Rate may be fixed at origination or variable based on an index.

attributes.name: interest_rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the loan interest rate is determined. Fixed rates remain constant; variable rates adjust periodically based on an index such as Moody's Corporate Bond Yield Average, US Treasury rates, or LIBOR; guaranteed_max indicates a rate with a contractual ceiling.

attributes.name: last_interest_posting_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which interest was calculated and posted to the accrued interest balance.

attributes.name: last_repayment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the most recent repayment transaction. Null if no repayments have been made.

attributes.name: last_repayment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent repayment transaction applied to this loan. Null if no repayments have been made.

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the policy loan, typically displayed on customer statements and correspondence.

attributes.name: loan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the policy loan. Active indicates outstanding balance; repaid indicates full repayment; foreclosed indicates policy lapsed due to loan exceeding CSV; offset_at_death indicates loan was deducted from death benefit at claim; offset_at_surrender indicates loan was deducted from surrender proceeds.

attributes.name: loan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the policy loan. Standard loans are borrower-initiated; Automatic Premium Loan (APL) loans are triggered when premium payment fails and policy has sufficient CSV; systematic loans are recurring scheduled loans; emergency loans are expedited loans for urgent needs.

attributes.name: maximum_loan_amount
attributes.description: Maximum amount that can be borrowed against the policy, typically a percentage of CSV (e.g., 90% of CSV) as defined in the policy contract.

attributes.name: mec_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loan was taken on a policy classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC), which has different tax treatment for loans and withdrawals. True if policy is a MEC; False otherwise.

attributes.name: next_scheduled_repayment_date
attributes.description: Date of the next scheduled loan repayment, if a repayment schedule is in place. Null if no repayment schedule exists or loan is fully repaid.

attributes.name: offset_amount_at_claim
attributes.description: Total loan balance (principal plus accrued interest) that was deducted from the death benefit when a claim was paid. Null if policy has not resulted in a death claim.

attributes.name: offset_amount_at_surrender
attributes.description: Total loan balance (principal plus accrued interest) that was deducted from the cash surrender value when the policy was surrendered. Null if policy has not been surrendered.

attributes.name: original_loan_amount
attributes.description: Principal amount of the loan at origination, before any interest accrual or repayments.

attributes.name: origination_date
attributes.description: Date the policy loan was issued and funds were disbursed to the policyholder or applied to premium.

attributes.name: outstanding_principal_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding principal balance of the loan after partial repayments, excluding accrued interest.

attributes.name: repayment_schedule_type
attributes.description: Type of repayment schedule established for the loan. None indicates no scheduled repayments (loan repaid at death or surrender); monthly/quarterly/annual indicate regular scheduled payments; custom indicates a non-standard repayment plan.

attributes.name: scheduled_repayment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of each scheduled repayment installment, if a repayment schedule is in place. Null if no repayment schedule exists.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source policy administration system from which this loan record originated (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle Insurance Policy Administration).

attributes.name: tax_reporting_year
attributes.description: Tax year in which a taxable event related to this loan must be reported to the IRS (e.g., when loan causes policy to become a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) or when loan is forgiven at lapse).

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: Amount subject to income tax reporting related to this loan (e.g., gain recognized on MEC loan distribution or loan forgiveness at lapse). Null if no taxable event has occurred.

attributes.name: taxable_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loan has triggered a taxable event requiring IRS reporting (e.g., loan on a MEC policy, loan forgiveness at lapse). True if taxable event occurred; False otherwise.

attributes.name: to_csv_ratio
attributes.business_glossary_term: Loan To Cash Surrender Value (CSV) Ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of total outstanding loan balance to current policy CSV, expressed as a decimal. Used to monitor loan collateralization and lapse risk. A ratio approaching 1.0 indicates high lapse risk.

attributes.name: total_outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Combined outstanding principal and accrued interest balance. This is the amount that would be deducted from death benefit or surrender value.

attributes.name: total_repayments_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of all repayments (principal and interest) made on this loan since origination.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this policy loan record was last modified in the system.

products.name: dividend
products.description: Tracks annual policyholder dividend declarations and elections for participating whole life policies. Stores dividend year, declared dividend amount, dividend option elected (cash, premium reduction, paid-up additions — PUA, accumulate at interest, one-year term), dividend option effective date, paid-up additions face amount purchased, accumulated dividend balance, dividend interest rate, and dividend payment date. Owned by the policy domain as a contractual feature of participating policies.

attributes.name: dividend_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dividend record. Primary key for the dividend product.

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.assumption_set. Business justification: Dividend scales are built from actuarial assumption sets containing mortality, interest, and expense factors. Actuaries use assumption_set to calculate declared_amount and apportionment factors. Real

attributes.name: experience_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.experience_study. Business justification: Dividend factors (mortality_factor, interest_factor, expense_factor on dividend record) are directly derived from experience study results. Actuarial teams set annual dividend scales based on experien

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the participating whole life policy to which this dividend applies. Links to the policy master record.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Dividend declarations and payments generate journal entries for policyholder dividend expense, cash disbursements, and PUA purchases. Finance requires direct traceability from dividend records to GL p

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Participating whole life dividend calculations are driven by general account portfolio performance (mortality, interest, expense factors). Required for dividend scale setting, apportionment methodolog

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: Participating policy dividend declarations are based on annual actuarial valuation results (mortality, interest, expense experience). Linking dividend to valuation_run enables actuarial teams to trace

attributes.name: accumulated_balance
attributes.description: The current balance of dividends left on deposit with the company when the accumulate-at-interest option is elected. Includes principal and accrued interest.

attributes.name: accumulated_interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate credited to accumulated dividends left on deposit. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0350 for 3.50%). Rate may be guaranteed or declared annually.

attributes.name: accumulated_interest_ytd
attributes.description: The interest credited to accumulated dividends during the current policy year. Used for tax reporting and policy value reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525 - Taxable and Nontaxable Income

attributes.name: apportionment_method
attributes.description: The actuarial method used to allocate divisible surplus to this policy. CONTRIBUTION = contribution method; THREE_FACTOR = mortality, interest, expense factors; EXPERIENCE = experience rating; ASSET_SHARE = asset share method.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Dividend Illustrations

attributes.name: cash_payment_amount
attributes.description: The amount paid in cash to the policyholder when the cash dividend option is elected. May differ from declared amount if partial amounts are applied to other options.

attributes.name: cash_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the cash dividend payment was issued or electronically transferred to the policyholder. Used for cash flow tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: cash_payment_method
attributes.description: The method used to disburse the cash dividend payment. CHECK = paper check; ACH = automated clearing house; WIRE = wire transfer; EFT = electronic funds transfer.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dividend record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the board of directors or authorized committee formally declared the dividend for the policy year. Represents the official authorization date.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Dividend Illustrations

attributes.name: declared_amount
attributes.description: The total dividend amount declared for the policy for the dividend year, expressed in the policy currency. Represents the policyholder's share of divisible surplus before any option election.

attributes.name: dividend_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the dividend. DECLARED = authorized but not yet processed; PENDING = awaiting option election; PAID = cash payment issued; APPLIED = applied per elected option; FORFEITED = lost due to lapse; REVERSED = reversed due to policy adjustment.

attributes.name: expense_factor
attributes.description: The expense component of the dividend calculation. Represents the policyholder's share of favorable expense experience relative to pricing assumptions.

attributes.name: illustration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dividend amount was used in a policy illustration. True if included in an illustration provided to the policyholder; false otherwise. Used for compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Life Insurance Illustrations

attributes.name: interest_factor
attributes.description: The investment earnings component of the dividend calculation. Represents the policyholder's share of investment income exceeding guaranteed rates.

attributes.name: loan_reduction_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the dividend applied to reduce the outstanding policy loan balance when the loan reduction option is elected. Reduces principal and/or accrued loan interest.

attributes.name: mortality_factor
attributes.description: The mortality component of the dividend calculation. Represents the policyholder's share of favorable mortality experience for the dividend year.

attributes.name: option_code
attributes.description: The dividend option elected by the policyholder. CASH = cash payment; PREM_RED = premium reduction; PUA = paid-up additions; ACCUM = accumulate at interest; OYT = one-year term insurance; LOAN_RED = loan reduction.

attributes.name: option_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the elected dividend option becomes effective. May differ from declaration date if the policyholder changes their election within the allowed window.

attributes.name: oyt_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The face amount of one-year term insurance purchased with the dividend when the OYT option is elected. Provides temporary additional death benefit for one policy year.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Policy Form Standards - One-Year Term Rider

attributes.name: oyt_premium_paid
attributes.description: The portion of the dividend used to purchase the one-year term coverage. Represents the cost of the temporary insurance benefit.

attributes.name: premium_reduction_amount
attributes.description: The amount of the dividend applied to reduce the next premium due when the premium reduction option is elected. Reduces the net premium payable by the policyholder.

attributes.name: processing_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the dividend record was processed by the policy administration system. Represents the system processing event, distinct from business effective dates.

attributes.name: pua_cash_value
attributes.description: The cash surrender value of the paid-up additions purchased with this dividend. Contributes to the total policy cash value and is available for loans or surrender.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions - Schedule D

attributes.name: pua_face_amount
attributes.description: The face amount of paid-up additional insurance purchased with the dividend when the PUA option is elected. Represents incremental death benefit added to the base policy.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Policy Form Standards - Paid-Up Additions Rider

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously declared or paid dividend was reversed. Used for audit trail and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason for reversing a previously declared or paid dividend. POLICY_LAPSE = policy lapsed before dividend paid; POLICY_RESCISSION = policy rescinded; DATA_CORRECTION = data error correction; CALCULATION_ERROR = actuarial calculation error; OPTION_CHANGE = policyholder changed option election.

attributes.name: scale_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the dividend scale used to calculate this dividend. Links to the actuarial dividend scale table and supports audit trail for rate changes.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Dividend Illustrations

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the source policy administration system from which this dividend record originated. Supports multi-system environments and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this dividend record in the source policy administration system. Enables traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: special_dividend_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a special or extraordinary dividend declared outside the normal annual dividend cycle. True for special dividends; false for regular annual dividends.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Dividend Illustrations

attributes.name: tax_reporting_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the dividend is reportable for tax purposes. May differ from dividend year due to timing of payment or option application.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 525 - Taxable and Nontaxable Income

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the dividend that is taxable to the policyholder. Generally zero for participating whole life unless dividends exceed premiums paid, but tracked for IRS reporting compliance.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72 - Annuities; Certain Proceeds of Endowment and Life Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: terminal_dividend_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a terminal dividend paid upon policy maturity, death claim, or surrender. True for terminal dividends; false for annual dividends.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dividend record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Management Assessment of Internal Controls

attributes.name: year
attributes.description: The policy year or calendar year for which the dividend was declared. Represents the experience period underlying the dividend calculation.

products.name: tax_compliance_test
products.description: Stores the results of IRC Section 7702A Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) testing performed on each policy at issuance and upon material change. Captures test date, test type (7-pay test), 7-pay premium limit, cumulative premiums paid to date, MEC status flag (MEC / non-MEC), material change event type, material change date, corridor test result, GPT/CVAT election, guideline single premium, guideline level premium, and the actuarial system that performed the calculation. Critical for IRS compliance and tax reporting.

attributes.name: tax_compliance_test_id
attributes.description: Primary key for tax_compliance_test

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.assumption_set. Business justification: IRC 7702 guideline premium and cash value accumulation test calculations require specific actuarial assumptions (interest rates, mortality). The assumption_set governs these inputs beyond just the mor

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance or annuity policy for which this MEC test was performed.

attributes.name: insured_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policyholder.insured. Business justification: IRC 7702 and MEC testing requires insured age, risk class, and mortality data directly from the insured record. insured_age_at_test is a denormalized copy of insured data. This FK enables actuarial co

attributes.name: irc7702_parameter_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.irc7702_parameter. Business justification: IRC 7702 CVAT/GPT compliance tests use guideline_single_premium, guideline_level_premium, seven_pay_premium_limit, and corridor_percentage defined in irc7702_parameter. Linking tax_compliance_test to

attributes.name: mortality_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.mortality_table. Business justification: MEC and CVAT tests require mortality assumptions to calculate guideline premiums and corridor percentages. IRS compliance testing mandates specific mortality tables. Real regulatory process actuaries

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: IRC 7702 compliance testing and MEC 7-pay testing are specific regulatory obligations under the Internal Revenue Code. Linking each tax_compliance_test to its governing regulatory_obligation enables c

attributes.name: separate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.separate_account. Business justification: IRC 7702/7702A compliance tests for variable life require the separate account's unit values and NAV to compute CVAT/GPT corridor tests and account value. Regulators and auditors require traceability

attributes.name: tax_compliance_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: IRC 7702 and MEC test results require mandatory policyholder notification documents (MEC notices, corridor test disclosures) under IRS regulations. Direct FK links the compliance test record to its ge

attributes.name: tax_compliance_journal_entry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tax Compliance Journal Entry Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: MEC reclassification events (IRC 7702 test failures) generate journal entries for deferred tax adjustments and IRS Form 1099-R reporting. Finance must trace MEC determination events to their GL impact

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: IRC 7702 and MEC compliance tests are executed within actuarial valuation cycles. Linking tax_compliance_test to valuation_run enables audit traceability of which valuation run produced the guideline

attributes.name: value_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.value. Business justification: IRC Section 7702A MEC testing is performed against a specific policy value snapshot as of the test date. Linking tax_compliance_test to the policy.value record used in the test provides authoritative

attributes.name: account_value_at_test
attributes.description: The policy account value (gross cash value before surrender charges) at the time the MEC test was performed. Relevant for universal life and variable universal life products.

attributes.name: actuarial_system_source
attributes.description: The name and version of the actuarial valuation system that performed the MEC test calculation (e.g., MoSes, AXIS, Prophet). Critical for audit trail and calculation reproducibility.

attributes.name: cash_value_accumulation_limit
attributes.description: The maximum cash value the policy can accumulate under the Cash Value Accumulation Test (CVAT) without violating IRC 7702 life insurance definition. Only applicable if CVAT election was made.

attributes.name: cash_value_at_test
attributes.description: The policy cash surrender value at the time the MEC test was performed. Used in corridor test calculations and CVAT limit assessments.

attributes.name: corridor_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the corridor test which ensures the death benefit maintains a minimum ratio to the cash value. Required for policies to maintain life insurance tax treatment under IRC 7702.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MEC test result record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_premiums_paid
attributes.description: The total amount of premiums paid into the policy from issuance through the test date. Used to compare against the 7-pay premium limit.

attributes.name: death_benefit_at_test
attributes.description: The policy death benefit amount in effect at the time the MEC test was performed. Death benefit is a key input to the 7-pay premium limit calculation.

attributes.name: definition_election
attributes.business_glossary_term: Definition Election (Guideline Premium Test (GPT) or Cash Value Accumulation Test (CVAT))
attributes.description: The IRC Section 7702 definition of life insurance elected by the policyholder at issuance. GPT uses guideline premiums and cash value corridor; CVAT uses cash value accumulation limits. This election is irrevocable.

attributes.name: exchange_1035_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy was acquired through a Section 1035 tax-free exchange from another life insurance or annuity contract. 1035 exchanges carry forward the MEC status from the original contract.

attributes.name: exchanged_policy_mec_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exchanged Policy Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) Status
attributes.description: If this policy was acquired through a 1035 exchange, this field captures the MEC status of the original exchanged policy. MEC status is preserved in 1035 exchanges.

attributes.name: form_1099r_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether distributions from this policy are reportable on IRS Form 1099-R due to MEC status. MEC distributions are subject to income tax and potential early withdrawal penalties.

attributes.name: guideline_level_premium
attributes.description: The maximum level annual premium that can be paid into the policy under the Guideline Premium Test (GPT) without violating IRC 7702 life insurance definition. Only applicable if GPT election was made.

attributes.name: guideline_single_premium
attributes.description: The maximum single premium that can be paid into the policy under the Guideline Premium Test (GPT) without violating IRC 7702 life insurance definition. Only applicable if GPT election was made.

attributes.name: irs_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MEC test result requires reporting to the IRS. True if the policy became a MEC or if a material change occurred that affects tax treatment.

attributes.name: material_change_date
attributes.description: The date on which a material change event occurred, triggering a new 7-pay test period. Null if no material change has occurred.

attributes.name: material_change_event_type
attributes.description: The type of material change event that triggered a new MEC test. Material changes reset the 7-pay test period. If no material change occurred, this field is set to 'none'.
attributes.value_regex: death benefit increase|rider addition|premium increase|policy exchange|none

attributes.name: mec_status
attributes.description: The result of the MEC test indicating whether the policy is classified as a Modified Endowment Contract. MEC status affects the tax treatment of policy distributions and loans.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: If the MEC test result was manually overridden by an underwriter or compliance officer, this field captures the business justification for the override. Null if no override occurred.

attributes.name: override_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the MEC test result was manually overridden. Null if no override occurred.

attributes.name: policy_issue_date
attributes.description: The original issue date of the policy. Used to determine policy year and the start of the 7-pay test period.

attributes.name: policy_year_at_test
attributes.description: The policy year (anniversary year) in which the MEC test was performed. Relevant for tracking the 7-pay test period which spans the first seven policy years or until a material change.

attributes.name: prior_mec_status
attributes.description: The MEC status of the policy before this test was performed. Used to track status changes and identify when a policy first became a MEC. Set to 'not applicable' for initial issuance tests.

attributes.name: seven_pay_premium_limit
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative premium that can be paid into the policy during the first seven years (or until a material change) without causing the policy to become a MEC. Calculated based on actuarial assumptions and policy death benefit.

attributes.name: test_calculation_method
attributes.description: The actuarial methodology and assumptions used to calculate the 7-pay premium limit and other test thresholds. May reference specific assumption sets or calculation standards.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: The date on which the MEC test was performed. This may be at policy issuance or upon a material change event.

attributes.name: test_notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments regarding the MEC test, including any special circumstances, assumptions, or actuarial judgments applied during the calculation.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: The processing status of the MEC test. Indicates whether the test calculation has been completed, is pending actuarial review, failed due to data issues, or was manually overridden.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: The type of MEC test performed. The 7-pay test is the primary test under IRC 7702A to determine if cumulative premiums paid exceed the 7-pay premium limit.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MEC test result record was last modified in the system.

products.name: fund_allocation
products.description: Tracks investment fund allocation instructions and current allocation percentages for universal life (UL, IUL, VUL) and fixed indexed annuity (FIA) policies with investment options. Stores fund code, fund name, allocation percentage, allocation effective date, allocation type (premium allocation, account value rebalance, transfer), rebalancing frequency, dollar cost averaging flag, index strategy code (for IUL/FIA: point-to-point, monthly average, annual reset), cap rate, participation rate, floor rate, spread, and last rebalance date. Sourced from the Policy Administration System investment allocation module.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for each policy fund allocation record. Primary key for the policy fund allocation entity.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.crediting_strategy. Linking fund_allocation to crediting_strategy is essential for s

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.scenario_set. Business justification: Indexed and variable fund allocations (IUL, VA) are stress-tested against economic scenario sets for AG43/VM-21 stochastic reserve requirements. Linking fund_allocation to scenario_set enables actuari

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.separate_account_fund. The existing separate_a

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.service_request. Business justification: Fund allocation changes (rebalancing, strategy changes, index segment elections) for universal life and variable annuity policies are initiated through service requests (request_type='FUND_REALLOCATIO

attributes.name: suitability_review_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.suitability_review. Business justification: Variable and indexed product fund allocation changes require suitability review under FINRA Reg BI and state variable product regulations. Linking fund_allocation to the suitability_review that approv

attributes.name: valuation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.valuation. Business justification: Each fund allocation's dollar amount (allocation_amount) is computed from the current market valuation of the underlying investment. Linking to the specific valuation snapshot used at allocation_effec

attributes.name: allocation_amount
attributes.description: For dollar-based allocations (e.g., DCA programs), the fixed dollar amount allocated to this fund per period. Null for percentage-based allocations.

attributes.name: allocation_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation instruction was approved and accepted by the policy administration system, completing validation and compliance checks.

attributes.name: allocation_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this fund allocation instruction became effective and began applying to premium payments or account value rebalancing.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: Current percentage of premium or account value allocated to this fund. Must sum to 100% across all allocations for a given policy and allocation type. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 25.50 for 25.5%).

attributes.name: allocation_request_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation change was requested by the policyholder or advisor. May differ from effective date due to processing time or future-dated instructions.

attributes.name: allocation_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number for multiple fund allocations within the same policy and allocation type. Used for processing priority and display ordering.

attributes.name: allocation_source
attributes.description: Origin of this allocation instruction: policyholder-elected, system default, advisor-recommended, or automated program-driven.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this fund allocation instruction. Active allocations are applied to transactions; inactive/terminated allocations are historical records.

attributes.name: allocation_termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this allocation instruction was terminated or superseded by a new allocation. Null for currently active allocations.

attributes.name: allocation_termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason why this allocation instruction was terminated. Null for active allocations.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Type of allocation instruction: premium_allocation (applies to new premium payments), account_value_rebalance (periodic rebalancing of existing AV), transfer (one-time fund transfer), systematic_rebalance (automated periodic rebalancing), dollar_cost_averaging (DCA program allocation).
attributes.references: NAIC Variable Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: Maximum interest rate that can be credited to the policy account value for this indexed fund allocation, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 12.00 for 12%). Applicable to IUL and FIA products with capped index strategies.
