attributes.description: Code identifying the Policy Administration System instance or module that originated this Automatic Premium Loan (APL) transaction record (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, EXL). Supports data lineage and multi-system reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System — APL Module; ACORD Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier or reference number assigned by the originating Policy Administration System for this APL event. Used for reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the source system of record.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System — APL Module; ACORD Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this Automatic Premium Loan (APL) transaction by the Policy Administration System. Used in policyholder correspondence, audit trails, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System — APL Module; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the Automatic Premium Loan (APL) transaction. 'initiated' = APL triggered but not yet posted to policy loan account; 'posted' = loan amount applied and premium paid; 'reversed' = APL reversed due to subsequent premium payment or reinstatement; 'cancelled' = APL voided before posting; 'pending_reversal' = reversal in progress.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System — APL Module; NAIC Model Regulation; SAP Accounting Principles

attributes.name: trigger_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the Automatic Premium Loan (APL) was triggered by the Policy Administration System, typically at the end of the grace period when the overdue premium remains unpaid. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System — APL Module; NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this Automatic Premium Loan (APL) transaction record was last modified in the data platform (Silver Layer), such as when a reversal or status update was applied. Used for change data capture and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Standards

products.name: suspense_account
products.description: Master and transactional record tracking unallocated or unidentified premium payments held in suspense, from creation through resolution. Captures suspense receipt date, amount, payment source, reason for suspense (policy not found, NIGO, amount mismatch, 1035 exchange in transit), aging bucket, resolution status, resolution date, resolution type (applied to policy, refunded to sender, transferred to unclaimed property), resolved amount, resolving user, target policy, and escheatment reference. Provides full audit trail for suspense creation through clearance. Critical for premium reconciliation, GAAP/SAP cash management, and state unclaimed property law compliance. Source: Sapiens BillingPro suspense module.

attributes.name: suspense_account_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each suspense account record. Primary key for the suspense_account data product in the Sapiens BillingPro suspense module.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; NAIC Model Regulation; SAP Accounting Standards

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Suspense accounts hold unallocated payments that should eventually be applied to billing accounts. This FK links the suspense record to the billing_account once identified. Nullable because suspense r

attributes.name: aml_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.aml_case. Business justification: Unidentified payments in suspense require AML review when amounts are large or patterns are unusual. Source-of-funds verification and customer identification for suspense items may trigger AML case cr

attributes.name: billing_premium_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_premium_payment. Business justification: When suspense is resolved, the unallocated payment is converted to a billing_premium_payment transaction. This FK links the suspense record to the payment transaction created upon resolution. Nullable

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.annuity_contract. Business justification: Unidentified payments received for annuity contracts are held in suspense pending contract identification. The resolution workflow requires linking the suspense record to the annuity_contract once mat

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Suspense accounts post to a specific GL account governing balance sheet classification of unallocated receipts. The existing gl_suspense_account_code is a denormalized code; replacing with a proper FK

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: System identifier of the target policy to which this suspense payment is intended to be applied, if the policy can be identified. Null when the policy cannot be matched (e.g., policy not found, NIGO condition). Populated upon resolution for applied payments.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; Policy Administration System (FAST/Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Suspense account receipts require GL journal entries for unidentified premium postings and subsequent resolution entries. Insurance finance teams reconcile suspense balances to journal entries for per

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: System identifier linking to the known party record of the remitter, if the remitter can be identified in the CRM or policyholder system. Null if remitter is unknown or unmatched.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: premium_bill_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_bill. Business justification: Suspense account items are often unmatched payments that should have been applied to specific bills. When the intended bill is identified during suspense resolution, this FK captures that relationship

attributes.name: premium_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_schedule. Business justification: Suspense account records hold unidentified or unallocated premium payments. When the intended premium schedule can be identified (e.g., from policy number or remittance advice), the suspense record sh

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: System identifier of the agent or broker associated with the target policy, if identified. Used to notify the writing agent of suspense items related to their book of business and to support commission management workflows.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission); NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: remittance_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Suspense items involve unidentifiable remittances with accompanying correspondence, checks, or payment stubs requiring research. Real business process: payment reconciliation, research resolution work

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Unclaimed property/escheatment dormancy periods and reporting requirements are state-regulated. suspense_account has escheatment_state (denormalized), escheatment_reference, dormancy_expiry_date. Repl

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Categorical aging classification of the suspense item based on the number of days elapsed since receipt_date. Used for management reporting, escalation workflows, and state unclaimed property dormancy period monitoring. Recalculated daily by the billing system.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; State Unclaimed Property Laws; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: aml_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this suspense item has been flagged for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) review due to unusual payment characteristics such as large cash amounts, structuring patterns, or unidentified remitters. True = flagged for AML review; False = no AML flag.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance; Bank Secrecy Act (BSA); NAIC AML Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: applied_billing_period
attributes.description: The billing period (YYYY-MM) to which the suspense payment was applied upon resolution. Used for premium reconciliation and to ensure the payment is credited to the correct modal billing cycle (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly).
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; GAAP ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: bank_account_last4
attributes.description: Last four digits of the bank account number from which the EFT/ACH payment was drawn. Stored in masked form for reconciliation and refund routing without retaining full account data per PCI DSS requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; NACHA ACH Operating Rules; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check number from the remitter's payment instrument when the payment source type is 'check'. Used for bank reconciliation, duplicate payment detection, and NSF (Non-Sufficient Funds) tracking.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; NAIC Model Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the suspense account record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; Sapiens BillingPro Audit Log

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the received payment amount (e.g., USD, CAD). Required for multi-currency operations and foreign national policyholder payments.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: customer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the policyholder or remitter was notified about the suspense item, requesting additional information or documentation to resolve the NIGO or unmatched payment condition.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; NAIC Model Regulation; State Insurance Regulations — Policyholder Communication Requirements

attributes.name: days_in_suspense
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the payment has been held in suspense since receipt_date. Drives aging bucket assignment, escalation triggers, and unclaimed property dormancy period calculations per state law.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; State Unclaimed Property Laws

attributes.name: dormancy_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the suspense item reaches the end of the applicable state unclaimed property dormancy period, after which the funds must be escheated to the state. Calculated based on receipt_date plus the state-specific dormancy period (typically 3–5 years).
attributes.references: NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; State Unclaimed Property Laws; Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module

attributes.name: escheatment_reference
attributes.description: State unclaimed property filing reference number assigned when the suspense amount is transferred to a state's unclaimed property program. Populated when resolution_type is 'transferred_to_unclaimed'. Required for state unclaimed property law compliance and audit.
attributes.references: NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; State Unclaimed Property Laws; Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module

attributes.name: exchange_1035_reference
attributes.description: Reference number associated with a tax-free 1035 Exchange transfer when the suspense reason is '1035_exchange_in_transit'. Links the suspense item to the originating carrier's transfer documentation. Required for IRS tax compliance under IRC Section 1035.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035 (1035 Exchange); IRS Tax Compliance; Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module

attributes.name: grace_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the target policy was in a grace period at the time the suspense payment was received. True = policy was in grace period; False = policy was current. Critical for lapse administration and determining urgency of suspense resolution.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Grace Period Module; NAIC Model Regulation; State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the suspense account record. Used for change tracking, reconciliation, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; Sapiens BillingPro Audit Log

attributes.name: lockbox_batch_number
attributes.description: Bank lockbox batch identifier associated with the physical or electronic payment deposit batch in which this suspense item was received. Used for bank reconciliation and cash posting audit trail.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Premium Collection Module; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: nigo_reason
attributes.description: Specific reason the payment or accompanying documentation was classified as Not In Good Order (NIGO), when suspense_reason_code is 'nigo'. Examples include missing policy number, incorrect payee name, unsigned check, or missing 1035 Exchange transfer form.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; NAIC New Business Processing Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: nsf_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment was returned by the bank due to Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF). True = NSF return received; False = no NSF. NSF payments placed in suspense require special handling including policyholder notification and potential lapse processing.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro NSF Handling Module; NACHA ACH Operating Rules; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: originating_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier from which funds were transferred in a 1035 Exchange. Populated only when payment_source_type is '1035_exchange'. Required for IRS reporting and exchange documentation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035 (1035 Exchange); IRS Tax Compliance; NAIC Data Standards

attributes.name: payment_method_detail
attributes.description: Additional detail about the payment instrument, such as bank name, check number, wire reference number, or ACH trace number. Supports payment tracing and reconciliation with the bank lockbox or EFT/ACH processor.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; NACHA ACH Operating Rules; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: payment_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment instrument or channel through which the suspense amount was received. Drives refund processing method and AML monitoring. '1035_exchange' indicates a tax-free policy exchange under IRC Section 1035.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; IRC Section 1035; FinCEN AML/BSA; NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: premium_due_date
attributes.description: The premium due date on the target policy that this suspense payment is intended to satisfy. Used to assess whether the payment, once applied, will prevent a lapse or grace period entry.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; Policy Administration System; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the unallocated or unidentified payment was received and entered into suspense. This is the principal real-world event date for the suspense item and drives aging calculations and unclaimed property dormancy periods.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; GAAP ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the payment was received and logged into the suspense module, including timezone offset. Used for intraday reconciliation and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: received_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of the payment received and placed into suspense, in the currency of receipt. This is the raw amount as received before any adjustments, fees, or partial allocations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB LDTI; Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module

attributes.name: remitter_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or entity that submitted the payment currently held in suspense. May differ from the policyholder if payment was made by a third party, trustee, or ILIT. Required for refund processing and AML/KYC compliance.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance; NAIC KYC Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Business date on which the suspense item was fully or partially resolved. Null if the suspense item remains open. Used for cash reconciliation, premium posting, and audit trail.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; GAAP ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the suspense item was resolved, including timezone offset. Supports intraday cash management and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: Method by which the suspense item was resolved. 'applied_to_policy' = premium applied to identified policy; 'refunded_to_sender' = payment returned to remitter; 'transferred_to_unclaimed' = funds transferred to state unclaimed property; 'partial_applied' = portion applied to policy with remainder refunded or still open; 'voided' = record cancelled due to error. Null if suspense is still open.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; State Unclaimed Property Laws; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: resolved_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the suspense balance that has been resolved (applied to policy, refunded, or transferred). May be less than received_amount if partial resolution occurred. Null if suspense is still open.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the Sapiens BillingPro suspense module. Enables lineage tracing back to the operational system of record for reconciliation and data quality validation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: suspense_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason explaining why the payment was placed into suspense rather than applied directly to a policy. 'policy_not_found' = no matching policy located; 'nigo' = Not In Good Order (NIGO) — missing or incorrect documentation; 'amount_mismatch' = payment does not match expected premium; '1035_exchange_in_transit' = tax-free 1035 Exchange funds awaiting policy setup; 'duplicate_payment' = potential duplicate of an existing payment; 'unidentified_remitter' = payer cannot be identified; 'currency_mismatch' = payment currency does not match policy currency. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: policy_not_found|nigo|amount_mismatch|1035_exchange_in_transit|duplicate_payment|unidentified_remitter|currency_mismatch — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 1035 (1035 Exchange); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: suspense_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional detail about why the payment was placed in suspense. Supplements the suspense_reason_code with case-specific context entered by the billing operations team.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: suspense_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the suspense item at receipt. Used in correspondence with policyholders, agents, and remitters to track unallocated payments. Format: SUS-YYYY-NNNNNNNN.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: suspense_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the suspense item. 'open' = unresolved and pending action; 'resolved' = successfully applied to a policy; 'refunded' = returned to remitter; 'transferred_to_unclaimed' = moved to state unclaimed property; 'escheatment_pending' = awaiting formal escheatment filing; 'voided' = cancelled due to error or duplicate.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module; NAIC Unclaimed Property Model Act; State Unclaimed Property Laws

attributes.name: unresolved_amount
attributes.description: Remaining balance of the suspense item that has not yet been resolved. Equals received_amount minus resolved_amount. Used for open-item reconciliation and cash management reporting under GAAP/SAP.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944; Sapiens BillingPro Suspense Module

products.name: account
products.description: Master record representing the billing relationship entity that aggregates one or more policies under a single payer arrangement. Supports list billing (employer/group), direct bill, payroll deduction, and government allotment scenarios. Captures payer identity, billing address, payment method preference, billing frequency, account balance, account status (active, suspended, closed), last payment date, and delinquency indicator. Distinct from the policyholder identity (owned by policyholder domain) — this is the financial billing relationship. SSOT for the payer-level billing aggregation point.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the billing account record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the billing_account data product.

attributes.name: account_party_id
attributes.description: FK to policyholder.party

attributes.name: account_payer_party_id
attributes.description: FK to policyholder.party

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Billing accounts are maintained under a specific legal entity in multi-entity carrier structures. Required for statutory premium income attribution, intercompany account reconciliation, and state-leve

attributes.name: list_bill_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.list_bill_group. Business justification: A billing account that participates in a group/employer list billing arrangement belongs to a list_bill_group. The account is the child entity (member account) and the list_bill_group is the parent (g

attributes.name: primary_account_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party (individual, employer, trustee, or government entity) responsible for remitting premium payments under this billing account. Distinct from the policyholder — supports list billing, payroll deduction, and government allotment scenarios.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: primary_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Multi-policy billing accounts benefit from tracking the primary/dominant product for portfolio analysis, cross-sell targeting, customer segmentation, and account-level service strategies. Enables prod

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed agent or broker associated with this billing account for servicing and commission purposes. Used to route billing inquiries and link to the Agent and Commission Management System.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens Commission

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing account. Active indicates premiums are being collected normally; suspended indicates a temporary hold (e.g., grace period); lapsed indicates the account has passed the grace period without payment; closed indicates the account is permanently terminated; pending indicates setup in progress; reinstated indicates a previously lapsed account restored to active status.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing arrangement governing how premiums are collected. Direct bill sends invoices to the individual payer; list bill aggregates multiple policies under an employer or group sponsor; payroll deduction routes premiums through employer payroll; government allotment routes through federal/state benefit programs; EFT/ACH and bank draft indicate electronic collection methods at the account level.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: aml_review_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this billing account is currently flagged for Anti-Money Laundering (AML) review or investigation. True triggers enhanced due diligence workflows and may suspend premium collection pending compliance clearance.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; USA PATRIOT Act; NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: ape_amount
attributes.description: The Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) for all policies aggregated under this billing account, calculated as the annualized value of all modal premiums. Used for production reporting, agent compensation benchmarking, and regulatory filings. Single-premium policies contribute 10% of face value per industry convention.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: apl_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the Automatic Premium Loan (APL) provision is enabled for this billing account. When true, unpaid premiums are automatically funded by a policy loan against the cash value of eligible permanent life insurance policies, preventing lapse during the grace period.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: balance
attributes.description: Current net balance on the billing account, representing the difference between amounts billed and amounts received. A positive balance indicates an amount owed by the payer; a negative balance indicates a credit or overpayment on account.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles); GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles); Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The payer's bank account number used for ACH/EFT premium collection. Stored in tokenized or masked form per PCI DSS and NACHA security requirements. Null for non-ACH payment methods.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS; FinCEN AML/BSA; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: bank_account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account used for ACH/EFT premium collection — checking or savings. Required for NACHA ACH transaction formatting.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bank Routing Number (ABA Routing Transit Number)
attributes.description: The nine-digit ABA Routing Transit Number identifying the financial institution for ACH/EFT premium collection. Required for NACHA-compliant electronic funds transfer processing.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ABA Routing Number Standard; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: billing_account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable account number assigned by the Billing and Premium Collection System (e.g., Sapiens BillingPro) to uniquely identify the billing relationship. Used on invoices, statements, and payer correspondence.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the billing account, used for mailing premium notices, billing statements, and lapse notifications to the payer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Privacy Regulation; USPS Addressing Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, apartment, floor, PO Box) for the billing account mailing address.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Privacy Regulation; USPS Addressing Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City component of the billing account mailing address.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Privacy Regulation; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the billing account mailing address (e.g., USA). Supports international payer scenarios and FATCA/AML compliance.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: The modal billing frequency at which premium invoices are generated and collected for all policies under this billing account. Drives the premium billing schedule and modal factor application (e.g., monthly modal factor applied to annual premium equivalent).
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: billing_notice_preference
attributes.description: Payer's preferred channel for receiving premium billing notices, statements, and lapse warnings. Drives the billing notice generation and delivery workflow in the Billing and Premium Collection System.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the billing account mailing address. Used for premium notice delivery and geographic segmentation.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; NAIC Model Privacy Regulation

attributes.name: billing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code for the billing account mailing address. Drives state-specific regulatory compliance, premium tax calculations, and grace period rules per state Department of Insurance requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; USPS State Abbreviations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this billing account record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail requirements, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this billing account (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency payer scenarios for international life insurance products.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: delinquency_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this billing account is currently delinquent — i.e., a premium payment is past due and the account is within or beyond the grace period. True indicates delinquent status requiring collection action or lapse processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this billing account became active and premium collection obligations commenced. Aligns with the earliest policy effective date under this account.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: eft_authorization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payer authorized Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT)/ACH debit for premium collection. Required for NACHA compliance to evidence pre-authorization of recurring ACH debits. Null for non-EFT payment methods.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the grace period expires for the current unpaid billing cycle. After this date, policies under the account are subject to lapse per state-mandated grace period rules (typically 30 days for life insurance, 61 days for some products). Null when account is current.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; IRC Section 7702; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: kyc_verified_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payer has completed Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification as required by AML/BSA regulations. True indicates verification is complete and on file. Required for FinCEN compliance and AML program adherence.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Model Regulation; USA PATRIOT Act; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: last_nsf_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF) or returned payment event on this billing account. Used alongside NSF count to assess payment reliability and trigger EFT suspension rules.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the most recent premium payment received on this billing account. Used for reconciliation, delinquency analysis, and partial payment tracking.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent premium payment was successfully received and applied to this billing account. Used for delinquency monitoring, grace period calculation, and lapse administration.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: next_due_date
attributes.description: The date on which the next premium payment is due for this billing account based on the billing frequency and last payment date. Drives billing notice generation and grace period monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: nsf_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF) or returned payment events on this billing account. Used for payment risk scoring, EFT eligibility assessment, and potential account suspension decisions.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: paperless_billing_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payer has opted into paperless (electronic-only) billing and statement delivery, suppressing physical mail generation. Supports green initiative tracking and operational cost reduction.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The preferred payment instrument used to remit premiums for this billing account. ACH/EFT indicates electronic funds transfer from a bank account; check indicates paper check; credit card indicates card-based payment; wire transfer indicates bank wire; payroll deduction and government allotment indicate employer or agency-routed collection.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NACHA Operating Rules (ACH); PCI DSS; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: policy_count
attributes.description: Number of active insurance policies currently aggregated under this billing account. Supports list billing administration and account-level premium aggregation reporting.

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously lapsed billing account was reinstated following satisfaction of reinstatement requirements (e.g., payment of back premiums, evidence of insurability). Null for accounts that have never lapsed or have not been reinstated.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this billing account record was ingested (e.g., SAPIENS_BILLING, MAJESCO_BILLING, FAST_BILLING). Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this billing account was permanently closed or terminated. Null for accounts that remain active or suspended. Populated upon account closure, policy lapse beyond reinstatement window, or group contract termination.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: The total premium amount currently billed and outstanding on this billing account for the current billing cycle, covering all policies and riders under the account. Represents the gross amount due before any credits or adjustments.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this billing account record was most recently modified in the source system. Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Data Standards

products.name: list_bill_group
products.description: Master record for employer or group list billing arrangements where a single bill is issued to a group administrator (employer, association, BGA) covering multiple employee/member policies. Captures group administrator identity, group billing address, billing cycle, total group premium, remittance reconciliation method, and group billing status. Supports payroll deduction and employer-sponsored life insurance billing workflows.

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the list bill group record in the billing system. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: plan_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.producer. Business justification: List bill groups (employer/group billing arrangements) are managed by group producers or GAs responsible for the account relationship, commission allocation, and ongoing servicing. Essential for group

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Group billing arrangements with ERISA plans, employer groups, and association groups carry specific regulatory obligations (ERISA, DOL, state group insurance laws). list_bill_group has erisa_plan_indi

attributes.name: administrator_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary billing contact at the group administrator organization. Used for electronic invoice delivery, billing notifications, and remittance reconciliation correspondence.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance

attributes.name: administrator_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the group administrator organization responsible for billing inquiries, remittance, and enrollment changes.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance

attributes.name: administrator_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the group administrator's billing contact. Used for billing inquiries, NSF resolution, and remittance reconciliation communications.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance

attributes.name: aml_review_status
attributes.description: Current Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) review status for the group administrator entity. Required for FinCEN BSA compliance and NAIC AML Model Regulation adherence.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC AML Model Regulation; USA PATRIOT Act; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: ape_amount
attributes.description: Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) for the list bill group, calculated as the annualized total of all member policy premiums. Used for new business production reporting, sales performance measurement, and actuarial analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SAP; NAIC Annual Statement; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number of the group administrator used for ACH/EFT premium remittance. Stored in tokenized or masked form per PCI-DSS requirements. Required for automated debit arrangements.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI-DSS; FinCEN AML/BSA; SOX

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number of the group administrator's financial institution used for ACH/EFT premium remittance. Nine-digit identifier assigned by the American Bankers Association.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation E; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the group administrator's billing address where invoices and billing correspondence are sent.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: billing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, floor, department, attention line) for the group administrator's billing address.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the group administrator's billing address.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the group administrator's billing address. Typically USA for domestic group life insurance arrangements.

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: Modal billing frequency at which a consolidated list bill invoice is issued to the group administrator. Determines the billing schedule and premium due dates for all member policies within the group.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: billing_day_of_month
attributes.description: Day of the month (1–28) on which the list bill invoice is generated and sent to the group administrator. Aligns with payroll deduction cycles for employer-sponsored plans.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance

attributes.name: billing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code for the group administrator's billing address. Determines applicable state insurance regulations and premium tax jurisdiction.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; NAIC State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: billing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the list bill group billing arrangement. Controls whether invoices are generated and whether member policies remain in force. Values: active (billing current), suspended (billing paused), lapsed (premium not received past grace period), terminated (group arrangement closed), pending_setup (new group being onboarded), grace_period (payment overdue but within grace window).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: billing_zip_code
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the group administrator's billing address.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this list bill group record. Typically USD for domestic US life insurance group billing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 944; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the list bill group billing arrangement became or becomes effective. Marks the start of the billing relationship and the first premium due date cycle.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance; IRC Section 7702; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: employer_contribution_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer contributes to the premium cost for member policies (employer-paid or contributory plan). True = employer contributes; False = fully employee-paid (non-contributory from employer perspective).
attributes.references: DOL ERISA; IRC Section 79; NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance

attributes.name: employer_contribution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total group premium contributed by the employer. Ranges from 0.00 (fully employee-paid) to 100.00 (fully employer-paid). Used for premium allocation, payroll reporting, and IRC Section 79 imputed income calculations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 79; DOL ERISA; NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance

attributes.name: erisa_plan_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Plan Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group billing arrangement is associated with an ERISA-governed employer-sponsored benefit plan. True = ERISA plan subject to DOL fiduciary and reporting requirements; False = non-ERISA arrangement.
attributes.references: DOL ERISA; DOL Form 5500; NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the premium due date during which the group administrator may remit payment without triggering lapse or suspension of member policies. Typically 31 days per NAIC model regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance; State Departments of Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Legal or trade name of the employer, association, or Brokerage General Agency (BGA) acting as the group administrator responsible for remitting consolidated premium payments on behalf of member policyholders.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance

attributes.name: group_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the list bill group by the billing system. Used on remittance statements, invoices, and correspondence with the group administrator. Maps to the group billing account number in Sapiens BillingPro.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Group Billing Guidelines; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group administrator entity. Determines billing workflow, regulatory treatment, and commission routing. Values: employer (payroll deduction sponsor), association (member organization), bga (Brokerage General Agency), mga (Managing General Agent), tpa (Third Party Administrator), trust (ILIT or employer trust). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: employer|association|bga|mga|tpa|trust — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the consolidated list bill invoice is delivered to the group administrator. Values: email (electronic delivery), mail (paper mail), portal (self-service web portal), edi (Electronic Data Interchange), fax.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the most recent consolidated premium payment received from the group administrator. Used for remittance reconciliation and underpayment/overpayment detection.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent consolidated premium payment was received from the group administrator. Used for grace period tracking, lapse administration, and billing status determination.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the list bill group record, including status changes, billing parameter updates, or administrator contact changes. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Market Conduct; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: member_policy_count
attributes.description: Current number of individual employee or member policies enrolled under this list bill group arrangement. Used for billing validation, group size reporting, and experience rating.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: next_bill_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which the next consolidated list bill invoice will be generated and sent to the group administrator. Derived from billing cycle and billing day of month but stored for operational scheduling.
attributes.references: Sapiens BillingPro; NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance

attributes.name: nsf_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of Non-Sufficient Funds (NSF) or returned payment events for this list bill group. Used for risk monitoring, payment method review, and potential suspension triggers.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the group administrator remits consolidated premium payments. Drives EFT/ACH setup, lockbox routing, and NSF handling workflows. Values: ach (Automated Clearing House), eft (Electronic Funds Transfer), check, wire (wire transfer), lockbox (bank lockbox remittance).
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Sapiens BillingPro; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: payroll_deduction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether member premiums are collected via employer payroll deduction and remitted as part of the consolidated list bill. True = payroll deduction arrangement; False = direct employer-paid or other remittance method.
attributes.references: DOL ERISA; NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: remittance_reconciliation_method
attributes.description: Method used to reconcile the group administrator's remittance against individual member policy premiums. Self-administered: employer submits detailed enrollment roster; carrier-administered: insurer maintains member records; tpa-administered: Third Party Administrator (TPA) manages reconciliation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance; ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: setup_date
attributes.description: Date on which the list bill group arrangement was initially established and configured in the billing system. Represents the record creation date from a business perspective.

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code identifying the industry of the employer or group administrator. Used for experience rating, underwriting risk segmentation, and group life insurance pricing.
attributes.references: US Department of Labor SIC Manual; NAIC Underwriting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational billing system of record from which this list bill group record was sourced (e.g., SAPIENS_BILLING, MAJESCO_BILLING). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; SOX IT General Controls

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the group administrator entity. Required for IRS reporting, AML/KYC compliance, and premium tax filings.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRC Section 6041; FinCEN AML/BSA; NAIC Annual Statement

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the list bill group billing arrangement was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null for active, open-ended arrangements. Triggers conversion or lapse processing for member policies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Group Life Insurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: total_group_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total consolidated premium amount billed to the group administrator for the current billing cycle, aggregating all member policy premiums within the group. Expressed in USD. Used for remittance reconciliation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944; SAP; NAIC Annual Statement; Sapiens BillingPro

products.name: premium_adjustment
products.description: Transactional record of premium adjustments applied to a policy's billing schedule, including rate changes due to policy anniversary, attained age recalculation, rider addition or removal, face amount change, risk class reclassification, cost of living adjustment (COLA), or regulatory rate revision. Captures adjustment effective date, prior premium amount, new premium amount, adjustment reason code, authorizing source system transaction, and approval status. Provides audit trail for all premium amount changes on the billing schedule.

attributes.name: premium_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each premium adjustment transaction record on a policy billing schedule. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Data Model

attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance policy whose billing schedule is being adjusted. Links the adjustment to the master policy record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Policy Administration Standards

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policyholder.insured. Business justification: Premium adjustments are driven by insured risk changes — tobacco status change, occupation reclassification, table rating removal, or attained-age recalculation. Regulatory rate change filings and pre

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Premium adjustments from rate changes, rider additions, or corrections require correcting journal entries. Essential for revenue accuracy, SOX controls, and audit trail. Links billing changes to finan

attributes.name: new_risk_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.risk_class. Business justification: Premium adjustments triggered by post-issue risk class changes (rating improvements, reconsiderations) must reference the new underwriting risk_class. premium_adjustment.new_risk_class and prior_risk_

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Premium adjustments must comply with product plan rules (COLA provisions, face amount change limits, rate adjustment triggers). Required for billing accuracy validation, regulatory compliance audits,

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Premium adjustments triggered by plan version changes must reference the new plan version to document what changed. This supports regulatory reporting on version-driven billing changes, actuarial audi

attributes.name: premium_bill_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific premium bill record on which this adjustment is applied, linking the adjustment to the billing cycle in which it takes effect.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; Sapiens BillingPro Premium Adjustment Module

attributes.name: premium_rate_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.premium_rate_table. Business justification: Premium adjustments for attained-age recalculations, face amount changes, and rate revisions are directly driven by a specific premium rate table version. Regulatory filings and actuarial audit trails

attributes.name: premium_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_schedule. Business justification: Premium adjustments modify premium schedules (rate changes, face amount changes, rider additions/removals, COLA adjustments). This FK links the adjustment transaction to the premium schedule being mod

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.producer. Business justification: Premium adjustments impact commission calculations and require producer notification for servicing. Tracking the servicing producer enables proper commission adjustments, chargebacks, and producer com

attributes.name: rate_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.rate_action. Business justification: Rate actions (COI increases, crediting rate changes) directly trigger premium adjustments for in-force policies. This link provides end-to-end traceability from product rate decision to billing impact

attributes.name: rate_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.rate_filing. Business justification: Premium adjustments implementing approved rate changes must reference the DOI-approved rate filing. Required for rate compliance verification, audit trail, and ensuring adjustments match approved rate

attributes.name: reversed_adjustment_premium_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original premium_adjustment_id that this record reverses, when reversal_indicator is True. Enables bidirectional audit trail linking between original and reversal adjustment records.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Premium adjustments must comply with state-mandated consumer notice requirements, effective date rules, and rate change limitations. state_of_issue is a denormalized reference; replacing with FK to st

attributes.name: statutory_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.statutory_reserve. Business justification: Premium adjustments (face amount changes, rate revisions, COLA) directly affect statutory reserve levels. Actuarial and finance teams must link adjustments to the impacted reserve for SAP reserve chan

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The net monetary change in modal premium resulting from this adjustment (new_modal_premium minus prior_modal_premium). A positive value indicates a premium increase; a negative value indicates a decrease. Used for financial reporting and actuarial analysis.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; FASB ASC 944; LDTI; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: adjustment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this premium adjustment transaction, assigned by the Policy Administration System or Billing System (e.g., ADJ-2024-00123456). Used for audit trail, correspondence, and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; Sapiens BillingPro; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for the premium adjustment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ANNIV_RATE_CHG|ATTAINED_AGE|RIDER_ADD|RIDER_REMOVE|FACE_AMT_CHG|RISK_RECLASS|COLA|REG_RATE_REV|UW_REVISION|BILLING_CORR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the reason for the premium adjustment, providing additional context beyond the standardized reason code. May include details such as the specific rider added, the new risk class assigned, or the regulatory revision reference.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the premium adjustment record. 'pending' indicates awaiting approval; 'approved' indicates authorized but not yet applied to billing; 'applied' indicates posted to the billing schedule; 'reversed' indicates a previously applied adjustment that has been backed out; 'rejected' indicates the adjustment was denied.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens BillingPro Adjustment Workflow

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the direction and nature of the premium adjustment. 'increase' indicates the new premium is higher than the prior; 'decrease' indicates the new premium is lower; 'correction' indicates a billing error fix with no net change in intended premium; 'reversal' indicates the cancellation of a previously applied adjustment.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this premium adjustment required and received formal authorization. 'not_required' for system-generated adjustments within automated rules; 'pending' for adjustments awaiting human review; 'approved' for authorized adjustments; 'rejected' for denied adjustments. Supports SOX and market conduct compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this premium adjustment was formally approved by the authorizing user or automated system. Null when approval_status is 'not_required' or 'pending'. Supports SOX audit trail and turnaround time reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the individual or automated process that approved this premium adjustment. Null when approval_status is 'not_required'. Required for SOX audit trail on manual or exception adjustments.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: attained_age
attributes.description: The insured's attained age (in whole years) at the time of this premium adjustment. Relevant for attained-age recalculation adjustments on Yearly Renewable Term (YRT), Universal Life (UL), and Indexed Universal Life (IUL) products where COI rates are age-banded.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: billing_mode
attributes.description: The modal billing frequency of the policy at the time of this adjustment (annual, semi-annual, quarterly, or monthly). Determines the modal factor applied to convert annual premium to the scheduled payment amount.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens BillingPro

attributes.name: cola_rate
attributes.description: The Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) percentage rate applied to the premium when the adjustment_reason_code is COLA. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0300 for 3%). Null for non-COLA adjustments.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; Consumer Price Index (CPI) Standards

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Identifies the specific premium component affected by this adjustment: 'base' for the base policy premium, 'rider' for a policy rider premium, 'coi' for Cost of Insurance (COI) charges on universal life products, or 'apl' for Automatic Premium Loan (APL) repayment component.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; IRC Section 7702; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this premium adjustment record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency policy administration for international or expatriate life insurance products.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Life Data Model

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the premium adjustment becomes effective on the policy billing schedule. This is the business event date — the date from which the new premium amount applies, which may differ from the transaction processing date.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; IRC Section 7702; NAIC Policy Administration Standards

attributes.name: mec_test_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this premium adjustment triggered a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) test review under IRC Section 7702A. True when the adjustment requires validation that the new premium level does not cause the policy to fail the 7-pay test and become classified as a MEC.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702A; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; IRS MEC Compliance Standards

attributes.name: new_annual_premium
attributes.description: The annualized premium amount (Annual Premium Equivalent) that will apply after this adjustment, calculated by annualizing the new modal premium based on the billing mode. Supports APE reporting, actuarial reserving, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Annual Statement; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: new_face_amount
attributes.description: The policy face amount (death benefit) that applies after this adjustment. Captured when the adjustment is triggered by a face amount change. Used to verify 7702 compliance and recalculate guideline premium limits.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; IRC Section 7702 GPT/CVAT; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: new_modal_premium
attributes.description: The modal premium amount (per billing frequency) that will apply to the policy billing schedule after this adjustment is applied. This becomes the new scheduled premium for future billing cycles.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, exception handling comments, or supplementary context recorded by the billing operations team regarding this premium adjustment. Not used for structured data; intended for human-readable commentary.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The policy year (1-based count from policy issue date) in which this premium adjustment is effective. Used for anniversary-based rate change processing, attained age recalculations, and actuarial experience studies.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: prior_annual_premium
attributes.description: The annualized premium amount (Annual Premium Equivalent) in effect before this adjustment, calculated by annualizing the prior modal premium based on the billing mode. Supports APE reporting and actuarial valuation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Annual Statement; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: prior_face_amount
attributes.description: The policy face amount (death benefit) in effect before this adjustment. Captured when the adjustment is triggered by a face amount change, as face amount directly drives base premium calculations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; IRC Section 7702 GPT/CVAT; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: prior_modal_premium
attributes.description: The modal premium amount (per billing frequency) in effect on the policy billing schedule immediately before this adjustment was applied. Provides the baseline for calculating the adjustment delta and supports audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the premium adjustment was fully processed and posted to the billing schedule in the Policy Administration or Billing System. Supports audit trail and SLA monitoring for billing operations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Sapiens BillingPro Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The internal product code identifying the life insurance or annuity product type associated with the policy (e.g., WL, UL, IUL, VUL, YRT, SPIA, FIA). Supports product-level premium adjustment analytics and actuarial segmentation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Product Filing Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_revision_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the regulatory filing, state department of insurance bulletin, or NAIC model regulation revision that mandated this premium rate adjustment. Populated when adjustment_reason_code is REG_RATE_REV. Supports regulatory compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; State Departments of Insurance Rate Filing Requirements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this adjustment record is a reversal of a previously applied adjustment. True when this record cancels and backs out a prior adjustment; False for original adjustments. Used in financial reconciliation to net out reversed transactions.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: rider_code
attributes.description: The standardized code identifying the specific policy rider whose premium is being adjusted, when the component_type is 'rider'. Examples include ADB (Accidental Death Benefit), AWL (Automatic Waiver of Premium), LTC (Long-Term Care), or DI (Disability Income) riders. Null when adjustment applies to base premium or COI.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: seven_pay_premium
attributes.description: The maximum annual premium allowed under the IRC Section 7702A seven-pay test at the time of this adjustment. Captured when mec_test_flag is True to document the compliance threshold against which the new premium was evaluated.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702A; IRS MEC Compliance Standards; NAIC Life Insurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this premium adjustment transaction. 'PAS' = Policy Administration System (e.g., Sapiens LifePro, FAST); 'BILLING' = Billing and Premium Collection System (e.g., Sapiens BillingPro); 'UW_WORKBENCH' = Underwriting Workbench; 'ACTUARIAL' = Actuarial Valuation System; 'MANUAL' = manual override by authorized user.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Model; SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The transaction identifier from the originating source system (Policy Administration System or Billing System) that authorized and triggered this premium adjustment. Provides end-to-end traceability from the billing data product back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the premium adjustment transaction was created and recorded in the source system. Represents the system-of-record capture time, distinct from the business effective date.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life Data Model; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

domains.name: annuity
domains.description: Dedicated operational domain for annuity contract administration distinct from life policy processing. Owns AV (Account Value), accumulation phase tracking, payout phase calculations, GMWB/GMIB/GMAB benefit base management, RMD tracking, 1035 exchange processing, withdrawal processing (systematic and ad-hoc), annuitization, and FIA index crediting. Manages annuity-specific compliance including tax reporting under IRC Section 72.

products.name: contract
products.description: Master record for each annuity contract issued by the company, serving as the SSOT for all annuity contract administration. Captures contract type (Fixed, Fixed Indexed, Variable, SPIA, MYGA), issue date, contract status, annuitant identity, owner identity, contract phase (accumulation vs payout), surrender charge schedule (declining charge percentages by contract year, free withdrawal allowance, MVA applicability, and waiver conditions for nursing home, terminal illness, unemployment, disability), market value adjustment (MVA) flag, tax qualification status (qualified IRA, Roth IRA, 403b, 457, non-qualified), IRC Section 72 tax treatment, 1035 exchange indicator, ownership type (individual, joint, trust, entity), and contract currency. Serves as the parent entity for all annuity domain transactions and valuations.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: Annuity contracts often originate from underwriting applications (deferred annuities sold with life insurance, standalone annuity applications requiring underwriting for large cases or impaired risk a

attributes.name: uw_decision_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.decision. Business justification: New business processing and audit trails require tracing which underwriting decision authorized contract issuance. Compliance and new business operations teams use this link to verify approved face am

attributes.name: account_value
attributes.description: Current Account Value (AV) of the annuity contract as of the last valuation date — the total accumulated value including all premiums paid, interest/index credits earned, and minus all withdrawals, fees, and charges. The AV is the primary valuation metric for deferred annuity contracts and drives CSV, death benefit, and GMWB benefit base calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: account_value_date
attributes.description: The valuation date as of which the account_value field was last calculated and recorded. Essential for point-in-time reporting, actuarial reserving, and reconciliation with the Actuarial Valuation System (e.g., AXIS, Prophet).
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: annuitization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract transitioned from the accumulation phase to the payout (annuitization) phase. Null for contracts still in accumulation. Populated when contract_status = ANNUITIZED. Drives payout benefit calculations and IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio computations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract number assigned by the Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity, FAST Annuity) at issuance. Used in all owner correspondence, statements, and regulatory filings. Maps to the contract_id field in the source system.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the annuity contract as maintained in the Annuity Administration Platform. ACTIVE = in-force accumulation or payout; SURRENDERED = full surrender processed; ANNUITIZED = converted to payout phase; LAPSED = terminated for non-payment; PENDING = application received, not yet issued; DEATH_CLAIM = death benefit claim in progress.
attributes.references: NAIC Life & Annuity Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the annuity product type: FIXED (traditional fixed annuity), FIA (Fixed Indexed Annuity), VARIABLE (Variable Annuity / VUL-linked), SPIA (Single Premium Immediate Annuity), or MYGA (Multi-Year Guaranteed Annuity). Drives product-specific processing rules, crediting methods, and regulatory treatment.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation #275; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: cost_basis_amount
attributes.description: The owner's investment in the contract (cost basis) for IRC Section 72 tax purposes — the total after-tax premiums paid minus any previously recovered basis through tax-free distributions. Used to calculate the taxable portion of withdrawals and the exclusion ratio upon annuitization. Carried forward from prior contract in 1035 exchanges.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; IRS Form 1099-R

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this annuity contract record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Represents the data ingestion audit trail timestamp, not the contract issue date. Required for SOX audit trail and data lineage compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; NAIC Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: csv_amount
attributes.description: The Cash Surrender Value (CSV) — the net amount the contract owner would receive upon full surrender, calculated as the Account Value minus applicable surrender charges and market value adjustment (MVA). Represents the owner's actual liquidity value at any point in time.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the annuity contract is denominated (e.g., USD). All monetary values on this contract record are expressed in this currency. Supports multi-currency operations for international annuity products.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: current_surrender_charge_pct
attributes.description: The surrender charge percentage currently applicable to this contract based on the current contract year within the surrender charge schedule (e.g., 0.0700 = 7%). Updated annually on the contract anniversary. Used to calculate CSV and net surrender proceeds.
