attributes.description: The date on which the IRS Form 5498 reporting the RMD obligation was filed or transmitted to the IRS. Null if form_5498_reported_flag is False. Supports tax reporting audit trails.
attributes.references: IRS Form 5498; IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 408(i)

attributes.name: form_5498_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RMD obligation for this calendar year has been reported to the IRS on Form 5498 (IRA Contribution Information), which requires insurers to report the RMD amount and indicate that an RMD is required for the year. Supports IRS tax reporting compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Form 5498; IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 408(i); NAIC

attributes.name: inherited_contract_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract is an inherited (beneficiary) contract subject to the IRS 10-year rule or life expectancy payout rules under SECURE Act 2.0. When True, the Single Life Expectancy Table and beneficiary-specific RMD rules apply.
attributes.references: SECURE Act 2.0; IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72(s); IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: The channel through which the RMD notification was delivered to the contract owner. 'suppressed' indicates the owner opted out of notifications or the notification was withheld for a documented reason.
attributes.references: IRS Reg. 1.408-8 Q&A-10; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity); CRM and Customer Engagement Platform

attributes.name: original_owner_dod
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Contract Owner Date of Death
attributes.description: The date of death of the original annuity contract owner, applicable when inherited_contract_flag is True. Determines the commencement of the beneficiary's RMD obligation and the applicable distribution rules under SECURE Act 2.0 (10-year rule vs. life expectancy payout).
attributes.references: SECURE Act 2.0; IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72(s); IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-3

attributes.name: owner_age_at_rmd_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Owner Age at RMD Year
attributes.description: The age of the annuity contract owner as of their birthday in the RMD calculation year. Used to look up the applicable distribution period from the IRS life expectancy table. Per IRS rules, age is determined as of the owner's birthday in the distribution year.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-5; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: owner_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract owner was notified of their RMD obligation and calculated amount for the calendar year. IRS regulations require insurers to notify IRA owners of their RMD amount by January 31 of the distribution year. Supports regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IRS Reg. 1.408-8 Q&A-10; IRS Publication 590-B; NAIC

attributes.name: prior_calculated_rmd_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Calculated Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) Amount
attributes.description: The RMD amount from the most recent prior calculation before the current recalculation. Populated only when recalculation_flag is True. Supports audit trails and change management for IRS reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — RMD tracking module)

attributes.name: prior_year_end_av
attributes.description: The Account Value (AV) of the annuity contract as of December 31 of the year immediately preceding the RMD calculation year. This is the IRS-mandated valuation date for RMD calculation purposes. Sourced from the Annuity Administration Platform's end-of-year account value snapshot.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; IRS Reg. 1.401(a)(9)-5; Annuity Administration Platform (FAST Annuity; Sapiens Annuity)

attributes.name: prior_year_end_av_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Year-End Account Value (AV) Valuation Date
attributes.description: The specific date on which the prior year-end Account Value (AV) was captured for RMD calculation purposes. Should be December 31 of the prior year. Recorded explicitly to support audit trails and IRS Form 5498 reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRS Form 5498; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: qualified_plan_type
attributes.description: The type of qualified retirement plan or IRA under which the annuity contract is held, which determines the applicable RMD rules, tax treatment, and reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: traditional_ira|sep_ira|simple_ira|401k|403b|457b|inherited_ira — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 590-B; ERISA; DOL fiduciary standards; IRS Form 5498

attributes.name: recalculation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RMD amount for this calendar year has been recalculated after the initial calculation, typically due to a correction in the prior year-end account value, a change in the applicable life expectancy table, or a data correction. When True, recalculation_reason should be populated.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — RMD tracking module)

attributes.name: recalculation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the RMD was recalculated for the calendar year. Applicable only when recalculation_flag is True. Examples include account value restatement, beneficiary designation change, table correction, or data quality remediation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — RMD tracking module)

attributes.name: remaining_rmd_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding RMD amount still required to be distributed to satisfy the IRS obligation for the calendar year. Computed as calculated_rmd_amount minus ytd_distributions_applied. A zero or negative value indicates the RMD has been satisfied. Used for proactive owner notifications and IRS compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 4974; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: rmd_calculation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RMD amount was calculated by the Annuity Administration Platform for the given calendar year. Supports audit trails and recalculation tracking when account values are restated or corrected.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — RMD tracking module); IRS Publication 590-B

attributes.name: rmd_due_date
attributes.description: The IRS deadline by which the RMD must be fully distributed to avoid the IRC Section 4974 excise tax. For most owners, this is December 31 of the RMD year. For the first RMD year (the year the owner reaches the applicable RMD age), the deadline may be extended to April 1 of the following year per IRS rules.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; IRC Section 4974; SECURE Act 2.0 (RMD age changes)

attributes.name: rmd_satisfied_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RMD obligation for the calendar year was fully satisfied (i.e., cumulative distributions reached or exceeded the calculated RMD amount). Null if the RMD has not yet been satisfied. Used for IRS Form 1099-R reporting and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-R; IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; IRC Section 4974

attributes.name: rmd_start_age
attributes.description: The IRS-mandated age at which the contract owner is required to begin taking RMDs from the qualified annuity. Reflects the applicable RMD age under current law (e.g., age 73 under SECURE Act 2.0 for owners born 1951–1959; age 75 for owners born 1960 or later). Stored to support historical accuracy as legislation changes.
attributes.references: SECURE Act 2.0 (Consolidated Appropriations Act 2023); IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 590-B

attributes.name: rmd_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RMD obligation for the given calendar year. 'pending' = RMD calculated but no distributions taken; 'in_progress' = partial distributions applied; 'satisfied' = full RMD amount distributed; 'waived' = IRS-approved waiver applied (e.g., first-year RMD deferral); 'overdue' = due date passed without satisfaction; 'cancelled' = contract no longer subject to RMD (e.g., annuitized, surrendered).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 4974 (excise tax on insufficient distributions); SECURE Act 2.0

attributes.name: rmd_year
attributes.description: The calendar year (YYYY) for which this RMD obligation applies. Each qualified annuity contract generates one RMD schedule record per applicable calendar year. Determines the December 31 prior-year account value snapshot used in the RMD calculation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 590-B; IRS RMD rules under SECURE Act 2.0

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the operational source system record from which this RMD schedule was originated or last updated (e.g., Sapiens Annuity contract ID, FAST Annuity record key). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL audit trails in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — RMD tracking module); ACORD data standards

attributes.name: systematic_rmd_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Systematic Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) Program Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract owner is enrolled in the annuity platform's automatic systematic RMD distribution program, which automatically calculates and distributes the RMD amount on a scheduled basis (monthly, quarterly, or annually) to ensure timely satisfaction.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module); IRS Publication 590-B

attributes.name: systematic_rmd_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which systematic RMD distributions are scheduled when the owner is enrolled in the automatic RMD program (systematic_rmd_flag = True). Null when systematic RMD is not elected.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module); IRS Publication 590-B

attributes.name: systematic_rmd_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract owner's enrollment in the systematic RMD distribution program became effective. Null when systematic RMD is not elected.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity — withdrawal processing module)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this RMD schedule record was most recently modified in the data platform. Updated whenever distributions are applied, recalculations occur, or status changes. Supports audit trails and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC data governance standards; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why the RMD obligation has been waived for the calendar year. Applicable only when rmd_status is 'waived'. Examples include first-year deferral election, IRS-approved waiver, contract annuitization, full surrender, or regulatory relief (e.g., COVID-19 CARES Act waiver).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; CARES Act (2020 RMD waiver); SECURE Act 2.0

attributes.name: ytd_distributions_applied
attributes.description: The cumulative amount of distributions taken from the annuity contract during the RMD calendar year that have been applied toward satisfying the RMD obligation. Updated each time a qualifying withdrawal is processed. Used to compute the remaining RMD balance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 590-B; IRC Section 72; Annuity Administration Platform (FAST Annuity; Sapiens Annuity — withdrawal processing module)

products.name: index_crediting_strategy
products.description: Defines and manages all investment allocation strategies elected for annuity contracts, covering both FIA index crediting strategies and variable annuity sub-account fund allocations — serving as the single source of truth for ALL annuity investment allocation management (subsumes sub_account_allocation). For FIA: captures index name (S&P 500, Russell 2000, MSCI EAFE), crediting method (annual point-to-point, monthly average, monthly cap), cap rate, participation rate, spread/margin, floor rate, buffer rate, and crediting term dates. For variable annuity: captures sub-account fund name, fund CUSIP, allocation percentage, current unit value, number of units held, current market value, allocation effective date, and rebalancing instructions. Common fields: allocation percentage, allocation effective date, strategy/fund election status, and transfer/rebalance history. Supports FIA index credit calculations, VA NAV-based AV calculations, and policyholder allocation reporting.

attributes.name: index_crediting_strategy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each index crediting strategy or sub-account allocation record associated with an annuity contract. Serves as the primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract to which this index crediting strategy or sub-account allocation belongs. Links the strategy to its parent contract in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: crediting_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.crediting_strategy. Business justification: Contract-level strategy elections reference product crediting strategy definitions for cap/participation rates, index types, crediting methods, and allocation limits. Essential for index credit calcul

attributes.name: derivative_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.derivative_contract. Business justification: Each FIA index crediting strategy term is hedged by a specific index option (derivative contract). This link supports GAAP ASC 815 hedge accounting, NAIC Schedule DB derivative reporting, and hedge ef

attributes.name: index_security_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.security. Business justification: FIA index strategies reference specific market indices (S&P 500, NASDAQ-100) that are securities in the investment master. Crediting calculations, cap/participation rate setting, and option pricing re

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: FIA crediting strategies with cap rates, participation rates, and index options are version-specific and change with product filings. Required for rate renewal processing, strategy availability valida

attributes.name: policy_form_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy_form_approval. Business justification: FIA crediting strategies (cap, participation, spread rates) must match approved policy forms and illustrations. Links strategy elections to approved form language for regulatory compliance validation.

attributes.name: prior_strategy_index_crediting_strategy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the predecessor index crediting strategy record that this record replaced or was renewed from. Enables transfer and rebalance history tracking and supports audit trail requirements for policyholder allocation changes.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: rate_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.rate_action. Business justification: FIA renewal rate-setting is driven by rate_action records. index_crediting_strategy has renewal_election and renewal_rate_flag indicating rate renewal events. Linking to rate_action enables renewal ra

attributes.name: rate_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.rate_filing. Business justification: FIA index crediting strategy parameters (cap rates, participation rates, spreads) are subject to state rate filings. The index_crediting_strategy must reference the approved rate filing to validate th

attributes.name: scenario_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.scenario_set. Business justification: FIA index crediting strategies are priced and hedged using economic scenario sets for option budget calculations and hedge effectiveness testing. Actuaries use this link to validate that credited rate

attributes.name: allocation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of new premium and/or account value directed to this specific strategy or sub-account. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 25.0000 = 25%). All active strategy allocations for a contract must sum to 100%. Governs how premium deposits and rebalancing flows are distributed.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this strategy election on the contract. 'active' = currently receiving allocations and crediting; 'pending' = elected but not yet effective; 'terminated' = no longer active; 'suspended' = temporarily halted; 'transferred' = funds moved to another strategy.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Platform

attributes.name: av_at_term_end
attributes.description: Account Value (AV) allocated to this FIA strategy at the end of the crediting term after interest has been credited, in USD. Reflects the starting AV plus credited interest minus any withdrawals during the term. Null for open terms and VA sub-account strategies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: av_at_term_start
attributes.description: Account Value (AV) allocated to this FIA strategy at the beginning of the crediting term, in USD. Serves as the basis for interest crediting calculations at term end. Null for VA sub-account strategies where unit-based valuation applies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: buffer_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of index loss absorbed by the carrier before the policyholder bears downside risk, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 10.0000 = 10%). Used in buffered or RILA-style FIA strategies as an alternative to a floor. Null for floor-based strategies and VA sub-accounts.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; SEC Registration (for registered index-linked annuities)

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: Maximum index-linked interest rate that can be credited to the FIA strategy in a given crediting term, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 8.5000 = 8.5%). Limits the upside participation in index gains. Null for uncapped strategies and VA sub-accounts. Set by the carrier and subject to contractual minimums filed with state regulators.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; State Department of Insurance Product Filing

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this index crediting strategy record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: credited_interest_rate
attributes.description: Actual index-linked interest rate credited to the FIA strategy at the end of the crediting term, expressed as a decimal percentage. Reflects the application of cap, participation rate, spread, floor, and buffer mechanics to the raw index change. Populated only after term completion. Null for open terms and VA sub-accounts.

attributes.name: crediting_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the FIA index crediting term in months (e.g., 12 for annual, 24 for two-year). Defines the measurement period over which index performance is evaluated and interest is credited. Null for VA sub-account strategies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: declared_interest_rate
attributes.description: Fixed interest rate declared by the carrier for a fixed declared rate strategy bucket, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 3.5000 = 3.5%). Applicable only to FIXED_DECLARED and DECLARED_RATE strategy types. Null for index-linked and variable sub-account strategies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; State Department of Insurance Product Filing

attributes.name: dollar_cost_averaging_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this strategy is part of a Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) program, where premium is systematically transferred from a fixed account into this strategy over a defined period. Common in variable annuity new business processing.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Platform

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this strategy election became or becomes effective for the contract. For FIA strategies, this typically aligns with the start of the crediting term. For VA sub-accounts, this is the date the allocation instruction took effect.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: election_source
attributes.description: Identifies the business event that created or last modified this strategy election. 'new_business' = elected at contract issue; 'policyholder_change' = changed via service request; 'renewal' = auto-renewed at term end; 'rebalance' = created by rebalancing event; 'transfer' = result of a fund transfer; 'dca_program' = created by DCA program.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Platform

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this strategy election expires or is scheduled to terminate. For FIA strategies, this is the end of the crediting term. Null for open-ended variable annuity sub-account allocations. Used to trigger renewal or reallocation workflows.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation 245

attributes.name: floor_rate
attributes.description: Minimum index-linked interest rate guaranteed to be credited to the FIA strategy in a given crediting term, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.0000 = 0%). Protects the policyholder from negative index returns. Typically 0% for most FIA products. Null for VA sub-accounts.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; State Department of Insurance Product Filing

attributes.name: fund_cusip
attributes.description: Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) identifier for the variable annuity sub-account fund. Uniquely identifies the registered investment fund underlying the sub-account. Null for FIA index crediting strategies and fixed declared rate strategies. Required for SEC-registered variable products.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation; FINRA; CUSIP Global Services

attributes.name: fund_ticker
attributes.description: Exchange ticker symbol for the underlying investment fund of a variable annuity sub-account (e.g., 'VFINX', 'AGTHX'). Used for market data feeds and NAV lookups. Null for FIA index crediting strategies.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation; FINRA; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: index_end_value
attributes.description: The closing value of the underlying market index on the crediting term end date. Used in conjunction with the index start value to calculate the index change percentage for interest crediting. Populated at term maturity. Null for VA sub-account strategies and open terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: index_start_value
attributes.description: The closing value of the underlying market index on the crediting term start date. Used as the baseline for calculating index-linked interest at term end. Captured at term inception and locked for the duration of the crediting term. Null for VA sub-account strategies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: market_value
attributes.description: Current market value of the policyholder's holding in the variable annuity sub-account, in USD. Calculated as units held multiplied by the current unit value. Updated daily. Null for FIA index crediting strategies where AV-based valuation applies.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act of 1940; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: maximum_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allocation percentage permitted for this strategy as specified in the product filing, expressed as a decimal percentage. Enforced during allocation change processing to prevent over-concentration in a single strategy.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance Product Filing; NAIC Model Regulation 245

attributes.name: minimum_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Minimum allocation percentage required for this strategy as specified in the product filing, expressed as a decimal percentage. Enforced during allocation change processing to ensure compliance with product design constraints.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance Product Filing; NAIC Model Regulation 245

attributes.name: participation_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of the index gain credited to the FIA strategy, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 80.0000 = 80%). Determines the proportion of index performance passed through to the policyholder's account value. Null for VA sub-accounts. Subject to contractual minimums per state-filed product specifications.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; State Department of Insurance Product Filing

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classifies the annuity product type to which this strategy applies. FIA = Fixed Indexed Annuity; VA = Variable Annuity; SPIA = Single Premium Immediate Annuity; FIXED = Traditional Fixed Annuity; IUL = Indexed Universal Life. Determines which crediting mechanics and regulatory frameworks apply.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: rebalancing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic periodic rebalancing is enabled for this strategy allocation. When True, the contract's account value is periodically rebalanced back to the target allocation percentage. Applicable primarily to variable annuity sub-account strategies.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Platform

attributes.name: rebalancing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which automatic rebalancing is performed for this strategy allocation. Applicable when rebalancing_flag is True. Null or 'none' when automatic rebalancing is not elected.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity Platform

attributes.name: renewal_election
attributes.description: Policyholder's standing instruction for what to do with the FIA strategy allocation at the end of the crediting term. 'renew_same' = automatically renew into the same strategy; 'reallocate' = redistribute per new allocation instructions; 'annuitize' = begin annuity payout; 'surrender' = surrender the contract. Drives automated renewal processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Platform

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this strategy record originated (e.g., 'SAPIENS_ANNUITY', 'FAST_ANNUITY'). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: spread_rate
attributes.description: Margin or asset fee deducted from the index gain before crediting to the FIA strategy, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 2.0000 = 2%). Also known as the 'margin' or 'asset fee'. Reduces the effective credited rate. Null for strategies using cap or participation rate mechanics and for VA sub-accounts.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: strategy_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this strategy is currently available for new elections or reallocation on the contract. A strategy may become unavailable if the carrier discontinues it, if it is closed to new money, or if the policyholder's contract vintage does not support it.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Product Filing

attributes.name: term_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current FIA index crediting term. The index value on this date serves as the ending point for point-to-point crediting calculations. Interest is credited to the account value at term end. Null for VA sub-account strategies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; Sapiens Annuity Platform

attributes.name: term_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current FIA index crediting term. The index value on this date serves as the starting point for point-to-point and other crediting method calculations. Null for VA sub-account strategies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; Sapiens Annuity Platform

attributes.name: transfer_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether transfers out of this strategy are currently restricted (e.g., due to market timing restrictions, surrender charge periods, or contractual lock-in provisions). When True, transfer requests from this strategy will be pended for compliance review.
attributes.references: SEC Regulation; FINRA Rule 2010; NAIC Model Regulation 245

attributes.name: unit_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Unit Value (Net Asset Value per Unit)
attributes.description: Current Net Asset Value (NAV) per accumulation unit for the variable annuity sub-account, in USD. Updated daily based on the underlying fund's NAV. Used to calculate the current market value of the policyholder's sub-account holding. Null for FIA index crediting strategies.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act of 1940; FINRA; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: units_held
attributes.description: Number of accumulation units held in the variable annuity sub-account as of the most recent valuation date. Multiplied by the unit value to derive the current sub-account market value. Null for FIA index crediting strategies.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act of 1940; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this index crediting strategy record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every change to the record. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Date as of which the current unit value, units held, and market value figures are reported. For VA sub-accounts, this is the most recent business day NAV date. For FIA strategies, this is the most recent account value calculation date.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act of 1940; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

products.name: index_credit_event
products.description: Records each index crediting event applied to a FIA contract at the end of a crediting term. Captures crediting term start and end dates, index start value, index end value, calculated index return, cap applied, participation rate applied, floor applied, buffer applied, credited interest rate, credited dollar amount, and resulting AV after credit. This is the transactional record of FIA index performance and credit application, supporting policyholder statements and actuarial experience studies.

attributes.name: index_credit_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA) index crediting event record in the Silver layer. Primary key for this transactional entity.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the FIA annuity contract to which this index crediting event applies. Links the crediting event to the owning contract in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: crediting_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.crediting_strategy. Business justification: Index credit events reference product crediting strategy definitions to validate cap/participation rates, crediting methods, and index calculation rules. Required for credit calculation validation, he

attributes.name: index_crediting_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.index_crediting_strategy. Business justification: index_credit_event records each FIA crediting event applied at the end of a crediting term. index_crediting_strategy defines the strategy (cap rate, participation rate, floor, buffer, term) that gover

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: FIA index crediting events generate journal entries for interest credited to policyholder accounts (GAAP interest expense, SAP reserve increase). Finance teams reconcile index credit amounts to GL pos

attributes.name: reversed_event_index_credit_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original index credit event record that this record reverses, when reversal_flag is True. Enables audit trail linkage between reversal and original crediting events. Null for original (non-reversal) events.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: sub_account_allocation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific index allocation segment within the FIA contract that this crediting event applies to. A contract may have multiple index allocations across different indices and crediting strategies.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation 245

attributes.name: actuarial_basis_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the actuarial valuation basis under which this index credit event is recognized for reserve and liability calculations (e.g., GAAP, SAP, IFRS). Supports multi-basis reporting in the Actuarial Valuation System (AXIS, Prophet, MoSes) and LDTI compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; IFRS 17; GAAP

attributes.name: allocation_av_after_credit
attributes.description: The Account Value (AV) of this specific index allocation segment immediately after the index credit has been applied. Equals allocation_av_start plus credited_amount, adjusted for any withdrawals processed at term end.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; IRC Section 72; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI)

attributes.name: allocation_av_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allocation Account Value (AV) at Term Start
attributes.description: The Account Value (AV) of this specific index allocation segment at the beginning of the crediting term, before any withdrawals or adjustments during the term. Used as the base for calculating the credited dollar amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; IRC Section 72; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI)

attributes.name: buffer_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of index loss absorbed by the insurance company before any loss is passed to the policyholder in a buffer-based FIA crediting strategy. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.100000 = 10% buffer). Null if a floor applies instead of a buffer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: cap_rate
attributes.description: The maximum index-linked interest rate that can be credited to the FIA contract for this crediting term, as specified in the contract terms. Limits the upside participation in index gains. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.060000 = 6.0%). Null if no cap applies to this crediting strategy.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation 245; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: contract_av_after_credit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Total Account Value (AV) After Credit
attributes.description: The total Account Value (AV) across all allocation segments of the FIA contract immediately after this index credit has been applied. Reflects the contract-level AV used for policyholder statements and benefit base calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; IRC Section 72; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this index credit event record was first created in the source Annuity Administration Platform system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: credited_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of index-linked interest credited to the FIA contract allocation for this term, calculated by applying the credited_interest_rate to the allocation_av_start. This is the actual monetary value added to the Account Value (AV).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; IRC Section 72; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI)

attributes.name: credited_interest_rate
attributes.description: The final index-linked interest rate credited to the FIA contract allocation for this term, after applying cap, participation rate, floor, buffer, and spread constraints to the raw index return. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.060000 = 6.0%). This is the rate that drives the credited dollar amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: crediting_event_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event timestamp representing when the index credit was officially applied to the FIA contract Account Value (AV) in the Annuity Administration Platform. Distinct from record audit timestamps.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: declared_rate_date
attributes.description: The date on which the insurance company declared the cap rate, participation rate, or spread applicable to this crediting term. Required for regulatory disclosure and policyholder notification compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation 245; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this index crediting event, as assigned by the Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity or FAST Annuity). Used on policyholder statements and audit trails.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the index crediting event within the Annuity Administration Platform workflow. 'pending' = term ended but credit not yet calculated; 'calculated' = credit computed awaiting posting; 'applied' = credit posted to Account Value (AV); 'reversed' = previously applied credit reversed; 'voided' = event cancelled before application.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation 245

attributes.name: floor_rate
attributes.description: The minimum index-linked interest rate that will be credited to the FIA contract for this crediting term, protecting the policyholder from negative index returns. Typically 0% (zero floor). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.000000 = 0%). Null if a buffer applies instead of a floor.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation 245

attributes.name: gmab_benefit_base_after_credit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) Benefit Base After Credit
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) benefit base value immediately after this index crediting event, if a GMAB rider is attached to the contract. Tracks whether the AV meets or exceeds the guaranteed accumulation target. Null if no GMAB rider is present.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IRC Section 72

attributes.name: gmib_benefit_base_after_credit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) Benefit Base After Credit
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) benefit base value immediately after this index crediting event, if a GMIB rider is attached to the contract. Updated when the credited AV triggers a step-up. Null if no GMIB rider is present.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IRC Section 72

attributes.name: gmwb_benefit_base_after_credit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Benefit Base After Credit
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) benefit base value immediately after this index crediting event, if a GMWB rider is attached to the contract. Updated when the credited AV exceeds the prior benefit base (step-up). Null if no GMWB rider is present.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IRC Section 72

attributes.name: index_end_value
attributes.description: The closing value of the external market index on the crediting term end date. Used in conjunction with the index start value to calculate the raw index return percentage.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: index_option_type
attributes.description: The type of derivative option instrument used by the insurance company to hedge the index crediting obligation for this allocation segment. Relevant for actuarial valuation, ALM (Asset Liability Management), and investment portfolio management.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); Investment Management System (Charles River IMS)

attributes.name: index_return_pct
attributes.description: The raw percentage change in the external market index over the crediting term, calculated as (index_end_value - index_start_value) / index_start_value. This is the pre-cap, pre-floor, pre-buffer gross index performance. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.085000 = 8.5%).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: index_start_value
attributes.description: The closing value of the external market index on the crediting term start date. Used as the baseline for calculating the index return percentage at the end of the term.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: participation_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of the index gain that is credited to the FIA contract for this crediting term. Applied to the index return before cap and floor constraints. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.800000 = 80%). Null if no participation rate applies to this crediting strategy.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: renewal_rate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cap rate, participation rate, or spread applied in this crediting term was a renewal rate (True) or the initial declared rate at contract issue (False). Renewal rates may differ from initial rates and are subject to NAIC disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation 245

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this index credit event record represents a reversal of a previously applied credit (True) or an original crediting event (False). Reversals occur due to data corrections, index value restatements, or system errors.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation 245

attributes.name: source_event_reference
attributes.description: The native event or transaction identifier from the originating Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity transaction ID or FAST Annuity event reference). Used for reconciliation between the Silver layer and the source system.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the Annuity Administration Platform source system that originated this index credit event record (e.g., 'SAPIENS_ANNUITY', 'FAST_ANNUITY'). Supports data lineage and multi-system reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: spread_rate
attributes.description: A fixed percentage deducted from the index return before crediting in a spread-based FIA crediting strategy. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.020000 = 2.0% spread). Null if cap/participation rate applies instead of a spread.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: step_up_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this index crediting event triggered a benefit base step-up on any attached guaranteed living benefit rider (GMWB, GMIB, or GMAB). True when the post-credit AV exceeds the prior benefit base, resulting in a ratchet to the higher value.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar tax year in which this index crediting event falls, relevant for IRC Section 72 tax reporting on annuity contract earnings. Used for IRS Form 1099-R preparation and tax deferred growth tracking.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Form 1099-R; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: term_duration_months
attributes.description: The length of the index crediting term expressed in months (e.g., 12 for a one-year term, 24 for a two-year term). Determines the measurement window for index performance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: term_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the index crediting term for this allocation segment. The index end value is typically captured on this date. Defines the end of the measurement period for index return calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: term_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the index crediting term for this allocation segment. The index start value is typically captured on this date. Defines the beginning of the measurement period for index return calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this index credit event record was last modified in the source Annuity Administration Platform system. Tracks reversals, corrections, and recalculations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: withdrawal_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of withdrawals processed during the crediting term that reduced the allocation base used for interest crediting. Reflects the impact of systematic or ad-hoc withdrawals on the credited amount calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 245; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

products.name: annuitization_election
products.description: Captures the annuitization election details when a contract transitions from the accumulation phase to the payout phase. Records election date, annuitization effective date, payout option selected (life only, life with period certain, joint and survivor, fixed period), annuity start date, annuitization basis (AV or guaranteed annuitization value), payout frequency, first payment date, and whether the election is irrevocable. Sourced from Sapiens Annuity benefit calculation and annuitization modules.

attributes.name: annuitization_election_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the annuitization election record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Annuitization Module; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: benefit_base_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.benefit_base. Business justification: annuitization_election has gmib_benefit_base_amount and gmib_rider_applied fields. When a GMIB rider is applied at annuitization, the election uses the guaranteed income benefit base to determine the

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract undergoing annuitization. Links this election to the parent contract record in the annuity domain.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: contract_owner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder or contract owner who submitted the annuitization election. Used for party-level reporting and KYC compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: election_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Annuitization elections require signed election forms per state insurance regulations. Links election record to executed document for regulatory audit trail, rescission period tracking, and irrevocabl

attributes.name: funding_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Annuitization converts accumulation value to payout stream backed by specific portfolio assets. ALM requires duration-matching payout obligations to portfolio holdings. Investment teams need to reserv

attributes.name: gaap_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gaap_reserve. Business justification: Annuitization elections reclassify contracts from accumulation to payout phase, triggering GAAP reserve reclassification under LDTI. Finance teams link elections to GAAP reserve records to measure the

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Annuitization elections trigger accounting entries: transfer from accumulation to payout reserve, DAC acceleration/write-off, and deferred gain recognition. Finance teams require a direct link from th

attributes.name: mortality_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.mortality_table. Business justification: Annuitization rates are calculated using specific mortality tables (e.g., 2012 IAM, Annuity 2000). Critical for pricing annuity payouts, regulatory compliance, and ensuring consistent rate application

attributes.name: payout_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.payout_schedule. Business justification: When a contract owner elects to annuitize (annuitization_election), the system creates a payout_schedule that defines the ongoing payment stream. The election captures the DECISION and election-time p

attributes.name: pricing_basis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.pricing_basis. Business justification: Annuity option rates applied at annuitization election are derived from actuarial pricing_basis assumptions (interest rate basis, mortality table). This link supports GMIB exercise pricing validation

attributes.name: primary_annuitization_annuitant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuitant whose life expectancy governs the payout calculations. May differ from the contract owner in owner-driven annuity structures.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed agent or financial professional who facilitated the annuitization election. Used for commission impact tracking and suitability compliance documentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; DOL ERISA Fiduciary Standards; Sapiens Commission — Agent Licensing Module

attributes.name: risk_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.risk_class. Business justification: Annuitization elections determine payout rates using the annuitant's risk class (standard, preferred, rated). The risk class directly drives the annuity option rate applied at election. Annuity operat

attributes.name: suitability_review_id
attributes.description: Reference to the suitability review record completed prior to or at the time of the annuitization election, as required under NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation and DOL fiduciary standards.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; DOL ERISA Fiduciary Standards; compliance.suitability_review

attributes.name: surrender_charge_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.surrender_charge. Business justification: annuitization_election captures surrender_charge_amount and surrender_charge_waived for contracts that annuitize during the surrender charge period. surrender_charge holds the schedule governing those

attributes.name: annuitant_age_at_election
attributes.description: The age of the primary annuitant (in whole years) at the time of the annuitization election date. Used in actuarial factor selection, mortality table lookup, and IRC Section 72 expected return calculations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Actuarial Tables; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: annuitization_basis
attributes.description: The value basis used to calculate the annuity income stream. 'account_value' (AV) = current contract account value; 'guaranteed_annuitization_value' = contractually guaranteed minimum value per rider (e.g., GMIB benefit base); 'greater_of' = higher of AV or guaranteed value. Determines the starting principal for payout calculations.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: annuitization_value_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the annuitization basis (AV or guaranteed annuitization value) used to calculate the periodic income payment at the time of election. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot at the effective date.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: annuity_option_rate
attributes.description: The annuity factor or option rate (per $1,000 of annuitization value) used to convert the annuitization basis into the periodic payment amount. Derived from the applicable mortality table and interest rate assumption at the time of annuitization.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module; NAIC Valuation of Life Insurance Policies Model Regulation; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: annuity_type
attributes.description: The type of annuity contract being annuitized. 'fixed' = guaranteed fixed payment; 'variable' = payments vary with separate account performance relative to AIR; 'fixed_indexed' = FIA with index-linked crediting. Governs payout calculation methodology and SEC/FINRA regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; SEC Variable Annuity Regulations; FINRA Rule 2330; Sapiens Annuity

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the annuitization election was formally approved by the insurance company's new business or contract servicing team. Null if election is still pending or was cancelled.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Annuitization Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: assumed_interest_rate
attributes.description: The Assumed Interest Rate (AIR) used in the annuity factor calculation at the time of annuitization. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0350 = 3.50%). Relevant for variable annuity payout calculations where actual performance is compared to AIR.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this election record. Typically USD for domestic US annuity contracts.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract officially transitions from the accumulation phase to the payout phase. Also known as the Annuity Start Date (ASD) or Annuity Commencement Date. Governs IRC Section 72 tax treatment.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the contract owner formally submitted the annuitization election request. Serves as the principal business event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Annuitization Module; IRC Section 72; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: election_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier assigned to this annuitization election by the Annuity Administration Platform. Used in correspondence, confirmations, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Annuitization Module; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: election_received_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the annuitization election request was received and logged in the Annuity Administration Platform. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Annuitization Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: election_source_channel
attributes.description: The distribution or service channel through which the annuitization election was submitted. Used for operational analytics and agent commission impact assessment.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Annuitization Module; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: election_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the annuitization election. 'pending' = submitted but not yet approved; 'approved' = approved but payout not yet started; 'in_force' = payout phase active; 'cancelled' = withdrawn before effective date; 'rescinded' = reversed after effective date per applicable free-look or regulatory provision.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Annuitization Module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: exclusion_ratio
attributes.description: The IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio representing the proportion of each annuity payment that is a tax-free return of the owner's cost basis. Calculated as investment in contract divided by expected return. Used for 1099-R tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 939; NAIC Tax Reporting Standards

attributes.name: expected_return
attributes.description: The total expected return from the annuity contract as calculated under IRC Section 72 tables, used as the denominator in the exclusion ratio calculation. For life annuities, derived from IRS actuarial tables based on annuitant age and payout option.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 939; IRS Actuarial Tables

attributes.name: first_payment_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date of the first annuity income payment to the payee following annuitization. May differ from the effective date depending on payout frequency and payment timing convention (immediate vs. deferred first payment).
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: gmib_benefit_base_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) Benefit Base Amount
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) benefit base amount at the time of annuitization election, when the GMIB rider is exercised. Represents the guaranteed minimum value used to calculate the income stream, which may exceed the current account value.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: gmib_rider_applied
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) Rider Applied Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) rider was exercised as the basis for this annuitization election. True = GMIB benefit base used; False = standard account value annuitization.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: investment_in_contract
attributes.description: The owner's total after-tax cost basis in the annuity contract at the time of annuitization, as defined under IRC Section 72. Used to calculate the exclusion ratio for tax-free recovery of basis in annuity payments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 939; Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: is_1035_exchange
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuitization election involves a tax-free 1035 Exchange (IRC Section 1035) from another insurance or annuity contract. True = the annuitization basis includes proceeds from a 1035 exchange; False = no exchange involved.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Publication 575; Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: is_irrevocable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuitization election is irrevocable once the effective date is reached. True = the owner cannot reverse or modify the election after the annuity start date; False = election may be modified within applicable free-look or rescission period.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity — Annuitization Module; State Department of Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this annuitization election record was last modified in the source system or Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens Annuity — Annuitization Module

attributes.name: rescission_deadline_date
attributes.description: The last date by which the contract owner may rescind or cancel the annuitization election under applicable state free-look or rescission provisions. Null for irrevocable elections or after the deadline has passed.
attributes.references: State Department of Insurance Free-Look Regulations; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: source_system_election_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this annuitization election record in the originating Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity). Supports data lineage tracing from Silver Layer back to the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Annuitization Module; ETL Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: surrender_charge_amount
attributes.description: The surrender charge amount that would have applied at the time of annuitization, prior to any waiver. Captured for audit and actuarial analysis even when waived. Null if no surrender charge schedule applies.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: surrender_charge_waived
attributes.description: Indicates whether the surrender charge was waived upon annuitization. Many annuity contracts waive surrender charges when the owner elects to annuitize, as an incentive for lifetime income election.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: tax_qualified_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract is tax-qualified (e.g., IRA, 403(b), 401(a)) or non-qualified. Governs IRC Section 72 tax treatment, RMD applicability, and 1099-R reporting codes.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRC Section 401; IRS Publication 575; NAIC Tax Reporting Standards

products.name: payout_schedule
products.description: Defines the periodic income payment schedule for annuity contracts in the payout phase, including SPIA (Single Premium Immediate Annuity) and annuitized deferred contracts. Captures scheduled payment amount, payment frequency, payment start date, payment end date (if period certain), cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) rate, inflation index linkage, joint annuitant survivor percentage, and total expected payments. Supports benefit payment processing and actuarial liability calculations.

attributes.name: payout_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the annuity payout schedule record in the Annuity Administration Platform. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent annuity contract for which this payout schedule is defined. Links the payout schedule to the annuity contract administration record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: mortality_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.mortality_table. Business justification: Life-contingent payout schedules (life only, joint-and-survivor, period certain and life) require mortality tables for payment calculation. Essential for accurate benefit payments, reserve adequacy, a

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Annuitization payout options, mortality tables, and annuity option rates are locked to plan version at election date. Critical for payout calculations, mortality table selection, and regulatory compli

attributes.name: pricing_basis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.pricing_basis. Business justification: Payout schedule payment amounts are calculated using actuarial pricing_basis assumptions (assumed interest rate, mortality). This link enables SPIA/annuity payment rate validation against filed pricin

attributes.name: primary_payout_annuitant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary annuitant (measuring life) whose life expectancy governs the payout duration. Required for life-contingent payout options.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: risk_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.risk_class. Business justification: Life-contingent payout schedules (life-only, life with period certain) use the annuitant's underwriting risk class to apply appropriate mortality assumptions for scheduled payment amounts and reserve

attributes.name: separate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.separate_account. Business justification: Variable annuity payout schedules calculate periodic payments using annuity unit values from a specific separate account. This link is required for annuity unit value lookups during payment calculatio

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Payout schedules must comply with state-specific nonforfeiture regulations, minimum annuity payout options, and withholding rules. Payout administrators reference the applicable state regulation to va

attributes.name: statutory_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.statutory_reserve. Business justification: Payout annuity schedules drive statutory reserve calculations (CARVM payout phase, Commissioners Annuity Reserve Valuation Method). Appointed actuaries link payout schedules to statutory reserve recor

attributes.name: account_value_at_annuitization
attributes.description: The Account Value (AV) of the deferred annuity contract at the time of annuitization, used as the premium basis for calculating the annuity income payment amount. Null for SPIA contracts.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245); FASB ASC 944; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: annuitization_date
attributes.description: Date on which a deferred annuity contract was formally annuitized, converting the accumulated account value into a stream of annuity income payments. Null for SPIA contracts where annuitization occurs at contract issue.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245); IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: annuity_start_date
attributes.description: The annuity commencement date (ACD) — the date on which the annuity contract formally enters the payout phase and benefit calculations are locked. Distinct from payment_start_date, which is the first actual disbursement date. Governs IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio calculations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: cola_anniversary_date
attributes.description: Annual date on which the Cost-of-Living Adjustment (COLA) is applied to increase the scheduled annuity income payment amount. Typically the contract anniversary date. Null if no COLA applies.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: cola_index_type
attributes.description: Type of inflation index used to determine the Cost-of-Living Adjustment (COLA) applied to annuity income payments. Fixed indicates a contractually specified fixed rate; CPI-U and CPI-W reference U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Consumer Price Index measures; none indicates no COLA applies.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245); U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics CPI

attributes.name: cola_rate
attributes.description: Annual Cost-of-Living Adjustment (COLA) rate applied to the scheduled payment amount to increase annuity income payments over time to offset inflation. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.03 for 3%). Zero or null if no COLA applies.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payout schedule record was first created in the system of record. Used for audit trail and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Enterprise Data Governance Policy; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this payout schedule (e.g., USD). Required for multi-currency annuity contracts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the payout schedule is in effect. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) tracking for schedule amendments such as COLA adjustments, payment amount changes, or payout option modifications.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: exclusion_ratio
attributes.description: The IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio applied to each annuity income payment to determine the non-taxable return-of-investment portion. Calculated as the investment in the contract divided by the expected return. Used for IRS Form 1099-R tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 939; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245)

attributes.name: expected_return
attributes.description: The total amount expected to be received under the annuity contract over its payout period, as calculated under IRC Section 72 using IRS actuarial tables. Used as the denominator in the exclusion ratio calculation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 939; IRS Actuarial Tables

attributes.name: federal_withholding_rate
attributes.description: Federal income tax withholding rate applied to the taxable portion of each annuity income payment, as elected by the annuitant or as mandated by IRS default withholding rules. Used for IRS Form 1099-R reporting and payment net calculation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 3405; IRS Publication 575; IRS Form W-4P

attributes.name: interest_rate_basis
attributes.description: The assumed interest rate used in the actuarial calculation of the annuity income payment amount at the time of annuitization or SPIA pricing. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.035 for 3.5%). Used in actuarial reserve calculations and FASB ASC 944 LDTI discount rate determinations.
attributes.references: NAIC Standard Valuation Law; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); Society of Actuaries (SOA) standards

attributes.name: investment_in_contract
attributes.description: The annuitant's after-tax cost basis in the annuity contract at the annuity start date, as defined under IRC Section 72. Used to calculate the exclusion ratio and the non-taxable portion of each annuity income payment for IRS Form 1099-R reporting.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of the most recently issued annuity income payment. May differ from scheduled_payment_amount due to COLA adjustments, partial-period proration, or manual adjustments.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent annuity income payment was issued under this payout schedule. Used to confirm payment continuity and detect missed payments.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity / FAST Annuity platform conventions

attributes.name: next_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next scheduled annuity income payment is due to be issued. Updated after each payment cycle by the Annuity Administration Platform. Used in benefit payment processing and cash flow management.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Sapiens Annuity / FAST Annuity platform conventions

attributes.name: payment_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the last scheduled annuity income payment is due. Populated for period-certain and fixed-term payout options; null for life-only payout options where payments continue until the annuitant's death.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245); IRC Section 72

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which annuity income payments are disbursed to the annuitant. Determines the payment schedule cadence and is used in benefit payment processing and actuarial liability calculations.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation

attributes.name: payment_mode_code
attributes.description: Method by which annuity income payments are disbursed to the annuitant (e.g., Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT), check, wire transfer). Drives payment processing routing in the Annuity Administration Platform.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NACHA Operating Rules (for EFT)

attributes.name: payment_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the first annuity income payment is scheduled to be issued. For Single Premium Immediate Annuities (SPIA), this is typically one payment period after the contract issue date. Governs the commencement of the payout phase.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245); IRC Section 72; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: payments_made_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of annuity income payments that have been issued to date under this payout schedule. Used to track progress against total expected payments and to determine remaining guaranteed payments.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: payout_option_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the annuity payout form elected by the annuitant (e.g., life-only, life with period certain, joint-and-survivor, period certain only, installment refund, cash refund). Drives payment duration logic and survivor benefit calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: life_only|life_period_certain|joint_survivor|period_certain_only|installment_refund|cash_refund|life_with_refund — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: payout_option_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the elected annuity payout option as it appears on the annuity contract and benefit statements (e.g., 'Life with 10-Year Period Certain', 'Joint and 50% Survivor'). Used in annuitant communications and regulatory disclosures.

attributes.name: period_certain_years
attributes.description: Number of years for which annuity income payments are guaranteed regardless of the annuitant's survival (e.g., 5, 10, 20 years). Applicable to life-with-period-certain and period-certain-only payout options. Null for life-only options.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245); IRC Section 72

attributes.name: pop_up_provision
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payout schedule includes a pop-up provision, whereby the annuity income payment increases (pops up) to the single-life amount if the joint annuitant predeceases the primary annuitant. Applicable to joint-and-survivor payout options only.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation (MDL-245); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: qualified_plan_type
attributes.description: Type of tax-qualified retirement plan under which the annuity contract is held, governing Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) rules and tax reporting requirements. Non-qualified for contracts not held in a qualified plan. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IRA|Roth_IRA|403b|401a|457b|457f|SEP_IRA|SIMPLE_IRA|non_qualified — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRC Section 408; IRC Section 403(b); DOL ERISA; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: refund_feature_type
attributes.description: Type of refund guarantee attached to the payout option. Cash refund pays the beneficiary a lump sum equal to the premium minus payments received; installment refund continues payments to the beneficiary until the total premium is recovered. None indicates no refund feature.
