attributes.description: The cost basis transferred out of this annuity contract to a receiving contract via a tax-free 1035 exchange. Reduces the investment-in-contract of this contract.

attributes.name: exclusion_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of the investment in contract to the expected return, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.35000000 = 35%). Applied to each annuity payment to determine the non-taxable portion under IRC Section 72(b). Calculated as remaining_investment_in_contract divided by expected_return.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72(b); IRS Publication 939; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: exclusion_ratio_exhausted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the investment in contract has been fully recovered through prior non-taxable distributions. When True, all future annuity payments are fully taxable with no exclusion allowed under IRC Section 72(b)(2).

attributes.name: exclusion_ratio_exhausted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the investment in contract was fully recovered and the exclusion ratio was exhausted. Null if the exclusion ratio has not yet been exhausted.

attributes.name: expected_return
attributes.description: The total amount expected to be received under the annuity contract over the payment period, calculated using IRS actuarial tables (life expectancy multiples) per IRC Section 72(c). Used as the denominator in the exclusion ratio calculation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72(c); IRS Publication 939; IRS Actuarial Tables

attributes.name: expected_return_multiple
attributes.description: The life expectancy multiple from the applicable IRS actuarial table (IRS Publication 939) used to calculate the expected return. Expressed in years (e.g., 20.0 years). Multiplied by the annual payment amount to derive the expected return.

attributes.name: form_1099r_box1_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRS Form 1099-R Box 1 Gross Distribution Amount
attributes.description: The gross distribution amount to be reported in Box 1 of IRS Form 1099-R for the applicable tax year. Represents total distributions paid from the contract during the tax year.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-R Instructions; IRC Section 72; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: form_1099r_box2a_amount
attributes.description: The taxable amount to be reported in Box 2a of IRS Form 1099-R for the applicable tax year. Represents the portion of gross distributions that is includable in gross income after applying the exclusion ratio.

attributes.name: form_1099r_taxable_amount_not_determined
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRS Form 1099-R Taxable Amount Not Determined Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the taxable amount cannot be determined by the insurance company and Box 2b 'Taxable amount not determined' should be checked on IRS Form 1099-R. True when the company lacks sufficient cost basis information to compute the taxable amount.

attributes.name: investment_in_contract
attributes.description: The cumulative after-tax investment in the annuity contract as defined under IRC Section 72(e)(6). Represents the total premiums paid less any amounts previously received tax-free. This is the primary cost basis figure used for exclusion ratio calculations and 1099-R reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72(e)(6); IRS Publication 575; IRS Form 1099-R Instructions

attributes.name: last_adjustment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent adjustment to the investment in contract (cost basis). Used for audit trail and reconciliation with the annuity administration platform.
attributes.references: Sapiens Annuity — Contract Administration Module; IRC Section 72

attributes.name: ledger_as_of_date
attributes.description: The business date through which this cost basis ledger snapshot is current. Used for point-in-time reporting, year-end tax reporting, and 1099-R preparation.

attributes.name: ledger_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this cost basis ledger record became effective, typically the contract issue date or the date of a 1035 exchange that established the initial investment in contract.

attributes.name: ledger_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost basis ledger record. Active indicates ongoing tracking; closed indicates the contract has been fully surrendered or annuitized; suspended indicates a hold pending review or correction; pending_review indicates an audit or reconciliation is in progress.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Model Regulation; Sapiens Annuity Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: mec_determination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract was determined to be or not to be a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC). Null if MEC determination has not been triggered.

attributes.name: mec_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract has been classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) under IRC Section 7702A. MEC status affects the tax treatment of distributions, subjecting them to LIFO (last-in, first-out) income recognition and potential 10% penalty tax.

attributes.name: nontaxable_distributions_received
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of distributions that have been treated as non-taxable return of cost basis (investment in contract) under the IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio. Reduces the remaining investment in contract.

attributes.name: partial_surrender_basis_adjustment
attributes.description: Cumulative reduction to the investment in contract resulting from partial surrenders or withdrawals that returned cost basis to the owner. Tracks the pro-rata cost basis recovery applied to partial surrenders of non-qualified annuities.

attributes.name: payout_option
attributes.description: The annuitization payout option elected by the contract owner. Determines the expected return calculation method and applicable IRS actuarial table (Table V, VI, or VII) for the exclusion ratio.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72(c); IRS Publication 939; Sapiens Annuity — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: periodic_payment_amount
attributes.description: The fixed periodic payment amount received under the annuitization option. Used to calculate the annual exclusion amount (periodic_payment_amount multiplied by payment frequency multiplied by exclusion_ratio).

attributes.name: remaining_investment_in_contract
attributes.description: The remaining unrecovered cost basis in the annuity contract as of the ledger_as_of_date. Calculated as investment_in_contract minus nontaxable_distributions_received. Drives the exclusion ratio for future annuity payments.

attributes.name: source_contract_number
attributes.description: The contract number of the prior annuity or life insurance contract from which cost basis was received via a 1035 exchange. Null if no 1035 exchange occurred.

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar tax year for which this cost basis ledger snapshot is prepared. Used for annual 1099-R tax reporting and IRS compliance. Format: YYYY (e.g., 2024).
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-R Instructions; IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575

attributes.name: taxable_distributions_received
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of distributions that have been treated as taxable income (earnings above cost basis) under IRC Section 72. Reported on IRS Form 1099-R Box 2a.

attributes.name: total_distributions_received
attributes.description: Cumulative gross distributions (withdrawals, partial surrenders, annuity payments) received from the contract since inception. Used in conjunction with the exclusion ratio to determine the taxable and non-taxable portions of each distribution.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; IRS Form 1099-R Instructions

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this cost basis ledger record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Audit Rule; Internal Data Governance Standard

products.name: contract_valuation
products.description: Periodic valuation snapshot of each annuity contract capturing the full financial position at a valuation date. Records contract AV, surrender value (CSV), death benefit amount, GMDB value, GMWB benefit base, GMIB benefit base, GMAB benefit base, net amount at risk (NAR) for each guarantee, accrued rider charges, and statutory reserve estimate. Supports actuarial valuation feeds, policyholder annual statements, and LDTI/IFRS 17 reporting. Generated at each valuation cycle (daily, monthly, quarterly, annually).

attributes.name: contract_valuation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each contract valuation snapshot record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: account_value_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.account_value. Business justification: contract_valuation is a periodic valuation snapshot capturing the full financial position of an annuity contract. account_value is the authoritative periodic valuation ledger for the same contract. A

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.assumption_set. Business justification: LDTI/GAAP reserve reporting requires tracing which actuarial assumption set (discount rate, lapse, mortality) produced each contract valuation snapshot. Actuaries and finance teams depend on this link

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract being valued. Links this valuation snapshot to the parent annuity contract master record.
attributes.references: Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity) — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: gaap_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gaap_reserve. Business justification: Valuation outputs feed GAAP reserve calculations for financial statement liability reporting under LDTI. Actuarial cash flow projections and discount rates from valuation runs populate reserve balance

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract owner/policyholder party record. Supports policyholder-level aggregation and annual statement generation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Contract valuation snapshots must reference the investment portfolio driving reserve calculations for ALM reporting, GAAP/STAT reserve attribution, and investment performance reporting. Actuaries and

attributes.name: scenario_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.scenario_set. Business justification: Variable and FIA annuity contract valuations under VM-21 CTE70 stochastic reserving reference a specific economic scenario set. This link enables traceability of which scenario set drove a contract-le

attributes.name: statutory_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.statutory_reserve. Business justification: Valuation run results directly populate statutory reserve amounts for regulatory filings. Actuarial valuation outputs feed reserve balances reported in NAIC Annual Statement and state regulatory submi

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the actuarial valuation batch run that produced this record. Enables traceability of valuation results back to a specific run of the actuarial valuation system (MoSes, AXIS, or Prophet). Supports audit and restatement workflows.
attributes.references: SOX; Internal Actuarial Governance Policy; Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: account_value
attributes.description: The total Account Value (AV) of the annuity contract as of the valuation date. Represents the accumulated fund value including premiums paid, credited interest/index credits, and less withdrawals and charges. Core financial metric for annuity contract administration.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Reserve Standards; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity) — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: accrued_rider_charges
attributes.description: Total rider charges accrued but not yet deducted from the AV as of the valuation date. Includes charges for GMWB, GMIB, GMAB, GMDB, and other optional benefit riders. Used for accurate AV reconciliation and income statement accruals.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; Annuity Administration Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: annuitization_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract transitioned from the accumulation phase to the annuitization/payout phase. Null if the contract has not yet been annuitized. Triggers shift from AV-based to income-stream-based valuation.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Reserve Standards; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: cash_surrender_value
attributes.description: The Cash Surrender Value (CSV) available to the contract owner upon full surrender as of the valuation date. Equals AV less applicable surrender charges and market value adjustments. Used for policyholder statements and surrender processing.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Model Regulation 830; Annuity Administration Platform — Withdrawal Processing Module

attributes.name: contract_phase
attributes.description: Current lifecycle phase of the annuity contract at the valuation date. Accumulation phase tracks AV growth; annuitization/payout phase tracks income stream; surrender and death claim phases indicate terminal events.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Suitability Model Regulation; Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: cost_basis
attributes.description: The owner's investment in the contract (cost basis) as of the valuation date per IRC Section 72. Represents after-tax premiums paid less any tax-free distributions received. Used to determine the taxable gain upon surrender or annuitization.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Form 1099-R; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract valuation record was first created in the Silver layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under SOX.

attributes.name: credited_interest_rate
attributes.description: The current credited interest rate applied to the contract AV for the valuation period. For fixed annuities, this is the declared rate. For FIA contracts, this reflects the effective rate after index crediting. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045 = 4.5%).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this valuation record. Typically USD for domestic US annuity contracts.

attributes.name: death_benefit_amount
attributes.description: The Death Benefit (DB) payable to the beneficiary upon the death of the annuitant or contract owner as of the valuation date. May equal AV, a return-of-premium guarantee, or a stepped-up value depending on contract terms.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; NAIC Annuity Reserve Standards; Annuity Administration Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: gaap_reserve
attributes.description: The GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) reserve for this contract as of the valuation date, calculated under FASB ASC 944 including LDTI requirements. Supports financial statement reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); GAAP; SOX; Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: gmab_benefit_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) Benefit Base
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) benefit base as of the valuation date. Represents the guaranteed minimum AV at the end of the accumulation period, protecting against investment losses.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: gmab_rider_active
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) Rider Active Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GMAB rider is currently active on this contract as of the valuation date. Drives inclusion of GMAB benefit base and maturity guarantee calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: gmdb_value
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit (GMDB) base or benefit amount as of the valuation date. Represents the minimum death benefit guaranteed regardless of investment performance. Applicable for variable and indexed annuities with GMDB riders.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Variable Annuity Reserve Standards; Actuarial Valuation System (AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: gmib_benefit_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) Benefit Base
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) benefit base as of the valuation date. Used to calculate the minimum annuitization income stream the contract owner is guaranteed upon exercising the GMIB rider.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: gmib_rider_active
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) Rider Active Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GMIB rider is currently active on this contract as of the valuation date. Drives inclusion of GMIB benefit base calculations and annuitization guarantee valuations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: gmwb_annual_withdrawal_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Annual Withdrawal Amount
attributes.description: The maximum annual withdrawal amount guaranteed under the GMWB rider as of the valuation date. Calculated as the GMWB benefit base multiplied by the applicable withdrawal percentage. Used for RMD compliance checks and policyholder benefit illustrations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS RMD Rules; NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Annuity Administration Platform — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: gmwb_benefit_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Benefit Base
attributes.description: The Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) benefit base as of the valuation date. This is the notional amount used to calculate the guaranteed annual withdrawal amount, which may differ from AV due to step-ups, roll-ups, or bonus credits.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: gmwb_rider_active
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Rider Active Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GMWB rider is currently active on this contract as of the valuation date. Drives inclusion of GMWB benefit base and NAR calculations in the valuation.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: index_credit_amount
attributes.description: The index credit amount applied to the contract AV during the current index crediting period as of the valuation date. Applicable for Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA) contracts. Reflects the gain linked to the selected index strategy.
attributes.references: NAIC FIA Model Regulation; Annuity Administration Platform (Sapiens Annuity; FAST Annuity) — Benefit Calculations Module

attributes.name: is_1035_exchange
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract was funded via a 1035 tax-free exchange from a prior insurance or annuity contract. True if funded by 1035 exchange; False if funded by direct premium. Affects cost basis tracking and tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Form 1099-R; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: is_mec
attributes.description: Indicates whether the annuity contract has been classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) under IRC Section 7702A. MEC status affects the tax treatment of withdrawals and loans. True if MEC; False otherwise.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702A; IRS; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The original issue date of the annuity contract. Used to calculate contract duration, surrender charge schedule position, and benefit base roll-up periods.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: market_value_adjustment
attributes.description: The Market Value Adjustment (MVA) applicable to the contract as of the valuation date. Positive or negative adjustment applied to the surrender value based on changes in interest rates since contract issue. Applicable for MVA-type fixed annuities.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830; Annuity Administration Platform — Withdrawal Processing Module

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The contractual maturity date of the annuity contract, after which the contract must be annuitized or surrendered per contract terms. Used for GMAB maturity benefit calculations and policyholder notifications.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Reserve Standards; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: nar_gmdb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) — Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit (GMDB)
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) for the GMDB rider as of the valuation date. Calculated as the excess of the GMDB value over the current AV. Represents the insurer's economic exposure on the death benefit guarantee. Key input for actuarial reserving and reinsurance cession.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: nar_gmwb
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) — Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB)
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) for the GMWB rider as of the valuation date. Represents the present value of projected future guaranteed withdrawals in excess of projected AV. Key input for LDTI/IFRS 17 liability measurement.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Actuarial Guideline 43 (AG43); Actuarial Valuation System

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific annuity product type (e.g., FIA, SPIA, variable annuity, fixed annuity) associated with this contract. Drives product-specific valuation logic and benefit calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing Standards; Internal Product Taxonomy

attributes.name: rmd_amount
attributes.description: The Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) amount calculated for the contract for the current tax year as of the valuation date. Applicable for qualified annuity contracts (IRA, 401(k)). Ensures IRS compliance under IRC Section 401(a)(9).
attributes.references: IRC Section 401(a)(9); IRS RMD Rules; Annuity Administration Platform — RMD Tracking Module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system that originated this valuation data. Supports data lineage tracking across the lakehouse Silver layer.

attributes.name: statutory_reserve
attributes.description: The estimated statutory reserve for this contract as of the valuation date, calculated under SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles) per NAIC requirements. Includes Commissioners Annuity Reserve Valuation Method (CARVM) or Principle-Based Reserving (PBR) as applicable. Feeds state regulatory reserve filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; SAP; PBR (Principle-Based Reserving); Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: surrender_charge_amount
attributes.description: The contingent deferred sales charge (CDSC) or surrender charge applicable to the contract as of the valuation date. Deducted from AV to arrive at CSV. Typically declines over the surrender charge period.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830; SEC (for variable products); Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: surrender_charge_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the surrender charge period expires for this contract. After this date, the contract owner may surrender without incurring a surrender charge. Key date for policyholder communications and surrender processing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830; Annuity Administration Platform — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: tax_qualification_type
attributes.description: The tax qualification status of the annuity contract. Determines applicable IRC tax rules, RMD requirements, and 1099-R reporting codes. Non-qualified contracts are funded with after-tax dollars; qualified contracts are funded with pre-tax dollars. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_qualified|traditional_ira|roth_ira|401k|403b|sep_ira|simple_ira — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRC Sections 72, 401, 403, 408; IRS Form 1099-R; Annuity Administration Platform

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract valuation record was last modified in the Silver layer lakehouse. Tracks restatements, corrections, and status transitions for audit purposes.

attributes.name: valuation_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency classification of this valuation run. Indicates whether the snapshot was generated as part of a daily, monthly, quarterly, or annual valuation cycle. Drives downstream actuarial and reporting workflows.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; Internal Actuarial Valuation Policy

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for this valuation snapshot. Represents the specific calendar date on which all financial positions (AV, CSV, DB, guarantees) are measured. Used as the primary time dimension for actuarial feeds, LDTI/IFRS 17 reporting, and policyholder statements.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Actuarial Guideline; Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this valuation record. Preliminary records are in-process; final records are approved for reporting; restated records reflect corrections; superseded records have been replaced by a newer run for the same contract and valuation date.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); Internal Actuarial Governance Policy

attributes.name: ytd_withdrawals
attributes.description: Total withdrawal amounts taken from the contract from the beginning of the current contract year through the valuation date. Used to determine excess withdrawal amounts that may reduce the GMWB benefit base and for IRC Section 72 tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Tax Reporting; Annuity Administration Platform — Withdrawal Processing Module

products.name: sub_account_allocation
products.description: Manages the sub-account investment allocations for variable annuity (VUL annuity) contracts, defining how the contract AV is distributed across available investment options (equity funds, bond funds, money market, fixed account). Captures sub-account fund name, fund CUSIP, allocation percentage, current unit value, number of units held, current market value, allocation effective date, and rebalancing instructions. Supports NAV-based AV calculations and investment performance attribution for variable annuity contracts.

attributes.name: sub_account_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each sub-account allocation record within a variable annuity contract. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the variable annuity contract to which this sub-account allocation belongs. Links the allocation to the parent annuity contract record.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: separate_account_fund_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment fund (sub-account) available within the variable annuity separate account. Identifies the specific fund option selected by the contract owner.
attributes.references: SEC Investment Company Act of 1940; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: separate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.separate_account. Business justification: Each sub-account allocation maps to a specific investment.separate_account for daily unit value pricing, NAV reporting, and SEC/NAIC regulatory filings. The existing separate_account_code is a denorma

attributes.name: allocation_instruction_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating source of the allocation instruction. Distinguishes between owner-directed, agent-directed, system-default, automatic rebalancing, DCA transfer, and system-generated allocations. Used for suitability review and audit trail.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation; DOL Fiduciary Rule; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this sub-account allocation record, as assigned by the Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity, FAST Annuity). Used in client statements and correspondence.

attributes.name: allocation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of new premium and/or rebalancing proceeds directed to this sub-account fund, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 25.0000 = 25%). All active allocations for a contract must sum to 100%. Used in premium allocation and rebalancing processing.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sub-account allocation. 'active' indicates the allocation is in force; 'pending' indicates awaiting effective date or processing; 'suspended' indicates temporarily halted; 'terminated' indicates closed; 'transferred' indicates moved to another fund.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: asset_transfer_rebalance_pct
attributes.description: Target allocation percentage used specifically for automatic rebalancing calculations. May differ from the current allocation_pct if the owner has submitted a pending rebalancing instruction not yet effective.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: cost_basis
attributes.description: Aggregate cost basis (investment in contract) allocated to this sub-account, used for tax reporting under IRC Section 72 to determine the taxable portion of withdrawals and annuity payments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sub-account allocation record was first created in the Annuity Administration Platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this allocation record (e.g., 'USD'). Supports multi-currency annuity contracts and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Financial Condition Examiners Handbook

attributes.name: dca_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) transfer program for this sub-account allocation is scheduled to end. Null if DCA is not active or has no defined end date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: dca_transfer_amount
attributes.description: Periodic dollar amount transferred into this sub-account under the Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) program per the defined frequency. Applicable only when dollar_cost_averaging_flag is True.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: dollar_cost_averaging_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sub-account allocation participates in a Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) program, where funds are systematically transferred from a fixed account or money market into this sub-account over a defined period.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this sub-account allocation instruction became effective for the contract. Represents the business event date when the allocation was applied, distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: expense_ratio
attributes.description: Annual expense ratio of the underlying investment fund expressed as a percentage (e.g., 0.7500 = 0.75%). Includes management fees and fund operating expenses. Required for prospectus disclosure and suitability analysis.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 482; FINRA Rule 2210; NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation

attributes.name: is_default_allocation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sub-account allocation is part of the contract's default investment allocation (e.g., applied when no explicit owner instruction is on file). Used in new business processing and NIGO resolution workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_restricted_fund
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sub-account fund is subject to trading restrictions (e.g., market timing restrictions, fund closure to new investments). When True, new allocations or transfers into this fund may be blocked.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 22c-2 (market timing); FINRA Rule 2010; NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement

attributes.name: last_transfer_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which a fund transfer (in or out) was processed for this sub-account allocation. Used to enforce transfer restriction periods and market timing compliance.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 22c-2; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: market_value
attributes.description: Current fair market value (FMV) of the contract owner's holdings in this sub-account, calculated as units_held multiplied by unit_value as of the valuation date. Contributes to the total Account Value (AV) of the annuity contract.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 (Fair Value Measurement); NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: mortality_expense_risk_charge_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mortality and Expense (M&E) Risk Charge Rate
attributes.description: Annual Mortality and Expense (M&E) risk charge rate assessed against this sub-account's market value, expressed as a percentage. Covers the insurer's mortality risk and expense guarantees. Required for cost disclosure and actuarial reserving.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; SEC Variable Annuity Prospectus Requirements

attributes.name: prospectus_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent fund prospectus under which this sub-account allocation was made. Required for SEC disclosure compliance and ensures the contract owner received current fund information.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 482; Securities Act of 1933 Section 10; FINRA Rule 2210

attributes.name: rebalancing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic portfolio rebalancing is enabled for this sub-account allocation. When True, the contract's holdings are periodically rebalanced back to the target allocation percentages per the rebalancing frequency.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: rebalancing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which automatic portfolio rebalancing is performed for this sub-account allocation, when rebalancing_flag is True. Determines how often the allocation is reset to the target percentage.
attributes.references: NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Standardized risk rating category assigned to this sub-account fund based on its investment objective and volatility profile. Used for suitability matching, asset allocation reporting, and client disclosure.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation; FINRA Rule 2111; SEC Variable Annuity Prospectus Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this allocation record originated (e.g., 'SAPIENS_ANNUITY', 'FAST_ANNUITY'). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: suitability_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the suitability review for this sub-account allocation instruction, per NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation and DOL fiduciary standards. Tracks whether the investment selection has been reviewed and approved as suitable for the contract owner.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation (Model #275); DOL Fiduciary Rule; FINRA Rule 2111

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this sub-account allocation was terminated, transferred, or zeroed out. Null if the allocation is still active. Used for historical allocation tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: transfer_restriction_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of calendar days that must elapse between transfers into and out of this sub-account fund. Enforces market timing restrictions per SEC Rule 22c-2 and fund prospectus requirements.

attributes.name: unit_value
attributes.description: Current Net Asset Value (NAV) per accumulation unit for this sub-account fund as of the valuation date. Sourced from the Investment Management System (e.g., Charles River IMS, SimCorp Dimension) daily pricing feed. Used to compute sub-account market value.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 22c-1; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: units_held
attributes.description: Number of accumulation units held in this sub-account as of the most recent valuation date. Multiplied by the current unit value to derive the sub-account market value. Core field for NAV-based Account Value (AV) calculation.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SEC Rule 22c-1 (forward pricing)

attributes.name: units_purchased_ytd
attributes.description: Cumulative number of accumulation units purchased in this sub-account during the current calendar year. Used for investment activity reporting and tax cost basis tracking under IRC Section 72.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: units_redeemed_ytd
attributes.description: Cumulative number of accumulation units redeemed from this sub-account during the current calendar year due to withdrawals, transfers, or charges. Used for investment activity reporting and cost basis tracking.
attributes.references: IRC Section 72; IRS Publication 575; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this sub-account allocation record. Used for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: Business date as of which the unit value, units held, and market value are reported. Corresponds to the NAV pricing date from the Investment Management System. Critical for daily AV reconciliation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SEC Rule 22c-1; NAIC Annuity Disclosure Model Regulation; FASB ASC 820

products.name: surrender_charge
products.description: Tracks the surrender charge schedule and calculations for annuity contracts. Captures surrender charge percentage by contract year, free withdrawal allowance, market value adjustment (MVA) calculations, and waiver conditions.

attributes.name: surrender_charge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the surrender charge schedule record.

attributes.name: charge_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.charge_schedule. Business justification: annuity.surrender_charge is the contract-specific instantiation of a product.charge_schedule definition. Actuarial reserve calculations, rate filing compliance, and surrender charge waiver processing

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annuity contract to which this surrender charge schedule applies.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Surrender charge collections are recognized as revenue and require journal entries for GAAP deferred revenue release and SAP income recognition. Finance teams reconcile surrender charge income to GL p

attributes.name: pricing_basis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.pricing_basis. Business justification: Surrender charge schedules (period length, rates) are actuarially derived from pricing assumptions (investment return, lapse rates, DAC recovery). This link supports rate filing validation and actuari

attributes.name: rate_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.rate_filing. Business justification: Surrender charge schedules require rate filing approval in many states. Links surrender charge schedules to approved rate filings for regulatory compliance validation. Required for market conduct exam

attributes.name: superseded_surrender_charge_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on surrender_charge (superseded_surrender_charge_id)

attributes.name: charge_application_method
attributes.description: Method by which surrender charges are applied to withdrawals (e.g., pro-rata across all withdrawals, only on amounts exceeding free withdrawal limit, or tiered based on withdrawal amount).

attributes.name: charge_calculation_basis
attributes.description: The basis upon which the surrender charge is calculated (e.g., current account value, premium paid, or withdrawal amount).

attributes.name: contract_year
attributes.description: The contract year to which this surrender charge rate applies, starting from 1 at contract issue.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this surrender charge schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_free_withdrawal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused free withdrawal amounts from prior years can be carried forward and used in subsequent years.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this surrender charge schedule.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this surrender charge schedule becomes effective for the contract.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the surrender charge schedule expires or is no longer applicable, typically at the end of the surrender charge period.

attributes.name: free_withdrawal_basis
attributes.description: The basis upon which the free withdrawal amount is calculated (e.g., account value, premium paid, or benefit base).

attributes.name: free_withdrawal_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of account value that can be withdrawn annually without incurring a surrender charge, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 for 10%).

attributes.name: mva_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a market value adjustment is applied to surrenders in addition to the surrender charge.

attributes.name: mva_formula_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific formula or calculation method used to determine the market value adjustment.

attributes.name: mva_index_type
attributes.description: The interest rate index or benchmark used to calculate the market value adjustment (e.g., 10-Year Treasury, LIBOR).

attributes.name: period_years
attributes.description: Total number of years during which surrender charges apply to the contract.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the annuity product to which this surrender charge schedule applies.

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Type of annuity product (fixed, variable, indexed, or immediate) to which this surrender charge schedule applies.

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to calculate the surrender charge for this contract year, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0800 for 8%).

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the surrender charge schedule, typically aligned with product or contract version.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the surrender charge schedule.

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the surrender charge schedule, used to track changes over time.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this surrender charge schedule data originated (e.g., FAST, Sapiens, EXL).

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the contract was issued, relevant for state-specific surrender charge regulations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this surrender charge schedule record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: waiver_annuitization_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Annuitization Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the contract is annuitized according to the available payout options.

attributes.name: waiver_death_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Death Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived upon the death of the owner or annuitant.

attributes.name: waiver_disability_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Disability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the owner becomes disabled, subject to policy terms.

attributes.name: waiver_ltc_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Long-Term Care (LTC) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the owner qualifies for long-term care benefits under the contract.

attributes.name: waiver_nursing_home_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Nursing Home Confinement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the owner is confined to a nursing home for a specified period.

attributes.name: waiver_rmd_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Required Minimum Distribution (RMD) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived for withdrawals taken to satisfy IRS required minimum distribution requirements.

attributes.name: waiver_terminal_illness_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Terminal Illness Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the owner is diagnosed with a terminal illness.

attributes.name: waiver_unemployment_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Surrender Charge Waiver on Unemployment Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether surrender charges are waived if the owner becomes involuntarily unemployed.

domains.name: reinsurance
domains.description: Governs all reinsurance treaty management, cession processing, and recoverable tracking. Owns YRT and coinsurance treaty terms, automatic and facultative cession records, modified coinsurance, bordereaux reporting, reinsurance premiums, claim recoverables, retrocession arrangements, and reinsurer relationship management. Supports RBC optimization and NAR-based cession calculations with partners such as RGA and Swiss Re.

products.name: treaty
products.description: Master record for all reinsurance treaties governing the terms under which Life Insurance cedes risk to reinsurers such as RGA and Swiss Re. Captures treaty type (YRT, coinsurance, modified coinsurance, excess of loss), treaty number, effective and expiration dates, automatic vs. facultative designation, retention limits, cession basis, currency, and treaty status. This is the SSOT for all reinsurance agreement terms and is the anchor entity for the reinsurance domain.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the reinsurance treaty record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the treaty master entity.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.assumption_set. Business justification: Treaty repricing, experience refund provisions, and RBC credit eligibility are governed by the actuarial assumption set in force. Actuaries reference assumption_set when validating treaty terms and se

attributes.name: experience_study_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.experience_study. Business justification: Treaty renegotiation and recapture eligibility reviews are triggered by experience study findings. Regulators and auditors require traceability from treaty rate changes to the experience study that ju

attributes.name: ifrs17_contract_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ifrs17_contract_group. Business justification: Under IFRS17, each reinsurance treaty held maps to an IFRS17 reinsurance held contract group for initial recognition and subsequent measurement. This link is required for IFRS17 reinsurance held accou

attributes.name: insurance_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Reinsurance treaties are executed legal contracts requiring formal document management (treaty text, amendments, endorsements). Linking the treaty record to its executed document supports treaty lifec

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Treaties are executed by specific legal entities for regulatory reporting, RBC credit allocation, and statutory filing. Reinsurance and finance teams track treaty ownership by legal entity for Schedul

attributes.name: mortality_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.mortality_table. Business justification: Treaties specify mortality tables for YRT rate calculations, risk classification, and automatic binding limit determination. Critical for treaty pricing, facultative underwriting, and reinsurance prem

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Treaties specify covered product lines. Essential for treaty administration, cession eligibility determination, and bordereaux reporting by product. Product_lines_covered is text field; structured FK

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: ModCo and funds-withheld treaties require designated investment portfolios for reserve backing and collateral. Treaty setup process mandates portfolio assignment for ALM matching and regulatory credit

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Treaties must comply with state reinsurance regulations governing retention limits, collateral requirements, and credit for reinsurance eligibility. Regulatory obligations drive treaty structure and f

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the reinsurer counterparty who is party to this treaty arrangement

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Reinsurance treaties are governed by state-specific credit-for-reinsurance laws (e.g., NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law). Compliance officers must verify treaty terms comply with the governing st

attributes.name: allowance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage allowance (expense reimbursement) paid by the reinsurer to the ceding company to offset acquisition and maintenance costs. Applicable primarily to coinsurance and modified coinsurance treaties. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%).
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944-40; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: authorized_product_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product risk lines that this reinsurer is authorized to accept for this product plan (e.g., mortality, morbidity, longevity, investment risk). Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: automatic_binding_limit
attributes.description: Maximum face amount up to which risks are automatically ceded without individual reinsurer approval. Risks exceeding this limit require facultative placement. Key parameter in the automatic cession workflow.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards; RGA AURA Reinsurance Module

attributes.name: bordereaux_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which bordereaux (detailed cession and premium reports) are submitted to the reinsurer under this treaty. Governs the reporting schedule in the Reinsurance Management System.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Module

attributes.name: capacity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate face amount or account value (in USD) that this reinsurer is willing to accept in cessions for this specific product plan. This is product-specific capacity, distinct from the reinsurer-level credit_exposure_limit. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: cession_basis
attributes.description: Indicates whether risk is ceded automatically under treaty terms without individual underwriting review (automatic), on a case-by-case basis requiring reinsurer approval (facultative), or a hybrid of both (automatic-facultative). Drives cession processing workflow in the Reinsurance Management System.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards; RGA AURA Reinsurance Module

attributes.name: cession_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of risk ceded to the reinsurer under quota share or coinsurance arrangements. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Not applicable for YRT or excess-of-loss treaties where cession is NAR-based.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944-40; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral arrangement securing the reinsurer's obligations under this treaty. Required for unauthorized reinsurers to obtain credit for reinsurance. Options include letter of credit, trust account, funds withheld, or none for authorized reinsurers.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission percentage paid by the reinsurer to Life Insurance on ceded premiums for this product, compensating for acquisition costs and administrative expenses.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the treaty record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and LDTI/IFRS 17 compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which treaty premiums, allowances, claims recoverables, and settlements are denominated.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinsurance treaty becomes binding and cessions may commence. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category. Used in cession eligibility checks and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944-40; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurance treaty was formally signed and executed by both parties. May differ from the effective date if the treaty was backdated or signed after the effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; SOX Section 302; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: experience_refund_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treaty includes an experience refund provision, whereby the reinsurer returns a portion of profits to the ceding company if actual claims experience is favorable relative to treaty pricing assumptions.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: experience_refund_provision
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treaty arrangement includes an experience refund provision where favorable claims experience results in profit sharing with Life Insurance.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinsurance treaty expires and no new cessions may be made. Nullable for evergreen/open-ended treaties. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944-40; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: funds_withheld_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treaty operates on a funds-withheld basis, where the ceding company retains the assets backing the ceded reserves rather than transferring them to the reinsurer. Relevant for modified coinsurance and funds-withheld coinsurance structures.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944-40; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: issue_age_max
attributes.description: Maximum insured issue age (in years) eligible for cession under this treaty. Policies with insured issue ages above this threshold are not eligible for automatic cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: issue_age_min
attributes.description: Minimum insured issue age (in years) eligible for cession under this treaty. Policies with insured issue ages below this threshold are not eligible for automatic cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: last_capacity_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capacity limit and terms for this reinsurer-product relationship were last reviewed and confirmed or updated.

attributes.name: max_cession_amount
attributes.description: Maximum face amount or NAR that can be ceded to the reinsurer per life or per policy under this treaty. Caps the reinsurer's exposure on any single risk.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special terms, conditions, or operational considerations specific to this reinsurer-product treaty relationship.

attributes.name: preferred_cession_basis
attributes.description: The preferred reinsurance treaty basis for this reinsurer-product combination (yrt = Yearly Renewable Term, coinsurance, mod_co = Modified Coinsurance, funds_withheld). May differ from the reinsurer's general preferred_treaty_basis depending on product characteristics. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: premium_mode
attributes.description: Frequency at which reinsurance premiums are remitted to the reinsurer under this treaty. Drives the billing and settlement schedule in the Reinsurance Management System.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Module

attributes.name: premium_rate_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which reinsurance premiums are calculated. NAR (Net Amount at Risk) is standard for YRT; face_amount for coinsurance; account_value for modified coinsurance; flat_extra for substandard risks.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944-40; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: product_lines_covered
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or description of insurance product lines covered under this treaty (e.g., 'Term Life, Whole Life, UL'). Defines the scope of eligible policies for cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: rate_competitiveness
attributes.description: Assessment of this reinsurer's pricing competitiveness for this specific product plan relative to market alternatives. Used in reinsurer selection and capacity allocation decisions. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: rbc_credit_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treaty qualifies for RBC credit under NAIC Risk-Based Capital requirements, meaning the reinsurer meets credit-for-reinsurance standards (e.g., authorized reinsurer or collateral posted). Critical for statutory capital optimization.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Framework; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: recapture_eligibility_years
attributes.description: Number of years after treaty inception after which the ceding company is eligible to recapture ceded risks (i.e., bring them back in-house). A key treaty term governing the ceding company's long-term risk management flexibility.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: recapture_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance written notice required by the ceding company to the reinsurer prior to exercising recapture rights under this treaty.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: recapture_provision
attributes.description: Indicates whether Life Insurance has the right to recapture (take back) ceded business from this reinsurer for this product, and under what conditions.

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reinsurance treaty. Active treaties govern ongoing cessions; pending treaties are awaiting execution; terminated treaties are closed to new cessions; suspended treaties are temporarily halted.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary relationship contact at the reinsurer for this treaty. Used for treaty administration, claims recoverable follow-up, and bordereaux dispute resolution.

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this reinsurer's authorization to accept new cessions for this product plan was terminated or expired. Null if relationship is currently active.

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this reinsurer was first authorized to accept cessions for this product plan under treaty arrangements. Identified in detection phase as relationship-specific data.

attributes.name: retention_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum face amount or Net Amount at Risk (NAR) that the ceding company retains per life before ceding the excess to the reinsurer under this treaty. A core parameter for NAR-based cession calculations and RBC optimization.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC RBC Framework; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: retention_limit_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the retention limit amount. Supports multi-currency treaty arrangements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: retention_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of risk that Life Insurance retains on policies ceded under this treaty arrangement (e.g., 10.00 means Life Insurance retains 10% and cedes 90% to the reinsurer).

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treaty is a retrocession arrangement, meaning the company is acting as a reinsurer ceding risk to a retrocessionaire, rather than as a primary ceding company.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: risk_classification_scope
attributes.description: Defines which underwriting risk classifications are eligible for cession under this treaty. 'Standard' covers only standard-rated lives; 'substandard' covers rated/impaired lives; 'all' covers both.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards; Swiss Re Magnum Underwriting Module

attributes.name: settlement_lag_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the reporting period end by which premium settlements and claim recoverables must be remitted between the ceding company and the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: source_system_treaty_reference
attributes.description: Native treaty identifier as recorded in the operational Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA Reinsurance). Enables traceability from the lakehouse silver layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance Module

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the treaty was terminated for new cessions, if applicable. Distinct from expiration_date (contractual end) — this captures the operational termination event date.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance written notice required by either party to terminate the treaty for new cessions. Does not affect in-force ceded risks, which typically run off under treaty terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for treaty termination. Used for regulatory reporting, actuarial experience studies, and reinsurer relationship management.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: treaty_name
attributes.description: Descriptive business name of the reinsurance treaty (e.g., 'RGA YRT Life 2020 Agreement'). Used for human-readable identification in reporting and reinsurer communications.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: treaty_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the reinsurance treaty, as referenced in bordereaux reporting, cession schedules, and reinsurer correspondence. Sourced from the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance).
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Module

attributes.name: treaty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this reinsurer-product treaty relationship. Active treaties are available for new cessions.

attributes.name: treaty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reinsurance arrangement structure. YRT (Yearly Renewable Term) is NAR-based; coinsurance shares proportional risk and reserve; modified coinsurance retains reserves with the ceding company; excess of loss provides catastrophic coverage above a retention limit; quota share cedes a fixed percentage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: YRT|coinsurance|modified_coinsurance|excess_of_loss|quota_share|stop_loss|funds_withheld — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944-40; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the treaty record was last modified in the system of record. Supports change data capture, audit trail, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version or amendment number of the treaty document (e.g., '1.0', '2.3', 'Amendment 4'). Tracks the evolution of treaty terms through amendments and endorsements over the treaty lifecycle.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Standards; SOX Section 302

products.name: reinsurer
products.description: Master record for all reinsurance counterparty organizations with whom Life Insurance maintains treaty or facultative relationships. Captures reinsurer legal name, NAIC company code, AM Best rating and rating history, S&P/Moody's ratings, domicile jurisdiction, contact details, authorized lines of business, credit exposure limits, collateral requirements, trust account details, and relationship status. Includes partners such as RGA, Swiss Re, Munich Re, and Hannover Re. Supports counterparty credit risk monitoring per NAIC Schedule S Part 6 requirements. Distinct from the agent domain — this is the SSOT for reinsurance counterparty identity and creditworthiness.

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the reinsurance counterparty record in the Life Insurance lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the reinsurer master data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S Part 6; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: collateral_portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Reinsurers establish trust accounts and collateral portfolios to secure ceded reserves per regulatory requirements. Business process: collateral monitoring, trust account reconciliation, and RBC credi

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.counterparty. Business justification: Under funds-withheld and ModCo treaties, reinsurers are investment counterparties subject to ISDA agreements, credit exposure limits, and collateral management. Investment credit risk teams require th

attributes.name: insurance_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Reinsurers require executed reinsurance agreements, financial statements, credit rating reports, authorization certificates, AML/KYC documentation, and OFAC screening results. Credit risk management a

attributes.name: jurisdiction_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction_license. Business justification: Reinsurers must hold valid licenses in each jurisdiction where they accept business. Critical for determining credit for reinsurance eligibility, RBC counterparty factors, and authorized reinsurer sta

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policyholder.party. Business justification: Reinsurers are corporate entities requiring party master records for KYC/AML compliance, contact management, address tracking, and regulatory reporting. Standard practice in insurance operations to ma

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Reinsurers must comply with specific regulatory obligations (e.g., Dodd-Frank collateral requirements for non-admitted reinsurers, NAIC credit for reinsurance model law). Compliance teams track which

attributes.name: am_best_outlook
attributes.description: AM Best rating outlook indicating the likely direction of the Financial Strength Rating over the medium term. 'under_review' indicates a rating under review for potential upgrade or downgrade. Used in counterparty credit risk monitoring and treaty renewal decisions.
attributes.references: AM Best Rating Services; ORSA ERM Framework

attributes.name: am_best_rating
attributes.description: Current AM Best Financial Strength Rating (FSR) assigned to the reinsurer, reflecting its ability to meet ongoing insurance obligations. Critical for counterparty credit risk assessment and treaty approval. Values follow AM Best's rating scale (A++ through F). Monitored continuously per NAIC Schedule S Part 6 requirements.
attributes.references: AM Best Rating Services; NAIC Schedule S Part 6; ORSA ERM Framework

attributes.name: am_best_rating_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current AM Best Financial Strength Rating was assigned or last affirmed. Used to determine rating currency and trigger re-evaluation workflows when ratings are stale beyond defined thresholds.
attributes.references: AM Best Rating Services; NAIC Schedule S Part 6

attributes.name: aml_kyc_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent AML/KYC due diligence review was completed for this reinsurer. Used to trigger periodic re-review workflows per the AML compliance program schedule (typically annual or upon material change in relationship status or ratings).
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; Bank Secrecy Act; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: aml_kyc_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Anti-Money Laundering / Know Your Customer (AML/KYC) Status
attributes.description: Current AML/KYC due diligence status for the reinsurer counterparty. 'approved' indicates completed and passed due diligence. 'pending_review' indicates initial or periodic review in progress. 'under_investigation' indicates a flag raised by compliance. 'rejected' indicates failed due diligence. Required for FinCEN BSA/AML compliance and OFAC sanctions screening.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA; OFAC Sanctions; Bank Secrecy Act; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: bordereaux_submission_frequency
attributes.description: Agreed frequency at which Life Insurance submits bordereaux (detailed cession and premium reports) to this reinsurer. Governs the reporting schedule in the Reinsurance Management System bordereaux reporting module. Typically monthly for YRT treaties and quarterly for coinsurance arrangements.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; ACORD Reinsurance Standards; Treaty Agreement Terms

attributes.name: collateral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reinsurer is required to post collateral (e.g., letters of credit, trust accounts, funds withheld) as a condition of receiving credit for reinsurance under applicable state law. True for unauthorized/alien reinsurers not meeting certified reinsurer status. Drives collateral monitoring workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; State Department of Insurance

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral arrangement required from or provided by this reinsurer to secure reinsurance recoverables. 'letter_of_credit' is most common for unauthorized reinsurers. 'trust_account' denotes a dedicated reinsurance trust. 'funds_withheld' denotes a modified coinsurance or funds-withheld arrangement. Null or 'none' when collateral is not required.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: credit_exposure_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit exposure limit and collateral amounts are denominated (e.g., 'USD'). Supports multi-currency treaty arrangements with international reinsurers.

attributes.name: credit_exposure_limit
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate credit exposure (in USD) that Life Insurance is authorized to hold with this reinsurer across all treaties and facultative arrangements. Established by the ERM credit risk framework and approved by the Chief Risk Officer. Triggers automated alerts when aggregate ceded reserves approach this threshold. Supports RBC optimization and counterparty concentration risk management.
attributes.references: NAIC ORSA; ERM Credit Risk Policy; RBC Framework; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: domicile_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the reinsurer is legally domiciled and licensed (e.g., 'USA', 'CHE' for Switzerland, 'DEU' for Germany, 'BMU' for Bermuda). Determines applicable credit for reinsurance rules and collateral requirements under NAIC Model Law.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: domicile_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the state of domicile for US-domiciled reinsurers (e.g., 'MO' for Missouri where RGA is domiciled). Null for non-US reinsurers. Used for state regulatory reporting and credit for reinsurance qualification.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule S; State Department of Insurance filings

attributes.name: fein
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) / Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) assigned by the IRS to the reinsurer entity. Required for tax withholding, 1099 reporting, and IRS compliance. Classified confidential due to sensitivity of tax identifiers.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRC Section 6041; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: headquarters_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the reinsurer's global headquarters is located (e.g., 'USA' for RGA, 'CHE' for Swiss Re, 'DEU' for Munich Re). May differ from domicile_country for subsidiaries and branches. Used for geopolitical risk assessment and sanctions screening.

attributes.name: internal_credit_grade
attributes.description: Life Insurance's internally assigned credit grade for this reinsurer counterparty (1=highest quality through 5=watch list/impaired). Assigned by the ERM/credit risk team based on a composite assessment of AM Best, S&P, Moody's ratings, financial statements, and qualitative factors. Drives credit exposure limit setting and treaty approval authority levels.
