attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: ceded_claim_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross claim amount ceded to the reinsurer under the applicable treaty, representing the maximum recoverable before any adjustments or disputes.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: claim_event_date
attributes.description: Date of the insured event (e.g., date of death, date of disability onset) that triggered the underlying claim. The principal real-world business event timestamp for this recoverable.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the underlying claim driving the recoverable. Includes Death Benefit (DB), Accidental Death Benefit (ADB), Long-Term Care (LTC), disability, maturity, surrender, and annuity payout claims. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: death_benefit|adb|ltc|disability|maturity|surrender|annuity_payout — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reinsurance recoverable record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for SOX and data governance compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this recoverable record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency reinsurance treaty arrangements.

attributes.name: dispute_open_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer formally raised the dispute. Starts the dispute resolution clock and triggers legal/reinsurance operations oversight. Null when is_disputed is False.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dispute was formally resolved and closed. Null if the dispute is still open. Used to measure dispute cycle time and reinsurer relationship performance.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Method by which the dispute was or is being resolved. Negotiation = bilateral agreement; arbitration = binding third-party decision per treaty arbitration clause; litigation = court proceedings; mediation = non-binding facilitated resolution; withdrawal = reinsurer withdrew the dispute. Null when is_disputed is False.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current state of the dispute lifecycle. 'open' = newly raised; 'under_review' = being evaluated; 'escalated' = referred to legal or senior management; 'resolved' = agreed outcome reached; 'withdrawn' = reinsurer retracted the dispute. Null when is_disputed is False.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the reinsurer's dispute. Coverage interpretation disputes involve treaty scope; treaty terms disputes involve contractual language; claim validity disputes challenge the underlying claim; documentation disputes involve missing or insufficient evidence; calculation disputes involve amount computation. Null when is_disputed is False.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The specific monetary amount contested by the reinsurer. May equal the full recoverable_amount or a partial portion. Null when is_disputed is False. Critical for legal reserve estimation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractual date by which the reinsurer is obligated to remit payment per the treaty terms. Used for aging bucket analysis and escalation of overdue recoverables.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: gross_claim_amount
attributes.description: Total gross claim payment made by Life Insurance to the claimant before any reinsurance recovery. Represents the full liability settled on the underlying policy.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: is_disputed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer has formally disputed this recoverable. True when the recoverable_status is 'disputed' or a dispute record is active. Drives legal and reinsurance operations workflow.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: is_facultative
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recoverable is associated with a facultative (individually negotiated) reinsurance arrangement rather than an automatic treaty. Facultative recoverables require additional documentation and underwriting evidence.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: is_retrocession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recoverable arises from a retrocession arrangement, where the reinsurer has itself ceded a portion of the risk to another reinsurer. True for retrocession recoverables; False for direct treaty recoverables.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: nar_at_cession
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) at Cession
attributes.description: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) on the underlying policy at the time of cession, representing the death benefit minus the policy account value. Used in YRT premium calculations and RBC optimization analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC RBC Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the recoverable, calculated as recoverable_amount minus amount_received. Drives statutory balance sheet reporting and RBC optimization analysis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; NAIC RBC Model Law

attributes.name: recoverable_amount
attributes.description: The calculated amount Life Insurance expects to recover from the reinsurer, derived from the ceded claim amount multiplied by the recoverable percentage. This is the primary balance sheet asset for statutory reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements)

attributes.name: recoverable_percentage
attributes.description: The contractual percentage of the ceded claim amount recoverable from the reinsurer as defined in the treaty terms. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Used in NAR-based cession calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: recoverable_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned to this reinsurance recoverable record, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer correspondence. Sourced from the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance).
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: recoverable_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reinsurance recoverable. 'pending' = identified but not yet submitted; 'submitted' = sent to reinsurer awaiting payment; 'received' = payment collected; 'disputed' = reinsurer has contested the recoverable; 'closed' = fully resolved; 'waived' = recoverable forgone.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: reinsurance_premium_paid
attributes.description: Total reinsurance premium paid to the reinsurer for the ceded risk on the underlying policy up to the claim event date. Used in net cost-of-reinsurance analysis and profitability reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: reinsurer_response
attributes.description: Free-text summary of the reinsurer's formal response or position on the recoverable or dispute, as communicated in writing. Captures treaty interpretation arguments, documentation requests, or payment confirmations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer completed payment of the recoverable amount. Null if the recoverable has not yet been settled. Used for cash flow and aging analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this recoverable record was extracted (e.g., SWISS_RE_IRIS, RGA_AURA). Supports data lineage and ETL audit traceability in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recoverable claim was formally submitted to the reinsurer for payment. Triggers the reinsurer's response and payment obligation timeline per treaty terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this reinsurance recoverable record. Tracks the last modification for change data capture and audit trail purposes in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; ACORD Data Standards

products.name: bordereaux
products.description: Periodic summary reporting package submitted to reinsurers detailing all cessions, premiums, and claims activity within a reporting period. Captures bordereaux type (premium, claims, in-force), reporting period, reinsurer, treaty reference, submission date, total ceded face amount, total reinsurance premium, total recoverables, and submission status. Supports Swiss Re IRIS and RGA AURA bordereaux reporting module requirements.

attributes.name: bordereaux_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each bordereaux submission record in the reinsurance management system. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module

attributes.name: insurance_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Bordereaux are formal reporting documents submitted to reinsurers with supporting schedules, reconciliation reports, and reinsurer acknowledgment letters. Treaty administration and settlement processe

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Bordereaux settlement accounting requires GL posting reference for monthly close, reinsurer reconciliation, and cash flow tracking. Finance teams post bordereaux net settlements to GL and reconcile to

attributes.name: original_bordereaux_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original bordereaux record when this record represents a corrected resubmission. Null for original submissions. Enables audit trail linking between original and corrected bordereaux versions.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance; NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Bordereaux data feeds statutory annual statement filings, particularly Schedule S reporting of reinsurance ceded. Direct link required for audit trail, filing reconciliation, and regulatory examinatio

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer counterparty (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re, Munich Re) to whom this bordereaux is submitted. Links to the reinsurer party master record.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which this bordereaux is submitted. Links to the treaty master record governing the cession terms (YRT, coinsurance, modified coinsurance, etc.).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: Bordereaux submissions provide reinsurance data inputs for actuarial valuation runs. Critical for quarterly valuation data reconciliation, reserve calculation validation, and statutory filing preparat

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bordereaux was formally approved by the authorized approver prior to submission to the reinsurer. Part of the internal control workflow for reinsurance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the authorized individual who approved this bordereaux submission prior to transmission to the reinsurer. Required for internal control and SOX compliance in the reinsurance reporting process.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: bordereaux_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the bordereaux submission, used for tracking and reconciliation with the reinsurer (e.g., Swiss Re, RGA). Corresponds to the submission reference in Swiss Re IRIS and RGA AURA bordereaux reporting modules.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: bordereaux_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bordereaux submission indicating the category of reinsurance activity reported. Premium bordereaux report ceded premiums; claims bordereaux report reinsurance recoverables; in-force bordereaux report active ceded policies; lapse bordereaux report terminated cessions; new business bordereaux report newly ceded policies.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: cession_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cessions reported in this bordereaux are automatic (ceded under treaty automatic binding limits), facultative (individually underwritten and negotiated), or retrocession (reinsurer ceding risk to another reinsurer). Drives different processing workflows in the reinsurance management system.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Cession Processing Module

attributes.name: claim_count
attributes.description: The total number of reinsurance claim recoverable transactions included in this bordereaux submission for the reporting period. Applicable primarily to claims bordereaux type submissions.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance; NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bordereaux record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Provides the audit trail creation point for data governance and lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts reported in this bordereaux (e.g., USD for US Dollar). All ceded face amounts, reinsurance premiums, and recoverables are denominated in this currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Standards; NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractually required deadline by which the bordereaux must be submitted to the reinsurer as specified in the reinsurance treaty terms. Used for monitoring compliance with reporting obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Reinsurance Treaty Terms

attributes.name: is_retrocession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bordereaux covers retrocession arrangements where the reinsurer is itself ceding risk to another reinsurer. True for retrocession bordereaux; False for standard cession bordereaux.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The net financial settlement amount for this bordereaux period, calculated as total reinsurance premium minus total recoverables minus total allowance amount. A positive value indicates a net payment due to the reinsurer; a negative value indicates a net recovery due to the ceding company.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; Swiss Re IRIS

attributes.name: new_cession_count
attributes.description: The number of newly ceded policies included in this bordereaux submission during the reporting period. Represents new business (NB) ceded to the reinsurer and is used for new business value (NBV) analysis and treaty capacity monitoring.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance; NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional commentary, exceptions, or explanatory notes related to this bordereaux submission. Used by the reinsurance operations team to document special circumstances, adjustments, or communications with the reinsurer.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance; Internal Reinsurance Operations

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The insurance product line classification for the policies covered in this bordereaux. Identifies whether the ceded business is term life, whole life (WL), universal life (UL), variable life (VUL/IUL), annuity, disability income (DI), or long-term care (LTC). Used for treaty-level product segmentation and experience analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: term_life|whole_life|universal_life|variable_life|annuity|disability_income|long_term_care — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; ACORD Standards; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: reinsurer_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinsurer formally acknowledged receipt of the bordereaux submission. Used to confirm delivery and initiate the reinsurer review and settlement process.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance; NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation

attributes.name: reinsurer_treaty_reference
attributes.description: The reinsurer's own internal reference code or identifier for the treaty, as used in the reinsurer's system (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS treaty code or RGA AURA treaty identifier). Required for cross-system reconciliation and bordereaux matching at the reinsurer.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The contractually agreed frequency at which bordereaux submissions are made to the reinsurer under the treaty terms. Determines the reporting period duration and submission schedule.
attributes.references: Reinsurance Treaty Terms; NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the reporting period covered by this bordereaux submission. Together with reporting_period_start_date, defines the complete activity window for cession, premium, and claims reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; ACORD Standards; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the reporting period covered by this bordereaux submission. Defines the beginning of the activity window for which cessions, premiums, and claims are being reported to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; ACORD Standards; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: resubmission_number
attributes.description: Sequential counter indicating how many times this bordereaux has been resubmitted to the reinsurer after an initial rejection or correction. A value of 0 indicates the original submission; values greater than 0 indicate corrected resubmissions.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance; NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the net financial settlement for this bordereaux was completed. Compared against settlement_due_date to identify late settlements and treaty compliance issues.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; Swiss Re IRIS

attributes.name: settlement_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the net financial settlement for this bordereaux must be completed between the ceding company and the reinsurer. Determined by treaty payment terms and used for cash flow management and accounts receivable/payable tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Reinsurance Treaty Terms; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this bordereaux data was originated or extracted. Identifies whether the data came from Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance, the Policy Administration System, or was manually prepared. Used for data lineage and ETL audit purposes.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the bordereaux was formally submitted to the reinsurer. Used for tracking timeliness of reporting obligations and treaty compliance deadlines.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: submission_format
attributes.description: The file or data format in which the bordereaux was submitted to the reinsurer. ACORD XML is the industry standard; CSV and Excel are common for legacy systems; EDI is used for electronic data interchange with certain reinsurers.
attributes.references: ACORD Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: The channel or method used to transmit the bordereaux to the reinsurer. Electronic submissions via SFTP or API are standard for Swiss Re IRIS and RGA AURA integrations; portal submissions use the reinsurer's web portal; email is used for legacy or manual submissions.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the bordereaux submission in the workflow. Draft indicates preparation in progress; submitted indicates sent to reinsurer; acknowledged indicates receipt confirmed; accepted indicates reinsurer validated and approved; rejected indicates reinsurer identified discrepancies; under_review indicates reinsurer is processing.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance; NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation

attributes.name: terminated_cession_count
attributes.description: The number of cessions terminated during the reporting period due to policy lapses, surrenders, deaths, or other termination events. Used for in-force reconciliation and treaty run-off analysis.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance; NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation

attributes.name: total_allowance_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate expense allowance or ceding commission paid by the reinsurer to the ceding company for the business ceded in this bordereaux period. Offsets the ceding company's acquisition and maintenance costs under coinsurance and modified coinsurance treaties.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: total_ceded_face_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate face amount (death benefit) of all policies ceded to the reinsurer within the reporting period covered by this bordereaux. Represents the total net amount at risk (NAR) transferred to the reinsurer. Used for RBC optimization analysis and treaty capacity monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: total_ceded_reserve
attributes.description: The aggregate actuarial reserve ceded to the reinsurer for all in-force cessions reported in this bordereaux. Relevant for coinsurance and modified coinsurance treaties where reserve credit is taken. Supports PBR compliance and RBC calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944 LDTI; PBR (Principle-Based Reserving)

attributes.name: total_cession_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual policy cession records included in this bordereaux submission for the reporting period. Used for reconciliation and completeness validation against the reinsurance management system cession records.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance; ACORD Standards

attributes.name: total_recoverables
attributes.description: The aggregate amount recoverable from the reinsurer for claims paid on ceded policies during the reporting period. Represents the reinsurer's share of claim settlements and is a key asset on the ceding company's balance sheet under SAP and GAAP.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944 LDTI

attributes.name: total_reinsurance_premium
attributes.description: The aggregate reinsurance premium payable to the reinsurer for all cessions reported in this bordereaux during the reporting period. Represents the cost of risk transfer and is a key financial settlement figure in the bordereaux.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bordereaux record was most recently modified in the reinsurance management system. Used for change tracking, data reconciliation, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The actuarial valuation date as of which reserves, net amount at risk (NAR), and in-force amounts are calculated for this bordereaux. Typically the last day of the reporting period. Aligns with actuarial valuation system (AXIS, MoSes, Prophet) run dates.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; PBR (Principle-Based Reserving); FASB ASC 944 LDTI; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

products.name: bordereaux_line
products.description: Individual line-item detail within a bordereaux submission, representing one cession or claim recoverable record included in the periodic report. Captures policy reference, insured details, ceded amount, premium or recoverable amount, risk class, plan code, and line status. Enables granular reconciliation between bordereaux submissions and individual cession and claim recoverable records.

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual line item within a bordereaux submission. Serves as the primary key for this record in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: cession_id

attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Cession Processing Module

Adding claim_recoverable_id creates a direct FK to the authoritative claim_recove

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance counterparty (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re) to whom this risk or recoverable is reported on this bordereaux line.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which this cession or claim recoverable is reported. Links the line to the governing treaty terms including YRT or coinsurance arrangements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bordereaux line is an adjustment or correction to a previously submitted line. True when the line represents a retroactive correction to prior period amounts.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Ceding allowance or expense allowance paid by the reinsurer to the ceding company on this line, representing the reinsurer's contribution toward acquisition and maintenance expenses under coinsurance treaties.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; Swiss Re IRIS

attributes.name: attained_age
attributes.description: Age of the insured at the time of the reporting period, used for YRT rate table lookups and NAR-based premium calculations. Typically calculated as age nearest or age last birthday per treaty terms.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation on Life Insurance; Swiss Re IRIS

attributes.name: ceded_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the policy face amount ceded to the reinsurer under the applicable treaty. Represents the reinsurer's share of the death benefit risk for this line.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; Swiss Re IRIS Cession Processing Module

attributes.name: claim_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Amount recoverable from the reinsurer for a paid or pending claim on this bordereaux line, representing the reinsurer's proportional share of the claim payment based on the ceded amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; Guidewire ClaimCenter; Swiss Re IRIS Recoverables Tracking Module

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Type of insurance claim associated with this bordereaux line when reporting claim recoverables. Distinguishes death claims, disability income (DI) claims, waiver of premium, critical illness, and Accidental Death Benefit (ADB) claims.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; ACORD Life Data Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bordereaux line record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and reconciliation processes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Audit Rule; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this bordereaux line (e.g., USD). Required for multi-currency treaty arrangements and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: face_amount
attributes.description: Total face amount (death benefit) of the underlying life insurance policy. Represents the gross insurance in force before any reinsurance cession.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Sapiens LifePro Policy Administration

attributes.name: flat_extra_premium
attributes.description: Additional per-thousand flat extra premium charged for temporary or permanent extra mortality risk not captured by table ratings (e.g., hazardous occupation, aviation). Applied in reinsurance premium calculations.
attributes.references: RGAX AURA Underwriting Workbench; Swiss Re Magnum; NAIC Model Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number of this record within the parent bordereaux submission, used for ordering, reconciliation, and identifying specific lines during dispute resolution.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this bordereaux line item within the reinsurance settlement workflow. Tracks the lifecycle from initial submission through reinsurer acceptance, dispute resolution, or voiding.

attributes.name: line_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of this bordereaux line item, distinguishing between reinsurance premium cessions, claim recoverables, reserve credits, experience refunds, and allowances. Drives downstream accounting and reconciliation logic. attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: mib_code
attributes.description: Medical Information Bureau (MIB) code associated with the insured's underwriting file, if applicable. Used by reinsurers to verify underwriting integrity and detect potential anti-selection.
attributes.references: MIB Group Data Standards; HIPAA Privacy Rule; RGAX AURA Underwriting Workbench

attributes.name: nar_amount
attributes.description: Net Amount at Risk representing the reinsurer's exposure on this cession, calculated as the ceded death benefit less the policy's reserve or account value. Drives YRT reinsurance premium calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; ACORD Life Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: policy_duration_years
attributes.description: Number of complete policy years elapsed since the policy issue date as of the reporting period. Used in select-and-ultimate mortality table lookups and experience studies.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: policy_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the underlying life insurance policy was originally issued. Used to determine policy duration, treaty applicability, and contestability period status.
attributes.references: ACORD Life Data Standards; Sapiens LifePro Policy Administration; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: reinsurance_premium_amount
attributes.description: Reinsurance premium due to the reinsurer for this bordereaux line for the reporting period. Calculated based on NAR, treaty rates, and risk class for YRT treaties, or as a proportional share for coinsurance treaties.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: reinsurer_line_reference
attributes.description: The reinsurer's own reference number or identifier for this bordereaux line as assigned by the reinsurer (e.g., RGA or Swiss Re internal reference). Used for cross-party reconciliation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the bordereaux reporting period covered by this line item. Defines the close of the interval for which premiums, recoverables, or other amounts are being reported.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the bordereaux reporting period covered by this line item. Defines the beginning of the interval for which premiums, recoverables, or other amounts are being reported.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module

attributes.name: retrocession_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bordereaux line relates to a retrocession arrangement, where the reinsurer has further ceded a portion of the risk to a retrocessionaire.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Reinsurance Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: risk_class
attributes.description: Underwriting risk classification assigned to the insured at policy issue, reflecting mortality risk level. Drives reinsurance premium rates and NAR-based cession calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preferred_plus|preferred|standard_plus|standard|substandard|rated|uninsurable — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: RGAX AURA Underwriting Workbench; Swiss Re Magnum; NAIC Model Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: smoker_status
attributes.description: Tobacco use status of the insured as determined at underwriting. A key mortality risk factor that affects reinsurance premium rates and risk classification under YRT and coinsurance treaties.
attributes.references: RGAX AURA Underwriting Workbench; ACORD Life Data Standards; NAIC Model Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: state_of_issue
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the underlying policy was issued. Relevant for state-specific regulatory compliance, reserve requirements, and treaty applicability by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; State Departments of Insurance; ACORD Life Data Standards

attributes.name: table_rating
attributes.description: Substandard mortality table rating applied to the insured (e.g., Table B, Table D, 150%), indicating the degree of extra mortality risk above standard. Affects reinsurance premium rates for rated policies.
attributes.references: RGAX AURA Underwriting Workbench; Swiss Re Magnum; NAIC Model Underwriting Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bordereaux line record was last modified in the Silver Layer data product, capturing status changes, adjustments, or dispute resolutions.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Model Audit Rule; ACORD Data Standards

products.name: nar_calculation
products.description: Stores the periodic Net Amount at Risk (NAR) calculations for each ceded policy, which form the basis for YRT reinsurance premium billing. Captures calculation date, policy reference, death benefit, account value or reserve, NAR amount, calculation method, and effective period. NAR is the fundamental driver of YRT cost of insurance charges and reinsurance premium computation. Supports actuarial and reinsurance premium reconciliation.

attributes.name: nar_calculation_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Amount at Risk (NAR) Calculation ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Net Amount at Risk (NAR) calculation record in the reinsurance domain. Primary key for the nar_calculation data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: account_value_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.account_value. Business justification: NAR = death_benefit - account_value. The nar_calculation stores account_value_amount as a denormalized plain column. Replacing with FK to account_value provides audit traceability to the exact valuati

attributes.name: benefit_base_id

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific reinsurance cession record under which this NAR calculation is performed. Links to the cession record in the Reinsurance Management System.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: coi_rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.coi_rate_schedule. Business justification: NAR calculations use COI rates from the product's COI rate schedule to determine the net amount at risk for reinsurance purposes. The coi_rate_per_thousand on nar_calculation is sourced from this sche

attributes.name: contract_id

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ceded life insurance policy for which the NAR is being calculated. Links to the policy master record in the Policy Administration System.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: mortality_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.mortality_table. Business justification: NAR calculation applies mortality table COI rates to determine net amount at risk (death benefit minus reserve). rate_table_version is a denormalized reference to the mortality table version used. A r

attributes.name: premium_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.premium_schedule. Business justification: NAR calculations require premium schedule data including modal premium amount, billing frequency, and paid-to-date status to compute net amount at risk accurately. Actuaries use this for treaty settle

attributes.name: prior_nar_calculation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous NAR calculation record for the same policy and cession, enabling version chaining for corrections and restatements. Null for the initial calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: reinsurer_id

attributes.name: reserve_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.reserve_calculation. Business justification: NAR calculations feed directly into reserve calculations for reinsurance accounting, premium billing, and statutory reporting. NAR is the basis for YRT premium calculation and reserve credit.

attributes.name: rider_benefit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.rider_benefit. Business justification: NAR calculations for annuity reinsurance are rider-specific (GMDB NAR differs from GMWB NAR on the same contract). Linking nar_calculation to rider_benefit identifies which rider's risk is being measu

attributes.name: separate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.separate_account. Business justification: For variable life and VUL policies, the net amount at risk equals death benefit minus separate account value. The NAR calculation must reference the specific separate account to retrieve current fund

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty (YRT or coinsurance) governing the cession for which NAR is calculated. Determines the applicable COI rates and premium computation rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: treaty_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.treaty_schedule. Business justification: NAR calculations use treaty schedule parameters (yrt_rate_per_thousand, retention_limit, coinsurance_percentage, attained_age_basis) to compute the net amount at risk for each ceded policy. nar_calcul

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: NAR calculations are produced within specific actuarial valuation runs. Reserve reconciliation, LDTI/IFRS17 reporting, and RBC calculations require tracing NAR amounts to the valuation run that genera

attributes.name: value_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.value. Business justification: NAR calculations use the specific policy value snapshot (account value, death benefit) as direct actuarial input. Actuarial audit and reinsurance premium reconciliation require tracing which exact val

attributes.name: billing_period_type
attributes.description: The frequency at which the reinsurance premium is billed to the reinsurer for this cession. Determines the proration of the annual NAR-based premium across billing cycles.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The YYYY-MM formatted reporting period for which this NAR calculation is included in the bordereaux report submitted to the reinsurer. Used for reinsurance premium reconciliation and treaty compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: The accounting basis under which the NAR calculation is performed. Statutory (SAP) basis is used for regulatory reporting; GAAP basis for financial reporting under FASB ASC 944; IFRS basis for international reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17; LDTI

attributes.name: calculation_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which the Net Amount at Risk was calculated for the ceded policy. Represents the principal real-world event date for this calculation record.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; LDTI

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The actuarial method used to compute the Net Amount at Risk. Determines how the death benefit and reserve or account value are combined to derive NAR. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_amount_at_risk_standard|interpolated_reserve|account_value_offset|modified_coinsurance|coinsurance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: calculation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing any exceptions, manual overrides, or special circumstances associated with this NAR calculation, such as facultative underwriting adjustments or treaty amendment impacts.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: calculation_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this NAR calculation record, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurance premium reconciliation with reinsurance partners such as RGA and Swiss Re.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting

attributes.name: calculation_run_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NAR calculation was produced as part of a scheduled periodic run, an ad hoc request, a correction to a prior calculation, or a restatement for prior-period adjustments.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: calculation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the NAR calculation record. Indicates whether the calculation is pending review, completed and approved, revised due to data corrections, voided, or in error state.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: ceded_death_benefit_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross death benefit ceded to the reinsurer under the treaty. May differ from the gross death benefit when only a portion of the risk is ceded (e.g., automatic cession limits apply).
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: coi_rate_per_thousand
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Insurance (COI) Rate per Thousand
attributes.description: The YRT cost of insurance (COI) rate per $1,000 of Net Amount at Risk, sourced from the applicable treaty rate table based on attained age, gender, risk class, smoker status, and policy year. Directly used to compute the reinsurance premium.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; YRT Treaty Rate Tables; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this NAR calculation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this NAR calculation record (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency reinsurance treaties.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: death_benefit_amount
attributes.description: The gross death benefit (DB) payable under the ceded policy as of the calculation date. Represents the total face amount including any riders such as Accidental Death Benefit (ADB) that are included in the cession.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The start date of the period for which this NAR calculation is effective. Used to determine the applicable YRT reinsurance premium billing period.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The end date of the period for which this NAR calculation is effective. Defines the close of the billing period for YRT reinsurance premium computation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: insured_age_at_calculation
attributes.description: The attained age of the insured as of the calculation date. Used in YRT rate table lookups to determine the applicable cost of insurance (COI) rate per unit of NAR for reinsurance premium billing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; YRT Treaty Rate Tables

attributes.name: insured_gender
attributes.description: The gender of the insured as used in the YRT rate table lookup. Unisex rates apply where state regulations prohibit gender-distinct pricing.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; State Department of Insurance Regulations; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: is_retrocession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NAR calculation pertains to a retrocession arrangement (i.e., the company is acting as a reinsurer ceding risk to a retrocessionaire). Distinguishes direct cession NAR from retrocession NAR in reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: nar_amount
attributes.description: The computed Net Amount at Risk (NAR), representing the difference between the ceded death benefit and the policy reserve or account value. This is the fundamental driver of YRT cost of insurance (COI) charges and reinsurance premium computation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; YRT Treaty Terms

attributes.name: policy_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The actuarial reserve held for the ceded policy as of the valuation date. Used in the NAR calculation as the offset against the death benefit for traditional life products. Derived from the Actuarial Valuation System (e.g., AXIS, Prophet).
attributes.references: NAIC PBR; FASB ASC 944; LDTI; SAP

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The policy year in force as of the calculation date. Used in YRT rate table lookups where rates vary by policy duration, and for actuarial experience studies.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; YRT Treaty Rate Tables

attributes.name: product_type_code
attributes.description: The type of life insurance product for the ceded policy. Determines the applicable NAR calculation method (e.g., account value offset for UL/IUL/VUL vs. interpolated reserve for WL/Term). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wl|ul|iul|vul|term|yrt|ltc|di — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: rbc_credit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurance cession associated with this NAR calculation qualifies for Risk-Based Capital (RBC) credit under NAIC RBC rules. Supports RBC optimization reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Model Act; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP

attributes.name: reinsurance_premium_amount
attributes.description: The reinsurance premium payable to the reinsurer for the effective period, computed as (NAR / 1,000) × COI rate per thousand. This is the primary output of the NAR calculation used in YRT premium billing and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_type
attributes.description: The type of reinsurance treaty under which the NAR is calculated. YRT (Yearly Renewable Term) treaties use NAR directly for premium billing; coinsurance and modified coinsurance treaties use NAR for risk monitoring and RBC optimization.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: risk_class
attributes.description: The underwriting risk classification assigned to the insured, which determines the applicable YRT COI rate tier. Preferred classes attract lower reinsurance premiums; substandard or rated classes attract higher rates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preferred_plus|preferred|standard_plus|standard|substandard|rated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA; Swiss Re Magnum); ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: smoker_status
attributes.description: Tobacco/smoker status of the insured as used in YRT rate table lookups. Smoker status significantly impacts the COI rate applied to the NAR for reinsurance premium computation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; YRT Treaty Rate Tables

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which the NAR calculation data was originated (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance, AXIS Actuarial Valuation System). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting

attributes.name: treaty_year
attributes.description: The year of the reinsurance treaty in force at the time of the NAR calculation. Used to identify the applicable rate table version when treaty terms are renegotiated periodically.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this NAR calculation record was last modified. Tracks revisions, corrections, and restatements for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The actuarial valuation date as of which the policy reserve or account value is measured for NAR computation. Typically aligns with the beginning-of-year (BOY) or end-of-year (EOY) valuation cycle.
attributes.references: NAIC PBR; FASB ASC 944; LDTI; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

products.name: recapture_event
products.description: Tracks recapture events where Life Insurance exercises its contractual right to reclaim previously ceded risk from a reinsurer, typically triggered by improved mortality experience, treaty renegotiation, or reinsurer credit concerns. Captures recapture date, treaty reference, recaptured ceded amount, recapture penalty if applicable, effective date, and recapture status. Supports treaty management and RBC capital planning.

attributes.name: recapture_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each recapture event record in the reinsurance management system. Primary key for the recapture_event data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific cession record being recaptured. Identifies the original cession transaction from which risk is being reclaimed by Life Insurance.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; RGA AURA Reinsurance Cession Processing Module

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.annuity_contract. Business justification: When an annuity contract surrenders or a rider terminates, the insurer may recapture previously ceded risk. Current recapture_event only references in_force_policy_id. This FK enables annuity-specific

attributes.name: experience_study_id

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying life insurance policy whose ceded risk is being recaptured. Links to the policy master record in the Policy Administration System.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Code; Sapiens LifePro Policy Administration Module

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Recapture events require formal notice documents, reinsurer acknowledgment letters, settlement agreements, penalty calculations, and regulatory notifications. Treaty administration and financial settl

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Recapture events may be triggered by or must comply with regulatory obligations (e.g., credit for reinsurance rules requiring recapture when reinsurer loses authorized status, RBC-triggered recapture

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer counterparty (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re) from whom risk is being recaptured. Identifies the party relationship in the reinsurance management system.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: surrender_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.surrender. Business justification: Policy surrender is a primary trigger for reinsurance recapture events. The recapture settlement amount and timing depend on the surrender transaction details (net proceeds, effective date). Reinsuran

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which the recapture right is exercised. Links to the treaty master record governing the cession arrangement being recaptured.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.treaty_schedule. Business justification: Recapture eligibility and terms (recapture_eligible, recapture_waiting_period_years, recapture_percentage) are defined at the treaty schedule level. A recapture event is triggered based on the specifi

attributes.name: approval_reference
attributes.description: Internal approval reference number or authorization code issued by Life Insurance's reinsurance management or finance team authorizing the recapture event. Supports audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The bordereaux reporting period (e.g., 2024-Q3 or 2024-06) in which this recapture event is included for submission to the reinsurer. Supports ACORD bordereaux reporting and reinsurer reconciliation.

attributes.description: Timestamp when the recapture event record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
