attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the recapture takes legal and financial effect, which may differ from the recapture_date if retroactive adjustments are required under the treaty terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: mortality_experience_ratio
attributes.description: The actual-to-expected (A/E) mortality ratio that served as the actuarial basis for a mortality_improvement recapture trigger. A ratio below 1.0000 indicates favorable mortality experience justifying recapture. Sourced from actuarial experience studies.
attributes.references: NAIC Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); SOA Mortality Experience Studies; AXIS/Prophet Actuarial Valuation System

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, context, or operational notes related to the recapture event, entered by the reinsurance operations team. Supports treaty management and audit documentation.

attributes.name: notice_date
attributes.description: Date on which Life Insurance formally notified the reinsurer of its intent to recapture, as required by treaty notice provisions. Used to validate compliance with contractual notice periods.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of advance notice required by the treaty before the recapture can take effect. Used to validate that the notice_date and recapture_date are compliant with treaty terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: partial_recapture_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recapture event represents a partial recapture of the ceded risk (True) or a full recapture of the entire cession (False). Partial recaptures are common in large facultative placements.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; RGA AURA Reinsurance Module

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Contractual penalty fee payable to the reinsurer upon exercise of the recapture right, as stipulated in the treaty terms. May be zero if the treaty permits penalty-free recapture after a specified duration or under qualifying trigger conditions.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: penalty_waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contractual recapture penalty has been waived by the reinsurer, typically through negotiation or as a result of a qualifying trigger condition such as reinsurer credit concern.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: rbc_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated change in Risk-Based Capital (RBC) requirement resulting from the recapture of ceded risk. A positive value indicates increased capital requirement as retained risk rises. Supports RBC capital planning and ORSA reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Framework; ORSA Guidelines; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: recapture_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event date on which Life Insurance formally exercises its contractual right to recapture previously ceded risk from the reinsurer. This is the operative date for treaty and RBC calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: recapture_percentage
attributes.description: The proportion of the original ceded risk being recaptured, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 = 50%). Applicable when partial_recapture_flag is True. Used to calculate pro-rata reserve and premium adjustments.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: recapture_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned to the recapture event, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer correspondence. Sourced from the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA Reinsurance).
attributes.references: ACORD Reinsurance Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: recapture_right_eligible_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which Life Insurance became contractually eligible to exercise the recapture right under the treaty terms, typically based on a minimum cession duration or treaty anniversary.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: recapture_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recapture event workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|in_progress|completed|cancelled|disputed — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: recapture_trigger_type
attributes.description: Classification of the business reason that triggered the recapture event. Supports treaty management analytics and RBC capital planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mortality_improvement|treaty_renegotiation|reinsurer_credit_concern|treaty_expiry|voluntary|regulatory_requirement — promote to reference product if additional triggers are required]
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC RBC Framework; ORSA Guidelines

attributes.name: recaptured_face_amount
attributes.description: The gross face amount (death benefit) of the ceded risk being recaptured from the reinsurer. Represents the notional insurance coverage amount returned to Life Insurance's retained book.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: recaptured_nar_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Recaptured Net Amount at Risk (NAR) Amount
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) — the difference between the death benefit and the policy reserve — that is being recaptured from the reinsurer. This is the primary quantitative measure of risk reclaimed and is central to RBC capital planning calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Framework; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: recaptured_premium_amount
attributes.description: The annualized or in-force reinsurance premium amount that will cease to be paid to the reinsurer as a result of the recapture. Used for premium billing reconciliation and financial impact assessment.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: recaptured_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The statutory or GAAP reserve amount associated with the recaptured cession that must be transferred back to Life Insurance's balance sheet upon recapture. Relevant for coinsurance and modified coinsurance treaty types.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; FASB ASC 944; PBR (Principle-Based Reserving) Guidelines; LDTI

attributes.name: reinsurer_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurer formally acknowledged the recapture notice. Populated when reinsurer_acknowledgment_flag is True. Used to track treaty compliance timelines.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: reinsurer_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer has formally acknowledged receipt of the recapture notice. Required to confirm the recapture process is proceeding in accordance with treaty terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: reinsurer_credit_rating
attributes.description: The credit rating of the reinsurer at the time the recapture event was initiated, as assigned by a recognized rating agency (e.g., A.M. Best, S&P, Moody's). Captured to document the credit concern trigger basis and support ERM reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Framework; ORSA Guidelines; ERM Standards; A.M. Best Rating Methodology

attributes.name: reinsurer_credit_rating_agency
attributes.description: The rating agency that issued the credit rating captured in reinsurer_credit_rating. Used to contextualize the rating value for ERM and credit risk reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Framework; ORSA Guidelines; ERM Standards

attributes.name: retrocession_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cession being recaptured was part of a retrocession arrangement (i.e., the reinsurer had further ceded the risk to a retrocessionaire). Flags potential downstream settlement complexity.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Retrocession Module

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Net financial settlement amount payable between Life Insurance and the reinsurer to finalize the recapture, accounting for reserve transfers, return premiums, and any applicable penalty. Represents the net cash flow of the recapture transaction.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; FASB ASC 944; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this recapture event record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency treaty arrangements with international reinsurers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the financial settlement of the recapture event is completed, including reserve transfers and penalty payments. Used for cash flow reconciliation and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Bordereaux Reporting Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this recapture event record originated (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: treaty_anniversary_year
attributes.description: The treaty year (number of years since treaty inception) at the time of recapture. Many treaties permit recapture only after a minimum number of treaty years, and this field documents compliance with that condition.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the recapture event record was most recently modified in the reinsurance management system. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; FASB ASC 944; Swiss Re IRIS Reinsurance Management System

products.name: reinsurer_settlement
products.description: Records periodic financial settlements between Life Insurance and reinsurers, netting reinsurance premiums payable against claim recoverables receivable and experience refunds. Captures settlement period, reinsurer, gross premium amount, gross recoverable amount, experience refund amount, net settlement amount, settlement direction (payable/receivable), settlement date, payment reference, and reconciliation status. Supports accounts payable/receivable reconciliation with the finance domain and provides the financial close record for each reinsurer relationship.

attributes.name: reinsurer_settlement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reinsurer settlement record in the lakehouse. Primary key for the reinsurer_settlement data product.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: bordereaux_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.bordereaux. Business justification: Reinsurer settlements reconcile financial positions between Life Insurance and reinsurers, and they reference specific bordereaux submissions as supporting documentation. The table currently has 'bord

attributes.name: insurance_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Reinsurer settlements generate formal remittance advices, settlement statements, and wire transfer confirmations that are retained as legal and accounting documents. Linking settlement to its document

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Settlement transactions must link to GL entries for cash reconciliation, intercompany elimination, and financial statement preparation. Treasury and accounting teams reconcile settlement payments to j

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Funds-withheld treaty settlements directly credit or debit specific investment portfolios holding the withheld assets. Investment accounting and ALM teams require this link to reconcile settlement cas

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Settlement amounts flow directly to statutory financial statements and must be disclosed in regulatory filings. Critical for Schedule S Part 3 reconciliation and quarterly/annual statement preparation

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.reinsurance_recoverable. Business justification: Cash application process: when a reinsurer settlement is received, it reduces the outstanding reinsurance_recoverable balance on the balance sheet. Finance teams must link settlement records to recove

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer entity (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re) that is the counterparty to this settlement. Links to the reinsurer master record.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: reserve_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.reserve_calculation. Business justification: reinsurer_settlement.reserve_adjustment_amount is directly derived from actuarial reserve calculations. Financial close, settlement reconciliation, and STAT/GAAP reporting require tracing settlement r

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty (YRT, coinsurance, modified coinsurance, or facultative) under which this settlement is calculated.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: Period-end reinsurer settlement reconciliation is performed against actuarial valuation run outputs for GAAP/STAT close. Settlement amounts must tie to the valuation run for LDTI/IFRS17 ceded reserve

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The financial reporting period to which this settlement is attributed, expressed as YYYY-MM for monthly or YYYY-Q# for quarterly periods (e.g., '2024-03' or '2024-Q1'). Used for financial close alignment and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; GAAP; LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements)

attributes.name: allowance_amount
attributes.description: Ceding allowance or expense allowance paid by the reinsurer to offset the ceding company's acquisition and administrative costs. Common in coinsurance and quota share treaties. Reduces the net settlement payable.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) accounting

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the settlement was formally approved by the authorized approver within Life Insurance prior to payment initiation. Supports SOX internal controls and dual-authorization requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: ceded_nar_amount
attributes.description: Total Net Amount at Risk (NAR) ceded to the reinsurer across all policies in the settlement period. NAR is the death benefit minus the policy reserve and is the basis for YRT premium calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards; NAR (Net Amount at Risk) definition

attributes.name: ceded_policy_count
attributes.description: Number of individual ceded policies or certificates included in this settlement period's bordereaux. Supports volume reconciliation and treaty capacity monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement record was first created in the Reinsurance Management System. Used for audit trail and financial close reconciliation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this settlement record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency reinsurance arrangements with international reinsurers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which a disputed settlement was resolved and agreed upon by both parties. Null if no dispute exists or if the dispute is still open.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert settlement amounts to the functional currency (USD) when the settlement currency differs. Rate is expressed as units of settlement currency per one USD.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: experience_refund_amount
attributes.description: Experience refund or profit commission payable by the reinsurer to the ceding company when actual claims experience is more favorable than the treaty's expected loss ratio. Reduces the net settlement payable.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: funds_withheld_balance
attributes.description: Cumulative balance of funds withheld by the ceding company from the reinsurer under a funds-withheld or modified coinsurance arrangement. The ceding company retains assets equal to the ceded reserve and pays interest to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; ALM (Asset Liability Management) standards

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code to which the net settlement amount is posted in the finance domain. Enables automated journal entry creation and financial close reconciliation under SAP and GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944; SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles); GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles)

attributes.name: gross_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total reinsurance premiums payable to the reinsurer for the settlement period before any offsets. Represents the ceded premium obligation under the treaty for the period.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; GAAP

attributes.name: gross_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Total claim recoverables receivable from the reinsurer for the settlement period before any offsets. Represents the reinsurer's share of claims paid or incurred under the treaty.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; GAAP; IBNR

attributes.name: ibnr_recoverable_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Recoverable Amount
attributes.description: Reinsurer's estimated share of Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) claims included in the settlement. Represents the actuarially estimated recoverable for claims that have occurred but have not yet been reported or fully adjudicated.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; IBNR (Incurred But Not Reported) actuarial standards; PBR (Principle-Based Reserving)

attributes.name: interest_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Interest credited or charged on funds withheld or late payments under modified coinsurance or funds-withheld arrangements. Positive values indicate interest owed to the ceding company; negative values indicate interest owed to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; ALM (Asset Liability Management) standards

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The net financial obligation after netting gross reinsurance premiums payable against gross claim recoverables receivable, experience refunds, allowances, and interest adjustments. Represents the final amount to be paid or received.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; GAAP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, special instructions, or contextual information related to this settlement. Used by reinsurance operations staff to document exceptions, adjustments, or communications with the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was initiated or the funds were transferred. May differ from settlement_date if there is a processing lag between settlement approval and actual funds movement.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; SOX Section 404; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Wire transfer reference, ACH trace number, or check number associated with the actual payment or receipt of the net settlement amount. Used for bank reconciliation and accounts payable/receivable matching in the finance domain.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FinCEN AML/BSA compliance

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the settlement was successfully reconciled against the finance domain's accounts payable/receivable ledger. Null if reconciliation is not yet complete.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the accounts payable/receivable reconciliation process for this settlement with the finance domain. 'unreconciled' indicates not yet matched; 'in_progress' indicates active review; 'reconciled' confirms match; 'exception' indicates a discrepancy requiring resolution.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: reserve_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Adjustment to ceded reserves transferred between the ceding company and reinsurer under coinsurance or modified coinsurance treaties. Reflects changes in policy reserves during the settlement period.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP; PBR (Principle-Based Reserving); LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements)

attributes.name: retrocession_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this settlement relates to a retrocession arrangement (True) where the reinsurer cedes risk to another reinsurer, or a standard cession from the primary insurer (False). Supports retrocession tracking and RBC optimization analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; RBC (Risk-Based Capital) standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the net settlement amount was paid or received, representing the principal real-world financial event date. Distinct from the settlement period end date and the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles)

attributes.name: settlement_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the net settlement amount is payable by Life Insurance to the reinsurer ('payable') or receivable by Life Insurance from the reinsurer ('receivable'). Drives accounts payable/receivable classification in the finance domain.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed-upon frequency at which settlements are performed under the reinsurance treaty. Drives the settlement period dates and financial close calendar.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: settlement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to this settlement by the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA). Used in bordereaux reporting and accounts payable/receivable reconciliation with the finance domain.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; Swiss Re IRIS; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: settlement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the accounting period covered by this settlement. Together with settlement_period_start_date, defines the bordereaux reporting window for premium and recoverable netting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: settlement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the accounting period covered by this settlement (e.g., first day of the month or quarter). Defines the beginning of the bordereaux reporting window.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; FASB ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the settlement record. 'draft' indicates initial calculation; 'pending' awaits approval; 'approved' is authorized for payment; 'settled' confirms payment has been made or received; 'disputed' indicates a discrepancy raised by either party; 'voided' indicates cancellation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this settlement record originated (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance). Supports data lineage tracking in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system_settlement_reference
attributes.description: The native settlement identifier from the originating Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA). Enables traceability from the lakehouse silver layer back to the operational system of record.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this settlement record, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking for financial close processes.

products.name: reserve
products.description: Stores reinsurance reserve calculations representing the ceded portion of policy reserves held by or credited from reinsurers under coinsurance, modified coinsurance (ModCo), and funds withheld coinsurance treaties. Captures valuation date, treaty reference, reinsurer, ceded reserve basis (GAAP/SAP/IFRS), ceded reserve amount, reserve type (traditional ceded/funds withheld/ModCo adjustment), funds withheld balance amount, credited interest rate, interest credited amount, modified coinsurance reserve adjustment, settlement status, and reserve method. This is the single source of truth for all ceded reserves and funds withheld balances. Supports LDTI, PBR, and IFRS 17 ceded reserve reporting, ALM coordination for withheld asset management, and investment domain integration for credited interest calculations.

attributes.name: reserve_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reinsurance reserve calculation record. Primary key for the reinsurance_reserve data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: cession_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific cession record (automatic or facultative) associated with this reserve calculation. Links to the cession processing record.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; RGA AURA Reinsurance Cession Processing Module

attributes.name: cohort_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.cohort_definition. Business justification: LDTI/IFRS17 ceded reserve measurement is organized by actuarial cohorts. reserve.ifrs17_csg_amount and ifrs17_ra_ceded_amount are cohort-based measures. A reinsurance actuary implementing LDTI/IFRS17

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to annuity.annuity_contract. Business justification: Ceded reinsurance reserves must be tracked per annuity contract for statutory and GAAP reporting. Current reserve only references in_force_policy_id. This FK enables annuity-specific ceded reserve cal

attributes.name: gaap_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gaap_reserve. Business justification: LDTI/GAAP reserve reconciliation requires tracing ceded reserve components (dac_ceded_amount, ifrs17_ra_ceded_amount) from the reinsurance operational system to the GAAP reserve record. Finance teams

attributes.name: ifrs17_contract_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ifrs17_contract_group. Business justification: IFRS17 requires reinsurance held contracts to be grouped into contract groups for measurement. Ceded reserve amounts (ifrs17_ra_ceded_amount, modco_reserve_adjustment) must be attributed to the correc

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying life insurance policy for which the ceded reserve is being calculated and reported.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Reserve movements require GL posting for statutory and GAAP reporting, RBC calculation, and external audit. Actuarial teams calculate ceded reserves; finance teams post reserve changes to GL for quart

attributes.name: nar_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.nar_calculation. Business justification: Reinsurance reserves for YRT and coinsurance treaties are computed using NAR as a key input — the ceded reserve is a function of the NAR and the applicable reserve factors. Linking reserve.nar_calcula

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Reinsurance reserves are held per product plan. Critical for statutory reporting, GAAP/IFRS reserve calculations, and product-level reserve adequacy analysis. Product_line is high-level category; FK e

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Ceded reserve calculations (statutory, GAAP, IFRS17) depend on the specific plan version's reserve basis, benefit structure, and actuarial assumptions. Actuarial valuation reports and regulatory filin

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.portfolio. Business justification: Ceded reserves are backed by designated investment portfolios in ModCo and funds-withheld arrangements. Business process: reserve valuation, investment income allocation, interest crediting, and ALM g

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Ceded reserves must comply with specific regulatory obligations (credit for reinsurance reserve credit rules, Regulation XXX, LDTI/IFRS17 ceded reserve requirements). The reserve entity has rbc_credit

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer counterparty (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re) holding or crediting the ceded reserve under this treaty.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: reserve_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.reserve_calculation. Business justification: Reinsurance reserves are calculated as part of overall reserve calculations for statutory valuation, RBC credit determination, and GAAP/IFRS17 reporting. Direct business process dependency.

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Ceded reserve calculations are governed by state-specific regulations (Regulation XXX, AG38, state credit-for-reinsurance rules). Statutory actuaries must reference the applicable state regulation whe

attributes.name: statutory_reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.statutory_reserve. Business justification: Statutory reserve reconciliation process requires matching ceded reserve amounts in the reinsurance system (reinsurance.reserve.ceded_reserve_amount) against the statutory reserve exhibit (finance.sta

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which this ceded reserve is calculated. Links to the treaty master record governing the cession terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: Reinsurance ceded reserves are produced within actuarial valuation runs. LDTI/IFRS17 ceded reserve reporting, reserve movement analysis, and actuarial opinion documentation require direct linkage of e

attributes.name: value_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.value. Business justification: Reinsurance ceded reserve calculations are based on the specific policy value snapshot (CSV, account value, reserve amount). Actuarial and statutory reporting require tracing which policy value record

attributes.name: actuarial_assumption_set
attributes.description: The identifier or label of the actuarial assumption set used in the reserve calculation (e.g., 'PBR_2024_Q4', 'LDTI_LOCKED_IN_2023', 'IFRS17_CURRENT_EST'). Enables traceability of reserve calculations to specific assumption vintages used in the Actuarial Valuation System.
attributes.references: NAIC VM-20 PBR; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); Actuarial Valuation System (AXIS; Prophet; MoSes)

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: The accounting or regulatory basis under which the ceded reserve is calculated. 'gaap' = Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (FASB ASC 944/LDTI); 'sap' = Statutory Accounting Principles (NAIC); 'ifrs17' = International Financial Reporting Standards 17; 'pbr' = Principle-Based Reserving (NAIC VM-20/VM-21); 'tax' = IRS tax reserve basis.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; IFRS 17; NAIC VM-20 PBR; IRS IRC Section 807

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The period identifier for the bordereaux report in which this reserve record is included (e.g., Q12024, M032024, FY2023). Bordereaux reports are periodic data submissions to reinsurers summarizing ceded reserves, premiums, and claims. Supports Swiss Re IRIS and RGA AURA bordereaux reporting modules.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: ceded_face_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the policy face amount (death benefit) ceded to the reinsurer under this treaty. Represents the reinsurer's share of the total death benefit exposure. Used in automatic and facultative cession calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Cession Processing Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: ceded_nar_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ceded Net Amount at Risk (NAR) Amount
attributes.description: The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) ceded to the reinsurer under this treaty as of the valuation date. NAR represents the excess of the death benefit over the policy reserve, and is the basis for YRT reinsurance premium calculations. Critical for RBC optimization and NAR-based cession calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC (Risk-Based Capital) Framework; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: ceded_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The gross ceded reserve amount transferred to or credited from the reinsurer under the treaty as of the valuation date. Represents the ceding company's share of policy reserves ceded to the reinsurer. Used in LDTI, PBR, and IFRS 17 ceded reserve reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; IFRS 17; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: The amount of collateral (letters of credit, trust funds, or funds withheld) posted by an unauthorized reinsurer to support the ceded reserve credit. Required for statutory credit for reinsurance when the reinsurer is not authorized in the ceding company's domiciliary state.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: The type of collateral posted by the reinsurer to support the ceded reserve credit for unauthorized reinsurers. 'letter_of_credit' = LOC from an approved bank; 'trust_fund' = assets held in a qualifying trust; 'funds_withheld' = assets retained by ceding company; 'cash_deposit' = cash deposited with the ceding company.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this reinsurance reserve record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements for financial reporting records.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; NAIC Annual Statement; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: credited_interest_rate
attributes.description: The interest rate credited by the ceding company to the reinsurer on the funds withheld balance under a funds withheld or ModCo treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.045000 = 4.5%). Drives the interest credited amount calculation and ALM coordination.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; Investment Management System (Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this reserve record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency reinsurance treaties with international reinsurers such as Swiss Re and RGA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: dac_ceded_amount
attributes.description: The Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) amount ceded to the reinsurer under coinsurance treaties. Represents the reinsurer's proportional share of deferred acquisition costs, which offsets the ceding company's DAC asset. Required for GAAP and LDTI financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); GAAP Generally Accepted Accounting Principles; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this reinsurance reserve record is effective. Represents the start of the period covered by this reserve calculation, typically aligned with the treaty effective date or policy issue date.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this reinsurance reserve record expires or is superseded. Represents the end of the period covered by this reserve calculation. Null for open-ended or in-force records.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: funds_withheld_balance
attributes.description: The balance of assets withheld by the ceding company on behalf of the reinsurer under a funds withheld coinsurance or ModCo treaty. Represents the liability owed to the reinsurer for assets retained. Critical for ALM coordination and investment domain integration.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17; Investment Management System (Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension)

attributes.name: ifrs17_csg_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: IFRS 17 Contractual Service Margin (CSG) Ceded Amount
attributes.description: The ceded Contractual Service Margin (CSM) amount under IFRS 17 for this reinsurance reserve record. Represents the reinsurer's share of unearned profit under IFRS 17 measurement. Required for IFRS 17 ceded reinsurance contract reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts; International Association of Insurance Supervisors (IAIS)

attributes.name: ifrs17_ra_ceded_amount
attributes.description: The ceded Risk Adjustment (RA) for non-financial risk under IFRS 17 for this reinsurance reserve record. Represents the reinsurer's share of the risk adjustment, reflecting the compensation required for bearing uncertainty in insurance cash flows.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts; International Association of Insurance Supervisors (IAIS)

attributes.name: interest_credited_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of interest credited to the reinsurer on the funds withheld balance for the valuation period. Calculated as the funds withheld balance multiplied by the credited interest rate for the period. Supports investment domain integration and settlement calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; Investment Management System (Charles River IMS; SimCorp Dimension)

attributes.name: is_authorized_reinsurer
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is authorized (licensed) in the ceding company's state of domicile (True) or is an unauthorized/alien reinsurer requiring collateral (False). Affects statutory credit for reinsurance and RBC treatment under NAIC regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: is_retrocession
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reserve record relates to a retrocession arrangement (True) where the reinsurer further cedes risk to another reinsurer, or a direct reinsurance cession (False). Supports retrocession reserve tracking and RBC reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: modco_reserve_adjustment
attributes.description: The Modified Coinsurance (ModCo) reserve adjustment amount representing the difference between the ceded reserve and the funds withheld balance. Captures the periodic settlement adjustment required under ModCo treaties to reconcile reserve movements with withheld asset performance.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: movement_amount
attributes.description: The change in ceded reserve between the prior valuation date and the current valuation date. Positive values indicate reserve increases (additional cession); negative values indicate reserve releases. Used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurance settlement calculations.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module

attributes.name: net_ceded_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The net ceded reserve amount after applying any ModCo adjustments, experience refund reserves, or other treaty-specific offsets. Represents the final net reserve position ceded to the reinsurer for financial reporting purposes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC SAP; IFRS 17; NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation

attributes.name: prior_period_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The ceded reserve amount as of the prior valuation date. Used to calculate the reserve movement (change in ceded reserve) for the current period, which drives reinsurance premium settlements and LDTI/IFRS 17 ceded reserve roll-forward reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC SAP; Actuarial Valuation System (AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: rbc_credit_amount
attributes.description: The Risk-Based Capital (RBC) credit recognized by the ceding company for this ceded reserve position. Represents the reduction in required capital resulting from the reinsurance arrangement. Supports RBC optimization reporting and ORSA (Own Risk and Solvency Assessment).
attributes.references: NAIC RBC (Risk-Based Capital) Framework; NAIC ORSA Model Act; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: reinsurer_share_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the policy reserve ceded to this reinsurer under the treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.900000 = 90%). Used in proportional coinsurance and quota share treaties to calculate the reinsurer's share of reserves and premiums.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The financial reporting period to which this reserve record belongs, expressed as quarter (e.g., Q12024, Q42023) or full year (e.g., FY2023). Used for LDTI, PBR, IFRS 17, and NAIC statutory reporting period alignment.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); IFRS 17; NAIC Annual Statement; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: reserve_method
attributes.description: The actuarial reserving method applied to calculate the ceded reserve. 'net_premium' = Net Premium Reserve method; 'gross_premium' = Gross Premium Reserve method (LDTI); 'commissioners_reserve' = NAIC Commissioners Reserve Valuation Method (CRVM); 'pbr_deterministic' = PBR deterministic scenario; 'pbr_stochastic' = PBR stochastic scenario. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: net_premium|gross_premium|commissioners_reserve|pbr_deterministic|pbr_stochastic|crvm|net_single_premium — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC VM-20 PBR; FASB ASC 944 LDTI; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); Actuarial Valuation System (AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: reserve_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this reinsurance reserve record, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer settlement statements. Typically assigned by the reinsurance management system (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA).
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; ACORD Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Bordereaux Reporting Module

attributes.name: reserve_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reinsurance reserve by structural arrangement. 'traditional_ceded' = standard ceded reserve transferred to reinsurer; 'funds_withheld' = reserve retained by ceding company under funds withheld coinsurance; 'modco_adjustment' = Modified Coinsurance (ModCo) reserve adjustment; 'experience_refund_reserve' = reserve held for experience refund obligations; 'retrocession_ceded' = reserve ceded under retrocession arrangement.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reinsurance reserve balance was or is expected to be settled with the reinsurer. Used for cash flow planning, ALM coordination, and reinsurance recoverable tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Settlement Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current settlement status of the reinsurance reserve balance with the reinsurer. 'pending' = awaiting settlement; 'settled' = fully settled in current period; 'disputed' = under dispute with reinsurer; 'partially_settled' = partially settled; 'voided' = record voided due to error or treaty termination.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Regulation; Swiss Re IRIS Settlement Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this reinsurance reserve record was sourced (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance). Supports data lineage and ETL (Extract Transform Load) traceability in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Swiss Re IRIS Reinsurance Management System; RGA AURA Reinsurance; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this reinsurance reserve record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and SOX compliance requirements for financial reporting records in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; NAIC Annual Statement; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for which the ceded reserve is calculated. Represents the actuarial valuation date used in reserve calculations (e.g., quarter-end or year-end). Aligns with LDTI, PBR, and IFRS 17 reporting periods.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944 (LDTI); NAIC PBR (Principle-Based Reserving); IFRS 17; Actuarial Valuation System (AXIS; Prophet; MoSes)

attributes.name: valuation_system
attributes.description: The actuarial valuation system used to calculate this ceded reserve (e.g., AXIS, Prophet, MoSes). Supports data lineage, audit traceability, and reconciliation between actuarial and reinsurance management systems.
attributes.references: Actuarial Valuation System (MoSes; AXIS; Prophet); NAIC PBR; FASB ASC 944 (LDTI)

products.name: automatic_binding_limit
products.description: Reference table defining the automatic binding limits per treaty, plan code, risk class, and age band — the maximum face amount that can be automatically ceded without facultative submission. Captures treaty reference, plan code, risk class, age band, automatic binding limit amount, jumbo limit, and effective date. Drives the cession routing logic determining whether a risk qualifies for automatic or facultative placement.

attributes.name: automatic_binding_limit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each automatic binding limit record. Primary key for the automatic_binding_limit reference table. [_canonical_skip_reason: Entity role is REFERENCE_LOOKUP — defines maximum face amounts auto-ceded per treaty/plan/risk-class/age-band combination; exempt from per-role minimums.]
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: mortality_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.mortality_table. Business justification: Automatic binding limits are calibrated by age band and risk class against specific mortality tables. Underwriting capacity management and RBC credit eligibility require tracing binding limit amounts

attributes.name: plan_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Automatic binding limits are negotiated for specific plan versions — when a plan version changes its benefit structure or underwriting requirements, binding limits must be renegotiated. Treaty adminis

attributes.name: pricing_basis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.pricing_basis. Business justification: Automatic binding limits are set based on pricing bases, mortality assumptions, and risk assessment. Required for automatic capacity determination and treaty design.

attributes.name: prior_limit_automatic_binding_limit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous version of this binding limit record that was superseded by the current record. Enables traversal of the amendment history chain for audit and regulatory review purposes.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Automatic binding limits must comply with regulatory obligations (e.g., NAIC credit for reinsurance model law limits on automatic cessions, RBC automatic binding capacity rules). attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer (e.g., RGA, Swiss Re) that is party to the treaty for which this binding limit is defined. Used to identify the counterparty in cession routing decisions.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: retention_limit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.retention_limit. Business justification: Automatic binding limits and retention limits are complementary reference tables that together define the cession framework for a treaty. The ABL (how much can be automatically ceded) is defined in th

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Automatic binding limits must comply with state-specific regulations governing retention requirements, jumbo limit thresholds, and automatic coverage capacity. State regulations define minimum retenti

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty under which this automatic binding limit applies. Links the limit record to the governing treaty agreement between the ceding company and the reinsurer.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: underwriting_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.underwriting_class. Business justification: Automatic binding limits differ by underwriting class — preferred risks have higher limits than substandard. The risk_class plain attribute is a denormalized underwriting class reference. Proper FK en

attributes.name: age_band_max
attributes.description: The maximum attained age (inclusive) of the insured for which this automatic binding limit row applies. Together with age_band_min, defines the age band dimension of the cession routing matrix.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: age_band_min
attributes.description: The minimum attained age (inclusive) of the insured for which this automatic binding limit row applies. Age banding is a standard actuarial practice in reinsurance treaty design as mortality risk and NAR vary significantly by age.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for creating or amending this binding limit record (e.g., treaty renegotiation, capacity adjustment, regulatory change, experience-driven repricing). Supports audit trail and governance review.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this binding limit record was formally approved by the authorized approver. Supports governance audit trail and SOX compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: automatic_capacity_amount
attributes.description: The total aggregate face amount capacity available under the automatic treaty for new cessions. Once this capacity is exhausted, new risks must be submitted facultatively even if they fall within the per-policy binding limit. Null indicates unlimited capacity.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: binding_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum face amount (death benefit) in the treaty currency that can be automatically ceded to the reinsurer under this treaty without requiring facultative submission. Risks with face amounts at or below this threshold qualify for automatic placement. This is the principal quantitative fact of this reference record.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance Module

attributes.name: cession_basis
attributes.description: Indicates whether this limit record governs automatic cessions, facultative cessions, or an automatic-facultative arrangement. Drives the cession routing logic in the Reinsurance Management System to determine placement pathway.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: cession_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the eligible risk (face amount or NAR) that is ceded to the reinsurer under quota-share or coinsurance arrangements. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Applicable primarily for coinsurance and quota-share treaty types; may be null for YRT treaties where cession is based on NAR excess over retention.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this automatic binding limit record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the binding limit and jumbo limit amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, CAD). Required for multi-currency treaty arrangements with international reinsurers such as Swiss Re or RGA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this automatic binding limit record becomes operative for cession routing decisions. New business applications with policy effective dates on or after this date are subject to this limit.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: facultative_threshold_amount
attributes.description: The face amount above the automatic binding limit at which the ceding company must submit the risk facultatively to the reinsurer. Risks between the binding limit and this threshold may be eligible for automatic-facultative placement; risks above this threshold require full facultative submission.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance Module

attributes.name: flat_extra_max
attributes.description: The maximum flat extra premium per thousand of face amount (per mille) that is eligible for automatic cession under this binding limit. Risks with flat extras exceeding this threshold require facultative submission. Null indicates no flat extra restriction.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Standards; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA / Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: insured_gender
attributes.description: The gender of the insured to which this binding limit applies. Some treaties define gender-specific binding limits due to mortality differentials. A value of Unisex indicates the limit applies regardless of gender.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Standards; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA)

attributes.name: is_aviation_excluded
attributes.description: Indicates whether risks involving aviation hazards (private pilot, commercial pilot, or frequent flyer exclusions) are excluded from automatic cession eligibility under this binding limit. When True, aviation-rated risks must be submitted facultatively.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Standards; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA / Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: is_foreign_national_excluded
attributes.description: Indicates whether foreign nationals (non-US citizens or non-permanent residents) are excluded from automatic cession eligibility under this binding limit. When True, policies on foreign nationals must be submitted facultatively regardless of face amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Standards; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA)

attributes.name: is_jumbo_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a jumbo limit check (aggregate in-force across all reinsurers on the same life) must be performed before automatic cession is permitted under this binding limit. When True, the cession routing system must query total in-force amounts across all treaties before confirming automatic placement.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: is_mib_check_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Medical Information Bureau (MIB) Check Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Medical Information Bureau (MIB) check is required as a condition of automatic cession eligibility under this binding limit. When True, the underwriting workbench must confirm MIB clearance before the risk qualifies for automatic placement.
attributes.references: MIB Group Inc. Data Standards; NAIC Underwriting Standards; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA / Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: issue_age_basis
attributes.description: The age calculation convention used to determine the insured's age for applying the age band (e.g., Age Last Birthday, Age Nearest Birthday). Must align with the age basis used in the Policy Administration System to ensure consistent cession routing.
attributes.value_regex: Age Last Birthday|Age Nearest Birthday|Age Next Birthday
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; NAIC Model Regulation; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP No. 25)

attributes.name: jumbo_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum total in-force amount across all reinsurers on a single life (aggregate across all treaties) beyond which the risk is considered a jumbo risk and requires special handling or facultative placement regardless of individual treaty binding limits. Prevents over-concentration of risk on a single life.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: limit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this automatic binding limit record. Active records are used in cession routing. Superseded records have been replaced by a newer version. Expired records are past their termination date. Suspended records are temporarily inactive pending treaty renegotiation.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: nar_basis
attributes.description: Specifies whether the binding limit is applied against the full face amount (death benefit) or the Net Amount at Risk (NAR), which is the death benefit less the policy reserve or account value. NAR-based limits are common in UL and IUL products where the NAR decreases as the account value grows.
attributes.value_regex: Face Amount|Net Amount at Risk|Account Value Excess
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: reinsurer_treaty_reference
attributes.description: The reinsurer's own internal reference number or identifier for this treaty and binding limit schedule. Used for reconciliation with reinsurer bordereaux reports and correspondence from partners such as RGA or Swiss Re.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance Module

attributes.name: retention_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum face amount the ceding company retains on its own books before ceding the excess to the reinsurer under this treaty. Used in conjunction with the binding limit to determine the ceded portion (face amount minus retention). Supports NAR-based cession calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance Module

attributes.name: smoker_status
attributes.description: The tobacco/smoker classification of the insured to which this binding limit applies. Smoker and non-smoker populations carry different mortality rates and may have distinct binding limits under the treaty.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Standards; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA / Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this binding limit record was extracted (e.g., SWISS_RE_IRIS, RGA_AURA, INTERNAL_TREATY_MGMT). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance Module

attributes.name: source_system_limit_ref
attributes.description: The natural key or record identifier assigned to this binding limit record in the originating source system (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS internal limit ID or RGA AURA schedule reference). Enables reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the source system.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module; RGA AURA Reinsurance Module

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (USPS abbreviation) for which this binding limit applies, if the limit is state-specific. Null indicates the limit applies in all states. Some states have regulatory restrictions that may affect automatic binding limits.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states); NAIC Model Regulation; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: table_rating_max
attributes.description: The maximum substandard table rating (e.g., Table A through Table P, or Table 1 through Table 16) eligible for automatic cession under this binding limit. Risks with table ratings exceeding this threshold must be submitted facultatively. Null indicates no table rating restriction.
attributes.references: NAIC Underwriting Standards; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Underwriting Workbench (RGAX AURA / Swiss Re Magnum)

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this automatic binding limit record ceases to be operative. Null indicates the record is currently active with no defined end date. Used to support historical versioning of binding limits as treaties are amended.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this automatic binding limit record was last modified in the data platform. Used to detect changes and support incremental processing in the Databricks Silver Layer ETL pipeline.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this binding limit record within the same treaty/plan/risk-class/age-band combination. Incremented each time the binding limit is amended. Supports historical audit trail and point-in-time cession routing reconstruction.
attributes.references: ACORD Life & Annuity Data Standards; Swiss Re IRIS Treaty Management Module

products.name: retention_limit
products.description: Consolidated reference table defining Life Insurance's net retention limits and automatic binding limits by treaty, plan code, risk class, age band, and policy year. Captures limit type (retention per life, retention per policy, automatic binding limit, jumbo limit), limit amount, effective date, and applicable treaty. Includes automatic binding limits per treaty — the maximum face amount that can be automatically ceded without facultative submission — with age/sex/risk class bands and jumbo thresholds. Drives the cession routing decision: risks within retention are kept, risks within automatic binding limits are auto-ceded, and risks exceeding jumbo limits require facultative submission. This is the single source of truth for all retention and automatic binding limit reference data. Supports NAR-based cession calculations and treaty compliance.
