attributes.description: Maximum price (for buy orders) or minimum price (for sell orders) at which the order may be executed. Null for market orders. Used for best execution compliance.

attributes.name: naic_designation
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Designation
attributes.description: NAIC credit quality designation of the security at time of trade (e.g., NAIC 1 for highest quality bonds, NAIC 6 for in or near default). Determines RBC charges and investment limit compliance.

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.description: Date the trade order was initiated by the portfolio manager or trader. Used for trade date accounting and settlement cycle calculation (T+1, T+2).

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique order number assigned by the Investment Management System (IMS) for external reference and reconciliation. Used in broker confirmations and audit trails.

attributes.name: order_price_type
attributes.description: Pricing instruction for the order: market (execute at current market price), limit (execute at specified price or better), stop (trigger at stop price), stop_limit (trigger at stop, execute at limit).

attributes.name: order_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the security ordered (number of shares for equity, par value for bonds, units for alternatives). Supports fractional quantities for certain asset types.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the trade order: pending (awaiting submission), submitted (sent to broker), partially_filled (partial execution), filled (fully executed), cancelled (order cancelled), rejected (failed compliance or broker rejection), expired (time limit exceeded). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|submitted|partially_filled|filled|cancelled|rejected|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the trade order was created in the Investment Management System. Critical for best execution analysis and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Type of trade order: buy (acquire security), sell (dispose security), short (borrow and sell), cover (buy to close short), securities_lending (lend security to counterparty), securities_recall (recall lent security).
attributes.references: NAIC Investment Guidelines, SEC Securities Lending Disclosure

attributes.name: post_trade_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes from post-trade compliance review, including any exceptions, remediation actions, or escalations to the investment committee.

attributes.name: post_trade_compliance_status
attributes.description: Result of post-trade compliance review verifying the executed trade complies with investment policy, RBC limits, and NAIC guidelines. Failed status triggers remediation workflow.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Investment Law, ORSA Requirements

attributes.name: pre_trade_compliance_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes from pre-trade compliance screening, including any warnings, limit breaches, or override justifications. Critical for regulatory exam defense.

attributes.name: pre_trade_compliance_status
attributes.description: Result of pre-trade compliance checks against investment policy limits, RBC constraints, NAIC investment guidelines, and concentration limits. Override indicates manual approval by compliance officer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Investment Law, RBC C-1 Risk Charges

attributes.name: rationale
attributes.description: Business justification for the trade documented by the portfolio manager (e.g., ALM rebalancing, yield enhancement, credit upgrade, liquidity management). Required for investment committee reporting and regulatory exams.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Investment Law, Prudent Person Rule

attributes.name: rbc_investment_risk_charge
attributes.description: Incremental Risk-Based Capital (RBC) C-1 investment risk charge resulting from this trade. Used to monitor RBC ratio impact and ensure compliance with NAIC RBC requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) C-1 Bond Risk

attributes.name: recall_date
attributes.description: Date when lent securities are recalled from the borrower. Null for non-lending trades or open-ended lending agreements. Triggers securities_recall order creation.

attributes.name: reinvestment_details
attributes.description: Description of how cash collateral from securities lending is reinvested (e.g., money market funds, short-term bonds). Null for non-cash collateral or non-lending trades. Required for NAIC Schedule DL disclosure.

attributes.name: securities_lending_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trade is part of a securities lending transaction. True for securities_lending and securities_recall order types. Triggers additional NAIC Schedule DL disclosure requirements.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when cash and securities are exchanged to settle the trade. Typically T+1 or T+2 depending on security type and market. Used for cash flow projections and liquidity management.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of trade settlement: pending (awaiting settlement date), settled (cash and securities exchanged), failed (settlement did not complete), cancelled (trade cancelled before settlement).

attributes.name: stop_price
attributes.description: Trigger price for stop or stop-limit orders. When market price reaches this level, the order becomes active. Null for market and limit orders.

attributes.name: total_transaction_cost
attributes.description: Sum of commission and transaction fees. Used for transaction cost analysis (TCA) and performance attribution. Does not include market impact or opportunity cost.

attributes.name: transaction_fee_amount
attributes.description: Additional transaction fees including exchange fees, clearing fees, and regulatory fees (SEC fees, FINRA TAF). Separate from broker commission.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this trade order record was last modified. Tracks status changes, execution updates, and settlement events. Used for audit trails and change data capture.

One trade order may result in multiple partial executions. Supports trade cost analysis, best execution reporting, and SEC/FINRA compliance for variable product separate accounts.

attributes.name: alm_bucket
attributes.description: The duration or maturity bucket assigned to this trade for Asset Liability Management (ALM) purposes. Used to match asset cash flows with policy liability cash flows.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the security traded. Supports Asset Liability Management (ALM) duration matching and portfolio diversification analysis.

attributes.name: average_price_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this execution is part of a volume-weighted average price (VWAP) or time-weighted average price (TWAP) algorithmic strategy.

attributes.name: best_execution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this execution met the firms best execution criteria based on price, speed, and likelihood of execution. Required for Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Rule 606 reporting.

attributes.name: block_trade_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this execution qualifies as a block trade (typically 10,000+ shares or $200,000+ value). Block trades may receive special handling and reporting treatment.

attributes.name: booking_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this execution was recorded in the investment management system. Used for audit trail and operational monitoring.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: The brokerage commission charged for executing this trade. Part of total transaction cost analysis.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2121 - Fair Prices and Commissions

attributes.name: compliance_check_result

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: The unique confirmation number provided by the broker-dealer for this trade execution. Used for reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the trade execution. Typically USD for US-domiciled insurers, but may vary for international investments.

attributes.name: exchange_code
attributes.description: The Market Identifier Code (MIC) of the exchange where the trade was executed, if applicable. Empty for Over-The-Counter (OTC) trades.

attributes.name: executed_price

attributes.name: executed_quantity

attributes.name: execution_capacity

attributes.name: execution_method

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The total cash amount to be settled, including principal, accrued interest, commissions, and fees. Positive for purchases (cash outflow), negative for sales (cash inflow).

attributes.name: rbc_category

attributes.name: separate_account_flag

attributes.name: time_in_force

attributes.name: trade_side

attributes.name: transaction_fee
attributes.description: Additional fees charged for the trade execution, including exchange fees, clearing fees, and regulatory fees (SEC fees, FINRA TAF).

products.name: valuation
products.description: Daily or periodic fair market value (FMV), NAV, and mark-to-market valuation records for all investment positions including cash securities, derivative contracts, and separate account units. Captures valuation date, asset or derivative reference, pricing source (Bloomberg, ICE, internal model), FMV per unit, total FMV, amortized cost, unrealized gain/loss, NAIC valuation method, ASC 820 fair value hierarchy tier (Level 1/2/3). For derivative valuations: greeks (delta, gamma, vega, theta), DV01, CVA (credit valuation adjustment), DVA (debit valuation adjustment), collateral balance, variation margin call, and valuation model used. Supports GAAP/SAP financial reporting, LDTI reserve calculations, ASC 815 hedge effectiveness testing, NAIC Schedule D and DB reporting, variable product unit value computations, and counterparty credit risk monitoring. Unified SSOT for all investment position valuations regardless of asset type.
products.reference: ASC 820 Fair Value / NAIC Valuation / SimCorp Valuation

products.name: separate_account
products.description: Master record for each separate account maintained for variable life (VUL) and variable annuity products, including daily accumulation unit value (AUV) pricing history. Tracks separate account name, SEC registration number, fund type (equity, bond, money market, balanced), investment objective, benchmark index, total NAV, expense ratio, sub-adviser name, regulatory status (SEC-registered, FINRA oversight). Daily pricing records capture: accumulation unit value, annuity unit value, total net assets, units outstanding, daily return, expense deductions (M&E charges, fund expenses), and pricing source. Used to calculate policyholder account values for VUL and variable annuity contracts, support GMDB/GMIB/GMWB benefit base calculations, and meet SEC/FINRA daily pricing requirements.

products.name: alm_analysis
products.description: Comprehensive ALM (Asset Liability Management) record covering both duration matching targets/constraints and periodic gap measurement results for each portfolio segment aligned to liability cohorts. For targets: stores target duration, duration band (min/max), convexity target, key rate duration targets, liability cohort reference, ALM strategy type (immunization, cash flow matching, dynamic hedging). For measurements: captures measurement date, asset duration, liability duration, duration gap, convexity gap, dollar duration, DV01, interest rate sensitivity by scenario (parallel shift, twist, steepening), and gap status (within tolerance, breach). Supports duration gap monitoring, interest rate risk management, RBC C-3 interest rate risk charge calculations, ORSA interest rate risk reporting, and ALM committee governance.
products.reference: ALM Duration Matching / NAIC RBC C-3 / ORSA Interest Rate Risk

attributes.name: alm_analysis_id
attributes.description: Primary key for alm_analysis

attributes.name: cohort_definition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the liability cohort that this portfolio segment is matched against for duration and cash flow alignment.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. attributes.name: separate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.separate_account. Business justification: ALM analysis covers both general account and separate account portfolios. Variable annuity and VUL separate accounts have their own liability duration profiles that require ALM duration matching analy

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch or run that produced this ALM measurement. Enables traceability and reconciliation of ALM calculations across portfolio segments.

attributes.name: alm_committee_decision
attributes.description: The decision or action taken by the ALM committee following review of this duration gap measurement. Documents governance oversight.

attributes.name: alm_committee_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Asset Liability Management (ALM) Committee Review Date
attributes.description: The date on which the ALM committee reviewed this duration gap measurement and approved or escalated the findings. Supports governance and oversight requirements.

attributes.name: alm_strategy_type
attributes.description: The ALM strategy employed for this portfolio segment and liability cohort pairing. Defines the approach used to manage interest rate risk and ensure asset-liability alignment.

attributes.name: asset_duration
attributes.description: The actual measured Macaulay or modified duration (in years) of the portfolio segment as of the measurement date. Represents the weighted average time to receive cash flows from the asset portfolio.

attributes.name: convexity_gap
attributes.description: The difference between asset convexity and liability convexity. Measures the mismatch in non-linear interest rate sensitivity between assets and liabilities.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ALM analysis record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: dollar_duration
attributes.description: The dollar change in portfolio value for a 1 basis point parallel shift in interest rates. Expressed in currency units. Combines duration and portfolio size to quantify absolute interest rate risk.

attributes.name: duration_band_maximum
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable duration (in years) for the portfolio segment. Defines the upper bound of the duration tolerance band.

attributes.name: duration_band_minimum
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable duration (in years) for the portfolio segment. Defines the lower bound of the duration tolerance band.

attributes.name: duration_gap
attributes.description: The difference between asset duration and liability duration (asset_duration minus liability_duration). A positive gap indicates assets are longer than liabilities; a negative gap indicates the opposite. Critical metric for interest rate risk exposure.

attributes.name: dv01
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dollar Value of One Basis Point (DV01)
attributes.description: The dollar value change in the portfolio for a one basis point change in yield. Also known as PV01 or basis point value. Key metric for hedging and risk management.

attributes.name: gap_status
attributes.description: The status of the duration gap relative to the defined tolerance band. Indicates whether the gap is acceptable or requires management action.

attributes.name: interest_rate_sensitivity_parallel_shift_down_100bp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest Rate Sensitivity Parallel Shift Down 100 Basis Points (bp)
attributes.description: The estimated change in portfolio value (in currency units) under a parallel downward shift of 100 basis points across the entire yield curve. Used for stress testing and RBC C-3 calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) C-3 Interest Rate Risk

attributes.name: interest_rate_sensitivity_parallel_shift_up_100bp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interest Rate Sensitivity Parallel Shift Up 100 Basis Points (bp)
attributes.description: The estimated change in portfolio value (in currency units) under a parallel upward shift of 100 basis points across the entire yield curve. Used for stress testing and RBC C-3 calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) C-3 Interest Rate Risk

attributes.name: interest_rate_sensitivity_twist_flattening
attributes.description: The estimated change in portfolio value (in currency units) under a yield curve flattening scenario (short rates up, long rates down). Captures non-parallel yield curve risk.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) C-3 Interest Rate Risk

attributes.name: interest_rate_sensitivity_twist_steepening
attributes.description: The estimated change in portfolio value (in currency units) under a yield curve steepening scenario (short rates down, long rates up). Captures non-parallel yield curve risk.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) C-3 Interest Rate Risk

attributes.name: key_rate_duration_10yr
attributes.description: Target key rate duration for the 10-year maturity point on the yield curve. Measures sensitivity to parallel shifts at this specific tenor.

attributes.name: key_rate_duration_1yr
attributes.description: Target key rate duration for the 1-year maturity point on the yield curve. Measures sensitivity to parallel shifts at this specific tenor.

attributes.name: key_rate_duration_20yr
attributes.description: Target key rate duration for the 20-year maturity point on the yield curve. Measures sensitivity to parallel shifts at this specific tenor.

attributes.name: key_rate_duration_30yr
attributes.description: Target key rate duration for the 30-year maturity point on the yield curve. Measures sensitivity to parallel shifts at this specific tenor.

attributes.name: key_rate_duration_5yr
attributes.description: Target key rate duration for the 5-year maturity point on the yield curve. Measures sensitivity to parallel shifts at this specific tenor.

attributes.name: liability_duration
attributes.description: The actual measured Macaulay or modified duration (in years) of the liability cohort as of the measurement date. Represents the weighted average time to pay cash flows to policyholders.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ALM duration gap measurement was performed. Represents the as-of date for all calculated metrics in this record.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when this ALM duration gap measurement was calculated. Provides audit trail for calculation timing.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, assumptions, or context related to this ALM measurement. Captures qualitative information not represented in structured fields.

attributes.name: orsa_interest_rate_risk_scenario
attributes.business_glossary_term: Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) Interest Rate Risk Scenario
attributes.description: The ORSA scenario identifier or description applied to this ALM measurement. Links the ALM analysis to enterprise risk management and ORSA reporting requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) Guidance

attributes.name: rbc_c3_interest_rate_risk_charge
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk-Based Capital (RBC) C-3 Interest Rate Risk Charge
attributes.description: The calculated RBC C-3 interest rate risk charge (in currency units) for this portfolio segment and liability cohort pairing. Used for statutory capital adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) C-3 Interest Rate Risk

attributes.name: remediation_plan_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the remediation plan or corrective actions to be taken if the duration gap is outside tolerance. Documents management response to identified risks.

attributes.name: target_convexity
attributes.description: The target convexity measure for the portfolio segment. Convexity captures the curvature of the price-yield relationship and is critical for managing non-linear interest rate risk.

attributes.name: target_duration
attributes.description: The target Macaulay or modified duration (in years) that the portfolio segment should maintain to match the liability cohort duration. Central metric for duration matching strategies.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ALM analysis record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

products.name: compliance_rule
products.description: Unified SSOT for all investment compliance rules, investment policy statement (IPS) guidelines, regulatory constraints, and RBC risk charge calculations governing portfolio construction and capital adequacy. Covers NAIC investment guidelines, state insurance regulations, internal IPS directives, strategic asset allocation limits, credit quality requirements, duration constraints, prohibited investments, and NAIC RBC factor applications. Captures rule/guideline type (concentration limit, credit quality floor, prohibited security, NAIC Schedule limit, diversification requirement, duration constraint, allocation range, rbc_charge_calculation), rule parameter values, target allocation percentages, min/max ranges, applicable portfolio scope, regulatory citation, rule source (IPS, regulatory, internal policy, NAIC RBC formula), effective date, approval authority, breach action (alert, block, escalate), and for RBC calculations: asset class, NAIC Schedule category, applicable RBC factor (C-1, C-3), calculated charge, and covariance adjustment. SSOT for all investment constraints, governance frameworks, and regulatory capital calculations used by compliance monitoring modules.
products.reference: NAIC Investment Guidelines / State Insurance Investment Laws / Charles River Compliance Rule

attributes.description: Allowable tolerance percentage before a breach action is triggered (e.g., 1% over limit triggers alert, 2% over limit triggers block). Null if zero tolerance.

attributes.name: minimum_value

attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule is enforced at pre-trade compliance check (true) or only monitored post-trade (false).

attributes.name: rbc_component
attributes.description: The specific RBC component category this rule applies to: C-0 (affiliate risk), C-1 (asset risk), C-2 (insurance risk), C-3 (interest rate/market risk), C-4 (business risk).

attributes.name: rbc_factor
attributes.description: The Risk-Based Capital factor applied to calculate the capital charge for this asset class or security type under NAIC RBC formula (C-1 for asset risk, C-3 for interest rate risk). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.003 for 0.3% charge).

attributes.name: rule_category
attributes.description: High-level category indicating the source and purpose of the compliance rule.

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the compliance rule, used for external reference and reporting (e.g., IPS-CONC-001, NAIC-SCH-D-LMT, RBC-C1-BOND).

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the compliance rule, including its purpose, scope, calculation methodology, and any special conditions or exceptions.

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the compliance rule (e.g., Corporate Bond Concentration Limit, Below Investment Grade Restriction, Real Estate Allocation Cap).

attributes.name: rule_notes

attributes.name: threshold_value

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

Supports NAIC examination responses, state DOI reporting, and internal investment governance.

attributes.description: Identifier of the trade order that caused or would have caused the compliance breach. Populated for pre-trade breaches. Nullable for post-trade breaches detected during monitoring.

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.description: The actual value or percentage of the exposure at the time of breach detection. Used in conjunction with limit_threshold to calculate the breach amount and percentage.

attributes.name: alm_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the compliance breach has implications for Asset Liability Management (ALM) duration matching or interest rate risk management. True if the breach affects ALM objectives; false otherwise.

attributes.name: asset_class

attributes.name: breach_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount by which the compliance limit was exceeded, expressed in the portfolio base currency. For concentration breaches, this is the excess market value. For other breach types, this may represent the notional exposure or Fair Market Value (FMV) of the non-compliant position.

attributes.name: breach_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance breach was detected or occurred. For pre-trade breaches, this is the date the order was submitted. For post-trade breaches, this is the date the breach condition was identified during monitoring.

attributes.name: breach_notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes providing additional context about the compliance breach. May include root cause analysis, mitigating factors, or special circumstances. Supports regulatory examination responses and internal governance documentation.

attributes.name: breach_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number assigned to the compliance breach for tracking and reporting purposes. Used in regulatory correspondence and internal governance documentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Examination Standards, Internal Investment Governance Policy

attributes.name: breach_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage by which the compliance limit was exceeded. For example, if a concentration limit is 10% and the actual exposure is 12%, the breach percentage is 2.00. Expressed as a percentage value (e.g., 2.00 for 2%).

attributes.name: breach_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the compliance breach. Warning indicates a minor or threshold breach; violation indicates a material breach requiring remediation; critical indicates a severe breach requiring immediate escalation and regulatory notification.
attributes.references: NAIC Examination Standards, Internal Investment Governance Policy

attributes.name: breach_status
attributes.description: Current status of the compliance breach in the remediation workflow. Tracks the lifecycle from detection through resolution or escalation.
attributes.references: NAIC Examination Standards, Internal Investment Governance Policy

attributes.name: breach_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the compliance breach was detected by the investment compliance monitoring system. Supports audit trail and regulatory examination response.

attributes.name: breach_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of compliance breach. Categorizes the nature of the violation for reporting and trend analysis purposes.
attributes.value_regex: concentration limit exceeded|prohibited security|credit rating violation|liquidity constraint|duration mismatch|sector limit exceeded

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the breach amount and limit threshold. Typically the base currency of the portfolio or USD for consolidated reporting.

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: The method by which the compliance breach was detected. Indicates whether the breach was caught by automated pre-trade controls, post-trade monitoring, manual review, periodic reconciliation, or during a regulatory examination.
attributes.value_regex: pre-trade automated|post-trade automated|manual review|periodic reconciliation|regulatory examination

attributes.name: investment_committee_decision
attributes.description: Decision or recommendation made by the investment committee or ALM committee regarding the compliance breach. Examples include approve remediation plan, request waiver, escalate to board, or accept residual risk.

attributes.name: investment_committee_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance breach was reviewed by the investment committee or Asset Liability Management (ALM) committee. Nullable if the breach did not require committee review.

attributes.name: limit_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum allowable value or percentage defined by the compliance rule that was breached. Provides context for the magnitude of the breach.
attributes.references: NAIC Investment Guidelines, Internal Investment Policy

attributes.name: naic_designation
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Designation
attributes.description: NAIC designation of the security involved in the breach. Used to assess Risk-Based Capital (RBC) implications and regulatory reporting requirements. Examples include NAIC 1 through NAIC 6 for bonds.
attributes.references: NAIC Securities Valuation Office (SVO) Designation System

attributes.name: rbc_category
attributes.description: Risk-Based Capital category of the security involved in the breach. Used to assess the capital charge implications of the non-compliant position. Examples include C1 (asset risk), C3 (interest rate risk).

attributes.name: rbc_charge_impact
attributes.description: Estimated incremental Risk-Based Capital charge resulting from the compliance breach. Quantifies the regulatory capital impact of the non-compliant position.

attributes.name: regulatory_escalation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the compliance breach was escalated to regulatory authorities. True if the breach was reported to NAIC, state Department of Insurance (DOI), or other governing bodies; false otherwise.
attributes.references: NAIC Examination Standards, State DOI Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance breach was reported to regulatory authorities. Nullable if the breach did not require regulatory escalation.
attributes.references: NAIC Examination Standards, State DOI Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: remediation_action
attributes.description: Description of the remediation action taken or planned to resolve the compliance breach. Examples include trade cancellation, position reduction, rebalancing, waiver request, or policy exception approval.
attributes.references: NAIC Examination Standards, Internal Investment Governance Policy

attributes.name: remediation_deadline
attributes.description: Target date by which the compliance breach must be remediated. Set based on breach severity and regulatory requirements. Nullable for breaches that are waived or do not require remediation.
attributes.references: NAIC Examination Standards, Internal Investment Governance Policy

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance breach was fully resolved or closed. Nullable for breaches that remain open or under review.
attributes.references: NAIC Examination Standards, Internal Investment Governance Policy

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes documenting the resolution of the compliance breach. Includes actions taken, approvals obtained, and any residual risk or follow-up items. Supports regulatory examination responses.

attributes.name: separate_account_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the compliance breach occurred in a separate account portfolio supporting variable products. True if the breach is in a separate account; false if in the general account.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the compliance breach record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking for regulatory examination purposes.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Compliance, Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: waiver_approved_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a waiver or exception was approved for the compliance breach. True if the breach was granted a policy exception; false otherwise.

attributes.name: waiver_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the approved waiver or exception. After this date, the position must be brought into compliance or a new waiver must be requested. Nullable if no waiver was granted.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the mortgage loan investment asset record. Primary key for the mortgage loan product.

attributes.name: borrower_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.counterparty. Business justification: mortgage_loan stores borrower_name and borrower_tin as denormalized strings. The counterparty table is the master record for all investment counterparties including borrowers, with legal_name, tax_ide

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Mortgage loans are Schedule B assets owned by specific legal entities, required for NAIC Annual Statement reporting and RBC C1 asset risk calculations.

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment portfolio that holds this mortgage loan asset. Links to the general account portfolio structure.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date when the insurer acquired the mortgage loan investment. May differ from origination date if purchased on secondary market.

attributes.name: acquisition_price
attributes.description: Purchase price paid by the insurer to acquire the mortgage loan. Used for premium/discount amortization and return calculations.

attributes.name: allowance_for_credit_losses
attributes.description: GAAP allowance for expected credit losses under ASC 326 CECL. Reduces the carrying value of the mortgage loan on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: amortization_type
attributes.description: Structure of principal repayment over the loan term. Fully amortizing loans pay down to zero; balloon loans require lump sum at maturity; interest-only defer principal.

attributes.name: amortized_cost
attributes.description: Amortized cost basis of the mortgage loan under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP). Reflects purchase price adjusted for premium/discount amortization and credit losses.

attributes.name: appraisal_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent property appraisal. Regulatory guidelines require periodic reappraisals for commercial mortgages.

attributes.name: appraisal_value
attributes.description: Most recent appraised Fair Market Value (FMV) of the property securing the mortgage loan. Used for LTV ratio calculations and impairment testing.

attributes.name: book_value
attributes.description: Carrying value of the mortgage loan on the general account balance sheet under Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP). May differ from outstanding principal due to premium/discount amortization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this mortgage loan record was first created in the investment management system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts. Supports international mortgage investments and foreign exchange risk management.

attributes.name: dscr
attributes.description: Debt Service Coverage Ratio for commercial mortgage loans. Measures the property's net operating income relative to debt service obligations. Key underwriting and risk metric.

attributes.name: impairment_status
attributes.description: Current impairment classification under GAAP ASC 326 Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) or SAP guidance. Drives allowance for credit losses and income recognition.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Current annual interest rate on the mortgage loan expressed as a decimal percentage. Used for income accrual and Asset Liability Management (ALM) duration calculations.

attributes.name: interest_rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interest rate structure. Fixed rates remain constant; variable/adjustable rates change based on index; hybrid combines both.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received from the borrower. Used to calculate delinquency status and days past due.

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: External loan number or identifier assigned by the originator or servicer. Business identifier for the mortgage loan.

attributes.name: loan_status
attributes.description: Current payment and performance status of the mortgage loan. Delinquency stages track days past due. Real Estate Owned (REO) indicates foreclosed property. Drives reserve requirements and RBC charges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: current|delinquent_30|delinquent_60|delinquent_90|in_foreclosure|reo|paid_off — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ltv_ratio
attributes.description: Loan-to-Value ratio expressed as a percentage. Calculated as outstanding principal balance divided by current appraised property value. Critical risk metric for NAIC Schedule B classification and RBC charges.

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when the mortgage loan principal is due in full. Critical for Asset Liability Management (ALM) duration matching and cash flow projections.

attributes.name: naic_designation
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Designation
attributes.description: NAIC credit quality designation for the mortgage loan ranging from 1 (highest quality) to 6 (in or near default). Determines RBC C-1 risk charge factors.

attributes.name: naic_schedule_b_line
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Schedule B Line Item
attributes.description: Specific line item classification on NAIC Schedule B annual statement where this mortgage loan is reported. Supports regulatory financial reporting.

attributes.name: next_payment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next principal and interest payment. Used for cash flow forecasting and delinquency monitoring.

attributes.name: original_loan_amount
attributes.description: Principal amount of the mortgage loan at origination. Used for Loan-to-Value (LTV) ratio calculations and historical tracking.

attributes.name: origination_date
attributes.description: Date when the mortgage loan was originally funded and the note was executed. Used for age-based risk analysis and amortization calculations.

attributes.name: outstanding_principal_balance
attributes.description: Current unpaid principal balance of the mortgage loan. Key metric for Risk-Based Capital (RBC) C-1 mortgage risk charge calculations.

attributes.name: prepayment_penalty_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mortgage loan includes prepayment penalties. True if penalties apply; False if borrower can prepay without penalty. Impacts ALM prepayment risk modeling.

attributes.name: property_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the street address for the property securing the mortgage loan.

attributes.name: property_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the street address for the property securing the mortgage loan (suite, unit, building).

attributes.name: property_city
attributes.description: City where the property securing the mortgage loan is located.

attributes.name: property_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the property location. Supports international mortgage investments.

attributes.name: property_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the property securing the mortgage loan.

attributes.name: property_state
attributes.description: State or province where the property securing the mortgage loan is located. Two-letter state code.

attributes.name: property_type
attributes.description: Classification of the property securing the mortgage loan. Determines risk assessment and regulatory capital treatment.

attributes.name: rbc_c1_charge
attributes.description: Risk-Based Capital charge for asset default risk (C-1 component) calculated for this mortgage loan. Based on NAIC designation and property type. Critical for solvency monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) for Insurers Model Act

attributes.name: rbc_factor
attributes.description: RBC factor percentage applied to the outstanding balance to calculate the C-1 risk charge. Varies by NAIC designation and property type.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) for Insurers Model Act

attributes.name: recourse_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loan is recourse or non-recourse. True if lender has recourse to borrower assets beyond collateral; False if limited to property collateral only. Affects credit risk assessment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this mortgage loan record. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

products.name: derivative_contract
products.description: Master record for derivative instruments used for hedging or replication purposes including interest rate swaps, swaptions, caps/floors, credit default swaps, equity options, and currency forwards. Captures derivative type, notional amount, counterparty, trade date, effective date, maturity date, hedge designation (fair value hedge, cash flow hedge, economic hedge), underlying reference, strike/fixed rate, current FMV, collateral posted/received, and ISDA master agreement reference. Supports ALM hedging programs, GMDB/GMWB hedge accounting, and NAIC derivative reporting.
products.reference: ISDA Derivative / NAIC Schedule DB / ASC 815 Hedge Accounting

attributes.name: derivative_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the derivative contract record. Primary key.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions - Schedule DB

attributes.name: benefit_structure_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.benefit_structure. Business justification: Derivative contracts hedge specific guaranteed benefit structures (GMDB, GMWB, GMIB). derivative_contract already has gmdb_hedge_flag and gmwb_hedge_flag but no FK to the benefit structure being hedge

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Derivatives (Schedule DB) are held by specific legal entities for regulatory reporting, collateral management, RBC calculations, and hedge accounting documentation.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Derivatives hedge product-specific risks: equity index options for GMDB/GMWB guarantees on variable annuities, interest rate swaps for fixed annuity crediting rates, and currency forwards for internat

attributes.name: portfolio_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investment portfolio that holds this derivative position.
attributes.references: Investment Management System - Portfolio Management Module

attributes.name: primary_derivative_broker_dealer_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the broker-dealer that facilitated the derivative transaction, if applicable.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Derivative contracts for GMDB/GMWB hedging are subject to specific regulatory obligations: NAIC Schedule DB reporting, state insurance derivative use plan requirements, and Dodd-Frank clearing obligat

attributes.name: trade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.trade. Business justification: Derivative contracts are initiated and executed through the trade lifecycle. A derivative_contract should reference the originating trade record that captured the order, execution, and settlement deta

attributes.name: underlying_security_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.security. Business justification: Derivative contracts reference underlying securities (stocks, bonds, indices). The existing underlying_cusip attribute identifies the underlying but lacks FK to security master. Adding underlying_secu

attributes.name: alm_segment
attributes.description: Asset Liability Management segment or bucket to which this derivative is assigned for duration matching and interest rate risk management purposes.

attributes.name: collateral_posted
attributes.description: The amount of collateral posted by the company to the counterparty to secure the derivative obligation.

attributes.name: collateral_received
attributes.description: The amount of collateral received from the counterparty to secure their derivative obligation to the company.

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral used to secure the derivative contract obligations.

attributes.name: contract_notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or special terms related to the derivative contract.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the derivative contract, typically assigned by the investment management system or counterparty.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the derivative contract indicating whether it is active, matured, terminated, cancelled, or pending execution.
attributes.references: Investment Management System - Trade Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this derivative contract record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards - Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the notional amount and contract payments.

attributes.name: current_fmv
attributes.description: The current fair market value of the derivative contract as of the most recent valuation date, representing the amount that would be received or paid to terminate the contract.

attributes.name: derivative_subtype
attributes.description: Further classification of the derivative instrument providing additional detail beyond the primary type (e.g., payer swap, receiver swap, call option, put option).

attributes.name: derivative_type
attributes.description: Classification of the derivative instrument type used for hedging or replication purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: interest_rate_swap|swaption|cap|floor|collar|credit_default_swap|equity_option|currency_forward|futures — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions - Schedule DB Part A

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the derivative contract becomes effective and obligations begin.

attributes.name: fair_value_hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Classification of the fair value measurement input level under GAAP (Level 1: quoted prices, Level 2: observable inputs, Level 3: unobservable inputs).
attributes.references: FASB ASC 820 - Fair Value Measurement Hierarchy

attributes.name: floating_rate_index
attributes.description: The benchmark interest rate index used for floating rate calculations (e.g., SOFR, LIBOR, Fed Funds Rate).

attributes.name: gmdb_hedge_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit (GMDB) Hedge Flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this derivative is used to hedge Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit exposure on variable annuity contracts.

attributes.name: gmwb_hedge_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) Hedge Flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this derivative is used to hedge Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit exposure on variable annuity contracts.

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: Accounting classification of the hedge relationship under GAAP or SAP, indicating whether the derivative qualifies for hedge accounting treatment.

attributes.name: hedge_effectiveness_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the most recent hedge effectiveness assessment, determining whether the derivative continues to qualify for hedge accounting.

attributes.name: isda_master_agreement_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Master Agreement Date
attributes.description: The effective date of the ISDA Master Agreement governing the derivative contract terms and conditions.

attributes.name: isda_master_agreement_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Master Agreement Version
attributes.description: Version of the ISDA Master Agreement under which the derivative contract is documented (e.g., 1992, 2002).

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: The date on which the derivative contract expires or reaches final settlement.

attributes.name: naic_designation
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Designation
attributes.description: NAIC quality rating designation for the derivative contract or underlying reference entity, used for regulatory capital calculations.

attributes.name: notional_amount
attributes.description: The principal amount upon which derivative payments are calculated. This amount is not exchanged but serves as the basis for calculating cash flows.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which cash flows or settlements occur under the derivative contract.

attributes.name: rbc_category
attributes.description: Risk-Based Capital category classification for the derivative contract used in calculating C-1, C-2, or C-3 risk charges.

attributes.name: rbc_charge
attributes.description: The calculated Risk-Based Capital charge amount for this derivative position, contributing to the company's total RBC requirement.

attributes.name: schedule_db_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this derivative contract must be reported on NAIC Schedule DB (Derivative Instruments) in the Annual Statement.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions - Schedule DB

attributes.name: separate_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this derivative is held in a separate account (variable product account) versus the general account.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions - Separate Accounts

attributes.name: strike_rate
attributes.description: The fixed interest rate, strike price, or reference rate specified in the derivative contract (e.g., fixed rate in an interest rate swap, strike price in an option).

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the derivative contract was terminated or closed out prior to maturity, if applicable.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for early termination of the derivative contract (e.g., hedge no longer needed, counterparty credit concerns, portfolio rebalancing).

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: The date on which the derivative contract was executed and agreed upon by both parties.

attributes.name: underlying_reference
attributes.description: Description or identifier of the underlying asset, index, rate, or reference entity upon which the derivative value is based (e.g., LIBOR, S&P 500, specific bond CUSIP).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this derivative contract record was last modified in the system.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards - Audit Trail Requirements

products.name: counterparty
products.description: Master record for all investment counterparties including broker-dealers, swap counterparties, custodian banks, fund managers, securities lending agents, and sub-custodians. Captures counterparty legal name, LEI (Legal Entity Identifier), counterparty type, credit rating, ISDA agreement reference, approved trading limits, collateral agreement type (CSA), custodian account details, AML/KYC status, regulatory registration (FINRA, SEC), and relationship manager. SSOT for investment counterparty identity within the investment domain; distinct from policyholder or agent counterparties in other domains.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the investment counterparty. Primary key for the counterparty master record.

attributes.name: affiliated_legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Investment counterparties may be affiliated legal entities requiring intercompany elimination, related-party disclosure, and consolidation adjustments for financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the counterparty's registered business address. Used for legal correspondence and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the counterparty's registered business address (suite, floor, building name).

attributes.name: aml_kyc_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) Status
attributes.description: Current status of AML and KYC due diligence for this counterparty. Must be compliant before executing transactions.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), FinCEN AML Requirements, USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: approved_asset_classes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of asset classes approved for trading with this counterparty (e.g., fixed_income, equity, derivatives, alternatives). Used for pre-trade compliance checks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fixed_income|equity|derivatives|alternatives|real_estate|commodities|structured_products — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Investment Policy Statement, NAIC Investment Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_trading_limit
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate exposure amount approved for trading with this counterparty. Enforced by pre-trade compliance checks to manage counterparty concentration risk.
attributes.references: NAIC Investment Guidelines, Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the counterparty's registered business address.

attributes.name: counterparty_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the counterparty relationship. Controls whether new trades and transactions can be executed with this counterparty.

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the counterparty role in investment operations. Determines applicable compliance rules, credit limits, and operational workflows.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the counterparty's domicile. Used for regulatory reporting and cross-border risk assessment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this counterparty record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Current credit rating assigned by external rating agencies (e.g., Moody's, S&P, Fitch). Used for counterparty risk assessment and RBC calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Securities Valuation Office (SVO), Rating Agency Standards

attributes.name: csa_type
attributes.description: Type of Credit Support Annex governing collateral arrangements for derivative transactions. Bilateral requires both parties to post collateral; unilateral requires only one party.
attributes.references: ISDA CSA Standards, Dodd-Frank Margin Rules

attributes.name: custodian_account_number
attributes.description: Account number assigned by the custodian bank for holding securities. Applicable when counterparty_type is custodian_bank or sub_custodian.

attributes.name: fatca_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) Status
attributes.description: FATCA classification status for foreign counterparties. Determines withholding and reporting obligations under US tax law.
attributes.references: FATCA (Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act), IRS Publication 515

attributes.name: finra_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Registration Number
attributes.description: FINRA Central Registration Depository (CRD) number for broker-dealers. Required for broker-dealer counterparties.

attributes.name: form_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the W-8 or W-9 form on file. W-8 forms typically expire after three years; W-9 forms do not expire but require updates when information changes.

attributes.name: isda_agreement_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Agreement Execution Date
attributes.description: The date when the ISDA Master Agreement was executed. Null if no ISDA agreement exists.

attributes.name: isda_agreement_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Swaps and Derivatives Association (ISDA) Agreement Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an ISDA Master Agreement is in place with this counterparty. Required for derivative and swap transactions.
attributes.references: ISDA Master Agreement Standards, Dodd-Frank Act

attributes.name: kyc_next_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Next Review Date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next KYC review. Typically annual or risk-based frequency.

attributes.name: kyc_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Know Your Customer (KYC) Last Review Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent KYC review. Used to trigger periodic re-verification workflows per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the counterparty as registered with regulatory authorities. Used for legal documentation, contracts, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Investment Guidelines, SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: lei
attributes.description: ISO 17442 standard 20-character Legal Entity Identifier used for global counterparty identification in financial transactions and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: limit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the approved trading limit. Typically USD for US-domiciled insurers.

attributes.name: naic_designation_override
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Designation Override
attributes.description: Manual NAIC designation override applied to securities issued by this counterparty. Used when SVO designation differs from external ratings.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional information about the counterparty, special handling instructions, or historical context.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date when the counterparty was approved and onboarded for trading. Marks the start of the business relationship.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the counterparty's registered business address.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person. Used for trade confirmations, settlement instructions, and operational communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the counterparty organization for operational and trading matters.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person for urgent operational matters and trade execution.

attributes.name: rating_agency
attributes.description: The rating agency that provided the credit rating. Multiple agencies may rate the same counterparty; this field captures the primary rating source used for risk decisions.
attributes.references: NAIC SVO, SEC Nationally Recognized Statistical Rating Organizations (NRSRO)

attributes.name: rating_date
attributes.description: The date when the current credit rating became effective. Used to track rating staleness and trigger review workflows.

attributes.name: rbc_concentration_factor
attributes.description: RBC concentration adjustment factor applied to positions with this counterparty. Higher factors increase capital charges for concentrated exposures.
attributes.references: NAIC RBC Instructions, C-1 Asset Risk Component

attributes.name: sec_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Registration Number
attributes.description: SEC registration number for investment advisers, broker-dealers, or fund managers. Used to verify regulatory standing.
attributes.references: Investment Advisers Act of 1940, Securities Exchange Act of 1934

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or common name used for operational purposes and system displays.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the counterparty's registered business address. Two-letter state code for US addresses.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number (EIN for US entities, equivalent for foreign entities). Used for tax reporting and IRS Form 1099 generation.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the counterparty relationship was terminated. Null for active relationships.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for terminating the counterparty relationship (e.g., credit downgrade, regulatory action, business decision, counterparty request).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this counterparty record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: w8_w9_form_on_file_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRS Form W-8 or W-9 On File Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid IRS Form W-8 (for foreign entities) or W-9 (for US entities) is on file. Required for tax withholding compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-8 and W-9 Instructions

attributes.name: business_name

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: date_of_birth

attributes.name: email_address

attributes.name: eo_coverage_indicator

attributes.name: middle_name

attributes.name: phone_number

products.name: hierarchy_node
products.description: Represents a single node in the multi-level distribution hierarchy — from individual writing agents up through supervisory levels, GAs, MGAs, BGAs, and broker-dealers. Each node captures the participant, their hierarchy level, parent node reference (enabling tree traversal), effective and termination dates, override eligibility flag, and hierarchy type (captive, independent, brokerage). Self-referencing parent-child structure enables roll-up reporting, commission override chain calculations, and organizational charting across distribution tiers.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hierarchy node. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.agency. Business justification: Hierarchy nodes can represent either individual producers or agency entities in the distribution hierarchy. When a node represents an agency (BGA, MGA, GA), this FK links to the agency master record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Hierarchy nodes map to cost centers for distribution expense allocation, override commission accounting, and production reporting. Finance requires cost center attribution at the hierarchy node level

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Distribution hierarchy nodes in multi-entity insurance groups are scoped to a legal entity for commission override calculations, production roll-up reporting, and statutory expense allocation by entit

attributes.name: parent_node_hierarchy_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent node in the distribution hierarchy. Self-referencing foreign key enabling tree traversal and roll-up reporting. Null for top-level nodes.

attributes.name: primary_hierarchy_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent or distribution participant represented by this hierarchy node. Links to the agent master record.

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commission.schedule. Business justification: Hierarchy nodes drive override commission calculations; each node is associated with a commission schedule that determines override rates for that level. Replacing the denormalized commission_schedule

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Distribution channel classification for this hierarchy node. Career represents captive career agents. Independent represents independent agents and agencies. Worksite represents employer-sponsored distribution. Financial institution represents bank and credit union channels. Broker-dealer represents securities-licensed distribution for variable products.

attributes.name: child_node_count
attributes.description: Number of direct child nodes reporting to this hierarchy node. Used for span-of-control analysis and organizational structure metrics. Zero for leaf nodes.

attributes.name: commission_hierarchy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node participates in commission calculation and override chains. True for nodes eligible for commission processing. False for reporting-only or inactive nodes.

attributes.name: commission_split_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of commission allocated to this hierarchy node when multiple nodes share commission on the same policy. Used in split-commission scenarios and joint-writing arrangements. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Legal relationship type between the company and this hierarchy node. W2 employee represents captive career agents. 1099 contractor represents independent agents. Corporate entity represents agency corporations. Partnership represents multi-owner agencies.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: depth_level
attributes.description: Calculated depth of this node from the root of the hierarchy tree. Root nodes have depth 0. Used for tree traversal algorithms and organizational chart rendering.

attributes.name: descendant_node_count
attributes.description: Total number of descendant nodes (children, grandchildren, etc.) under this hierarchy node. Used for organizational size metrics and production roll-up calculations. Zero for leaf nodes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node became active and operational. Used for temporal queries and commission eligibility determination.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the distribution hierarchy tree. Level 1 represents top-level nodes (e.g., Brokerage General Agency (BGA)), higher numbers represent deeper levels (e.g., writing agents). Enables depth-based queries and organizational charting.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized path representing the full lineage from root to this node, typically formatted as slash-delimited node IDs (e.g., /1/45/203/). Enables efficient ancestor and descendant queries without recursive joins.

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution hierarchy structure. Captive represents company-owned distribution, independent represents non-exclusive agents, brokerage represents broker-dealer channels, hybrid represents mixed models, direct represents company-direct sales, reinsurance represents reinsurance intermediary chains.

attributes.name: hierarchy_version
attributes.description: Version number for this hierarchy node configuration. Incremented when node attributes change. Supports temporal hierarchy analysis and historical commission recalculations.

attributes.name: leaf_node_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node is a leaf node (has no children) in the hierarchy tree. True for individual writing agents. False for supervisory and management levels with downstream agents.

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Business identifier or code for this hierarchy node. Used for reporting, commission processing, and system integration. May align with legacy system codes or external partner identifiers.

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Business name or label for this hierarchy node. May represent the agent name, agency name, Managing General Agent (MGA) name, General Agent (GA) name, or Brokerage General Agency (BGA) name depending on hierarchy level.

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the hierarchy node. Active indicates the node is operational and eligible for commission processing. Inactive indicates temporary suspension. Terminated indicates permanent closure. Pending indicates awaiting approval or activation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text notes and comments about this hierarchy node. Used for documenting special arrangements, historical context, or operational considerations.

attributes.name: organizational_unit
attributes.description: Business division, region, or organizational unit to which this hierarchy node belongs. Used for management reporting, territory assignment, and organizational charting.

attributes.name: override_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node is eligible to receive override commissions from downstream production. True for supervisory and management levels (Managing General Agent (MGA), General Agent (GA), Brokerage General Agency (BGA)). False for individual writing agents.

attributes.name: production_credit_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of production volume credited to this hierarchy node for quota and performance tracking. Used in split-credit scenarios and joint-production arrangements. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: reporting_hierarchy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node participates in management reporting hierarchies. True for nodes used in executive dashboards and performance reporting. False for commission-only or administrative nodes.

attributes.name: roll_up_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether production from this node should roll up to parent nodes for reporting and commission calculations. Typically true for all nodes except top-level organizational units.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Display sequence for this node among siblings in the hierarchy tree. Used for consistent organizational chart rendering and report ordering.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchy node was terminated or deactivated. Null for active nodes. Used for historical reporting and commission cutoff calculations.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for hierarchy node termination. Voluntary indicates agent-initiated departure. Involuntary indicates company-initiated termination. Restructure indicates organizational change. Compliance indicates regulatory or policy violation. Performance indicates failure to meet production targets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary|involuntary|restructure|merger|acquisition|compliance|performance|retirement — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Geographic or market territory assigned to this hierarchy node. Used for territory management, lead assignment, and market penetration analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

domains.name: commission
domains.description: Manages all agent and broker compensation calculations, payment processing, and incentive tracking. Owns first-year (FYC) and renewal commission schedules, hierarchy-based overrides, chargeback rules, bonus and incentive programs, 1099 tax reporting, commission statement generation, and commission disputes/adjustments for policy changes and lapses. Directly references agent hierarchy from the agent domain for multi-level payout calculations tied to NBV and policy sales.

products.name: schedule
products.description: Master reference entity defining commission rate structures, granular rate tiers, and compensation schedules for life insurance and annuity products. Each schedule contains one or more rate rows specifying exact percentage or flat-dollar commission payable per policy year, premium band, product code, agent tier, and distribution channel. Stores FYC (First-Year Commission) rates, renewal rates, excess interest credits, override rate tables, and modal factors with effective date ranges. Supports heaped, level, and hybrid compensation structures across WL, UL, IUL, VUL, FIA, SPIA, and annuity product lines. Consolidates both schedule-level metadata and individual rate-row detail as a single authoritative rate source. Owned by the Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera).
