attributes.name: compensation_basis
attributes.description: Defines how the commission amount is calculated. 'percent_of_premium' applies the rate to the premium paid; 'flat_dollar' pays a fixed dollar amount per policy; 'percent_of_account_value' applies to Account Value (AV) for UL/annuity products; 'percent_of_nav' applies to Net Asset Value (NAV) for VUL sub-accounts.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); FINRA Rule 2341 (for variable products)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this commission schedule record was first created in the system of record. Expressed in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which commission rates and amounts under this schedule are denominated (e.g., 'USD'). Supports multi-currency operations for international or cross-border distribution arrangements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel for which this commission schedule is applicable. Differentiates compensation structures across career agents, independent agents, Brokerage General Agencies (BGA), Managing General Agents (MGA), bank distribution, direct-to-consumer, Third Party Administrators (TPA), and worksite/employer channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: career_agent|independent|bga|mga|bank|direct|tpa|worksite — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this commission schedule becomes effective and applicable to new policy sales. Policies issued on or after this date are subject to the rates defined in this schedule. Part of the effective date range governing schedule applicability.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: excess_interest_credit_rate
attributes.description: The excess interest credit rate applicable to UL and annuity products, representing additional compensation tied to credited interest rates above the guaranteed minimum. Expressed as a percentage. Null for products where excess interest credits do not apply.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this commission schedule ceases to apply to new policy sales (inclusive). Null for open-ended schedules with no defined end date. Policies issued after this date will be governed by a successor schedule. Part of the effective date range.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: finra_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commission schedule applies to variable products (VUL, variable annuities) subject to FINRA oversight and compensation disclosure requirements. True = FINRA reporting obligations apply; False = not subject to FINRA reporting.
attributes.references: FINRA Rule 2341; SEC Regulation Best Interest (Reg BI); FINRA Broker-Dealer Oversight

attributes.name: fyc_rate
attributes.description: The First-Year Commission (FYC) rate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 55.0000 = 55%) or flat-dollar amount per the compensation_basis. Represents the commission payable in the first policy year. Core field for heaped and hybrid compensation structures across WL, UL, IUL, and annuity product lines.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: modal_factor_annual
attributes.description: The modal factor applied when premiums are paid on an annual basis. Used to adjust the commission base for modal premium payments. Typically 1.000000 for annual mode. Part of the modal factor set used in commission calculations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: modal_factor_monthly
attributes.description: The modal factor applied when premiums are paid on a monthly basis (e.g., 0.950000). Adjusts the commission base for monthly modal premium payments. Monthly mode is the most common payment frequency and often carries the lowest modal factor.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: modal_factor_quarterly
attributes.description: The modal factor applied when premiums are paid on a quarterly basis (e.g., 0.970000). Adjusts the commission base for quarterly modal premium payments in commission calculations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: modal_factor_semi_annual
attributes.description: The modal factor applied when premiums are paid on a semi-annual basis. Adjusts the commission base for semi-annual modal premium payments (e.g., 0.980000). Used in commission calculations to account for the timing difference in premium collection.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: override_rate
attributes.description: The override commission rate payable to a supervising agent, GA, MGA, or BGA in the hierarchy above the writing agent. Expressed as a percentage of premium or AV per the compensation_basis. Supports multi-level hierarchy-based payout calculations tied to NBV and policy sales.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: persistency_bonus_rate
attributes.description: Additional commission rate payable as a persistency bonus when the policy remains in force beyond a defined duration threshold. Expressed as a percentage of premium or AV. Incentivizes agents to write quality, long-duration business. Null if no persistency bonus applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: policy_year_from
attributes.description: The starting policy year (inclusive) for which this commission rate row is applicable. Used to define rate tiers by policy duration (e.g., policy year 1 for FYC, years 2-10 for renewal, year 11+ for trail). Enables granular multi-year commission schedules.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: policy_year_to
attributes.description: The ending policy year (inclusive) for which this commission rate row is applicable. Null indicates the rate applies indefinitely beyond the policy_year_from. Paired with policy_year_from to define the policy duration band for this rate tier.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: premium_band_max
attributes.description: The maximum annualized premium amount (exclusive) defining the upper bound of the premium band for this rate tier. Null indicates no upper limit (open-ended band). Paired with premium_band_min to define the premium volume tier.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: premium_band_min
attributes.description: The minimum annualized premium amount (inclusive) defining the lower bound of the premium band for this rate tier. Enables tiered commission rates based on premium volume. Expressed in USD. Null if no premium banding applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The insurance or annuity product line to which this commission schedule applies (e.g., WL — Whole Life, UL — Universal Life, IUL — Indexed Universal Life, VUL — Variable Universal Life, FIA — Fixed Indexed Annuity, SPIA — Single Premium Immediate Annuity, Term, DI — Disability Income, LTC — Long-Term Care). Drives which policies are eligible for this schedule. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|FIA|SPIA|Term|DI|LTC|Annuity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Product Classification; ACORD Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: renewal_rate
attributes.description: The commission rate applicable to renewal years (policy year 2 and beyond) expressed as a percentage or flat-dollar amount per the compensation_basis. Used in level and hybrid compensation structures. May vary by policy year band as defined in rate tier rows.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: requires_state_filing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commission schedule requires regulatory filing with one or more State Departments of Insurance prior to use. True = state filing required; False = no filing required. Supports compliance tracking for state-specific commission rate approvals.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this commission schedule within the Agent and Commission Management System (e.g., 'WL-FYC-TIER1-2024'). Used in bordereaux reporting, agent statements, and system integrations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: schedule_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the commission schedule, including its business purpose, applicable product lines, special conditions, and any notes relevant to commission calculation or agent communication. Used in commission statements and internal documentation.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the commission schedule (e.g., 'Whole Life First-Year Heaped Schedule 2024'). Used in agent-facing commission statements and internal reporting.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission schedule. 'active' schedules are applied to new and in-force policies; 'superseded' schedules have been replaced by a newer version but may still govern existing policies; 'draft' schedules are under review and not yet applied.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the compensation structure of the schedule. 'heaped' concentrates commission in the first year (FYC); 'level' spreads commission evenly across policy years; 'hybrid' combines both; 'override' applies to hierarchy-based override rates; 'bonus' covers incentive/bonus programs; 'trailer' applies to ongoing trail commissions on annuity and investment products.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this commission schedule record originated (e.g., 'SAPIENS_COMM', 'ANNOCERA'). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); Enterprise Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: tax_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether commissions paid under this schedule are subject to IRS 1099 tax reporting requirements. True = commissions are reportable on Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC; False = not subject to 1099 reporting (e.g., W-2 employee agents). Governs 1099 tax reporting obligations.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-MISC / 1099-NEC; IRS Publication 15-A; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this commission schedule record was most recently modified. Expressed in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection in ETL pipelines and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing version number for this commission schedule, incremented each time the schedule is revised or superseded. Enables version history tracking and audit trail for regulatory compliance. Version 1 is the original schedule.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera)

attributes.name: vested_after_months
attributes.description: The number of months after policy issue after which the agent's commission is fully vested and no longer subject to chargeback. Supports partial vesting schedules where chargeback_rate decreases over time. Null if no vesting schedule applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission / Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

products.name: rate
products.description: Granular rate rows within a commission schedule, specifying the exact percentage or flat-dollar commission payable per policy year, premium band, product code, and agent tier. Captures FYC rates, renewal rates, excess interest credits, and override rates. Supports heaped, level, and hybrid compensation structures used across WL, UL, IUL, VUL, FIA, and annuity product lines.

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a commission rate row within a commission schedule. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: premium_rate_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.premium_rate_table. Business justification: Commission rates are calculated as a percentage of premium; the premium rate table defines the premium basis for FYC and renewal commission calculation. Insurance operations require direct traceabilit

attributes.name: pricing_basis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.pricing_basis. Business justification: Commission rates are a direct output of the actuarial pricing process — the pricing_basis contains acquisition expense rates, profit margin targets, and commission loads that determine sustainable com

attributes.name: rider_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.rider_definition. Business justification: Rider-specific commission rates differ from base product rates. Explicit rider_definition_id FK enables accurate rider commission calculation, rider rate table joins, and rider-specific commission rul

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent commission schedule that owns this rate row. Links the rate to its governing schedule definition.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: separate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.separate_account. Business justification: Variable annuity commission rates differ by separate account fund type (equity vs. fixed, proprietary vs. third-party). Linking rate to separate_account enables fund-specific commission rate lookup du

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Commission rates are state-regulated in life insurance. The rate product has state_code (plain attr, denormalized). Linking to state_regulation enables compliance validation that commission rates conf

attributes.name: underwriting_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.underwriting_class. Business justification: Life insurance commission rates vary by underwriting class (preferred, standard, substandard table ratings). Commission rate lookup during policy issue requires matching the underwriting class to the

attributes.name: agent_tier_code
attributes.description: Agent or broker compensation tier designation (e.g., GA, MGA, BGA, career agent, broker) that determines which rate row applies. Supports multi-level hierarchy payout calculations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this commission rate row was formally approved by the designated business authority. Supports regulatory audit trails and SOX compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: The base upon which the commission rate or flat amount is calculated: target_premium = target/planned premium for UL/IUL; modal_premium = actual modal premium paid; annualized_premium = APE basis; account_value = AV for trailer commissions on annuities; face_amount = death benefit face; deposit = single premium deposit for SPIAs/FIAs.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Distribution channel for which this rate applies: career = captive career agents; broker = independent brokers; bga = Brokerage General Agency (BGA); mga = Managing General Agent (MGA); ga = General Agent (GA); bank = bank distribution; direct = direct-to-consumer; tpa = Third Party Administrator (TPA). Supports channel-specific compensation strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: career|broker|bga|mga|ga|bank|direct|tpa — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: chargeback_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months during which a commission chargeback applies if the policy lapses or is surrendered. After this period, the commission is considered fully earned. Critical for lapse administration and commission recovery.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: chargeback_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the original commission subject to chargeback upon policy lapse or surrender within the chargeback period. May be a full 100% recapture or a graded percentage depending on the schedule. Stored as a decimal fraction.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: compensation_structure
attributes.description: Describes the commission compensation design: heaped = large FYC with low renewals; level = uniform rate across all policy years; hybrid = combination of heaped and level; graded = rate steps down over defined policy years.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission rate row was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the commission rate (e.g., USD). Required for flat_dollar_amount rows and for multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: dac_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether commissions under this rate row qualify as Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC) for GAAP accounting purposes under FASB ASC 944 (LDTI). True = commission is deferrable as DAC; False = expensed immediately. Critical for actuarial reserving and financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; LDTI (Long Duration Targeted Improvements); GAAP

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this commission rate row becomes active and applicable to new business or in-force policy calculations. Part of the rate versioning mechanism.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: excess_premium_rate_percent
attributes.description: Commission rate applicable to premium paid above the target premium level for UL/IUL products. Typically lower than the target premium rate. Stored as a decimal fraction. Null if not applicable to this product type.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this commission rate row is no longer applicable to new calculations. Null indicates the rate is open-ended with no scheduled expiry. Supports rate versioning and schedule amendments.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: flat_dollar_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar commission amount payable per policy or per unit, used when compensation is not percentage-based. Mutually exclusive with rate_percent; one must be populated and the other null. Common in certain annuity and group products.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level within the agent distribution hierarchy at which this rate applies (e.g., 1 = writing agent, 2 = GA, 3 = MGA, 4 = BGA). Supports multi-level override and upline commission calculations tied to New Business Value (NBV).
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: issue_age_max
attributes.description: Maximum insured issue age (in years) for this commission rate row to apply. Used with issue_age_min to define age-banded commission structures. Null if no upper age restriction applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Life Insurance

attributes.name: issue_age_min
attributes.description: Minimum insured issue age (in years) for this commission rate row to apply. Some products offer differentiated commission rates by age band (e.g., juvenile policies, senior market). Null if no age restriction applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Life Insurance

attributes.name: max_face_amount
attributes.description: Maximum policy face amount (death benefit) for which this commission rate row applies. Null indicates no upper cap. Used in conjunction with min_face_amount to define face amount bands.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: min_face_amount
attributes.description: Minimum policy face amount (death benefit) required for this commission rate row to apply. Used to differentiate rates for jumbo or high-face-amount policies. Null if no minimum face amount restriction applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: nbv_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether commissions calculated under this rate row are included in New Business Value (NBV) reporting and multi-level hierarchy payout calculations. True = eligible for NBV-linked override calculations; False = excluded.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); IFRS 17; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, exceptions, or conditions associated with this commission rate row (e.g., 'Applies only to 1035 Exchange business', 'Excludes MEC policies', 'Subject to STOLI review'). Not used for calculations.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: override_rate_percent
attributes.description: Additional override commission rate percentage payable to upline hierarchy levels (GA, MGA, BGA) on top of the writing agent's base rate. Stored as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.02000 = 2%). Null if this row does not carry an override component.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: payment_mode
attributes.description: Premium payment frequency mode for which this rate applies: annual, semi_annual, quarterly, or monthly. Commission rates may be adjusted by payment mode to account for modal loading factors in the Billing and Premium Collection System.
attributes.references: Billing and Premium Collection System (Sapiens BillingPro; Majesco Billing); ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: percent
attributes.description: Commission rate expressed as a percentage of the applicable premium or account value (AV). Stored as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.05500 = 5.5%). Mutually exclusive with flat_dollar_amount; one must be populated and the other null.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure

attributes.name: persistency_bonus_rate_percent
attributes.description: Additional commission rate awarded as a persistency bonus when a policy remains in force beyond a defined duration. Incentivizes agents to place quality, long-duration business. Stored as a decimal fraction. Null if no persistency bonus applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: policy_year_from
attributes.description: Starting policy year (inclusive) for which this rate row is applicable. Policy year 1 typically carries the FYC rate; subsequent years carry renewal rates. Used in conjunction with policy_year_to to define the rate band.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: policy_year_to
attributes.description: Ending policy year (inclusive) for which this rate row is applicable. A null value indicates the rate applies indefinitely beyond policy_year_from. Supports graded and level structures.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards

attributes.name: premium_band_max
attributes.description: Maximum annualized premium amount (in USD) for this rate row to apply. Null indicates no upper cap on the premium band. Used with premium_band_min to define the qualifying premium range.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: premium_band_min
attributes.description: Minimum annualized premium amount (in USD) for this rate row to apply. Enables banded commission schedules where higher premium volumes attract different rates. Null if no lower band threshold applies.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Insurance product code to which this commission rate applies (e.g., WL, UL, IUL, VUL, FIA, SPIA, Term). Aligns with the product catalog in the Policy Administration System.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro)

attributes.name: product_line

attributes.name: product_subtype

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this commission rate row: active = currently in use for calculations; inactive = no longer applied; pending = approved but not yet effective; superseded = replaced by a newer rate version; draft = under review and not yet approved.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the commission rate row: fyc = First-Year Commission (FYC) paid on new business premium; renewal = ongoing renewal commission; override = hierarchy override paid to upline; excess_interest = credit on interest above guaranteed rate; bonus = incentive bonus rate; trailer = trail commission on annuity account value (AV). True = rate applies to target premium only; False = rate applies to excess or total premium. Critical for heaped UL commission structures.

attributes.name: tax_reportable

products.name: transaction
products.description: Core transactional record capturing every individual commission and compensation earning event tied to a policy or annuity contract. Records all transaction types via discriminator: standard commissions (FYC, renewal, trailer), override commissions, persistency credits (with milestone and credit type), service/trail fees (with fee type, fee basis, fee rate, and calculation period for RIA/TPA/broker-dealer asset-based compensation), advance commissions (with advance basis, repayment schedule, outstanding balance, and repayment status), and split commissions (with split percentage, co-agent references, split type, and approval status). Captures gross amount, net-of-chargeback amount, calculation basis (APE, modal premium, account value, NAV), policy year, and payment status. Primary audit trail for all commission payables. Sourced from Sapiens Commission / Annocera commission calculation module.

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: The financial base upon which the commission rate is applied. Determines how the gross commission amount is derived: Annual Premium Equivalent (APE), modal premium, Account Value (AV), Net Asset Value (NAV), face amount, or annualized premium.

attributes.name: calculation_basis_amount
attributes.description: The actual dollar value of the calculation basis (APE, modal premium, AV, NAV, etc.) used to compute the gross commission amount for this transaction. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: chargeback_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount recovered or debited from the agent due to policy lapse, surrender, or cancellation within the chargeback period. Reduces the net payable commission.

attributes.name: chargeback_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which the agent is no longer subject to chargeback recovery for this commission transaction. Determined by the commission schedule chargeback rules and policy year.

attributes.name: chargeback_reason
attributes.description: The business reason triggering a commission chargeback or recovery: policy lapse, surrender, cancellation, NSF payment, or free-look period cancellation. Populated when chargeback_amount is non-zero.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to the calculation basis to derive the gross commission amount. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 = 5%). Sourced from the applicable commission schedule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: earning_date
attributes.description: The real-world business date on which the commission was earned, typically aligned to the premium due date, policy issue date, or annuity contract anniversary. Principal business event date for this transaction.

attributes.name: fee_basis
attributes.description: The financial base upon which the service or trail fee rate is applied: account value, NAV, flat fee, or per-policy basis. Populated only when transaction_type is service_fee.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; SEC Investment Advisers Act of 1940

attributes.name: fee_calculation_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the period over which the service or trail fee is calculated. Defines the billing window for asset-based compensation. Populated only when transaction_type is service_fee.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module

attributes.name: fee_calculation_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the period over which the service or trail fee is calculated. Defines the billing window for asset-based compensation. Populated only when transaction_type is service_fee.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module

attributes.name: fee_rate
attributes.description: The annualized percentage rate applied to the fee basis to calculate the service or trail fee amount. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0025 = 0.25% basis points). Populated only when transaction_type is service_fee.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; SEC Investment Advisers Act of 1940

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total commission amount calculated before any chargebacks, adjustments, or deductions. Represents the full earned compensation prior to netting. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; GAAP ASC 944-40 (Deferred Acquisition Costs)

attributes.name: hierarchy_level

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commission transaction must be included in IRS Form 1099-MISC reporting for the agent. False for internal adjustments, reversals, or transactions below the IRS reporting threshold.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net commission payable after subtracting chargebacks and adjustments from the gross amount. This is the actual disbursement amount to the agent. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; IRS Form 1099-MISC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: payment_date

attributes.name: persistency_credit_type

attributes.name: persistency_milestone

attributes.name: policy_year

attributes.name: split_percentage

attributes.name: split_type

Captures payment type discriminator (commission, bonus, incentive, persistency, service_fee), payment date, payment method (ACH, check, wire), gross payment amount, tax withholding (federal, state), net payment amount, payment run identifier, and bank account reference. For bonus payments: includes bonus program reference, qualification period, and bonus amount. Supports 1099 tax reporting, payment reconciliation against commission_transaction and bonus_qualification records. Sourced from Sapiens Commission / Annocera payment processing module.

attributes.description: 15-digit NACHA ACH trace number assigned by the originating depository financial institution (ODFI) for ACH payment transactions. Used for payment tracing, return item processing, and bank reconciliation. Null for check or wire payments.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for any manual adjustment applied to this payment amount. Populated when the payment differs from the system-calculated amount due to dispute resolution, rate correction, retroactive schedule change, or manual override by commission operations.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; SOX Section 404 — Manual Adjustment Controls

attributes.name: annualized_premium_equivalent

attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module

attributes.name: backup_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS backup withholding at the statutory rate (currently 24%) was applied to this payment due to missing, incorrect, or IRS-notified TIN. True = backup withholding applied; False = no backup withholding.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1281 — Backup Withholding; IRC Section 3406; IRS CP2100 Notice

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized reference to the payee's bank account on file used for ACH or wire disbursement. Stores a non-sensitive token or last-4 digits only; full account details are held in the secure payment vault. Null for check payments.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS v4.0 — Payment Data Security; FinCEN BSA/AML Requirements

attributes.name: bonus_qualification_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the performance measurement period during which the agent accumulated qualifying production to earn this bonus payment. Populated only when payment_type is 'bonus' or 'incentive'.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Incentive Tracking Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure

attributes.name: bonus_qualification_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the performance measurement period during which the agent accumulated qualifying production to earn this bonus payment. Populated only when payment_type is 'bonus' or 'incentive'.

attributes.name: chargeback_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment record represents a chargeback (recovery of previously paid commission due to policy lapse, surrender, or cancellation within the chargeback period). True = chargeback debit; False = standard credit payment.

attributes.name: chargeback_reason_code

Null when chargeback_flag is False. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lapse|surrender|cancellation|not_in_good_order|rescission|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Sequential check number printed on the physical commission check issued to the payee. Used for check reconciliation, stop-payment processing, and positive pay bank file matching. Null for ACH or wire payments.

attributes.name: commission_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the commission was earned (not necessarily the payment year). Used for 1099 tax year assignment, DAC amortization schedules, and annual production reporting. Four-digit year (e.g., 2024).
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; FASB ASC 944-40 — Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC); SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission payment record was first created in the source commission system. Supports audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment denomination (e.g., 'USD' for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency operations for international reinsurance intermediaries or cross-border distribution arrangements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; FASB ASC 830 — Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: federal_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: Amount of federal income tax withheld from the gross payment under backup withholding rules (IRS 24% backup withholding rate) or voluntary withholding agreements. Zero if no federal withholding applies.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1281 — Backup Withholding; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRC Section 3406

attributes.name: gross_payment_amount
attributes.description: Total compensation amount before any tax withholding deductions. Represents the full earned commission, bonus, incentive, persistency credit, or service fee amount prior to federal and state withholding. Denominated in USD.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; FASB ASC 944-40 — Insurance Acquisition Costs; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: nbv_basis_amount
attributes.description: The New Business Value (NBV) amount used as the basis for calculating commission on new policy sales. Represents the present value of future profits attributable to new business production tied to this payment. Used for production reporting and commission schedule application.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944-40 — Insurance Acquisition Costs; IFRS 17 — Insurance Contracts; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount disbursed to the payee after deducting federal and state tax withholding from the gross payment amount. This is the amount that appears on the remittance advice and is transferred via ACH, check, or wire.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: override_level
attributes.description: Hierarchy level at which this payment is being made within the agent distribution hierarchy: 'direct' (writing agent), 'ga' (General Agent override), 'mga' (Managing General Agent override), 'bga' (Brokerage General Agent override), 'corporate' (corporate entity or home office override). Supports multi-level commission payout calculations.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the commission disbursement was released to the payee. Used for 1099 tax year assignment, cash flow reporting, and payment reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-A; IRS Form 1099-NEC; SOX Section 404 — Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The disbursement instrument used to transfer funds to the payee: 'ACH' (Automated Clearing House electronic transfer), 'check' (physical check mailed to payee), 'wire' (domestic or international wire transfer for large or international payments).
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules and Guidelines; Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable payment reference number assigned by the commission system (e.g., PAY-0000123456). Used on remittance advices, commission statements, and 1099 tax reporting reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module; IRS Form 1099-NEC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission payment disbursement: 'pending' (scheduled but not yet released), 'processed' (submitted to payment processor), 'paid' (confirmed settled to payee), 'reversed' (payment recalled or reversed), 'voided' (cancelled before processing), 'on_hold' (suspended pending dispute or compliance review).
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Discriminator classifying the nature of the compensation disbursement: 'commission' for standard first-year (FYC) or renewal commissions, 'bonus' for program-based bonus awards, 'incentive' for sales contest or incentive awards, 'persistency' for persistency credits on in-force policies, 'service_fee' for administrative service fee payments.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Payment Processing Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation Disclosure

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the commission earning period covered by this payment. Together with payment_period_start_date, defines the full earning window for reconciliation against commission_transaction records.

products.name: chargeback
products.description: Transactional and reference entity managing commission recapture events and the rules governing them. Transaction records capture chargebacks triggered by policy lapse, surrender, not-taken, or early termination — including original commission transaction reference, chargeback amount, reason code (lapse, surrender, NTO, rescission), chargeback period remaining, recovery method (deduction from future commissions or direct repayment), and resolution status. Rule records define chargeback parameters by product type, distribution channel, and policy duration — specifying chargeback period length (months), recapture percentage schedule by policy month, minimum premium threshold, and applicable distribution tiers. Uses record_type discriminator to distinguish transaction vs rule entries. Critical for managing FYC recapture on early-lapse policies. Sourced from Sapiens Commission / Annocera rules engine and chargeback processing module.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The net dollar amount to be recaptured from the agent based on the applicable recapture percentage schedule and the policy duration at time of lapse or surrender. This is the primary monetary fact of the chargeback transaction.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; GAAP ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the commission operations manager or supervisor who approved the chargeback initiation, waiver, or write-off decision. Supports SOX audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: chargeback_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the chargeback event or rule by the commission system. Used in agent statements, dispute correspondence, and 1099 reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: chargeback_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the chargeback record: pending (initiated, not yet in recovery), in_recovery (deductions or repayments in progress), recovered (fully recaptured), waived (management decision to forgive), disputed (agent has filed a dispute), written_off (deemed unrecoverable).
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; NAIC

attributes.name: commission_paid_date
attributes.description: The date on which the original commission subject to chargeback was disbursed to the agent. Used for aging analysis and DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) accounting.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; GAAP ASC 944 DAC

attributes.name: commission_type
attributes.description: Identifies the type of commission being recaptured: FYC (First-Year Commission), renewal, override (hierarchy-level override commission), or bonus. Critical for FYC recapture tracking on early-lapse policies.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; NAIC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this chargeback record was first created in the commission system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this chargeback record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution.

attributes.name: dac_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) asset adjustment triggered by the chargeback event. When a policy lapses and commission is recaptured, the corresponding DAC balance must be reversed for GAAP and SAP reporting.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has formally disputed the chargeback. When True, the chargeback is placed in a disputed state pending review and resolution by the commission operations team.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the agent's stated reason for disputing the chargeback (e.g., policy reinstated, incorrect trigger date, rule misapplication). Populated only when dispute_flag is True.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which the policy was sold (e.g., career agent, brokerage, BGA, MGA, direct, bank). Chargeback period length and recapture percentage schedules vary by channel.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC

attributes.name: distribution_tier
attributes.description: The distribution tier classification of the agent or agency (e.g., Tier 1 top producer, Tier 4 standard). Chargeback rules and recapture schedules may vary by distribution tier as part of producer incentive agreements.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC Producer Licensing

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the chargeback rule or transaction record is effective. For rule records, this is the date the rule parameters became active. For transaction records, this aligns with the trigger event date.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Rules Engine; NAIC

attributes.name: expected_recovery_date
attributes.description: The projected date by which the full chargeback amount is expected to be recovered, based on the recovery method and scheduled deduction plan. Used for cash flow forecasting and accounts receivable aging.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the chargeback rule record expires and is no longer applicable to new transactions. Null for open-ended rules. Supports rule versioning and temporal validity management.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The level in the agent distribution hierarchy at which the chargeback applies: writing agent, GA (General Agent), MGA (Managing General Agent), BGA (Brokerage General Agency), or carrier. Supports multi-level chargeback payout calculations.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: The date on which the chargeback was formally initiated in the commission system following detection of the trigger event. Marks the start of the recovery process.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: minimum_premium_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum annualized or modal premium amount required for the chargeback rule to apply. Policies with premiums below this threshold may be exempt from chargeback. Applies primarily to rule records.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Rules Engine; NAIC

attributes.name: nbv_impact_amount
attributes.description: The estimated impact of the chargeback on the New Business Value (NBV) metric for the associated policy sale. Used in sales performance reporting and agent scorecard analytics tied to NBV and policy sales.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera; IFRS 17; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: original_commission_amount
attributes.description: The gross commission amount originally paid to the agent for the policy that is now subject to chargeback. Denominated in USD. Serves as the basis for calculating the recapture amount.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Calculation Module; GAAP ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: The remaining dollar amount of the chargeback not yet recovered (chargeback_amount minus recovered_amount). Drives accounts receivable reporting and agent balance management.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; GAAP ASC 944; SAP

attributes.name: period_months
attributes.description: The total number of months during which a commission is subject to chargeback recapture per the applicable rule. Typically 12–24 months for FYC on life products. Applies to rule records; populated on transaction records from the governing rule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Rules Engine; NAIC

attributes.name: period_remaining_months
attributes.description: The number of months remaining in the chargeback period at the time the trigger event occurred. Used to calculate the recapture amount and schedule recovery deductions.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: policy_duration_months
attributes.description: The number of months the policy had been in force at the time the chargeback trigger event occurred. Used to look up the applicable recapture percentage from the chargeback rule schedule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: policy_issue_date
attributes.description: The date the underlying insurance policy was issued and placed in force. Used to calculate policy duration at trigger and validate chargeback period applicability.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System (FAST; Sapiens LifePro); NAIC

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance or annuity product associated with the chargeback (e.g., Whole Life, Term, Universal Life, Fixed Indexed Annuity). Determines which chargeback rule schedule applies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|Term|UL|IUL|VUL|FIA|SPIA|DI|LTC|Annuity — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: recapture_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the original commission to be recaptured, determined by the chargeback rule schedule based on the policy duration month at time of trigger event. For example, a policy lapsing in month 6 may have a 75% recapture rate.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Rules Engine; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: recapture_schedule
attributes.description: Serialized representation of the month-by-month recapture percentage schedule (e.g., '100,100,75,75,50,50,25,25,0,0,0,0' for a 12-month schedule). Applies to rule records. Defines the declining recapture rate as policy duration increases.

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator field distinguishing between a chargeback transaction event (recapture of previously paid commission) and a chargeback rule record (parameters governing recapture logic). Drives downstream processing and reporting branching.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: recovered_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative dollar amount of the chargeback that has been successfully recaptured to date through commission deductions or direct repayment. Used to track recovery progress against the total chargeback amount.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which the chargeback amount will be recaptured: commission_deduction (withheld from future commission payments), direct_repayment (agent remits payment directly), offset (netted against other payables), or write_off (deemed unrecoverable and expensed).
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the chargeback was fully resolved — either through complete recovery, waiver, write-off, or dispute settlement. Null if still open.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this chargeback record was sourced (e.g., Sapiens Commission, Annocera, manual entry, policy administration system). Supports data lineage and ETL audit.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

attributes.name: trigger_event_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the triggering business event (lapse, surrender, NTO, rescission) occurred on the policy. This is the principal real-world event date driving the chargeback calculation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; Policy Administration System

attributes.name: trigger_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business event that triggered the chargeback: lapse (policy lapsed for non-payment), surrender (policyholder surrendered the policy), NTO (not-taken, policy returned during free-look), rescission (policy voided), death (death claim within chargeback period), or maturity.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; NAIC Model Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this chargeback record (e.g., status change, recovery posting, dispute filing). Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chargeback has been formally waived by management (e.g., due to agent hardship, policy reinstatement, or contractual exception). When True, no further recovery action is taken.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module; NAIC

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Description of the business justification for waiving the chargeback (e.g., policy reinstated within grace period, agent deceased, contractual exception). Populated only when waiver_flag is True.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Chargeback Processing Module

Specifies chargeback period length (months), recapture percentage schedule by policy month, minimum premium threshold, and applicable distribution tiers. Governs when and how much commission is recaptured upon early policy termination. Managed within Sapiens Commission / Annocera rules engine.

The chargeback_rule has state_jurisdiction (plain attr, denorm

attributes.description: Reference to the chargeback_rule_id of the newer rule that replaced this rule when it was superseded. Enables forward-chaining of rule version history for audit and compliance purposes. NULL if this rule has not been superseded.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this chargeback rule received final business approval and was authorized for activation in the commission rules engine.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of this chargeback rule within the commission governance process. Rules must be approved before activation. 'under_review' indicates the rule is being evaluated by compliance or actuarial teams.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the business owner or compliance officer who approved this chargeback rule for activation. Required for SOX audit trail and commission governance documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: chargeback_period_months
attributes.description: Total number of policy months during which a commission chargeback may be triggered upon early policy termination or lapse. After this period expires, no commission recapture is applied. Typically ranges from 12 to 36 months for life products.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission Rules Engine

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this chargeback rule record was first created in the commission management system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and NAIC market conduct standards.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Standards; FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary thresholds and amounts defined in this chargeback rule (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international life insurance products.

attributes.name: dac_impact_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) Impact Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether commission chargebacks under this rule affect the Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) balance recorded in the general ledger. True = DAC amortization schedule is adjusted upon chargeback processing.

attributes.description: Indicates whether policies terminated due to insured death are exempt from commission chargeback under this rule. True = death-triggered terminations do not trigger recapture. Standard industry practice to exempt death claims.

attributes.name: disability_waiver_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether policies terminated due to activation of a disability waiver of premium (AWL) rider are exempt from commission chargeback. True = AWL-triggered terminations are excluded from recapture.

attributes.name: distribution_tier
attributes.description: Specific tier or level within the distribution channel hierarchy to which this rule applies (e.g., Tier 1 BGA, Tier 2 MGA, Standard Agent). Enables differentiated chargeback schedules for high-volume or preferred distribution partners. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tier_1|tier_2|tier_3|standard|preferred|elite — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this chargeback rule is effective and applicable to new policy terminations. Policies issued on or after this date are subject to this rule's recapture schedule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: exchange_1035_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether policies terminated via a tax-free 1035 Exchange to another policy within the same carrier are exempt from commission chargeback. True = internal 1035 exchanges do not trigger recapture.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1035; IRS Tax Compliance; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this chargeback rule is no longer applicable to new policy terminations. NULL indicates the rule has no defined end date and remains active until explicitly superseded or deactivated.

attributes.name: free_look_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether policies terminated during the state-mandated free-look period (typically 10–30 days) are exempt from commission chargeback under this rule. True = free-look terminations are excluded from recapture.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Free Look Regulation; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: fyc_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of First-Year Commission (FYC) that can be recaptured upon policy termination within the chargeback period. Represents the starting recapture rate at policy month 1 before any earned-down schedule is applied.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera

attributes.name: hierarchy_level_scope
attributes.description: Specifies which levels of the agent commission hierarchy are subject to chargeback under this rule. 'writing_agent' recaptures only from the producing agent; 'all_levels' recaptures proportionally across the full hierarchy including GA, MGA, and BGA overrides.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Hierarchy Management Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: installment_recapture_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the chargeback amount may be recovered from the agent in installments (deducted from future commission payments) rather than as a single lump-sum deduction. True = installment recovery is permitted under this rule.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: max_chargeback_amount
attributes.description: Absolute dollar cap on the commission amount that can be recaptured under this rule for a single policy termination event. Prevents disproportionate recapture on high-face-value policies. NULL indicates no cap applies.

attributes.name: max_installment_months

attributes.name: min_premium_threshold

attributes.name: override_recapture_pct

attributes.name: policy_month_12_recapture_pct

attributes.name: policy_month_1_recapture_pct

attributes.name: policy_month_24_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates at or around policy month 24. Represents the renewal commission recapture rate at the end of the second policy year.

attributes.name: policy_month_36_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates at or around policy month 36. Typically the final step in a 36-month chargeback schedule; after this point no recapture applies.

attributes.name: policy_month_6_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates at or around policy month 6. Represents an intermediate point in the earned-down schedule.

attributes.name: product_type_code
attributes.description: Insurance product type to which this chargeback rule applies (e.g., WL — Whole Life, UL — Universal Life, IUL — Indexed Universal Life, VUL — Variable Universal Life, Term, FIA — Fixed Indexed Annuity, SPIA — Single Premium Immediate Annuity, DI — Disability Income, LTC — Long-Term Care). attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing Standards; IRC Section 7702; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: recapture_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the declining recapture percentage over the chargeback period. 'straight_line' reduces recapture evenly each month; 'step_down' applies tiered reductions at defined intervals; 'pro_rata' is proportional to remaining period; 'flat' applies a constant rate; 'custom_schedule' references a separate recapture schedule table.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: renewal_recapture_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of renewal commissions that can be recaptured upon early policy termination within the chargeback period. Renewal recapture schedules are typically less aggressive than FYC recapture.

attributes.name: rule_code

attributes.name: rule_description

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the chargeback rule (e.g., 'Term Life 24-Month FYC Recapture — BGA Tier'). Used in commission statements and agent communications.

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the chargeback rule within the rules engine. 'active' rules are applied to new policy terminations; 'superseded' rules remain for historical recapture calculations on in-force policies.

attributes.name: source_rule_reference
attributes.description: Native rule identifier or reference key from the originating commission management system (Sapiens Commission / Annocera). Enables traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer record and the operational system rule definition.

attributes.name: termination_reason_scope

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this chargeback rule, incremented each time the rule is modified and re-approved. Enables historical tracking of rule changes and ensures correct rule version is applied to policies issued under prior schedules.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Rules Engine; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Hierarchy Management Module

attributes.name: is_stackable
attributes.description: Indicates whether bonuses earned under this program can be combined (stacked) with bonuses from other active programs for the same agent during the same qualification period. False means the program is mutually exclusive with other programs.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: is_tiered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bonus program uses a tiered payout structure where higher production levels earn progressively higher bonus rates or amounts. When True, tier details are stored in the associated bonus_program_tier child entity.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: max_bonus_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total bonus payout amount an individual agent or broker may earn under this program during the qualification period, regardless of production achieved. Null if no cap applies.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041 (1099 Reporting); Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: min_agent_tenure_months
attributes.description: Minimum number of months an agent must have been actively contracted with the company to be eligible to participate in this bonus program. Zero means no tenure requirement.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Agent Licensing Module

attributes.name: min_production_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum qualifying production amount (in APE, NBV, or premium dollars) an agent must achieve during the qualification period to become eligible for any bonus payout under this program.
attributes.references: APE (Annual Premium Equivalent); NBV (New Business Value); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date on which earned bonus amounts are disbursed to qualifying agents or brokers following the close of the qualification period.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041 (1099 Reporting); NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: persistency_measurement_months
attributes.description: Number of months over which policy persistency is measured to determine eligibility for a persistency bonus. Typically 12 or 13 months per NAIC persistency reporting conventions.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: persistency_rate_required
attributes.description: Minimum policy persistency rate (as a percentage) an agent must maintain during the qualification period to remain eligible for a persistency bonus. Applicable when program_type is 'persistency_bonus'. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 85.00 = 85%).
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the bonus program, used in commission statements, bordereaux reporting, and agent communications (e.g., 'PROD-BONUS-2024', 'PERSIST-Q1-2024').
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the bonus program's objectives, eligibility rules, qualification criteria, and payout mechanics as communicated to agents and distribution management.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the bonus or incentive program as displayed to agents, brokers, and distribution management (e.g., 'Q1 2024 Production Bonus', 'Annual Persistency Award', 'NBV Champions Contest').
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the bonus program: draft (being configured), active (open for qualification), suspended (temporarily halted), closed (no new qualifications accepted), expired (past effective period).
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bonus program by its incentive purpose: production_bonus (volume-based), persistency_bonus (policy retention), nbv_bonus (New Business Value target), sales_contest (time-limited competition), recruiting_bonus (agent recruitment), conservation_bonus (lapse prevention). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production_bonus|persistency_bonus|nbv_bonus|sales_contest|recruiting_bonus|conservation_bonus — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: program_version
attributes.description: Version number of the bonus program definition, incremented each time material changes are made to eligibility criteria, payout structure, or thresholds. Supports audit trail and historical comparison of program terms.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Section 404; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: qualification_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the measurement window during which agent production, persistency, or NBV activity is tracked for bonus qualification purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: qualification_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the measurement window during which agent production, persistency, or NBV activity is tracked for bonus qualification purposes. May differ from the program effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this bonus program record was sourced (e.g., 'SAPIENS_COMM', 'ANNOCERA'). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; ETL (Extract Transform Load) Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system_program_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this bonus program record in the originating operational system (Sapiens Commission or Annocera). Enables reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; ETL (Extract Transform Load) Best Practices; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: state_availability
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of US state codes (e.g., 'CA,TX,NY,FL') where this bonus program is available to agents. 'ALL' indicates nationwide availability. Supports state-level regulatory compliance for producer compensation disclosures.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State Departments of Insurance (all 50 US states); NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: target_product_line
attributes.description: The insurance product line(s) whose sales count toward qualification for this bonus program (e.g., 'WL', 'UL', 'IUL', 'FIA', 'Term', 'Annuity', 'All'). Multiple values may be stored as a delimited string. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|FIA|SPIA|Term|DI|LTC|Annuity|All — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WL (Whole Life); UL (Universal Life); IUL (Indexed Universal Life); FIA (Fixed Indexed Annuity); SPIA (Single Premium Immediate Annuity); NAIC Product Filing Standards

attributes.name: tax_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether bonus payments under this program must be reported on IRS Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC for independent contractor agents. True for cash bonuses; may be False for non-cash awards below IRS de minimis thresholds.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041; IRS Form 1099-MISC; IRS Form 1099-NEC; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Commission Calculation Module

attributes.name: threshold_basis
attributes.description: The unit of measure used to evaluate whether an agent has met the minimum production threshold: ape (Annual Premium Equivalent), nbv (New Business Value), premium (collected premium dollars), policy_count (number of issued policies), face_amount (total face amount of issued policies).
attributes.references: APE (Annual Premium Equivalent); NBV (New Business Value); ACORD Data Standards; Sapiens Commission / Annocera Incentive Tracking Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this bonus program record in the system of record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

products.name: bonus_qualification
products.description: Transactional record tracking an agent's progress toward bonus program qualification thresholds during a qualification period. Captures cumulative APE, policy count, NBV, persistency rate, and qualification status (in-progress, qualified, disqualified) per bonus program per agent per period. Enables real-time incentive tracking and agent motivation reporting.

attributes.name: bonus_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each bonus qualification tracking record. Primary key for the bonus_qualification data product.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: bonus_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific bonus or incentive program for which qualification is being tracked (e.g., annual sales contest, quarterly production bonus, convention qualifier).
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera) — incentive tracking module

attributes.name: compensation_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commission.compensation_contract.
