Cancelled and on_hold are terminal or paused states requiring manual intervention. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in_progress|completed|failed|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commission processing cycle indicating its business purpose. Regular runs are scheduled periodic cycles; off-cycle runs are unscheduled; adjustment runs correct prior period errors; reversal runs undo a prior run; bonus runs process incentive payouts; supplemental runs handle additional payments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular|off_cycle|adjustment|reversal|bonus|supplemental — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Model Regulation on Producer Compensation

attributes.name: scheduled_run_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this commission run was originally scheduled to execute. Used for SLA tracking, run calendar management, and reconciliation against actual execution date.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this commission run record. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and reconciliation between source systems.
attributes.references: ACORD Life and Annuity Data Standards; SOX Section 404 Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_run_ref
attributes.description: The native run identifier or batch reference number assigned by the originating source system (Sapiens Commission or Annocera). Enables direct traceability back to the operational system record for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; SOX Section 404 Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The IRS tax year (YYYY) to which commission payments in this run are attributed for 1099-NEC reporting purposes. Critical for year-end tax reporting reconciliation and FinCEN AML compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Publication 15; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: total_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The net sum of all manual corrections, dispute resolutions, and prior-period adjustments applied in this commission run. May be positive (additional payment) or negative (reduction). Distinct from chargebacks which are rule-driven recaptures.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: total_chargeback_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate amount of commission chargebacks applied in this run due to policy lapses, surrenders, cancellations, or other recapture events. Reduces gross commission to arrive at net payable.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: total_tax_withheld_amount
attributes.description: The aggregate federal and state income tax withheld from agent commission payments in this run, applicable for agents subject to backup withholding. Required for IRS 1099 tax reporting reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 — Employer's Tax Guide; IRS Form 1099-NEC; FinCEN AML/BSA Compliance

attributes.name: transactions_generated_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual commission transaction records created by this run, including first-year commissions (FYC), renewals, overrides, and service fees. Used for run output validation and downstream reconciliation.
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this commission run record was most recently modified. Tracks status transitions, corrections, and any updates to run metadata for audit and change management purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: warning_count
attributes.description: The total number of warning conditions flagged during this commission run that did not prevent processing but require review (e.g., missing licensing data, rate schedule gaps, hierarchy mismatches).
attributes.references: Sapiens Commission / Annocera — Commission Run Module; NAIC Producer Licensing Standards

products.name: payee
products.description: Master entity representing all commission payees — individual agents, brokers, BGAs, MGAs, GAs, RIAs, TPAs, broker-dealers, and corporate entities — eligible to receive commission and fee payments. Captures payee legal name, payee type (individual, corporation, partnership, LLC), TIN/SSN, banking details (ACH routing/account number), payment preference (ACH, check, wire), W-9 certification status, backup withholding flag, 1099 reporting classification, and payee active/inactive status. This is the financial disbursement identity — distinct from the agent domain's agent record which owns licensing, appointment, and hierarchy data. Cross-referenced to agent domain via agent identifier for operational linkage.

attributes.name: payee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the commission payee record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the payee master entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.agency. Business justification: In life insurance, commissions are frequently paid to agency entities rather than individual producers. A payee can represent an agency (not just a producer). Linking payee to agency enables agency-le

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier linking this payee to the corresponding agent record in the agent domain. Enables operational linkage between the financial disbursement identity (payee) and the licensing/appointment/hierarchy record (agent). Nullable for non-agent payees such as corporate BGAs or TPAs with no direct agent record.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Producer Licensing Model

attributes.name: w9_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Payee has w9_certified and w9_certification_date fields requiring the actual W-9/W-8 document on file. IRS backup withholding rules and FINRA recordkeeping require insurers to retain and reference the

attributes.name: ach_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number at the payee's financial institution for ACH direct deposit of commission payments. Required when payment_method is ACH. May be checking or savings account. Stored in encrypted/tokenized form per PCI DSS requirements. Only the last four digits are displayed in operational interfaces.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; PCI DSS v4.0; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements

attributes.name: ach_account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account used for ACH commission payment deposits. Checking accounts are most common for business payees; savings accounts may be used by individual agents. Required for ACH payment file generation per NACHA formatting standards.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: ach_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing transit number identifying the payee's financial institution for ACH direct deposit of commission payments. Required when payment_method is ACH. Validated against the Federal Reserve's routing number database. Stored in encrypted form per PCI DSS requirements.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ABA Routing Number Standard; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: advance_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee is eligible to receive commission advances — upfront payment of future expected commissions against new business production. Eligibility is typically based on production history, chargeback record, and contractual agreement. When True, the commission system may process advance payments subject to advance repayment tracking.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); NAIC Producer Licensing Model

attributes.name: advance_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding commission advance balance permitted for this payee at any point in time. Expressed in the payee's payment currency. Enforced by the commission management system to limit financial exposure from advance chargebacks. Null if advance_eligible is False.
attributes.references: Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera); SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: backup_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee is subject to mandatory IRS backup withholding on commission payments. Set to True when the IRS notifies the company of a TIN mismatch, when the payee fails to certify their TIN on Form W-9, or when the payee has underreported income. When True, the payment processing system must withhold the statutory backup withholding rate from all reportable payments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 3406; IRS Publication 1281; IRS CP2100 Notice

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution where the payee holds the account designated for commission payment deposits. Used for payment reconciliation, remittance advice generation, and ACH return resolution. Stored for operational reference alongside the routing and account numbers.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: commission_statement_delivery
attributes.description: Payee's preferred delivery method for periodic commission statements. Electronic = PDF delivered via secure portal or email; Paper = printed statement mailed to mailing address; Both = electronic and paper. Drives statement generation and distribution workflows in the commission management system.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: crd_number
attributes.description: FINRA-assigned Central Registration Depository (CRD) number for payees who are registered representatives or broker-dealers selling variable life insurance or variable annuity products. Required for FINRA regulatory reporting and suitability compliance for variable product commissions.
attributes.references: FINRA Rules; SEC Regulation Best Interest (Reg BI); FINRA BrokerCheck

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payee record was first created in the commission management system. Represents the business onboarding event time, not the ETL load time. Used for audit trail, compliance reporting, and payee lifecycle analytics.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the payee operates, if different from the legal name. Common for BGAs, MGAs, and GAs operating under a brand name distinct from their legal entity name. Used on commission statements and correspondence.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model; State Department of Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee record became active and eligible to receive commission payments. Typically corresponds to the date the payee's contract with the company was executed and all onboarding requirements (W-9, KYC, banking) were satisfied.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Producer Licensing Model; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the payee used for electronic commission statement delivery, payment notifications, W-9 re-certification requests, and compliance communications. For entity payees, this is typically the accounts payable or finance contact email.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; GDPR Article 4 (if applicable); CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Position of the payee within the multi-level commission hierarchy used for override commission calculations. Determines eligibility for first-year commission (FYC), renewal commissions, and hierarchy-based override payments. Writing Agent = direct producer; Field Manager = first-level override; Regional Manager = second-level override; BGA/MGA = wholesale distribution override levels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: writing_agent|field_manager|regional_manager|bga|mga|home_office|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Producer Licensing Model; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: kyc_status
attributes.description: Current Know Your Customer (KYC) verification status for the payee as required by FinCEN AML/BSA regulations. Verified = identity confirmed and AML screening passed; Pending = verification in progress; Failed = identity verification or AML screening failed, payments blocked; Exempt = entity type exempt from KYC requirements (e.g., publicly traded corporations). Payments must not be processed to payees with Failed KYC status.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; USA PATRIOT Act Section 326; NAIC AML Model Regulation

attributes.name: kyc_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee's KYC identity verification and AML screening was most recently completed and approved. Used to determine KYC currency and trigger periodic re-verification workflows per the company's AML compliance program.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; USA PATRIOT Act; NAIC AML Model Regulation

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the payee as registered with the IRS and state authorities. For individuals, this is the name on the W-9 form. For entities, this is the registered business name. Used for 1099 tax reporting, ACH payment files, and check issuance. Must match the name associated with the TIN on file.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRS Publication 1220; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements

attributes.name: license_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which the payee holds their primary insurance producer license. Used to validate appointment status and commission payment eligibility per state-specific insurance regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model; State Department of Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for mailing commission checks, 1099 tax forms, and commission statements to the payee. For individuals, this is typically a home or office address. For entities, this is the registered business address.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220 (1099 mailing requirements); USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, apartment, unit, floor, or PO Box information for the payee's mailing address. Optional field used when the primary address line is insufficient to fully specify the delivery location.

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City component of the payee's mailing address. Used for check mailing, 1099 form delivery, and commission statement distribution.

attributes.name: mailing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the payee's mailing address. Defaults to USA for domestic payees. Required for international wire transfer payees and cross-border distribution arrangements. Drives FATCA and FBAR reporting obligations for foreign payees.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IRS FATCA (IRC Section 1471-1474); FinCEN FBAR Requirements

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the payee's mailing address. Used for check delivery, 1099 form mailing, and geographic analytics on distribution channel coverage.

attributes.name: mailing_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the payee's mailing address. Used for state income tax withholding determination, state-level 1099 reporting, and compliance with state Department of Insurance requirements.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; NAIC State Reporting Requirements; IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: npn
attributes.description: NAIC-assigned National Producer Number (NPN) uniquely identifying the payee as an insurance producer across all US states. Used for cross-state license verification via the NAIC NIPR database, appointment validation, and regulatory reporting. Mandatory for all licensed producer payees.
attributes.references: NAIC National Producer Number (NPN) Standard; NAIC NIPR Database; State Department of Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: ofac_last_screened_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee was most recently screened against OFAC sanctions lists. Used to enforce periodic re-screening requirements and ensure ongoing compliance with US sanctions regulations before each payment run.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; 31 CFR Part 501

attributes.name: ofac_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee has been screened against the OFAC (Office of Foreign Assets Control) Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list and other sanctions lists. Must be True before any commission payment is disbursed. Payments to OFAC-listed entities are prohibited by US law.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List; USA PATRIOT Act; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements; 31 CFR Part 501

attributes.name: payee_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier assigned to the payee by the Agent and Commission Management System (e.g., Sapiens Commission, Annocera). Used on commission statements, 1099 forms, and payment remittance advices to uniquely identify the payee across operational systems.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; IRS Publication 1220 (1099 Reporting)

attributes.name: payee_role
attributes.description: Distribution channel role of the payee within the life insurance and annuity sales ecosystem. Drives commission schedule selection, hierarchy override eligibility, and regulatory reporting. BGA = Brokerage General Agency; MGA = Managing General Agent; GA = General Agent; RIA = Registered Investment Advisor; TPA = Third Party Administrator. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: agent|broker|bga|mga|ga|ria|tpa|broker_dealer|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model; FINRA Rules (for broker-dealers); DOL ERISA Fiduciary Standards

attributes.name: payee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payee record in the commission management system. Active = eligible to receive commission payments; Inactive = no current production but record retained; Suspended = payments on hold pending investigation or compliance review; Pending = onboarding in progress, W-9 or banking not yet verified; Terminated = permanently closed, no further payments.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model; SOX Internal Controls; FinCEN AML/BSA Requirements

attributes.name: payee_type
attributes.description: Legal entity classification of the payee for tax reporting and payment processing purposes. Determines W-9 federal tax classification, 1099 reporting obligations, and backup withholding rules. Individual = natural person agent/broker; Corporation = incorporated entity; Partnership = general or limited partnership; LLC = limited liability company; Trust = ILIT or other trust entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|corporation|partnership|llc|trust|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRC Section 3406 (Backup Withholding); IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for commission payment disbursements to this payee. Defaults to USD for domestic US payees. May be CAD or other currencies for cross-border distribution arrangements. Drives currency conversion logic in the commission payment run.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred method for disbursing commission payments to this payee. ACH = Automated Clearing House electronic funds transfer (most common); Check = paper check mailed to payee address; Wire = domestic or international wire transfer for large or international payees. Drives payment run processing logic in the commission management system.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules (ACH); Federal Reserve Regulation J (Wire); ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the payee. Used for payment issue resolution, W-9 certification follow-up, and commission dispute communications. For entity payees, this is the main business phone number.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this payee record was sourced (e.g., Sapiens Commission, Annocera, Salesforce Financial Services Cloud). Used for data lineage tracking, ETL reconciliation, and issue resolution in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; SOX Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: Native primary key or unique identifier of this payee record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., Sapiens Commission internal payee ID, Annocera agent code). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the source system for reconciliation and issue resolution.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; SOX Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: Primary state insurance producer license number for the payee. For individual agents and brokers, this is the license number in their primary state of appointment. For entity payees (BGAs, MGAs), this is the entity license number. Used to validate commission payment eligibility — commissions may only be paid to licensed producers per state insurance regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model; State Department of Insurance Requirements; NAIC NIPR Database

attributes.name: tax_classification_1099
attributes.description: IRS 1099 form type classification for annual tax reporting of commission and fee payments to this payee. 1099-NEC = non-employee compensation for individual agents/brokers; 1099-MISC = miscellaneous income for certain entity payees; 1099-R = distributions from retirement/annuity contracts; Exempt = corporations exempt from 1099 reporting per IRS rules; Not Reportable = payments below IRS reporting threshold or otherwise excluded.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRC Section 6041; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Form 1099-MISC

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee's commission payment eligibility was terminated. Null for active payees. After this date, no new commission payments are processed except for renewal commissions or chargebacks governed by the payee's contract terms. Used in conjunction with payee_status to manage the full payee lifecycle.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Producer Licensing Model; State Department of Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: IRS-issued Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) used for 1099 tax reporting and backup withholding determination. For individuals, this is the Social Security Number (SSN); for entities, this is the Employer Identification Number (EIN). Stored in masked or encrypted form per PCI/PII data protection requirements. Must match the name on the W-9 certification.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRC Section 3406; IRS Publication 1220; FinCEN AML/BSA; HIPAA (if applicable)

attributes.name: tin_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the TIN on file is a Social Security Number (SSN) for individual payees or an Employer Identification Number (EIN) for entity payees. Drives IRS 1099 form type selection (1099-NEC vs 1099-MISC) and backup withholding logic.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRS Publication 1220; IRC Section 3406

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the payee record in the commission management system. Tracks changes to banking details, W-9 status, KYC status, payment preferences, or any other payee attributes. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the lakehouse ETL pipeline and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Data Model

attributes.name: w9_certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee's most recent IRS Form W-9 was signed and certified. Used to determine W-9 currency and trigger re-certification workflows when the form is stale or when payee information changes (e.g., name change, TIN change).
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRS Publication 1281; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: w9_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee has submitted a valid, signed IRS Form W-9 certifying their TIN and federal tax classification. Payments to payees without a certified W-9 are subject to mandatory backup withholding at the IRS-prescribed rate. Required before any commission disbursement can be processed.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-9; IRC Section 3406 (Backup Withholding); IRS Publication 1281

products.name: compensation_contract
products.description: Master record of the formal compensation agreement between the insurer and a distribution entity (agent, BGA, MGA, GA, broker-dealer). Captures contract type, contracted commission schedule references, override entitlements, bonus program eligibility, chargeback terms, advance provisions, effective date, termination date, and contract status. Serves as the authoritative agreement governing all commission and compensation obligations for a distribution relationship.

attributes.name: compensation_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the compensation contract record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.agency. Business justification: Agencies have their own compensation contracts with carriers governing override rates and agency-level compensation terms. A compensation_contract can belong to an agency entity (not just an individua

attributes.name: agency_producer_affiliation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.agency_producer_affiliation. Business justification: Agency-producer affiliation arrangements often have distinct compensation contracts governing split percentages and agency override terms. Linking compensation_contract to agency_producer_affiliation

attributes.name: bonus_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific bonus or incentive program applicable to this compensation contract. Governs production thresholds, qualification periods, and bonus payout structures.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; IRC Section 6041; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: chargeback_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chargeback rule set governing recapture of commissions paid under this contract in the event of policy lapse, surrender, or early termination.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: contract_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Compensation contracts are legal agreements requiring signature workflow, version control, legal hold capability, and long-term retention. Real business process: contract execution, e-signature captur

attributes.name: contracting_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agent.contracting. Business justification: Compensation contracts define commission terms for producer contracting agreements. Business requires linking contract_number across domains for commission dispute resolution, contract amendment track

attributes.name: jurisdiction_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction_license. Business justification: Compensation contracts are state-specific and can only be executed in jurisdictions where the insurer holds a valid license. Compliance teams validate compensation contracts against jurisdiction licen

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Compensation contracts are legal agreements between a producer and a specific issuing legal entity, determining the tax reporting entity for 1099 issuance, intercompany commission allocation, and regu

attributes.name: payee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to commission.payee. Business justification: A compensation_contract is a formal agreement between the insurer and a distribution entity. payee is the commission-domain master representing all such distribution entities as payees. compensation_c

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Contracts specify product line eligibility; product_line exists but plan_id FK enables granular product authorization validation, product-specific contract term application, and agent product appointm

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Compensation contracts specify commission terms for specific product versions. When a plan_version is released or retired, new compensation contracts are executed. Linking enables producer compensatio

attributes.name: producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution entity (agent, broker, BGA, MGA, GA, or broker-dealer) that is the primary counterparty to this compensation contract.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Compensation contracts are subject to specific regulatory obligations including FINRA disclosure rules, state producer compensation disclosure requirements, and DOL fiduciary standards. Compliance tea

attributes.name: schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission schedule that governs the base compensation rates applicable under this contract.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: separate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.separate_account. Business justification: Compensation contracts for variable annuity producers are scoped to eligible separate account fund families (e.g., proprietary funds only). This link supports producer eligibility validation, FINRA ov

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Compensation contracts must comply with state-specific commission regulations including disclosure requirements and compensation caps. The state_code plain attribute is a denormalization of state_regu

attributes.name: superseded_by_contract_compensation_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the replacement compensation contract that supersedes this record upon amendment or renegotiation. Null if this is the current active version.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: advance_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contracted entity is eligible to receive commission advances (pre-payment of future earned commissions) under this contract.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: advance_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of earned first-year commission that may be advanced to the contracted entity prior to full earning. Governs the advance provision under this contract.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: advance_repayment_months
attributes.description: The number of months over which commission advances must be repaid through earned commission offsets under this contract.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: ape_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) production threshold that the contracted entity must achieve to qualify for enhanced commission rates, bonus programs, or override entitlements under this contract.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compensation contract received final internal approval and was authorized for commission processing.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The internal approval workflow status of the compensation contract. Contracts must be approved before commission calculations can be initiated.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: backup_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contracted entity is subject to IRS backup withholding on commission payments due to TIN mismatch, IRS notification, or failure to certify TIN.
attributes.references: IRC Section 3406; IRS Publication 1281; IRS Form W-9

attributes.name: bonus_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contracted entity is eligible to participate in bonus and incentive programs (e.g., production bonuses, persistency bonuses, Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) thresholds) under this contract.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; IRC Section 6041; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: chargeback_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months from policy issue date during which commissions paid under this contract are subject to chargeback recapture upon policy lapse or surrender.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: compensation_basis
attributes.description: The primary basis on which compensation is calculated under this contract. FYC (First-Year Commission) applies to new business; renewal applies to in-force policies; fee-based applies to service arrangements; hybrid combines multiple bases.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; IRC Section 6041; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the compensation contract as assigned by the Agent and Commission Management System. Used in correspondence, statements, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the compensation contract. Drives eligibility for commission calculation, payment processing, and chargeback enforcement.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution entity type that is party to this contract. Determines the applicable compensation structure and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: agent|bga|mga|ga|broker_dealer|tpa — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; ACORD Data Standards; FINRA Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compensation contract record was first created in the lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary compensation amounts under this contract are denominated.

attributes.name: dac_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether commissions paid under this contract qualify as Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC) for GAAP and statutory accounting purposes under FASB ASC 944.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; GAAP; SAP; LDTI; Actuarial Valuation System (AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The sales and distribution channel through which the contracted entity operates. Determines applicable commission schedules, override structures, and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: e_o_coverage_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contracted distribution entity is required to maintain active Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability insurance as a condition of this compensation contract.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State Departments of Insurance

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compensation contract becomes legally binding and commission obligations commence. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; IRC Section 6041 (1099 reporting); Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: finra_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether compensation paid under this contract is subject to FINRA reporting requirements, applicable for variable product (VUL, variable annuity) distribution arrangements.
attributes.references: FINRA Rules 2320 and 2341; SEC Regulation Best Interest; FINRA

attributes.name: fyc_rate
attributes.description: The contracted First-Year Commission (FYC) rate expressed as a percentage of target premium for new business written under this contract. Represents the primary compensation incentive for new policy sales.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; IRC Section 6041; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The level of the contracted entity within the agent distribution hierarchy. Governs override commission entitlements and multi-level payout calculations tied to New Business Value (NBV).
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: nbv_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether production under this compensation contract is included in New Business Value (NBV) calculations for actuarial and financial reporting purposes.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944; LDTI; IFRS 17; Actuarial Valuation System (AXIS; Prophet)

attributes.name: override_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compensation contract entitles the distribution entity to receive override commissions on downline production. True for BGA, MGA, GA, and supervising agent contracts.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: override_rate
attributes.description: The contracted override commission rate entitlement for this entity on production generated by downline agents. Applicable for BGA, MGA, GA, and supervising agent contracts.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: The contracted frequency at which commission payments are processed and disbursed to the distribution entity under this agreement.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The contracted method by which commission payments are disbursed to the distribution entity: ACH direct deposit, paper check, wire transfer, or offset against outstanding advances.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: The insurance product line(s) covered by this compensation contract. Determines which policy types generate commissions under this agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; ACORD Data Standards; IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: renewal_commission_rate
attributes.description: The contracted renewal commission rate expressed as a percentage of renewal premium for in-force policies beyond the first policy year. Incentivizes persistency and ongoing policy servicing.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; IRC Section 6041; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: source_contract_ref
attributes.description: The native contract identifier as recorded in the originating Agent and Commission Management System (e.g., Sapiens Commission or Annocera). Enables traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational source system from which this compensation contract record was ingested (e.g., SAPIENS_COMMISSION, ANNOCERA). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: tax_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether compensation paid under this contract is subject to IRS 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC reporting requirements. Drives annual tax reporting obligations.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041; IRS Publication 1220; IRS Form 1099-NEC

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compensation contract ends and commission obligations cease. Nullable for open-ended contracts. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for contract termination when the contract_status is terminated or expired. Drives chargeback enforcement, vesting forfeiture, and regulatory notification requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State Departments of Insurance; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of the contracted distribution entity as required for IRS 1099 tax reporting. May be an SSN for individual agents or EIN for business entities.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041; IRS Form W-9; IRS Publication 1220; FinCEN AML/BSA

attributes.name: tin_type
attributes.description: Identifies the type of Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) on file for the contracted entity: SSN (Social Security Number) for individuals, EIN for business entities, or ITIN for foreign individuals.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6041; IRS Form W-9; IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compensation contract record was last modified in the lakehouse. Supports change detection, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ACORD Data Standards; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the compensation contract, incremented each time material terms are amended. Supports contract amendment history and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

attributes.name: vesting_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months of continuous contract tenure required before renewal commissions and override entitlements become fully vested for the contracted entity.
attributes.references: ACORD Data Standards; Agent and Commission Management System (Sapiens Commission; Annocera)

domains.name: product
domains.description: SSOT for all life insurance and annuity product definitions — WL, UL, IUL, VUL, YRT, FIA, SPIA, GMAB/GMDB/GMIB/GMWB riders, and DI products. Owns product configuration, plan codes, benefit structures, premium rate tables, underwriting classes, IRC 7702 compliance parameters, product filing metadata, state approvals, product retirement schedules, and product profitability tracking. Governs the product catalog across all distribution channels.

products.name: plan
products.description: Master catalog of all life insurance and annuity product plans offered by the company — WL, UL, IUL, VUL, YRT, FIA, SPIA, GMAB/GMDB/GMIB/GMWB riders, and DI products. Defines the canonical product identity including plan code, product line, product family, insurance type, tax qualification status (IRC 7702 / MEC), minimum and maximum issue ages, face amount limits, underwriting class eligibility, distribution channel availability, product status (active, filed, retired), effective and expiration dates, and NAIC product type code. This is the SSOT for all product definitions across the enterprise.
products.reference: ACORD Life Product Catalog / NAIC Product Type Classification

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product plan. Primary key.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Products map to specific GL accounts for premium revenue recognition, reserve liability booking, and DAC asset capitalization. Required for automated journal entry generation, financial statement prep

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Products are issued by specific insurance carriers (legal entities). Essential for statutory reporting by NAIC company code, RBC calculations, and state regulatory filings. Every product must be owned

attributes.name: cash_value_option
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this product plan includes a cash value accumulation component. True for permanent life insurance and annuities; false for term life and pure protection products.

attributes.name: contestability_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years from policy issue during which the insurer can contest claims based on material misrepresentation in the application. Typically 2 years per state regulation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this product plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dac_amortization_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to amortize deferred acquisition costs for this product plan under GAAP and LDTI standards. Used in actuarial valuation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of distribution channels through which this product plan can be sold (e.g., career_agent, independent_broker, bank_channel, direct_to_consumer, worksite). Used in agent authorization and commission calculation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: career_agent|independent_broker|bank_channel|direct_to_consumer|worksite|bga|mga — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this product plan becomes available for sale and new business issuance. Used in policy administration and new business processing.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this product plan is no longer available for new business. Nullable for plans with no planned retirement date. Existing policies remain in force after this date.

attributes.name: free_look_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days after policy delivery during which the policyholder can cancel the policy for a full refund. Varies by state regulation, typically 10-30 days.

attributes.name: gpt_corridor_factor
attributes.description: The corridor factor used in the Guideline Premium Test calculation to ensure IRC 7702 compliance. Defines the minimum death benefit relative to cash value at each attained age.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days after a premium due date during which the policy remains in force without penalty. Typically 30-31 days per state regulation.

attributes.name: guaranteed_issue
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this product plan is available on a guaranteed issue basis without medical underwriting. Used in underwriting workbench and new business processing.

attributes.name: illustration_software_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the illustration software configuration used to generate policy illustrations for this product plan. Used in point-of-sale systems and agent tools.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Illustrations Model Regulation

attributes.name: insurance_type
attributes.description: The specific insurance product type code. WL (Whole Life), UL (Universal Life), IUL (Indexed Universal Life), VUL (Variable Universal Life), YRT (Yearly Renewable Term), FIA (Fixed Indexed Annuity), SPIA (Single Premium Immediate Annuity), GMAB (Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit), GMDB (Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit), GMIB (Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit), GMWB (Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit), DI (Disability Income). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|YRT|FIA|SPIA|GMAB|GMDB|GMIB|GMWB|DI — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: irc_7702_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the product plan is designed to comply with IRC Section 7702 life insurance tax qualification requirements including cash value accumulation test and guideline premium test.

attributes.name: loan_provision
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether policyholders can take loans against the cash value of this product plan. Used in policy servicing and customer service operations.

attributes.name: maximum_face_amount
attributes.description: The maximum death benefit or coverage amount that can be issued under this product plan without special underwriting approval. Used in underwriting and new business validation.

attributes.name: maximum_issue_age
attributes.description: The maximum age at which an applicant is eligible to purchase this product plan. Used in underwriting rules and new business processing.

attributes.name: maximum_premium_amount
attributes.description: The maximum premium amount allowed for this product plan without triggering MEC status or requiring special approval. Used in new business validation and IRC 7702 compliance testing.

attributes.name: minimum_face_amount
attributes.description: The minimum death benefit or coverage amount that can be issued under this product plan. Used in underwriting and new business validation.

attributes.name: minimum_issue_age
attributes.description: The minimum age at which an applicant is eligible to purchase this product plan. Used in underwriting rules and new business processing.

attributes.name: minimum_premium_amount
attributes.description: The minimum premium amount required for this product plan, typically expressed as annual premium equivalent. Used in new business validation and underwriting.

attributes.name: naic_product_type_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Product Type Code
attributes.description: The three-digit NAIC product type code used for statutory reporting and regulatory filings. Required for Annual Statement Schedule T reporting.

attributes.name: participating_product
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this product plan is a participating policy eligible to receive dividends based on company experience. Used in actuarial valuation and policyholder communications.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying this product plan across all systems and distribution channels. Used in policy administration, underwriting, and billing systems.

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the product plan including key features, benefits, and target market. Used for agent training and customer education materials.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: The full marketing and legal name of the product plan as it appears in policy documents, illustrations, and customer communications.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the product plan. Active plans are available for new business; filed plans are pending regulatory approval; approved plans are cleared but not yet active; suspended plans are temporarily unavailable; retired plans are closed to new business; withdrawn plans have been removed from filing.

attributes.name: premium_mode_options
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of premium payment frequency options available for this product plan (e.g., annual, semi_annual, quarterly, monthly, single). Used in billing system configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: annual|semi_annual|quarterly|monthly|single|flexible — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_family
attributes.description: The product family grouping used for portfolio management, profitability analysis, and strategic planning. Examples include term life family, universal life family, fixed annuity family.

attributes.name: profitability_target_irr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profitability Target Internal Rate of Return (IRR)
attributes.description: The target internal rate of return for this product plan used in pricing and profitability analysis. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1200 for 12.00%). Business-confidential metric.

attributes.name: reinstatement_period_months
attributes.description: The number of months after policy lapse during which the policyholder can reinstate the policy without new underwriting. Typically 3-5 years per state regulation.

attributes.name: reinsurance_treaty_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the reinsurance treaty under which this product plan is ceded. Used in reinsurance management system for cession processing and bordereaux reporting.

attributes.name: reserve_basis
attributes.description: The primary reserve calculation basis for this product plan. Statutory (SAP), GAAP, IFRS 17, or Principle-Based Reserving (PBR). Used in actuarial valuation system.
attributes.references: NAIC Valuation Manual, FASB ASC 944, IFRS 17

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: The business or regulatory reason for retiring this product plan. Used in product lifecycle management and strategic planning.

attributes.name: simplified_issue
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this product plan uses simplified underwriting with limited health questions and no medical exam. Used in underwriting workbench and new business processing.

attributes.name: state_approval_count
attributes.description: The number of US states and territories in which this product plan has received regulatory approval for sale. Used in distribution planning and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: suicide_exclusion_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years from policy issue during which death by suicide results in limited or no death benefit payment. Typically 2 years per state regulation.

attributes.name: surrender_charge_schedule
attributes.description: Reference to the surrender charge schedule identifier that defines the penalty structure for early policy termination. Used in policy servicing and cash surrender value calculations.

attributes.name: tax_qualification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is tax-qualified under IRC Section 7702 and whether it is classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) under IRC Section 7702A. Critical for tax reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: underwriting_class_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of underwriting risk classes eligible for this product plan (e.g., preferred_plus, preferred, standard, substandard). Used in underwriting workbench and rate table selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preferred_plus|preferred|standard|substandard|table_rated|declined — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this product plan record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: plan_version
products.description: Tracks versioned iterations of a product plan over its full lifecycle from initial filing through active sale to retirement. Captures version number, effective date, superseded date, change reason, filing reference, approval status, and version type (new filing, amendment, rate revision, retirement). For product retirement: records retirement announcement date, last new business effective date, in-force continuation policy, reason for retirement (regulatory, profitability, product redesign, market exit), replacement product plan reference, communication plan details, and closed-block transition parameters. Enables point-in-time product configuration retrieval for in-force policy administration, actuarial valuation, and closed-block management. The retirement version type marks the terminal lifecycle event and supports orderly transition of in-force blocks. This is the single source of truth for product versioning and retirement lifecycle management.
products.reference: ACORD Product Versioning / NAIC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the plan version record. Primary key.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Plan versions define product economics (expected_nbv_per_policy, profitability_target_irr) used to establish DAC capitalization accounts and GAAP reserve GL mappings at new business setup. Finance tea

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Plan versions track which legal entity issues them for state approval tracking and financial reporting segregation. State approvals and filings are entity-specific; version-level tracking enables accu

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product plan. Links this version to the overarching product plan entity.

attributes.name: replacement_plan_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the successor plan version that replaces this retired version. Supports product migration and agent guidance. Null if no direct replacement exists.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the state insurance department granted approval for this plan version. May differ from effective date based on filing type and state requirements.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current state of regulatory approval for this plan version. Tracks progression through state insurance department review and approval workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|conditionally_approved|rejected|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approved_by_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority that approved this version (e.g., New York Department of Financial Services, California Department of Insurance). Supports multi-state product tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC State Departments of Insurance Directory

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for creating this version. Documents the driver for the version change such as regulatory mandate, competitive positioning, profitability improvement, actuarial assumption update, or product redesign.

attributes.name: closed_block_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this plan version is part of a closed block for statutory accounting and reserve segregation. True when the version is closed to new business and subject to closed block reporting requirements.

attributes.name: closed_block_transition_date
attributes.description: Date when this plan version was formally designated as a closed block for statutory accounting purposes. Triggers specific reserve calculation and reporting requirements under SAP (Statutory Accounting Principles).

attributes.name: communication_plan_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or description of the stakeholder communication strategy for this version change. Documents agent bulletins, policyholder notices, and internal training materials associated with the version transition.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this plan version record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and version history tracking.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of authorized distribution channels for this plan version. Examples: career_agent, independent_broker, bank_channel, direct_to_consumer, worksite, brokerage_general_agency. Governs product availability across sales channels.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this plan version becomes active and available for new business or in-force policy administration. Aligns with state insurance department approval effective dates.

attributes.name: expected_nbv_per_policy
attributes.business_glossary_term: Expected New Business Value (NBV) Per Policy
attributes.description: Projected new business value per policy for this plan version based on actuarial pricing assumptions. Represents the present value of future profits at issue. Confidential metric used for product portfolio management and sales incentive design.

attributes.name: filing_reference_number
attributes.description: State insurance department filing identifier or SERFF (System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing) tracking number. Links this version to the regulatory approval documentation.

attributes.name: gpt_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan version satisfies the Guideline Premium Test under IRC Section 7702. One of two tests (GPT or Cash Value Accumulation Test) required for life insurance tax qualification.

attributes.name: inforce_continuation_policy
attributes.description: Strategy for managing existing policies after version retirement. Full servicing maintains all policy features; limited servicing restricts certain transactions; closed block segregates reserves; reinsured transfers risk; sold indicates block sale to another carrier.

attributes.name: irc_7702_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan version meets IRC Section 7702 definition of life insurance for federal tax qualification. Critical for ensuring death benefit tax-free treatment and cash value accumulation tax deferral.

attributes.name: last_new_business_date
attributes.description: Final date on which new policies may be issued under this plan version. Critical for product retirement and closed-block management. Typically precedes or coincides with superseded date.

attributes.name: maximum_face_amount
attributes.description: Highest death benefit amount permitted for policies issued under this plan version without special underwriting or reinsurance approval. Supports risk management and capacity planning.

attributes.name: maximum_issue_age
attributes.description: Oldest age at which an applicant may be issued a policy under this plan version. Expressed in years. Aligns with mortality assumptions and product profitability targets.

attributes.name: mec_risk_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this plan version design carries elevated risk of MEC classification under the 7-pay test. True when premium structure or cash value accumulation patterns approach MEC thresholds.

attributes.name: minimum_face_amount
attributes.description: Lowest death benefit amount permitted for policies issued under this plan version. Enforces product design constraints and underwriting efficiency thresholds.

attributes.name: minimum_issue_age
attributes.description: Youngest age at which an applicant may be issued a policy under this plan version. Expressed in years. Supports product design and underwriting rules.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this plan version record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: pbr_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan version is subject to Principle-Based Reserving under VM-20 (Valuation Manual Section 20). Determines reserve calculation methodology and actuarial opinion requirements.

attributes.name: profitability_target_irr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profitability Target Internal Rate of Return (IRR)
attributes.description: Target internal rate of return percentage for this plan version as established during product pricing. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 12.50 for 12.5%). Confidential business metric used for product performance monitoring.

attributes.name: rate_table_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the premium rate table set associated with this plan version. Links to actuarial rate tables for premium calculation, cost of insurance charges, and benefit pricing.

attributes.name: retirement_announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when the company publicly announced the retirement of this plan version. Supports agent communication and customer notification timelines. Null for non-retired versions.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Primary business driver for retiring this plan version. Regulatory change indicates compliance requirements; profitability reflects financial performance; product redesign signals strategic repositioning; market exit covers business line discontinuation; competitive pressure addresses market dynamics; technology limitation reflects system constraints.

attributes.name: rider_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of rider codes or names that may be attached to policies issued under this plan version. Examples: ADB (Accidental Death Benefit), WP (Waiver of Premium), GMDB (Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit), LTC (Long-Term Care). Governs product configuration options.

attributes.name: state_availability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of US state and territory postal codes where this plan version is approved for sale. Supports multi-state product distribution and compliance tracking. Example: NY,CA,TX,FL.
attributes.references: NAIC State Departments of Insurance Directory

attributes.name: superseded_date
attributes.description: Date when this plan version is replaced by a subsequent version. Null for the current active version. Marks the end of new business eligibility for this version.

attributes.name: underwriting_class_structure
attributes.description: Description of the risk classification framework for this plan version. Documents available underwriting classes such as Preferred Plus, Preferred, Standard Plus, Standard, Rated, and any substandard table ratings. Supports rate table selection and pricing.

attributes.name: version_description
attributes.description: Narrative summary of this plan version including key features, target market, competitive positioning, and material changes from prior versions. Supports product training and agent sales materials.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential or semantic version identifier for this plan iteration (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0-A). Supports both numeric and alphanumeric versioning schemes.

attributes.name: version_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this plan version. Draft indicates work in progress; pending approval awaits regulatory review; active is available for new business; superseded is replaced by newer version but may have in-force policies; retired is closed to new business; withdrawn is cancelled before activation.

attributes.name: version_type
attributes.description: Classification of the version change. New filing represents initial product launch; amendment covers contract language changes; rate revision updates premium or cost structures; benefit enhancement adds or modifies benefits; compliance update addresses regulatory requirements; retirement marks the terminal lifecycle event.

products.name: benefit_structure
products.description: SSOT for all benefit configurations across life insurance, annuity, and disability income (DI) product plans. For life products: death benefit (DB) type (level, increasing, return of premium), cash value accumulation method, dividend options (for participating WL), cost of insurance (COI) structure, nonforfeiture options (extended term, reduced paid-up, cash surrender), and nonforfeiture value calculation basis. For annuity products: guaranteed minimum death benefit (GMDB), guaranteed minimum accumulation benefit (GMAB), guaranteed minimum income benefit (GMIB), guaranteed minimum withdrawal benefit (GMWB), and long-term care (LTC) acceleration provisions. For disability income (DI) products: own-occupation vs any-occupation definition of disability, elimination period options (30, 60, 90, 180 days), benefit period options (2-year, 5-year, to age 65, lifetime), monthly benefit maximum, partial and residual disability provisions, cost of living adjustment (COLA) parameters, social insurance substitute benefit, return-to-work incentive provisions, DI-specific occupation class definitions, and benefit offset rules. Captures benefit formula parameters, floor and ceiling values, and IRC 7702 compliance constraints. This is the single source of truth for ALL product benefit definitions — no other product in this domain stores benefit structures or DI benefit parameters.
products.reference: ACORD Life Benefit Definition / IRC Section 7702

attributes.name: benefit_structure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit structure configuration. Primary key.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Different benefit structures (term, whole life, universal life) have distinct accounting treatment and GL mapping per GAAP/SAP rules. Required for accurate revenue recognition, reserve calculation, an

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product (WL, UL, IUL, VUL, YRT, FIA, SPIA, DI) to which this benefit structure applies.

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Benefit structures evolve between product versions (death benefit options, cash value methods, rider availability). Each version may offer different benefit configurations. The effective_date and term

attributes.name: underwriting_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.underwriting_class. Business justification: Benefit structures may vary by underwriting class (different benefit options, limits, or features for different risk classes). While not all benefit structures are class-specific, some products offer

attributes.name: benefit_ceiling_value
attributes.description: Maximum benefit amount payable under this benefit structure, regardless of performance or other factors. Null if no ceiling applies.

attributes.name: benefit_floor_value
attributes.description: Minimum benefit amount guaranteed under this benefit structure, regardless of performance or other factors. Null if no floor applies.

attributes.name: benefit_formula_parameters
attributes.description: Structured representation of the mathematical formula and parameters used to calculate benefit amounts, including variables, coefficients, and calculation rules.

attributes.name: benefit_structure_code
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique code identifying this benefit structure configuration across systems and distribution channels.

attributes.name: benefit_structure_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the benefit structure configuration, including key features, limitations, and business purpose.

attributes.name: benefit_structure_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the benefit structure configuration for business user identification and reporting.

attributes.name: benefit_structure_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit structure configuration: active (available for sale), inactive (temporarily unavailable), pending approval (awaiting regulatory approval), or retired (permanently discontinued).

attributes.name: cash_value_accumulation_method
attributes.description: For permanent life products: method by which cash value accumulates — fixed interest (WL), indexed crediting (IUL), variable investment (VUL), or not applicable for term/annuity/DI products.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702 - Life Insurance Contract Defined

attributes.name: coi_structure
attributes.description: For UL/IUL/VUL products: structure of cost of insurance charges — level (fixed), increasing (rises over time), attained age (based on current age), or not applicable for term/WL/annuity/DI products.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830 - Standard Nonforfeiture Law

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit structure record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: csv_calculation_basis
attributes.description: For permanent life products: formula or methodology used to calculate cash surrender value, including surrender charge schedules and interest crediting rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830 - Standard Nonforfeiture Law

attributes.name: death_benefit_option
attributes.description: For UL/IUL/VUL products: death benefit option selected (Option A: level, Option B: level plus account value, Option C: increasing). Not applicable for term or annuity products.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830 - Standard Nonforfeiture Law

attributes.name: death_benefit_type
attributes.description: For life products: type of death benefit structure — level (constant), increasing (grows with cash value or inflation), return of premium, or not applicable for non-life products.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 830 - Standard Nonforfeiture Law

attributes.name: di_benefit_offset_rules
attributes.description: For DI products: description of rules governing how other income sources (Social Security, workers compensation, other group disability) offset or reduce the DI benefit payable.

attributes.name: di_benefit_period
attributes.description: For DI products: maximum duration for which disability benefits are payable — 2-year, 5-year, to age 65, to age 67, lifetime, or not applicable for life/annuity products.

attributes.name: di_cola_available
attributes.business_glossary_term: Disability Income (DI) Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) Available
attributes.description: For DI products: indicates whether cost of living adjustment (COLA) rider is available to increase benefits during claim period.

attributes.name: di_cola_rate_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Disability Income (DI) Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) Rate Percent
attributes.description: For DI products with COLA: annual percentage rate at which benefits increase during claim period (e.g., 3.00 for 3% annual increase). Null if COLA not available.

attributes.name: di_disability_definition
attributes.description: For DI products: definition of disability used to determine benefit eligibility — own occupation, any occupation, modified own occupation, or not applicable for life/annuity products.

attributes.name: di_elimination_period_days
attributes.description: For DI products: number of days the insured must be disabled before benefits begin (common values: 30, 60, 90, 180, 365 days). Null for life/annuity products.

attributes.name: di_monthly_benefit_maximum
attributes.description: For DI products: maximum monthly benefit amount payable under this benefit structure. Null for life/annuity products.

attributes.name: di_partial_disability_available
attributes.business_glossary_term: Disability Income (DI) Partial Disability Benefit Available
attributes.description: For DI products: indicates whether partial disability benefit provision is included in this benefit structure.

attributes.name: di_residual_disability_available
attributes.business_glossary_term: Disability Income (DI) Residual Disability Benefit Available
attributes.description: For DI products: indicates whether residual disability benefit provision is included in this benefit structure.

attributes.name: di_return_to_work_incentive
attributes.description: For DI products: indicates whether return-to-work incentive provisions are included to encourage rehabilitation and return to employment.

attributes.name: di_social_insurance_substitute
attributes.business_glossary_term: Disability Income (DI) Social Insurance Substitute Benefit
attributes.description: For DI products: indicates whether social insurance substitute benefit is included to provide additional income if Social Security disability benefits are denied.

attributes.name: dividend_option
attributes.description: For participating whole life products: policyholder election for dividend treatment — cash, reduce premium, paid-up additions, accumulate at interest, one-year term insurance, or not applicable for non-participating products.
