attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Rate filings are made by specific legal entities in specific jurisdictions. Fundamental regulatory filing requirement - rates must be approved for each entity in each state.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance product (e.g., term life, whole life, LTC, annuity) for which the rate filing is submitted. Links the filing to the specific product line subject to rate regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC Product Filing Requirements; State DOI Rate Regulation

attributes.name: plan_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan_version. Business justification: Rate filings are version-specific regulatory submissions. Actuaries and state DOI filings reference the exact plan version whose rates are being changed. rate_filing already has plan_id but lacks plan

attributes.name: policy_form_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.policy_form_approval. Business justification: Rate filings reference specific approved policy forms (rate changes apply to approved form numbers). Links rate filing to the form approval for product launch coordination and regulatory compliance va

attributes.name: premium_rate_table_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.premium_rate_table. Business justification: A compliance rate_filing is the regulatory approval that activates a new premium_rate_table. Actuarial and compliance teams must link the approved filing to the rate table it governs. This is the core

attributes.name: rbc_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.rbc_calculation. Business justification: Rate filings, particularly LTC rate increase filings, are directly tied to RBC calculations demonstrating capital adequacy supporting the rate change. Regulators require actuarial justification linkin

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Rate filings fulfill regulatory obligations for premium rate approval. The obligation defines the filing type and jurisdiction requirements.

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_regulation. Business justification: Rate filings must comply with state-specific rate filing regulations. The filing describes the submission, while the regulation describes the state-specific rules governing rate approval.

attributes.name: affected_policy_count
attributes.description: Number of in-force policies in the filing jurisdiction that will be affected by the proposed rate change. Required for LTC rate increase filings and used by the DOI to assess consumer impact. Derived from policy administration system counts at time of filing.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State DOI Rate Increase Impact Assessment Requirements

attributes.name: annual_premium_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total annual premium impact (in USD) of the proposed rate change across all affected in-force policies in the filing jurisdiction. Used by the DOI to assess the financial impact on policyholders and by the company for financial planning.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Increase Impact Assessment Requirements

attributes.name: approved_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the DOI-approved rates become effective for use. May differ from the proposed effective date if the DOI modifies the requested effective date as a condition of approval. Null until the filing reaches approved status.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: approved_rate_change_percentage
attributes.description: The rate change percentage as finally approved by the state DOI, which may differ from the originally proposed rate_change_percentage if the DOI required modifications as a condition of approval. Null until the filing is approved.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: certifying_actuary_credential
attributes.description: Professional actuarial credential of the certifying actuary (e.g., FSA — Fellow of the Society of Actuaries, MAAA — Member of the American Academy of Actuaries). Validates the actuary's qualification to certify the rate filing.
attributes.references: American Academy of Actuaries (AAA) Qualification Standards; NAIC Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: certifying_actuary_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified actuary (Fellow of the Society of Actuaries or equivalent) who certified the actuarial memorandum and rate justification supporting this filing. Required by most state DOIs as part of the rate filing package.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP); NAIC Rate Filing Requirements; State DOI Actuarial Certification Requirements

attributes.name: consumer_notice_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rate filing requires individual policyholder notification of the rate change (e.g., LTC rate increases, in-force rate revisions). Triggers the consumer notification workflow in the policy administration system.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State DOI Consumer Notification Requirements; HIPAA

attributes.name: consumer_notice_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which policyholder notification letters were sent for the rate change. Required for LTC rate increases and other in-force rate revisions requiring consumer notice. Null if consumer_notice_required_flag is false.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State DOI Consumer Notification Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rate filing record was first created in the compliance system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: disapproval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the state Department of Insurance (DOI) formally disapproved the rate filing. Null for filings that are approved, pending, or withdrawn. Triggers the company's obligation to respond or refile.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: disapproval_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the state DOI's stated reason(s) for disapproving the rate filing. Null for approved or pending filings. Used to guide refiling strategy and actuarial revisions.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: doi_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the state Department of Insurance (DOI) formally approved the rate filing. Null for filings that are pending, disapproved, or withdrawn. Distinct from the approved effective date, which is when rates go into use.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: doi_objection_count
attributes.description: Number of formal objections or deficiency letters issued by the state DOI during the review of this rate filing. Each objection requires a company response and may extend the review timeline. Tracks regulatory engagement complexity.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Review Procedures

attributes.name: doi_objection_response_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company submitted its response to the DOI's most recent objection or deficiency letter. Used to track compliance with DOI response deadlines and filing timeline management.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Review Procedures

attributes.name: doi_objection_response_due_date
attributes.description: Due date for the company's response to the most recent DOI objection or deficiency letter. Failure to respond by this date may result in automatic disapproval or withdrawal of the filing.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Review Procedures

attributes.name: experience_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the actuarial experience period used to develop the loss ratios, claim costs, and other actuarial assumptions supporting the rate filing. Together with the start date, defines the historical data window underlying the actuarial justification.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 25; NAIC Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: experience_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the actuarial experience period used to develop the loss ratios, claim costs, and other actuarial assumptions supporting the rate filing. Defines the historical data window underlying the actuarial justification.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 25; NAIC Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: external_counsel_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or name of external legal counsel engaged to support the rate filing, if applicable. Relevant for contested filings, LTC rate increase hearings, or filings requiring regulatory negotiation.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: filing_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the rate filing, summarizing the nature of the rate change, the affected policy forms, the actuarial basis, and any special circumstances (e.g., LTC rate stabilization, experience deterioration, regulatory mandate). Used for internal compliance tracking and DOI correspondence.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: filing_method
attributes.description: Regulatory filing method required by the state for this rate filing. Prior approval requires DOI approval before use; file-and-use allows immediate use upon filing; use-and-file requires filing after use; no-filing-required states are exempt. Determines the compliance timeline and approval workflow.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Regulation Framework; State DOI Rate Filing Statutes

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the rate filing, typically generated by the company or the state DOI system (e.g., SERFF tracking number or company-assigned filing reference). Used for cross-referencing with state DOI portals and internal compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC SERFF (System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing); State DOI Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: filing_preparer_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal compliance or actuarial staff member responsible for preparing and submitting the rate filing. Used for accountability tracking and DOI correspondence.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate filing with the state DOI. Tracks the filing from initial draft through submission, regulatory review, and final disposition (approved, disapproved, or withdrawn). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|pending_review|approved|disapproved|withdrawn|conditionally_approved — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: hearing_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the DOI public or administrative hearing for this rate filing. Null if hearing_required_flag is false. Tracks the regulatory hearing calendar for compliance management.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Administrative Hearing Procedures

attributes.name: hearing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state DOI has required a public hearing or administrative hearing as part of the rate filing review process. Hearings are common for large LTC rate increases and may significantly extend the approval timeline.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Administrative Hearing Procedures

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or territory code identifying the state Department of Insurance (DOI) to which this rate filing is submitted. Each state has independent rate regulation authority; a single product rate change may require separate filings per state.
attributes.references: NAIC State DOI Jurisdiction; ISO 3166-2:US State Codes

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Regulatory line of business classification for the rate filing as defined by NAIC and state DOI reporting standards. Determines the applicable rate regulation statutes and actuarial certification requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Line of Business Definitions; State DOI Rate Regulation

attributes.name: loss_ratio_current
attributes.description: The current (pre-filing) loss ratio for the affected product line and policy forms, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.85 = 85%). A key actuarial metric supporting the rate change justification; high loss ratios indicate inadequate current rates.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 25; NAIC Rate Filing Requirements; State DOI Rate Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: loss_ratio_projected
attributes.description: The projected loss ratio following implementation of the proposed rate change, expressed as a decimal. Demonstrates to the DOI that the revised rates will achieve actuarial adequacy and rate stability.
attributes.references: Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 25; NAIC Rate Filing Requirements; State DOI Rate Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: ltc_rate_increase_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this filing is a Long-Term Care (LTC) rate increase filing, which is subject to heightened regulatory scrutiny, consumer notification requirements, and actuarial certification standards under the NAIC LTC Insurance Model Regulation.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation (#641); State DOI LTC Rate Increase Requirements

attributes.name: policy_form_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of policy form numbers (as approved by the DOI) to which the rate filing applies. Policy forms are the standardized contract templates approved by the state DOI; rate filings are tied to specific approved forms.
attributes.references: NAIC Policy Form Filing Requirements; State DOI Form Approval Standards

attributes.name: prior_filing_number
attributes.description: Filing number of the immediately preceding approved rate filing for the same product line and jurisdiction. Establishes the rate revision history chain and allows comparison of current vs. prior approved rates.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Broad insurance product line classification for the rate filing (e.g., Term Life, Whole Life (WL), Universal Life (UL), Long-Term Care (LTC), Annuity). Determines applicable regulatory framework and actuarial standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: term_life|whole_life|universal_life|variable_life|ltc|annuity|disability_income|accidental_death — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Product Line Classifications; State DOI Rate Filing Requirements

attributes.name: proposed_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company proposes the new or revised rates to become effective for new business or in-force policies. Subject to DOI approval for prior approval states; may differ from the approved effective date.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: rate_change_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage change in premium rates proposed in this filing relative to the currently approved rates. Positive values indicate a rate increase; negative values indicate a rate decrease. Critical metric for actuarial justification and DOI review. For LTC rate increase filings, subject to heightened regulatory scrutiny.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation; State DOI Rate Increase Standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: rate_change_type
attributes.description: Directional classification of the rate change proposed in this filing. Distinguishes between rate increases, decreases, no-change filings (e.g., non-forfeiture value updates), and new rate filings for newly introduced products.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: rate_stability_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the filing includes an actuarial certification of rate stability as required by the NAIC LTC Insurance Model Regulation. Rate stability certifications attest that the proposed rates are not expected to require future increases.
attributes.references: NAIC Long-Term Care Insurance Model Regulation (#641); Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: serff_tracking_number
attributes.description: Tracking number assigned by the NAIC System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing (SERFF) upon submission of the rate filing to the state DOI. Serves as the authoritative cross-reference between the company's internal records and the state regulatory portal.
attributes.references: NAIC SERFF System; State DOI Electronic Filing Requirements

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rate filing was formally submitted to the state Department of Insurance (DOI). Marks the start of the regulatory review clock for prior approval states and establishes the compliance timeline for file-and-use states.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rate filing record was most recently updated in the compliance system. Supports audit trail requirements, change tracking, and data lineage for the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the company voluntarily withdrew the rate filing from DOI review. Null for filings not withdrawn. Withdrawal may occur due to actuarial revisions, regulatory feedback, or business strategy changes.
attributes.references: NAIC Rate Filing Standards; State DOI Rate Regulation Requirements

products.name: jurisdiction_license
products.description: Master record of the company's Certificate of Authority (COA) and licenses to transact insurance business in each state and territory. Captures jurisdiction, license type (life, annuity, variable life, variable annuity), license number, effective date, renewal date, renewal status, authorized lines of business, and any license conditions or restrictions imposed by the DOI. Ensures the company only writes business in jurisdictions where it is properly licensed.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_license_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each jurisdiction license record in the Silver layer. Primary key for the jurisdiction_license data product.
attributes.references: NAIC Data Standards; ACORD Data Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: License renewal fees, statutory deposit requirements, and state compliance costs are allocated to cost centers by jurisdiction. Insurance companies track licensing costs by state/cost center for expen

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Licenses are issued to legal entities. Fundamental regulatory relationship - each legal entity must be licensed in jurisdictions where it operates. Required for regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: license_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Jurisdiction licenses have associated certificate documents, renewal notices, and DOI correspondence stored in the document system. Compliance teams need to retrieve the actual license certificate doc

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Jurisdiction licenses are maintained to satisfy regulatory obligations for authority to transact insurance business. The license describes the authority granted, while the obligation describes the req

attributes.name: admitted_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the company is admitted (licensed and subject to state guaranty fund protection), non-admitted, or writing on a surplus lines basis in the jurisdiction. Affects policyholder protections and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Surplus Lines Model Act; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: annual_statement_filing_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the company must file its NAIC Annual Statement (statutory financial statement) with the DOI for this jurisdiction. Typically March 1 for most states but may vary. Drives the regulatory filing calendar.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; State DOI Filing Requirements; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: authorized_lines_of_business
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of the specific lines of business authorized under this license (e.g., Life, Annuity, Variable Life, Variable Annuity, Accident and Health). Governs which product types may be sold in the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC Lines of Business Codes; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: compliance_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the company's designated compliance officer or regulatory contact responsible for managing the license and DOI relationship in this jurisdiction. Used for regulatory correspondence and examination coordination.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: domicile_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS code for the state in which the company is domiciled (chartered). Distinguishes the home state license from foreign state licenses and determines which state's insurance laws govern the company's primary regulatory oversight.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Holding Company Act; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Certificate of Authority or license became effective and the company was first authorized to transact the specified line of business in the jurisdiction. Marks the start of the binding authorization period.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current license term expires and renewal is required to maintain authorization. Null for perpetual licenses that do not require periodic renewal. Drives the renewal calendar and compliance alerts.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: fein
attributes.description: The Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) of the company as registered with the IRS. Required on certain state DOI filings and tax-related regulatory submissions. Also known as Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN).
attributes.references: IRS TIN Requirements; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: guaranty_fund_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the company is a member of the state life and health guaranty association for this jurisdiction. Admitted carriers are typically required to be members. Relevant for policyholder protection disclosures and NAIC reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Life and Health Insurance Guaranty Association Model Act; State Guaranty Fund Requirements

attributes.name: is_domestic
attributes.description: Indicates whether this license is a domestic (home state) license (True) or a foreign state license (False). Domestic licenses are issued by the state of domicile; foreign licenses are issued by other states where the company is admitted to transact business.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Insurance Holding Company Act; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body that issued the license (e.g., California Department of Insurance, New York State Department of Financial Services). Identifies the specific DOI or equivalent authority responsible for the license.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: issuing_authority_contact
attributes.description: Contact information (address, phone, or email) for the issuing DOI or regulatory authority. Used for correspondence, renewal submissions, and regulatory inquiries.
attributes.references: State DOI Contact Directories; NAIC State Contact Registry

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the state or territory jurisdiction (e.g., California, New York, Puerto Rico, District of Columbia). Complements the state code for display and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Jurisdiction Codes; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state or territory code identifying the jurisdiction in which the license is held (e.g., CA, NY, TX, PR, DC). Used to validate that the company is authorized to write business in the state before policy issuance.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; NAIC Jurisdiction Codes; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: last_examination_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent market conduct or financial examination conducted by the DOI in this jurisdiction. Used to track examination cycles and anticipate upcoming examinations per NAIC examination standards.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; NAIC Financial Condition Examiners Handbook

attributes.name: license_condition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DOI has imposed any conditions, restrictions, or limitations on this license. When True, the license_conditions field contains the details. Conditions may restrict product types, distribution channels, or require enhanced reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text description of any conditions, restrictions, or limitations imposed by the DOI on this license. Examples include restrictions on writing new business, requirements for enhanced consumer disclosures, or limitations on specific product features. Populated only when license_condition_flag is True.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: The official license or Certificate of Authority (COA) number assigned by the state Department of Insurance (DOI) to the company for the given jurisdiction. This is the externally-known business identifier used in regulatory filings and correspondence with the DOI.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the jurisdiction license as maintained by the state DOI. Active indicates the company is authorized to transact business. Suspended or revoked statuses trigger immediate cessation of new business writing in the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance license by product line authorized. Determines which lines of business the company is permitted to transact in the jurisdiction. Variable product types are subject to additional SEC/FINRA oversight. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: life|annuity|variable_life|variable_annuity|accident_health|disability_income — promote to reference product if additional lines are added]
attributes.references: NAIC Lines of Business Codes; IRC Section 7702; SEC Variable Products Regulation

attributes.name: minimum_capital_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum capital and surplus amount required by the jurisdiction's DOI for the company to maintain its license, denominated in USD. Linked to Risk-Based Capital (RBC) requirements and solvency monitoring.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital (RBC) Instructions; State DOI Capital Requirements; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: naic_company_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code
attributes.description: The five-digit NAIC company code assigned to the insurer. Used in all NAIC regulatory filings, state financial examinations, and market conduct reporting to uniquely identify the company across all jurisdictions.
attributes.references: NAIC Company Licensing Database; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: next_examination_due_date
attributes.description: The anticipated or scheduled date for the next DOI examination in this jurisdiction. Typically every 3-5 years per NAIC standards. Used for compliance planning and resource allocation.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; NAIC Financial Condition Examiners Handbook

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional compliance notes, DOI correspondence summaries, or internal observations related to the license. Used by the compliance team to document material events not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: original_issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company was first granted a license in this jurisdiction for this license type, regardless of subsequent renewals. Establishes the historical tenure of authorization in the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this jurisdiction license record was first created in the compliance data product. Provides audit trail for record provenance in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this jurisdiction license record was most recently updated in the compliance data product. Supports change tracking, audit trails, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Corporate Governance Annual Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: registered_agent_address
attributes.description: Physical address of the registered agent for service of process in the jurisdiction. Required for legal and regulatory correspondence. Maintained as confidential business contact information.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; State Corporation Law

attributes.name: registered_agent_name
attributes.description: Name of the company's registered agent for service of process in the jurisdiction. Required by most states as a condition of licensure. The registered agent receives legal notices and regulatory correspondence on behalf of the company.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; State Corporation Law

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously suspended or lapsed license was reinstated by the DOI. Null if the license has never been reinstated. Marks the resumption of authorization to transact business.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the company submitted the renewal application to the state DOI. Used to confirm timely filing and to calculate days-before-expiration for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date by which the renewal application and associated fees must be submitted to the DOI to avoid lapse of authorization. May differ from expiration_date where the DOI requires advance filing.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_fee_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount paid or payable to the state DOI for license renewal, denominated in USD. Tracked for budgeting, accounts payable, and regulatory expense reporting.
attributes.references: State DOI Fee Schedules; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the renewal process for the license. Tracks whether the renewal application has been submitted, is under DOI review, approved, or has lapsed. Critical for compliance monitoring to ensure continuous authorization.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the type of restriction or condition imposed on the license by the DOI. Enables structured reporting and monitoring of restricted licenses across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the DOI permanently revoked the license, if applicable. Null for active or suspended licenses. A revoked license requires a new application process to re-enter the jurisdiction.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: statutory_deposit_amount
attributes.description: The amount of securities or cash deposited with the state treasury or DOI as a condition of licensure in the jurisdiction, denominated in USD. Required by certain states as a financial security requirement for admitted carriers.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; State DOI Deposit Requirements; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: statutory_deposit_type
attributes.description: Type of asset held on deposit with the state as a condition of licensure. Determines the nature of the financial security arrangement and applicable valuation methods under SAP.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; State DOI Deposit Requirements; SAP Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the DOI suspended the license, if applicable. Null for licenses that have never been suspended. Triggers immediate cessation of new business writing and notification to the Policy Administration System.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason provided by the DOI for suspending the license. Populated only when suspension_date is not null. Used for regulatory response planning and remediation tracking.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Regulation Handbook; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: variable_product_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this license authorizes the sale of variable insurance products (variable life or variable annuity) that are subject to SEC and FINRA oversight in addition to state DOI regulation. True triggers additional compliance checks.
attributes.references: SEC Variable Products Regulation; FINRA Rules; NAIC Model Variable Annuity Regulation

products.name: state_regulation
products.description: Reference table of state-specific insurance regulatory requirements, variations, and effective dates by jurisdiction. Captures state DOI-specific rules for policy forms, rate filings, nonforfeiture requirements, free look periods, grace periods, and replacement regulations that vary by state.

attributes.name: state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the state-specific insurance regulation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_regulation_state_regulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer state regulation that replaces this regulation, if applicable. Null if not superseded.

attributes.name: accelerated_death_benefit_regulation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state has specific regulations governing accelerated death benefit riders. True if ADB regulations apply, False if not.

attributes.name: best_interest_standard_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state has adopted a best interest standard for annuity sales (similar to Regulation Best Interest). True if best interest standard applies, False if not.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation 275 - Annuity Best Interest

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes documenting compliance considerations, implementation guidance, or special handling requirements for this state regulation.

attributes.name: contestability_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months during which the insurer may contest a life insurance policy for material misrepresentation, as mandated by state law. Typically 24 months but may vary by state.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this state regulation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the state-specific regulation becomes enforceable and applicable to insurance operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the state regulation ceases to be in effect, if applicable. Null for regulations with no defined end date.

attributes.name: form_filing_method
attributes.description: State-mandated method for submitting and approving policy forms (prior approval required before use, file and use after DOI review, use and file with post-use notification, no filing required).

attributes.name: free_look_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days the policyholder has to review and cancel a newly issued policy without penalty, as mandated by state regulation. Varies by state and product type.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation for Free Look Provisions

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after premium due date during which coverage remains in force without lapse, as required by state regulation. Typically 30-31 days but varies by state.

attributes.name: illustration_regulation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state has specific regulations governing life insurance policy illustrations. True if illustration rules apply, False if not.
attributes.references: NAIC Life Insurance Illustrations Model Regulation

attributes.name: insurable_interest_requirement
attributes.description: State-specific definition and requirements for establishing insurable interest in life insurance transactions. Describes when insurable interest must exist (at inception, at death, etc.).
attributes.references: State Insurance Code - Insurable Interest Provisions

attributes.name: interest_rate_guarantee_minimum
attributes.description: State-mandated minimum guaranteed interest rate for cash value accumulation in life insurance and annuity products. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0200 for 2%).

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the state regulatory body that issued or enforces this regulation (e.g., California Department of Insurance, New York Department of Financial Services).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: Full name of the state or territory regulatory jurisdiction (e.g., California, New York, Texas).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Aligns with NAIC state codes.

attributes.name: last_amended_date
attributes.description: Date when the state regulation was last amended or revised. Null if no amendments have been made since original enactment.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this state regulation record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: long_term_care_partnership_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state participates in the Long-Term Care Partnership Program, allowing policyholders to protect assets while qualifying for Medicaid. True if partnership state, False if not.
attributes.references: Deficit Reduction Act of 2005 - LTC Partnership Program

attributes.name: minimum_cash_surrender_value_percentage
attributes.description: State-mandated minimum cash surrender value as a percentage of premiums paid or reserves, as required by nonforfeiture laws. Null if no state-specific requirement.

attributes.name: minimum_death_benefit_amount
attributes.description: State-mandated minimum death benefit amount for life insurance policies issued in the jurisdiction. Null if no state-specific minimum applies.

attributes.name: nonforfeiture_method
attributes.description: State-mandated method for calculating nonforfeiture values (Commissioners Reserve Valuation Method, Commissioners Extended Term Method, Cash Surrender Value Method).

attributes.name: nonforfeiture_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state mandates nonforfeiture benefits (cash surrender value, reduced paid-up insurance, extended term insurance) for this product type. True if required, False if not.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Insurance product line(s) to which this state regulation applies (e.g., Life, Annuity, Variable Life, Variable Annuity, Long-Term Care). May contain multiple values separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: rate_filing_method
attributes.description: State-mandated method for submitting and approving insurance rates (prior approval required before use, file and use after DOI review, use and file with post-use notification, no filing required).

attributes.name: regulation_citation
attributes.description: Official citation reference to the state statute, regulation, or administrative code section that establishes this requirement (e.g., California Insurance Code Section 10113.71).
attributes.references: State Insurance Code and Administrative Regulations

attributes.name: regulation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the state-specific regulatory requirement, including key provisions, applicability conditions, and compliance obligations.
attributes.references: State Insurance Code and Administrative Regulations

attributes.name: regulation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the state regulation (active, superseded by newer regulation, pending approval, withdrawn).

attributes.name: regulation_type
attributes.description: Category of state-specific insurance regulation (policy form approval, rate filing requirements, nonforfeiture standards, free look period, grace period, replacement regulations).

attributes.name: replacement_notice_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state requires written notice to the existing insurer when a policy replacement is proposed. True if notice required, False if not.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Life Insurance and Annuity Replacements

attributes.name: replacement_regulation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state has specific regulations governing policy replacement transactions (1035 exchanges, internal replacements). True if state has replacement rules, False if not.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Life Insurance and Annuity Replacements

attributes.name: serff_filing_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing (SERFF) Filing Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state requires rate and form filings to be submitted through the NAIC SERFF system. True if SERFF required, False if alternative methods allowed.

attributes.name: stoli_prohibition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state has enacted specific prohibitions against stranger-originated life insurance transactions. True if STOLI prohibited, False if not.

attributes.name: suicide_exclusion_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months during which death by suicide is excluded from life insurance coverage, as mandated by state law. Typically 24 months but may vary by state.
attributes.references: State Insurance Code - Suicide Exclusion Provisions

attributes.name: suitability_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state mandates suitability reviews and documentation for annuity sales. True if suitability review required, False if not.
attributes.references: NAIC Suitability in Annuity Transactions Model Regulation

attributes.name: variable_product_registration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state requires separate registration or approval for variable life and variable annuity products beyond standard form filing. True if additional registration required, False if not.
attributes.references: SEC and State DOI Variable Product Standards

products.name: sar_filing
products.description: Transactional record of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) filed with FinCEN under the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) for life insurance and annuity transactions. Captures SAR type (initial/continuing), filing date, FinCEN BSA ID, suspicious activity date range, transaction amounts, subject information, narrative description, filing status, and acknowledgment receipt. Required for AML/BSA compliance.

attributes.name: sar_filing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SAR filing record. Primary key.
attributes.references: Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), FinCEN SAR Filing Requirements

attributes.name: aml_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the AML case investigation that resulted in this SAR filing.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the life insurance or annuity policy involved in the suspicious activity, if applicable.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policyholder who is the subject of the suspicious activity report.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.plan. Business justification: SAR filings reference the specific insurance plan involved in suspicious activity. FinCEN BSA reporting for insurance requires product-level identification. product_type on sar_filing is a denormalize

attributes.name: prior_sar_filing_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on sar_filing (prior_sar_filing_id)

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: SAR filings fulfill FinCEN AML/BSA regulatory obligations. The obligation defines the filing deadline and requirements.

attributes.name: sar_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: SAR filings are formal FinCEN documents with narrative descriptions and supporting evidence required by BSA/AML regulations. Critical for AML regulatory reporting and FinCEN submission tracking in Lif

attributes.name: trade_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.trade. Business justification: SAR filings report suspicious trading activity (structuring, unusual patterns, STOLI indicators). Real business process: suspicious transaction reporting, FinCEN filing, AML compliance. Required for i

attributes.name: acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date when FinCEN acknowledged receipt of the SAR filing. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: activity_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the suspicious activity ended or was last observed. May be null for ongoing activity. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: activity_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the suspicious activity began or was first observed. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the SAR filing was approved for submission to FinCEN. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the senior compliance officer or manager who approved the SAR filing for submission.

attributes.name: confidentiality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates that this SAR filing is subject to strict confidentiality requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act. Always True for SAR filings.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SAR filing record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: detection_method
attributes.description: Method by which the suspicious activity was detected: automated monitoring system, manual review, customer complaint, law enforcement inquiry, regulatory examination, or other.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the SAR was filed with FinCEN. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: filing_reference_number
attributes.description: Internal reference number assigned to this SAR filing for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the SAR filing in the internal workflow: draft (being prepared), pending_review (awaiting compliance review), approved (ready for submission), submitted (sent to FinCEN), acknowledged (FinCEN confirmation received), rejected (FinCEN rejected submission).

attributes.name: filing_type
attributes.description: Type of SAR filing: initial (first report of suspicious activity), continuing (follow-up to prior SAR), corrected (correction to previously filed SAR), or amended (substantive change to prior SAR).

attributes.name: fincen_bsa_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by FinCEN upon successful submission of the SAR. Also known as the BSA Identifier or acknowledgment number.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the suspicious activity occurred or where the policy was issued.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SAR filing record was last modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_agency
attributes.description: Name of the law enforcement agency contacted regarding this suspicious activity, if applicable.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether law enforcement has been contacted regarding this suspicious activity. True if contacted, False otherwise.

attributes.name: narrative_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the suspicious activity, including facts, circumstances, and reasons for suspicion. This is the core content of the SAR filing.
attributes.references: FinCEN SAR Instructions, Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the compliance officer or employee who prepared the SAR filing.

attributes.name: prior_sar_reference
attributes.description: Reference to a prior SAR filing if this is a continuing, corrected, or amended SAR. Contains the FinCEN BSA ID of the prior SAR.

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date when FinCEN rejected the SAR filing due to errors or incomplete information. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by FinCEN for rejecting the SAR filing, if applicable.

attributes.name: subject_address
attributes.description: Full address of the subject involved in the suspicious activity.

attributes.name: subject_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the individual subject, if applicable. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: subject_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual or entity that is the subject of the suspicious activity report.
attributes.references: FinCEN SAR Instructions, Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: subject_tax_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number of the subject: Social Security Number (SSN) for individuals or Employer Identification Number (EIN) for entities.

attributes.name: subject_type
attributes.description: Type of subject involved in the suspicious activity: individual (natural person), entity (organization/business), or unknown.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the SAR was electronically submitted to FinCEN. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: suspicious_activity_type
attributes.description: Category or type of suspicious activity being reported (e.g., structuring, money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, identity theft). May contain multiple types separated by semicolons. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: structuring|money_laundering|terrorist_financing|fraud|identity_theft|elder_financial_exploitation|insurance_fraud|premium_financing_abuse|stoli|tax_evasion|bribery|embezzlement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FinCEN SAR Instructions, Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount of the transaction(s) involved in the suspicious activity. Aggregate amount if multiple transactions.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: Owns general ledger, statutory (SAP) and GAAP financial reporting, IFRS 17 reporting, RBC calculations, cost center management, DAC asset tracking, intercompany settlement, budget vs. actual variance, and SOX-controlled financial close processes. Manages FASB ASC 944 / LDTI financial statement impacts, chart of accounts, journal entries, and external audit support. Serves as SSOT for all enterprise financial positions.

products.name: general_ledger
products.description: SSOT for all enterprise general ledger accounts, balances, and chart of accounts (COA) hierarchy. Owns account codes, account names, account type classifications (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense, contra), normal balance direction (debit/credit), financial statement line mapping, SAP and GAAP dual-basis account mappings, IFRS 17 cohort account linkages, statutory vs. GAAP account designations, RBC line mapping, and account active/inactive governance with effective date ranges. Includes COA change management, account hierarchy (parent-child), account group definitions, and COA governance processes. Manages period open/close governance, close milestone tracking, and SOX-controlled financial close processes. Serves as the authoritative financial position record and chart of accounts master for all legal entities. Supports external audit support and regulatory filing account mapping.
products.reference: GAAP/SAP General Ledger — FASB ASC 944, NAIC SAP

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger entry. Primary key for the general ledger data product.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: general_ledger IS the instance of a chart_of_accounts account with balances. All master data attributes (account_name, account_type, normal_balance, hierarchy, classifications, flags, etc.) should com

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the cost center associated with this account. Used for expense allocation, departmental reporting, and management accounting. Null for balance sheet accounts.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Framework, Cost Allocation Standards

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the legal entity to which this general ledger entry belongs. Links to the legal entity master for multi-entity consolidation and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_code
attributes.description: The unique account code from the chart of accounts (COA). Serves as the primary business identifier for the GL account. Typically 4-10 digit numeric code following the enterprise COA structure.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles, IFRS 17

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the general ledger account. Inactive or closed accounts cannot accept new postings but retain historical balances.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404, Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: cohort_code
attributes.description: The IFRS 17 cohort identifier for insurance contract grouping. Used for Contractual Service Margin (CSM) tracking and IFRS 17 measurement.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts, IFRS 17 Cohort Definition Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this general ledger account record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for this account. Supports multi-currency accounting and foreign exchange reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes, Multi-Currency Accounting Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this account becomes inactive and no longer accepts new postings. Null for currently active accounts. Supports historical reporting and COA governance.
attributes.references: Chart of Accounts Governance, Financial System Configuration Standards

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this account becomes active and available for posting. Supports chart of accounts change management and version control.
attributes.references: Chart of Accounts Governance, Financial System Configuration Standards

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 functional currency code for the legal entity. Used for currency translation and consolidation under ASC 830.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters, ISO 4217

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier that last modified this general ledger account record. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this general ledger account record was last modified. Critical for change tracking and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: The insurance product line associated with this account (e.g., 'WL' for Whole Life, 'UL' for Universal Life, 'SPIA' for Single Premium Immediate Annuity). Enables product-level profitability analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions, Product Profitability Reporting

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system from which this general ledger account originated. Supports data lineage and integration troubleshooting.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework, Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: The natural key or unique identifier for this account in the source system. Enables traceability back to the originating system of record.
attributes.references: Data Integration Standards, Master Data Management Framework

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier that created this general ledger account record. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Captures all double-entry accounting journal entries posted to the general ledger. Includes entries for premium revenue recognition, DAC amortization, reserve movements, claim payments, commission accruals, investment income, intercompany settlements, and period-end adjusting entries. Tracks SAP vs. GAAP basis, IFRS 17 measurement model (GMM/PAA/VFA), posting period, reversal indicators, SOX control reference, and preparer/approver workflow for financial close. Supports LDTI transition adjustments and PBR reserve entries.
products.reference: Journal Entry — FASB ASC 944, IFRS 17, NAIC SAP

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry record. Primary key for the journal entry entity.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific insurance policy or annuity contract associated with this journal entry. Populated for policy-level transactions such as premium revenue recognition, claim payments, surrender processing, and policy-specific reserve adjustments.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Policy Forms and Rate Filings

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: journal_entry has legal_entity_code (STRING) and should FK to legal_entity. Journal entries are posted within a legal entity; FK is essential for legal entity financial statements and consolidation.

attributes.name: reversed_entry_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated when this entry is a reversing entry, creating an audit trail back to the original transaction.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: Reserve-related journal entries (pbr_indicator, ldti_indicator flagged) must be traceable to their actuarial valuation run. This supports the reserve-to-GL reconciliation process — a key SOX control i

attributes.name: accounting_basis
attributes.description: The accounting framework under which this journal entry is recorded. SAP = Statutory Accounting Principles (regulatory), GAAP = Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP), IFRS17 = International Financial Reporting Standards 17 (insurance contracts), TAX = Tax basis reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC SAP, IFRS 17, IRS Publication 542

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period to which this journal entry is assigned, typically in YYYY-MM format (e.g., 2024-03 for March 2024). Used for period-end close processes and financial reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was approved for posting. Used to track approval workflow timing and ensure timely financial close processes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who approved the journal entry. Used for financial close workflow tracking and audit documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch or group of journal entries processed together. Used for bulk posting operations, system-generated entries from upstream processes, and batch-level reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational cost center responsible for this journal entry. Used for management reporting, budget vs. actual variance analysis, and expense allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the journal entry record was first created in the database. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The total credit amount for this journal entry header. In double-entry accounting, this must equal debit_amount to maintain balance. Represents increases to liability, equity, and revenue accounts or decreases to asset and expense accounts.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, GAAP Double-Entry Accounting Principles

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the journal entry amounts. Typically USD for US-domiciled life insurance companies, but may include other currencies for international operations or foreign investments.
attributes.references: ISO 4217, FASB ASC 830 Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: The total debit amount for this journal entry header. In double-entry accounting, this must equal credit_amount to maintain balance. Represents increases to asset and expense accounts or decreases to liability, equity, and revenue accounts.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, GAAP Double-Entry Accounting Principles

attributes.name: entry_category
attributes.description: High-level business classification of the journal entry purpose. Examples: Premium Revenue, DAC Amortization, Reserve Movement, Claim Payment, Commission Accrual, Investment Income, Intercompany Settlement, Reinsurance Cession, Policy Acquisition Cost, Benefit Payment, Surrender Processing, LDTI Adjustment, PBR Reserve Entry.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the journal entry was created or recorded in the system. May differ from posting_date for adjusting or backdated entries.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: entry_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique journal entry number assigned by the general ledger system. Used for external audit trails and financial close documentation.

attributes.name: entry_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the journal entry. Draft = in preparation, Pending Approval = submitted for review, Approved = authorized but not yet posted, Posted = committed to general ledger, Reversed = entry has been reversed, Rejected = not approved for posting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry based on its purpose in the accounting cycle. Standard = routine operational entries, Adjusting = period-end accruals and deferrals, Reversing = automatic reversal of prior period adjusting entries, Closing = period-end closing entries, Opening = beginning of period entries, Reclassification = reallocation between accounts.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency amounts to functional currency. Populated only for entries involving foreign currency transactions.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this journal entry belongs. Used for annual financial statement preparation and multi-year comparative reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: functional_currency_credit
attributes.description: The credit amount converted to the company's functional currency (typically USD) using the applicable exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting when original entry is in a foreign currency.

attributes.name: functional_currency_debit
attributes.description: The debit amount converted to the company's functional currency (typically USD) using the applicable exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting when original entry is in a foreign currency.

attributes.name: ifrs17_measurement_model
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) 17 Measurement Model
attributes.description: The IFRS 17 measurement model applied to this journal entry for insurance contract accounting. GMM = General Measurement Model (building block approach), PAA = Premium Allocation Approach (simplified for short-duration contracts), VFA = Variable Fee Approach (for participating contracts with investment components).

attributes.name: intercompany_entity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the counterparty legal entity for intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany reconciliation and consolidated financial statement elimination entries. Populated only when intercompany_indicator is True.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810, NAIC Holding Company System Regulation

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry involves intercompany transactions between legal entities within the insurance group. True = entry requires intercompany elimination for consolidated reporting, False = intra-entity entry.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 810 Consolidation, NAIC Holding Company System Regulation

attributes.name: journal_entry_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the journal entry purpose, business rationale, and supporting documentation references. Used for audit trails, financial close documentation, and regulatory examinations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, NAIC Financial Examination Handbook

attributes.name: ldti_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is related to FASB ASU 2018-12 Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) accounting changes. True = entry is part of LDTI implementation (e.g., transition adjustments, updated DAC amortization, market risk benefit remeasurement), False = standard entry not impacted by LDTI.

attributes.name: pbr_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry relates to Principle-Based Reserving (PBR) calculations under VM-20 and VM-21. True = entry records PBR reserves, stochastic reserve adjustments, or deterministic reserve calculations, False = entry not related to PBR.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when the journal entry was committed to the general ledger. Used for audit trails and to track financial close process timing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger. This is the effective date for financial statement impact and determines the accounting period assignment.

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who prepared the journal entry. Used for financial close workflow tracking and audit documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the insurance product line to which this journal entry relates. Examples: Term Life, Whole Life, Universal Life, Variable Universal Life, Fixed Annuity, Variable Annuity, Indexed Annuity. Used for product-level profitability analysis and segment reporting.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 280 Segment Reporting, NAIC Annual Statement Exhibit 5

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which this journal entry will be or was automatically reversed. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, GAAP Accrual Accounting Standards

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is configured to automatically reverse in the subsequent accounting period. True = entry will auto-reverse, False = entry is permanent. Commonly used for accruals and deferrals.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, GAAP Accrual Accounting Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The upstream system or module that originated this journal entry. Examples include Policy Administration System, Claims Management System, Billing System, Actuarial Valuation System, Investment Management System, or Manual Entry for finance-initiated entries.

attributes.name: sox_control_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the SOX internal control that governs this journal entry. Used to document control testing, segregation of duties, and audit evidence for SOX 404 compliance. Examples: JE-001 (Standard Entries), JE-002 (Manual Adjusting Entries), JE-003 (Management Review Entries).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the journal entry record was last modified. Used for audit trails, change tracking, and data quality monitoring.

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit and credit line items within a journal entry. Captures account code, cost center, legal entity, product line, debit/credit amount in functional and reporting currency, IFRS 17 insurance contract group reference, reinsurance ceded/assumed indicator, and intercompany elimination flag. Enables granular drill-down from financial statements to source transactions. Supports multi-currency translation and FX revaluation entries.

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for the journal entry line product.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: journal_entry_line has gl_account_code (STRING) but should FK to chart_of_accounts for referential integrity and to retrieve account metadata via JOIN. gl_account_name is redundant and can be retrieve

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific claim associated with this journal entry line, if applicable. Links claim payments and reserves to general ledger entries.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

products.name: cost_center

products.name: statutory_reserve
products.description: SSOT for finance-booked statutory (SAP) reserve balances by policy cohort, product line, valuation basis, legal entity, and reporting period. Captures statutory reserve amount, PBR (Principle-Based Reserving) reserve per VM-20 (life) and VM-21 (variable annuity), CARVM reserve (annuity), CRVM reserve (life), reserve basis (CSO mortality table, valuation interest rate), reinsurance ceded reserve, net amount at risk (NAR), and reserve adequacy margin. Distinct from actuarial domain reserve calculations which are the source computations — this product owns the finance-booked statutory reserve position after actuarial hand-off and management sign-off.
