attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.value. Business justification: GAAP LDTI reserve calculations reference specific policy value snapshots for cash flow projections and discount rate application. Direct FK to the policy value record supports LDTI cohort reconciliati

attributes.name: actual_experience_effect_amount
attributes.description: The financial impact on the reserve balance resulting from actual experience differing from expected assumptions (e.g., actual mortality vs. expected mortality).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this reserve balance was approved by the Chief Actuary or designated authority for inclusion in financial statements.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual (typically Chief Actuary or Finance Officer) who approved this reserve calculation.

attributes.name: assumption_change_effect_amount
attributes.description: The financial impact (increase or decrease) on the reserve balance resulting from changes in actuarial assumptions during the reporting period, as required by LDTI disclosure.

attributes.name: assumption_update_date
attributes.description: The date when the cash flow assumptions were last updated or reviewed for this reserve calculation.

attributes.name: cash_flow_assumption_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the set of actuarial assumptions (mortality, lapse, expense, etc.) used to project future cash flows for this reserve calculation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this reserve record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the reserve amount.

attributes.name: dac_asset_amount
attributes.description: The deferred acquisition cost asset balance associated with this contract group, amortized over the life of the contracts under GAAP.

attributes.name: discount_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The discount rate percentage applied to calculate the net present value of future policy benefits, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.04500 for 4.5%).

attributes.name: discount_rate_type
attributes.description: The type of discount rate applied to calculate the present value of future cash flows. LOCKED_IN=original cohort rate locked at issue, UPPER_MEDIUM_GRADE=current upper-medium grade fixed income instrument rate, CURRENT_MARKET=current market observable rate.

attributes.name: expense_assumption_per_policy
attributes.description: The assumed annual maintenance expense per policy used in the cash flow projections for this reserve calculation.

attributes.name: external_audit_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reserve balance has been reviewed and validated by external auditors as part of the annual financial statement audit.

attributes.name: face_amount_total
attributes.description: The total face amount (death benefit or account value) of all policies included in this reserve calculation.

attributes.name: gaap_vs_statutory_difference_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) vs Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP) Difference Amount
attributes.description: The difference between the GAAP reserve balance and the corresponding statutory reserve balance for the same contract group, used for reconciliation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: lapse_rate_assumption_percentage
attributes.description: The assumed annual lapse (policy termination) rate used in the cash flow projections for this reserve calculation, expressed as a decimal.

attributes.name: ldti_cohort_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) Cohort Year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the insurance contracts were issued, used for LDTI cohort grouping under FASB ASC 944-40.

attributes.name: ldti_transition_adjustment_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) Transition Adjustment Amount
attributes.description: The cumulative adjustment to the reserve balance resulting from the transition to LDTI accounting standards (ASU 2018-12), typically recorded as a cumulative effect adjustment to retained earnings.

attributes.name: mrb_fair_value_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Market Risk Benefit (MRB) Fair Value Amount
attributes.description: The fair value measurement of market risk benefits (e.g., GMDB, GMIB, GMWB) embedded in variable annuity and variable life contracts, measured at fair value under LDTI.

attributes.name: mrb_instrument_credit_risk_adjustment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Market Risk Benefit (MRB) Instrument Credit Risk Adjustment
attributes.description: The adjustment to MRB fair value reflecting the company's own credit risk (non-performance risk) as required under fair value measurement guidance.

attributes.name: net_reserve_amount
attributes.description: The net GAAP reserve balance after deducting reinsurance recoverables (reserve_amount minus reinsurance_recoverable_amount).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, explanations, or commentary regarding this reserve calculation, including any unusual adjustments or methodology changes.

attributes.name: policy_count
attributes.description: The number of in-force insurance policies included in this reserve calculation for the contract group and reporting period.

attributes.name: premium_deficiency_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Additional reserve established when a loss recognition event is identified (i.e., when the present value of expected future cash flows exceeds the existing reserve plus anticipated future premiums).

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Insurance product line classification. WL=Whole Life, UL=Universal Life, IUL=Indexed Universal Life, VUL=Variable Universal Life, TERM=Term Life, SPIA=Single Premium Immediate Annuity, FIA=Fixed Indexed Annuity, VA=Variable Annuity, DI=Disability Income, LTC=Long-Term Care. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|TERM|SPIA|FIA|VA|DI|LTC — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reserve_adequacy_test_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent reserve adequacy test was performed.

attributes.name: reserve_adequacy_test_status
attributes.description: The result of the most recent reserve adequacy testing (loss recognition testing) performed to ensure reserves are sufficient to cover expected future obligations.

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: The total GAAP reserve balance amount for this contract group and reporting period, measured in accordance with FASB ASC 944 and LDTI standards.

attributes.name: reserve_calculation_method
attributes.description: The actuarial methodology used to calculate the reserve balance (e.g., net premium method, gross premium method, benefit reserve method, fair value measurement).

attributes.name: reserve_category
attributes.description: Classification of the GAAP reserve type. FPB=Future Policy Benefit, PAB=Policyholder Account Balance, MRB=Market Risk Benefit, CLAIM=Claim Reserve, IBNR=Incurred But Not Reported, UNEARNED=Unearned Premium Reserve.

attributes.name: reserve_status
attributes.description: The current status of this reserve calculation in the financial close process. PRELIMINARY=initial calculation, FINAL=approved for financial statements, ADJUSTED=post-close adjustment, RESTATED=prior period restatement.

attributes.name: sox_control_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reserve balance has been certified under SOX internal controls for financial reporting accuracy and completeness.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this reserve record was last modified.

products.name: ifrs17_contract_group
products.description: SSOT for IFRS 17 insurance contract group definitions and periodic measurement roll-forwards. Defines the unit of account: portfolio identifier, cohort year, profitability classification (onerous, not onerous, remaining coverage), measurement model (GMM, PAA, VFA), and reinsurance contract group linkage. Records all periodic measurement roll-forwards: opening/closing fulfilment cash flows (FCF), contractual service margin (CSM) opening/closing balance, release pattern, and movement analysis, risk adjustment for non-financial risk and movement, loss component for onerous groups, insurance revenue recognized, insurance service expense, insurance finance income/expense, OCI vs. P&L allocation election, experience variance, assumption change impact, and reinsurance held measurement. Serves as SSOT for IFRS 17 contract group definitions, measurement disclosures, and statement of financial position / profit or loss reporting.

attributes.name: ifrs17_contract_group_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IFRS 17 insurance contract group. Represents the unit of account for measurement and disclosure under IFRS 17.

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.assumption_set. Business justification: IFRS17 contract group CSM and FCF are directly driven by actuarial assumption sets. Direct link enables IFRS17 assumption change attribution at the contract group level — required for IFRS17 Note 39 d

attributes.name: cohort_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.cohort_definition. Business justification: IFRS17 contract groups ARE cohorts under the standard (annual cohorts of onerous/non-onerous contracts). Direct link enables cohort-level CSM tracking, loss component management, and regulatory disclo

attributes.name: grouping_policy_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: IFRS 17 contract grouping decisions require documented policies, cohort definitions, and onerous contract assessments. IFRS 17 disclosure preparation and audit depend on linking contract groups to sup

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: IFRS 17 insurance contract groups are defined and measured at the legal entity level — each contract group belongs to a specific reporting legal entity. ifrs17_contract_group currently has no legal_en

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: IFRS 17 contract groups are defined by product and cohort year for international financial reporting. Required for CSM calculation, insurance revenue recognition, and onerous contract testing. Links c

attributes.name: reinsurance_contract_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance contract group held that covers this direct insurance contract group, if applicable.

attributes.name: risk_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to underwriting.risk_class. Business justification: IFRS 17 requires contract groups to be segregated by profitability and risk profile at initial recognition. Underwriting risk class is a primary determinant of onerous vs. non-onerous contract group c

attributes.name: closing_csm_balance
attributes.description: The unearned profit component at the end of the reporting period after all movements including release, interest accretion, and adjustments.

attributes.name: closing_fcf_estimate
attributes.description: The present value of future cash flows at the end of the reporting period after all movements and adjustments.

attributes.name: contract_boundary_assessment
attributes.description: Description of the contract boundary determination, identifying the point at which the entity has the practical ability to reassess risks and can set a price that reflects those risks.

attributes.name: contract_group_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the contract group used in financial reporting and actuarial systems.

attributes.name: coverage_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this measurement relates to the liability for remaining coverage or the liability for incurred claims.

attributes.name: coverage_units_closing
attributes.description: The quantity of coverage units at the end of the period after adjustments for service provided and changes in expected coverage.

attributes.name: coverage_units_opening
attributes.description: The quantity of coverage units at the beginning of the period, used to determine the pattern of CSM release. Coverage units represent the quantity of service provided by the contracts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this contract group record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: csm_assumption_change_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contractual Service Margin (CSM) Assumption Change Impact
attributes.description: Adjustments to CSM resulting from changes in estimates of future cash flows relating to future service, excluding changes in financial assumptions when the entity has chosen to disaggregate insurance finance income or expense.

attributes.name: csm_currency_exchange_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contractual Service Margin (CSM) Currency Exchange Impact
attributes.description: The effect of changes in foreign exchange rates on the CSM for contracts denominated in foreign currencies.

attributes.name: csm_experience_variance
attributes.description: Adjustments to CSM for differences between expected and actual cash flows relating to future service.

attributes.name: csm_interest_accretion
attributes.description: The interest accreted on the CSM balance during the period using discount rates determined at initial recognition.

attributes.name: csm_new_business_addition
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contractual Service Margin (CSM) New Business Addition
attributes.description: The CSM arising from new contracts added to the group during the period.

attributes.name: csm_release_amount
attributes.description: The amount of CSM recognized as insurance revenue in the current period based on coverage units provided.

attributes.name: derecognition_date
attributes.description: The date when the contract group was derecognized from the statement of financial position, when all rights and obligations are extinguished or transferred.

attributes.name: discount_rate_closing
attributes.description: The discount rate applied to the fulfilment cash flows at the end of the reporting period.

attributes.name: discount_rate_opening
attributes.description: The discount rate applied to the fulfilment cash flows at the beginning of the reporting period, reflecting the time value of money and financial risk.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the primary economic environment in which the entity operates for this contract group.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: ifrs17_contract_group_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the contract group: active (in force), closed (no longer accepting new contracts but existing contracts remain), or derecognized (fully extinguished).

attributes.name: initial_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date when the contract group was first recognized in the financial statements, typically the earliest of: beginning of coverage period, first payment due, or when the group becomes onerous.

attributes.name: insurance_finance_income_expense
attributes.description: The change in the carrying amount of the group of insurance contracts arising from the time value of money, financial risk, and changes in financial risk.

attributes.name: insurance_revenue_recognized
attributes.description: The amount of insurance revenue recognized in profit or loss during the period, comprising the release of CSM, risk adjustment, and expected incurred claims.

attributes.name: insurance_service_expense
attributes.description: The total insurance service expenses recognized in profit or loss, including incurred claims, other incurred expenses, amortization of insurance acquisition cash flows, and losses on onerous contracts.

attributes.name: loss_component_closing
attributes.description: The closing balance of the loss component for onerous contract groups after movements during the period.

attributes.name: loss_component_opening
attributes.description: The opening balance of the loss component for onerous contract groups. Represents the extent to which the fulfilment cash flows exceed the carrying amount of the liability for remaining coverage.

attributes.name: measurement_model
attributes.description: The IFRS 17 measurement model applied to this contract group: General Measurement Model (GMM), Premium Allocation Approach (PAA), or Variable Fee Approach (VFA) for direct participating contracts.

attributes.name: oci_amount
attributes.description: The portion of insurance finance income or expense recognized in other comprehensive income when the entity has elected to disaggregate insurance finance income or expense.

attributes.name: oci_pl_allocation_election
attributes.business_glossary_term: Other Comprehensive Income (OCI) vs Profit or Loss (P&L) Allocation Election
attributes.description: The accounting policy choice for presenting insurance finance income or expense: entirely in profit or loss, or disaggregated between profit or loss and OCI.

attributes.name: opening_csm_balance
attributes.description: The unearned profit component at the beginning of the reporting period. Represents the unearned profit the entity will recognize as it provides services under the insurance contracts.

attributes.name: opening_fcf_estimate
attributes.description: The present value of future cash flows at the beginning of the reporting period. Comprises estimates of future cash flows, discount rate adjustment, and risk adjustment for non-financial risk.

attributes.name: profitability_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the contract group based on initial recognition assessment: onerous (expected to be loss-making), not onerous (profitable), or no significant possibility of becoming onerous.

attributes.name: reporting_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the contract group measurements are reported.

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the reporting period for which this contract group measurement applies.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the reporting period for which this contract group measurement applies.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_closing
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment for Non-Financial Risk Closing Balance
attributes.description: The compensation the entity requires for bearing the uncertainty about the amount and timing of cash flows from non-financial risk at the end of the period.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_opening
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Adjustment for Non-Financial Risk Opening Balance
attributes.description: The compensation the entity requires for bearing the uncertainty about the amount and timing of cash flows from non-financial risk at the beginning of the period.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_release
attributes.description: The amount of risk adjustment recognized in profit or loss as the entity is released from risk during the period.

attributes.name: transition_approach
attributes.description: The transition method applied when IFRS 17 was first adopted for this contract group: full retrospective application, modified retrospective approach, or fair value approach.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this contract group record was last modified.

products.name: ifrs17_measurement
products.description: Periodic IFRS 17 measurement roll-forward by insurance contract group and reporting period. Captures opening/closing fulfilment cash flows (FCF), contractual service margin (CSM) movement, risk adjustment movement, insurance revenue recognized, insurance service expense, insurance finance income/expense, OCI vs. P&L allocation, experience variance, assumption change impact, and reinsurance held measurement. Supports IFRS 17 statement of financial position and statement of profit or loss disclosures.

attributes.name: ifrs17_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the IFRS 17 measurement record.

attributes.name: actuarial_report_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: CSM releases and risk adjustment changes require supporting actuarial reports and assumption change documentation. Quarterly IFRS 17 measurement and disclosure processes depend on linking measurements

attributes.name: assumption_set_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.assumption_set. Business justification: IFRS17 requires disclosure of assumption changes and their CSM/FCF impact. Direct link from ifrs17_measurement to assumption_set enables assumption unlock analysis and IFRS17 Note disclosures — a mand

attributes.name: cash_flow_projection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.cash_flow_projection. Business justification: IFRS17 fulfilment cash flows (FCF) are directly sourced from actuarial cash_flow_projection. Direct FK enables IFRS17 FCF reconciliation and supports IFRS17 Note disclosures on future cash flow estima

attributes.name: ifrs17_contract_group_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the insurance contract group to which this measurement applies. Contract groups are portfolios of insurance contracts managed together under IFRS 17.

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the actuarial valuation run that produced this measurement, linking to the actuarial system for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: acquisition_expense
attributes.description: Expenses incurred during the reporting period for acquiring new insurance contracts, including commissions and underwriting costs.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the individual who approved this measurement for financial reporting, supporting SOX compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this measurement was approved for financial reporting.

attributes.name: assumption_change_impact
attributes.description: The total impact on the insurance contract liability from changes in actuarial assumptions during the reporting period.

attributes.name: closing_csm
attributes.description: The closing balance of the Contractual Service Margin at the end of the reporting period.

attributes.name: closing_fcf_estimate
attributes.description: The closing balance of the present value of future cash flows at the end of the reporting period.

attributes.name: closing_risk_adjustment
attributes.description: The closing balance of the risk adjustment for non-financial risk at the end of the reporting period.

attributes.name: cohort_year
attributes.description: The year in which the insurance contracts in this group were initially recognized, used for cohort-based measurement under IFRS 17.

attributes.name: coverage_units
attributes.description: The quantity of coverage units provided during the reporting period, used to allocate CSM release. Coverage units reflect the quantity of benefits provided under the insurance contracts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this measurement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: csm_assumption_change
attributes.description: Adjustment to CSM arising from changes in estimates of future cash flows that relate to future service (e.g., changes in mortality, lapse, expense assumptions).

attributes.name: csm_experience_adjustment
attributes.description: Adjustment to CSM arising from differences between actual experience and previous estimates (experience variances) that relate to future service.

attributes.name: csm_interest_accretion
attributes.description: The interest accreted on the CSM balance during the reporting period, calculated using the discount rate locked in at initial recognition.

attributes.name: csm_release_for_service
attributes.description: The amount of CSM released to profit or loss as insurance revenue during the reporting period, reflecting the insurance service provided.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the measurement amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: The discount rate applied to future cash flows for this measurement, reflecting the time value of money and characteristics of the cash flows.

attributes.name: experience_variance
attributes.description: The difference between actual experience and previous estimates during the reporting period, recognized immediately in profit or loss for past service.

attributes.name: finance_oci_component
attributes.description: The portion of insurance finance income or expense recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) during the reporting period, when the entity elects the OCI option.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Disaggregation of Insurance Finance Income or Expenses

attributes.name: finance_pl_component
attributes.description: The portion of insurance finance income or expense recognized in profit or loss during the reporting period.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Disaggregation of Insurance Finance Income or Expenses

attributes.name: incurred_claims
attributes.description: The amount of claims incurred during the reporting period, including claims paid and changes in claims liabilities.

attributes.name: insurance_finance_expense
attributes.description: Finance expense recognized during the reporting period from the unwinding of discount on insurance contract liabilities and changes in discount rates.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Insurance Finance Income or Expenses

attributes.name: insurance_finance_income
attributes.description: Finance income recognized during the reporting period from the unwinding of discount on insurance contract liabilities and changes in discount rates.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Insurance Finance Income or Expenses

attributes.name: insurance_revenue
attributes.description: Total insurance revenue recognized in profit or loss during the reporting period, comprising CSM release, risk adjustment release, and expected claims and expenses.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Statement of Profit or Loss

attributes.name: insurance_service_expense
attributes.description: Total insurance service expenses recognized in profit or loss during the reporting period, including incurred claims, acquisition expenses, and other directly attributable expenses.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Standard - Statement of Profit or Loss

attributes.name: loss_component
attributes.description: The loss component balance for onerous contract groups, tracked separately to determine the allocation of subsequent changes in fulfilment cash flows.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the IFRS 17 measurement is performed, typically the reporting period end date.

attributes.name: measurement_model
attributes.description: The IFRS 17 measurement model applied to this contract group: General Measurement Model (GMM), Premium Allocation Approach (PAA), or Variable Fee Approach (VFA).
attributes.value_regex: General Measurement Model|Premium Allocation Approach|Variable Fee Approach

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: The status of this measurement record in the financial close process: Draft (work in progress), Preliminary (under review), Final (approved for reporting), or Restated (corrected after initial reporting).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this measurement record was last modified.

attributes.name: onerous_contract_loss
attributes.description: Loss recognized immediately in profit or loss when a group of insurance contracts becomes onerous (i.e., the fulfilment cash flows exceed any remaining CSM).

attributes.name: opening_csm
attributes.description: The opening balance of the Contractual Service Margin at the beginning of the reporting period. CSM represents the unearned profit that will be recognized as insurance revenue over the coverage period.

attributes.name: opening_fcf_estimate
attributes.description: The opening balance of the present value of future cash flows (estimates of future cash inflows and outflows) at the beginning of the reporting period.

attributes.name: opening_risk_adjustment
attributes.description: The opening balance of the risk adjustment for non-financial risk at the beginning of the reporting period. Risk adjustment represents the compensation required for bearing uncertainty about the amount and timing of cash flows.

attributes.name: reinsurance_held_csm
attributes.description: The CSM for reinsurance contracts held, representing the unearned benefit from reinsurance coverage.

attributes.name: reinsurance_held_fcf
attributes.description: The present value of future cash flows for reinsurance contracts held, representing the reinsurance asset or liability.

attributes.name: reinsurance_held_risk_adjustment
attributes.description: The risk adjustment for non-financial risk on reinsurance contracts held.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_change
attributes.description: Change in risk adjustment during the period due to changes in estimates of non-financial risk.

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_release
attributes.description: The amount of risk adjustment released to profit or loss during the reporting period as risk is reduced through the passage of time and claim settlement.

products.name: rbc_calculation

Captures total adjusted capital (TAC), authorized control level (ACL) RBC, company action level (CAL) RBC, C-0 (asset default) risk, C-1 (asset risk), C-2 (insurance/pricing risk), C-3 (interest rate/market risk), C-4 (business risk), covariance adjustment, RBC ratio, and regulatory action level trigger flags. attributes.name: plan_id

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RBC calculation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: filed_with_regulator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RBC calculation has been officially filed with the state insurance regulator.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RBC report was filed with the state insurance department.

attributes.name: filing_method
attributes.description: Method used to file the RBC report with the regulator (electronic, paper, exempt).

attributes.name: mandatory_control_level_rbc
attributes.description: The mandatory control level RBC amount. Represents the threshold at which the regulator must place the company under regulatory control.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #312 - Risk-Based Capital for Insurers

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this RBC calculation record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RBC calculation record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and commentary regarding the RBC calculation, including assumptions, adjustments, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: orsa_alignment_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) Alignment Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RBC calculation aligns with the company's ORSA capital assessment and risk management framework.

attributes.name: rbc_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of Total Adjusted Capital to Authorized Control Level RBC, expressed as a percentage. Key metric for regulatory capital adequacy.

attributes.name: regulator_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The state or jurisdiction code of the primary insurance regulator (e.g., NY, CA, TX).

attributes.name: regulatory_action_level_rbc
attributes.description: The regulatory action level RBC amount. Represents the threshold at which the regulator may take corrective action.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Act #312 - Risk-Based Capital for Insurers

attributes.name: reporting_quarter
attributes.description: The quarter within the reporting year (1-4). Null for annual-only calculations.

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which RBC is being reported.

attributes.name: total_adjusted_capital
attributes.description: Total adjusted capital available to support risk. Calculated as statutory capital and surplus plus other adjustments per NAIC formula.

attributes.name: total_rbc_after_covariance
attributes.description: Total RBC requirement after applying the covariance adjustment for diversification.

attributes.name: total_rbc_before_covariance
attributes.description: Sum of all RBC risk components (C-0 through C-4) before applying the covariance adjustment.

attributes.name: trend_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the RBC trend test comparing current year to prior year capital adequacy (pass, fail, not_applicable).

products.name: tax_provision
products.description: Income tax provision records by legal entity and reporting period. Captures current tax expense, deferred tax expense/benefit, effective tax rate, deferred tax asset (DTA) balance, deferred tax liability (DTL) balance, valuation allowance, uncertain tax position (UTP) reserve under ASC 740-10, temporary difference components (DAC, reserves, unrealized gains), IRC Section 7702 tax compliance impact, and tax return-to-provision true-up. Supports GAAP income tax footnote disclosure and statutory tax exhibit.

attributes.name: tax_provision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the income tax provision record. Primary key for the tax provision entity.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: Tax provisions are posted to specific GL accounts defined in the chart of accounts (e.g., current tax expense, deferred tax asset/liability accounts). tax_provision currently has no chart_of_accounts_

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity for which this tax provision is recorded. Each legal entity files separate tax returns and maintains separate tax positions.

attributes.name: supporting_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Tax provisions require supporting documentation: IRS correspondence, external auditor workpapers, tax return filings, and SOX control evidence. Life insurance finance teams attach provision documentat

attributes.name: tax_compliance_test_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to policy.tax_compliance_test. Business justification: Tax provision IRC 7702 adjustment field is directly driven by policy-level compliance test results (MEC status, 7-pay limits). Finance tax teams reference compliance test records when computing irc_77

attributes.name: valuation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.valuation. Business justification: Tax provision deferred tax calculation requires investment fair values for unrealized gain/loss temporary differences (tax_provision.unrealized_gain_temporary_difference). ASC 740 and IRC Section 1221

attributes.name: valuation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.valuation_run. Business justification: tax_provision.reserve_temporary_difference and dac_temporary_difference are derived from actuarial valuation results. Direct link to valuation_run supports IRC 807 tax reserve calculations, deferred t

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current status of tax authority audit or examination for this tax period. Tracks IRS or state tax authority review lifecycle.

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax provision calculation was performed. Used for audit trail and version control.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax provision record was first created in the system. Part of standard audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this tax provision record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: current_tax_expense
attributes.description: The portion of total income tax expense attributable to taxes currently payable or refundable for the reporting period. Represents cash tax impact.

attributes.name: dac_temporary_difference
attributes.description: Temporary difference arising from DAC capitalization for GAAP versus immediate deduction for tax. Major source of deferred tax liability for life insurance companies.
attributes.references: IRC Section 848 Capitalization of Policy Acquisition Expenses

attributes.name: deferred_tax_expense
attributes.description: The portion of total income tax expense attributable to changes in deferred tax assets and liabilities. Positive values represent expense; negative values represent benefit.

attributes.name: dta_balance
attributes.description: Total deferred tax asset balance as of the reporting period end. Represents future tax benefits from temporary differences, NOL carryforwards, and tax credit carryforwards.

attributes.name: dtl_balance
attributes.description: Total deferred tax liability balance as of the reporting period end. Represents future tax obligations from temporary differences such as accelerated depreciation and DAC capitalization.

attributes.name: effective_tax_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of total income tax expense to pretax income, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2100 for 21%). Key metric for tax efficiency analysis and rate reconciliation disclosure.

attributes.name: external_auditor_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax provision has been reviewed by external auditors as part of financial statement audit procedures.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this tax provision applies (e.g., 2024). Used for multi-year tax analysis and trend reporting.

attributes.name: foreign_tax_expense
attributes.description: Income tax expense attributable to foreign jurisdictions. Includes taxes paid to foreign governments on international operations and investments.

attributes.name: gaap_reporting_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) Reporting Basis
attributes.description: The accounting framework under which this tax provision was prepared (US GAAP, IFRS, or Statutory Accounting Principles).

attributes.name: irc_7702_adjustment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internal Revenue Code (IRC) Section 7702 Tax Compliance Adjustment
attributes.description: Tax provision adjustment related to IRC Section 7702 life insurance contract qualification testing. Ensures products meet tax-favored treatment requirements.
attributes.references: IRC Section 7702 Life Insurance Contract Defined

attributes.name: ldti_tax_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Long Duration Targeted Improvements (LDTI) Tax Impact
attributes.description: Tax provision impact from FASB ASU 2018-12 LDTI implementation. Captures deferred tax effects of changes in insurance liability measurement and DAC amortization.
attributes.references: ASC 944-40 LDTI and ASC 740-10 Tax Effects

attributes.name: net_deferred_tax_position
attributes.description: Net deferred tax asset or liability, calculated as DTA balance minus DTL balance. Positive values indicate net asset; negative values indicate net liability.

attributes.name: nol_carryforward
attributes.description: Tax net operating loss carryforward available to offset future taxable income. Generates deferred tax asset based on expected utilization and statutory tax rate.
attributes.references: IRC Section 172 Net Operating Loss Deduction

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for documenting significant assumptions, judgments, tax planning strategies, or unusual items affecting the tax provision. Supports audit documentation requirements.

attributes.name: permanent_difference_adjustment
attributes.description: Tax provision impact from permanent book-tax differences that do not reverse over time (e.g., tax-exempt interest, non-deductible expenses, dividends received deduction).

attributes.name: pretax_income
attributes.description: Income before income taxes per GAAP financial statements. Used as the base for effective tax rate calculation.

attributes.name: provision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax provision was calculated and recorded. Represents the business event timestamp for this tax calculation.

attributes.name: provision_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the tax provision for interim periods. Discrete method treats each period independently; annual effective rate method estimates full-year rate.

attributes.name: provision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax provision record. Tracks progression from initial draft through final audited state.

attributes.name: rate_change_impact
attributes.description: Impact on deferred tax balances from changes in enacted tax rates. Requires remeasurement of deferred tax assets and liabilities at new rates.

attributes.name: reserve_temporary_difference
attributes.description: Temporary difference between GAAP insurance reserves and tax reserves. Reflects differences in reserve calculation methodologies between financial reporting and tax compliance.

attributes.name: return_to_provision_adjustment
attributes.description: Adjustment to reconcile prior period tax provision estimates to actual amounts reported on filed tax returns. Recorded when tax returns are finalized.

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the senior tax professional who reviewed and approved this tax provision. Required for segregation of duties.

attributes.name: sox_control_certification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax provision has been reviewed and certified under SOX Section 404 internal control requirements. Required for public companies.

attributes.name: state_tax_expense
attributes.description: Income tax expense attributable to state and local jurisdictions. Tracked separately from federal tax for rate reconciliation and multi-state tax planning.
attributes.references: State Departments of Insurance Tax Regulations

attributes.name: statutory_tax_rate
attributes.description: The federal statutory corporate income tax rate applicable to the reporting period (e.g., 0.2100 for 21% under IRC Section 11). Starting point for effective tax rate reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_credit_carryforward
attributes.description: Tax credits available to reduce future tax liabilities, including general business credits, foreign tax credits, and alternative minimum tax credits. Generates deferred tax asset.

attributes.name: tax_return_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax return for this period has been filed with tax authorities. True when return is filed; False when provision is estimated.

attributes.name: total_tax_expense
attributes.description: Total income tax expense for the period, calculated as the sum of current tax expense and deferred tax expense. Reported on the GAAP income statement.

attributes.name: unrealized_gain_temporary_difference
attributes.description: Temporary difference from unrealized gains and losses on investments recognized in GAAP financial statements but not yet taxable. Includes available-for-sale securities and fair value adjustments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 1001 Realization of Gain or Loss

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tax provision record was last modified. Tracks all subsequent changes after initial creation.

attributes.name: utp_reserve
attributes.description: Reserve for unrecognized tax benefits under ASC 740-10 (formerly FIN 48). Represents tax positions that do not meet the more-likely-than-not recognition threshold.

attributes.name: valuation_allowance
attributes.description: Contra-asset account reducing deferred tax assets to the amount that is more-likely-than-not to be realized. Reflects management judgment on future taxable income sufficiency.

products.name: reinsurance_recoverable
products.description: SSOT for finance-booked reinsurance recoverable balances from ceded reinsurance treaties. Captures reinsurer name, treaty reference, recoverable type (ceded reserve, ceded claim, ceded premium), gross recoverable amount, allowance for uncollectible reinsurance, net recoverable balance, credit quality of reinsurer (AM Best rating), collateral held (LOC, trust, funds withheld), SAP vs. GAAP recoverable basis, and aging of recoverable. Supports statutory balance sheet Schedule F reporting, GAAP reinsurance accounting under ASC 944, and counterparty credit risk management. Distinct from reinsurance domain treaty administration — this product owns the finance-booked recoverable position for financial statement presentation.
products.reference: Reinsurance Recoverable — NAIC SAP Schedule F, FASB ASC 944-40

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_id
attributes.description: Primary key for reinsurance_recoverable

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.chart_of_accounts. Business justification: reinsurance_recoverable has gl_account_code (STRING) and should FK to chart_of_accounts. Recoverables are booked to GL accounts; FK is essential for financial statement classification and RBC reportin

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the underlying claim to which this recoverable relates, if applicable.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: reinsurance_recoverable has cost_center_code (STRING) and should FK to cost_center. Recoverables are allocated to cost centers for expense management; FK enables cost allocation tracking.

attributes.name: in_force_policy_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the underlying insurance policy to which this recoverable relates, if applicable.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: reinsurance_recoverable has journal_entry_number (STRING) representing the JE that posted the recoverable. FK to journal_entry provides critical audit trail linking reinsurance accounting to financial

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: reinsurance_recoverable has legal_entity_code (STRING) and should FK to legal_entity. Recoverables are owned by legal entities; FK is essential for statutory reporting, RBC calculations, and credit ri

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the reinsurer counterparty from whom the recoverable is due.

attributes.name: reserve_calculation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to actuarial.reserve_calculation. Business justification: reinsurance_recoverable amounts are derived from actuarial reserve_calculation.reinsurance_ceded_reserve. Direct link supports ceded reserve reconciliation between finance and actuarial — a mandatory

attributes.name: treaty_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document. Business justification: Reinsurance recoverables require treaty documents, bordereaux, and collateral agreements for collectibility assessment. Quarterly reinsurance accounting and credit risk assessment depend on linking re

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the reinsurance treaty under which this recoverable arises.

attributes.name: accounting_basis
attributes.description: The accounting framework under which this recoverable balance is reported: Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP), Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), International Financial Reporting Standards 17 (IFRS17), or tax basis.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM format) to which this recoverable balance applies.

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: The aging category of the recoverable based on the number of days outstanding since the recoverable became due.

attributes.name: allowance_for_uncollectible
attributes.description: The estimated amount of the gross recoverable that may not be collectible due to reinsurer credit risk, recorded as a contra-asset.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status of this recoverable balance entry: draft, pending approval, approved, or rejected.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the individual who approved this recoverable balance for financial reporting.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recoverable balance was approved for financial reporting.

attributes.name: collateral_held_amount
attributes.description: The total value of collateral held to secure the recoverable, including letters of credit, trust accounts, and funds withheld.

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: The form of collateral securing the recoverable: letter of credit (LOC), trust account, funds withheld at source, or none.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recoverable balance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the recoverable amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: days_outstanding
attributes.description: The number of calendar days the recoverable has been outstanding since it became due for payment.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4) to which this recoverable balance applies for quarterly financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this recoverable balance applies for annual financial reporting.

attributes.name: gaap_classification
attributes.description: The balance sheet classification of the recoverable under GAAP: current asset (collectible within 12 months) or non-current asset.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this recoverable balance is posted in the chart of accounts.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 944, NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: gross_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: The total amount recoverable from the reinsurer before any allowance for uncollectible reinsurance or offsets.

attributes.name: ifrs17_csm_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards 17 (IFRS17) Contractual Service Margin (CSM) Impact
attributes.description: The impact of this recoverable on the Contractual Service Margin under IFRS 17 accounting for insurance contracts.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recoverable balance record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: net_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: The net recoverable balance after deducting the allowance for uncollectible reinsurance from the gross recoverable amount.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, explanations, or special circumstances related to this recoverable balance.

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recoverable balance was posted to the general ledger.

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: The product line code (e.g., term life, whole life, annuity) to which this recoverable relates for segment reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Exhibit of Premiums and Losses

attributes.name: rbc_category
attributes.description: The Risk-Based Capital category assigned to this recoverable for statutory capital adequacy calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Risk-Based Capital for Insurers Model Act

attributes.name: recoverable_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the recoverable: billed to reinsurer, unbilled (accrued but not yet invoiced), disputed, collected, or written off.

attributes.name: recoverable_type
attributes.description: Classification of the recoverable by its nature: ceded reserve, ceded claim payment, ceded premium refund, ceded benefit, or ceded commission.

attributes.name: reinsurer_credit_rating
attributes.description: The financial strength rating of the reinsurer as assigned by AM Best or equivalent rating agency (e.g., A++, A+, A, B++, NR for not rated).

attributes.name: sap_exhibit_line
attributes.description: The specific line item on the NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F or other exhibit where this recoverable is reported.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or code of the source system from which this recoverable balance originated (e.g., reinsurance management system, actuarial valuation system).

attributes.name: sox_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recoverable balance is subject to SOX internal control testing and audit procedures.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for which this recoverable balance was calculated and recorded.

domains.name: document
domains.description: Manages the full lifecycle of insurance documents — policy contracts, illustrations, applications, APS records, beneficiary change forms, endorsements, rider documents, regulatory filings, claim correspondence, and disclosure documents. Owns document metadata, version control, e-delivery consent, NIGO tracking for incomplete applications, document imaging, retention schedules aligned with state DOI requirements, and ACORD forms management.

products.name: document
products.description: Master registry of all insurance documents managed across the enterprise — policy contracts, applications, illustrations, endorsements, rider documents, claim correspondence, regulatory filings, and disclosure documents. Serves as the authoritative catalog entry for every document object with metadata including document type classification (FK to type), origination channel, source system, retention category, confidentiality level, and lifecycle status (draft, active, superseded, archived, destroyed). This is the SSOT for document identity and metadata within the document domain. All other domain entities (version, signature, access_log, workflow, delivery_event, legal_hold) reference this master record.

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Primary key for document

attributes.name: acord_form_id

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.counterparty. Business justification: Counterparties require ISDA master agreements, KYC documentation, credit agreements, W-8/W-9 tax forms, AML verification, and custodial agreements. Critical for counterparty onboarding, regulatory com

attributes.name: retention_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.retention_schedule. Business justification: Documents should link to their governing retention schedule. The retention_schedule table defines retention rules by document_type_code and jurisdiction. Many documents follow one retention schedule (

attributes.name: security_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to investment.security. Business justification: Securities require prospectus documents, offering memoranda, private placement memoranda, and SEC registration filings. Insurance investment operations must link CUSIP-level regulatory and offering do

attributes.name: template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_template. Business justification: Documents are generated from templates. A policy contract document is created from a policy_contract_template. Many documents can be generated from one template (N:1). No bidirectional conflict. Stron

attributes.name: type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_type. Business justification: Document has type_code (STRING) attribute but no FK to the document_type reference table. This is a missing normalization. The document_type table exists with document_type_id PK and contains code, na

attributes.name: archived_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document was moved to archive storage. Tracks transition from active to archived state per retention policy.

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level indicating the sensitivity of the document content. Determines access controls and handling requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document record was first created in the system. Audit trail for document lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: destroyed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document was destroyed per retention policy. Audit trail for compliance with record destruction requirements.

attributes.name: document_category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the document type. Used for broad classification and filtering of document inventory. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: policy|application|illustration|underwriting|claim|annuity|regulatory|disclosure|correspondence|form — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: document_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the document content, purpose, and context. Provides additional metadata for search and classification.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the document. Human-readable unique number assigned to the document for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: e_delivery_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the policyholder has consented to electronic delivery of this document type. True if e-delivery is authorized, false if paper delivery required.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the document becomes effective or enforceable. Relevant for policy contracts, endorsements, riders, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the document expires or is no longer valid. Relevant for time-limited documents such as illustrations, quotes, and temporary authorizations.

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Technical file format of the stored document. Identifies the MIME type or file extension for retrieval and rendering. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pdf|docx|tiff|jpeg|png|xml|html|txt — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Size of the document file in bytes. Used for storage management and transmission planning.

attributes.name: hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash of the document content. Used for integrity verification, tamper detection, and duplicate detection.

attributes.name: indexed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document was indexed for search and retrieval. Tracks completion of document imaging and metadata extraction processes.

attributes.name: is_latest_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document record represents the most current version. True if this is the active version, false if superseded.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: State or jurisdiction code where this document applies or was filed. Two-letter state abbreviation or country code for regulatory and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: legal_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is subject to a legal hold and must be preserved beyond normal retention schedules. True if under legal hold, false otherwise.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle. Tracks progression from draft through active use to archival or destruction per retention policy.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document record was last modified. Audit trail for tracking changes to document metadata.

attributes.name: nigo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is incomplete or missing required information. True if NIGO, false if complete and acceptable.

attributes.name: nigo_reason
attributes.description: Description of why the document was flagged as NIGO. Details missing information, incomplete sections, or quality issues that prevent processing.

attributes.name: origination_channel
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the document was received or created. Identifies the source interface for document intake. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile|email|fax|mail|agent_portal|customer_portal|call_center|branch — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: Number of pages in the document. Relevant for printed documents and multi-page electronic files.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when the document was received by the insurance company. Relevant for inbound documents such as applications, claim forms, and correspondence.

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body associated with this document. Examples include state Department of Insurance, NAIC, SEC, FINRA, IRS.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is a regulatory filing submitted to or received from a regulatory body. True if regulatory filing, false otherwise.

attributes.name: retention_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the document retention period expires and the document becomes eligible for destruction. Calculated based on retention category and applicable regulations.

attributes.name: signature_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document requires a signature for validity. True if signature is mandatory, false otherwise.

attributes.name: signature_status
attributes.description: Current status of signature collection for this document. Tracks progression through signature workflow.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that created or manages this document. Examples include policy administration system, claims system, underwriting workbench, document management system.

attributes.name: storage_location_uri
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Identifier pointing to the physical or logical storage location of the document file. May reference cloud storage, content management system, or file system path.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title or name of the document. Human-readable label that summarizes the document content or purpose.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the document. Tracks revisions and updates to the document over time.

products.name: version
products.description: Tracks the full version history of each insurance document, capturing every revision, amendment, re-issue, or correction event. Stores version number, effective date, author, change reason, checksum/hash for integrity verification, storage URI, file format (PDF, TIFF, XML), page count, and version status (draft, pending approval, approved, superseded, archived). Enables point-in-time retrieval of any document version for regulatory audit, litigation hold, or policyholder inquiry.

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each document version record. Primary key for the document version entity.

attributes.name: document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent document entity for which this version record exists. Links to the master document record.

attributes.name: superseded_by_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the document_version_id that supersedes this version. Null if this is the current active version. Enables version chain navigation.

attributes.name: template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.template. Business justification: Each version of a document was generated from a specific template version — tracking which template produced a given document version is essential for regulatory compliance (e.g., proving a policy con

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this document version received formal approval to transition from draft or pending status to approved status.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who approved this document version for release or publication. Required for versions that require formal approval workflow.

attributes.name: author_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or system user who created or authored this document version. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: author_role
attributes.description: Organizational role or job function of the author at the time of version creation (e.g., Underwriter, Policy Services Representative, Compliance Officer, Actuarial Analyst).

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or trigger for creating this new version. Examples include regulatory update, policyholder request, error correction, product enhancement, or compliance remediation.

attributes.name: checksum_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256, MD5) of the document file content. Used for integrity verification, tamper detection, and duplicate detection. Critical for regulatory audit and litigation hold.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this document version record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this document version becomes legally binding or operationally effective. Critical for regulatory compliance and policy servicing.

attributes.name: eligible_for_purge_date
attributes.description: Calculated date when this document version becomes eligible for deletion or purge based on retention_period_years and retention_trigger_date. Used for automated archival and compliance-driven purge processes.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Regulation on Record Retention

attributes.name: encryption_method
attributes.description: Encryption algorithm or method applied to the document file (e.g., AES-256, RSA-2048). Null if is_encrypted is false.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `life_insurance_ecm`.`_metrics`.`actuarial_assumption_set`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Assumption set governance metrics tracking the quality, completeness, and financial impact of actuarial assumptions used in valuation and pricing. Supports assumption change management, peer review compliance, and profitability target monitoring."
  source: "`life_insurance_ecm`.`actuarial`.`assumption_set`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "assumption_basis"
      expr: assumption_basis
      comment: "Basis of the assumption set (e.g., Best Estimate, Prudent, Regulatory), the primary classification for assumption governance."
    - name: "assumption_set_status"
      expr: assumption_set_status
      comment: "Status of the assumption set (e.g., Active, Superseded, Draft), used to filter to production-quality assumptions."
    - name: "regulatory_basis"
      expr: regulatory_basis
      comment: "Regulatory framework governing the assumption set (e.g., NAIC, IFRS17, GAAP), enabling multi-basis assumption tracking."
    - name: "model_platform"
      expr: model_platform
      comment: "Actuarial modeling platform used with this assumption set (e.g., MG-ALFA, Prophet, AXIS), supporting model governance."
    - name: "valuation_date"
      expr: valuation_date
      comment: "Valuation date for which the assumption set is applicable, aligning assumptions with reporting periods."
    - name: "effective_date"
      expr: effective_date
      comment: "Date from which the assumption set is effective, used to track assumption change history."
    - name: "peer_review_completed_flag"
      expr: peer_review_completed_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether peer review has been completed for the assumption set, a mandatory governance control under actuarial standards."
    - name: "reinsurance_assumption_flag"
      expr: reinsurance_assumption_flag
      comment: "Indicates whether reinsurance assumptions are included in the set, affecting net reserve and cash flow projections."
    - name: "interest_rate_scenario"
      expr: interest_rate_scenario
      comment: "Interest rate scenario underlying the assumption set (e.g., Level, Rising, Falling), used for scenario-based assumption analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "avg_investment_return_assumption_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(investment_return_assumption_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average investment return assumption across assumption sets. Monitors the interest rate environment embedded in assumptions and its adequacy relative to market conditions."
    - name: "avg_expense_loading_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(expense_loading_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average expense loading percentage across assumption sets. Tracks expense assumption levels and their impact on reserve and pricing adequacy."
    - name: "avg_credibility_factor"
      expr: AVG(CAST(credibility_factor AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average credibility factor applied across assumption sets. Measures the weight given to company-specific experience versus industry tables."
    - name: "avg_profit_margin_target_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(profit_margin_target_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average profit margin target embedded in assumption sets. Tracks whether assumptions are calibrated to achieve required profitability thresholds."
    - name: "avg_roi_target_pct"
      expr: AVG(CAST(roi_target_pct AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average ROI target across assumption sets. Monitors whether actuarial assumptions are aligned with the company's return on investment objectives."
    - name: "total_nbv_target_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(nbv_target_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total New Business Value target across assumption sets. Measures the aggregate expected value creation embedded in current actuarial assumptions."
    - name: "peer_reviewed_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN peer_review_completed_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of assumption sets with completed peer review. Tracks compliance with actuarial peer review requirements under ASOP and regulatory standards."
    - name: "active_assumption_set_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN assumption_set_status = 'Active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of currently active assumption sets. Monitors the breadth of active assumptions in use and identifies sets requiring review or update."
    - name: "assumption_set_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of assumption sets. Measures the scope of assumption governance activity across valuation and pricing processes."
$$
metric_views.description: Assumption set governance metrics tracking the quality, completeness, and financial impact of actuarial assumptions used in valuation and pricing. Supports assumption change management, peer review compliance, and profitability target monitoring.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `life_insurance_ecm`.`_metrics`.`actuarial_cash_flow_projection`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Cash flow projection metrics supporting asset-liability management, reserve adequacy testing, and profitability analysis. Covers premium inflows, benefit outflows, investment income, and duration/convexity risk metrics."
  source: "`life_insurance_ecm`.`actuarial`.`cash_flow_projection`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "valuation_date"
      expr: valuation_date
      comment: "Valuation date of the cash flow projection, the primary time anchor for ALM and reserve analysis."
    - name: "projection_date"
      expr: projection_date
      comment: "Future date to which cash flows are projected, enabling term structure analysis of liability cash flows."
    - name: "projection_period"
      expr: projection_period
      comment: "Projection period label (e.g., Year 1, Year 5, Year 10), used to analyze cash flow patterns over the policy lifecycle."
    - name: "projection_basis"
      expr: projection_basis
      comment: "Basis of projection (e.g., Best Estimate, Adverse, Stochastic), enabling scenario comparison for stress testing."
    - name: "scenario_type"
      expr: scenario_type
      comment: "Economic scenario type (e.g., Base, Stress, Tail), critical for ALM and capital adequacy analysis."
    - name: "product_segment_code"
      expr: product_segment_code
      comment: "Product segment driving the cash flows, enabling profitability and liability analysis by product line."
    - name: "cte_level"
      expr: cte_level
      comment: "Conditional Tail Expectation level (e.g., CTE70, CTE90) associated with the projection, used for PBR and capital reporting."
    - name: "model_version"
      expr: model_version
      comment: "Actuarial model version used for the projection, supporting model change impact analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "total_premium_inflow"
      expr: SUM(CAST(premium_inflow_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total projected premium inflows. Primary revenue driver in cash flow projections, used in profitability and ALM analysis."
    - name: "total_benefit_outflow"
      expr: SUM(CAST(benefit_outflow_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total projected benefit outflows (death benefits, surrenders, maturities). The largest liability cash flow component, critical for reserve adequacy and ALM."
    - name: "total_expense_outflow"
      expr: SUM(CAST(expense_outflow_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total projected expense outflows including maintenance and acquisition costs. Impacts profitability and pricing adequacy assessments."
    - name: "total_commission_outflow"
      expr: SUM(CAST(commission_outflow_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total projected commission outflows. Monitors distribution cost efficiency and its impact on product profitability."
    - name: "total_investment_income"
      expr: SUM(CAST(investment_income_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total projected investment income. Key asset-side cash flow supporting liability funding and spread income analysis."
    - name: "total_net_cash_flow"
      expr: SUM(CAST(net_cash_flow_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total net cash flow (inflows minus outflows) across all projection periods. The primary ALM metric indicating whether assets are sufficient to fund liabilities."
    - name: "total_present_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(present_value_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total present value of projected cash flows. The discounted liability measure used in reserve calculations and economic capital assessment."
    - name: "total_reserve_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reserve_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total reserve amount from cash flow projections. Validates reserve levels against projection-based estimates."
    - name: "total_reinsurance_ceded_premium"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reinsurance_ceded_premium_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total reinsurance premiums ceded in projections. Quantifies the cost of reinsurance protection and its impact on net cash flows."
    - name: "total_reinsurance_recoverable"
      expr: SUM(CAST(reinsurance_recoverable_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total projected reinsurance recoverables. Measures the benefit of reinsurance in offsetting projected benefit outflows."
    - name: "total_nar_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(nar_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total Net Amount at Risk (NAR) across projections. Measures mortality risk exposure net of account value, driving COI charges and reinsurance needs."
    - name: "total_risk_adjustment"
      expr: SUM(CAST(risk_adjustment_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total risk adjustment applied to projected cash flows. Required under IFRS17 to reflect uncertainty in non-financial risk, impacting reported profit."
    - name: "total_csm_balance"
      expr: SUM(CAST(csm_balance_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total Contractual Service Margin (CSM) balance from projections. The unearned profit liability under IFRS17, released to income as services are provided."
    - name: "avg_liability_duration"
      expr: AVG(CAST(liability_duration AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average liability duration across projections. Core ALM metric measuring interest rate sensitivity of liabilities; compared to asset duration to manage duration gap."
    - name: "avg_asset_duration"
      expr: AVG(CAST(asset_duration AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average asset duration across projections. Paired with liability duration to assess and manage the asset-liability duration gap."
    - name: "avg_duration_gap"
      expr: AVG(CAST(duration_gap AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average duration gap (asset duration minus liability duration). A positive gap indicates interest rate risk; monitored by the ALM committee to guide hedging strategy."
    - name: "avg_lapse_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(lapse_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average projected lapse rate across cash flow scenarios. Monitors policyholder behavior assumptions and their impact on liability run-off."
    - name: "avg_discount_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(discount_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average discount rate applied in cash flow projections. Tracks the interest rate environment's impact on present value of liabilities."
    - name: "projection_record_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of cash flow projection records. Used to validate projection completeness and coverage across policy cohorts and scenarios."
$$
metric_views.description: Cash flow projection metrics supporting asset-liability management, reserve adequacy testing, and profitability analysis. Covers premium inflows, benefit outflows, investment income, and duration/convexity risk metrics.
